title: Sensitive dependence of the motion of a legged robot on granular media
summary: Legged locomotion on flowing ground ({\em e.g.} granular media) is unlike locomotion on hard ground because feet experience both solid- and fluid-like forces during surface penetration. Recent bio-inspired legged robots display speed relative to body size on hard ground comparable to high performing organisms like cockroaches but suffer significant performance loss on flowing materials like sand. In laboratory experiments we study the performance (speed) of a small (2.3 kg) six-legged robot, SandBot, as it runs on a bed of granular media (1 mm poppy seeds). For an alternating tripod gait on the granular bed, standard gait control parameters achieve speeds at best two orders of magnitude smaller than the 2 body lengths/s ($\approx 60$ cm/s) for motion on hard ground. However, empirical adjustment of these control parameters away from the hard ground settings, restores good performance, yielding top speeds of 30 cm/s. Robot speed depends sensitively on the packing fraction $\phi$ and the limb frequency $\omega$, and a dramatic transition from rotary walking to slow swimming occurs when $\phi$ becomes small enough and/or $\omega$ large enough. We propose a kinematic model of the rotary walking mode based on generic features of penetration and slip of a curved limb in granular media. The model captures the dependence of robot speed on limb frequency and the transition between walking and swimming modes but highlights the need for a deeper understanding of the physics of granular media.

AI.tldr: 本文研究小型六足机器人SandBot在颗粒介质上的速度与步态参数关系，发现经验调整参数可将速度从近零提升至30 cm/s，并提出"旋转行走—慢速游泳"转变的运动学模型。
AI.motivation: 仿生腿式机器人在硬地上可达与蟑螂相当的相对体长速度，但在沙等流动介质上性能骤降。作者希望理解并改善腿式机器人在颗粒介质上的运动性能，并揭示其力学机制。
AI.method: 在1 mm罂粟籽颗粒床上进行实验，测量2.3 kg六足机器人SandBot以交替三角步态运动时的速度；扫描步态控制参数、颗粒堆积分数φ与腿频ω；基于弯曲腿在颗粒介质中侵入与滑移的通用特征，建立旋转行走模式运动学模型。
AI.result: 硬地标准步态参数在颗粒床上的速度比硬地约2 BL/s（≈60 cm/s）低两个数量级；经验调参后达到30 cm/s。速度对φ和ω高度敏感，φ减小和/或ω增大时出现从旋转行走向慢速游泳的突变。模型能复现速度对腿频的依赖及行走—游泳转变。
AI.conclusion: 腿式机器人在流动介质上的性能可通过对控制参数的经验再调优大幅恢复，旋转行走模式可由简化的运动学模型描述；足—颗粒相互作用的物理机制仍需深入研究。

title: V-JEPA 2 Meets AQA: Phase-Based Scoring and Reference-Based Feedback for Mountain Biking
summary: We study mountain-bike action quality assessment (AQA) with weak labels and candidate feedback. The training corpus comprises 95 field-recorded jump clips with binary labels denoting good or poor technique. These are coarse categorical labels, not continuous expert quality scores; phase-boundary and aspect-level annotations are unavailable. Our pipeline summarizes four heuristic phases using frozen V-JEPA 2 video features and two-dimensional pose and motion measurements. A small transformer predicts a binary-label score. A separate reference layer compares phase-specific measurements with those of clips labelled as good technique to propose phase, body-parameter, and direction cues. We detail the measurements, network, and evaluation so that the limits of each output are explicit. In five-fold clip-level cross-validation, the full scorer obtained pooled out-of-fold AUROC 0.768 and average precision 0.812. These are exploratory figures because the reporting fold also selected the neural training epoch and riders were not separated between folds. Removing biomechanical scoring inputs raised AUROC to 0.809. A separate inner-selection run obtained AUROC 0.678, but used about 57 rather than 76 training clips per outer fold, so its difference from the test-selected run does not quantify selection bias. The unsupervised aspect head did not learn distinct factors. On a 17-clip external probe, an earlier checkpoint obtained binary accuracy 0.412 and Spearman association -0.135 with expert scores. Candidate cues had precision 0.118 and recall 1.0 against each of two coaches, with substantial disagreement about direction. These findings do not establish rider-independent scoring or reliable corrective feedback; they identify the empirical work needed to evaluate either use.

AI.tldr: 弱标签山地车速降跳跃动作质量评估(AQA)探索性研究：用冻结V-JEPA 2特征+2D姿态/运动测量+小型Transformer预测二分类标签，AUROC 0.768(存在折内选epoch、未按骑手划分等泄漏)，内部选择偏差校正后仅0.678，外部17片段探针准确率0.412、与专家分Spearman为-0.135，候选纠正提示精确率0.118。
AI.motivation: 真实运动场景缺乏连续专家评分与阶段性/维度级标注，只有粗粒度二分类"技术好/差"标签；作者希望在弱监督、候选反馈(candidate feedback)设定下探索AQA能力的边界，并显式披露每个输出环节的可靠性局限。
AI.method: 95段现场拍摄跳跃片段；用冻结V-JEPA 2视频特征与2D姿态、运动量测归纳四个启发式阶段；小型Transformer输出二分类分数；独立参考层将阶段特化量测与"好技术"片段比对，生成阶段/身体参数/方向三类候选提示；五折片段级交叉验证，并做移除生物力学输入的消融、内层选择跑、17片段外部探针及两位教练的人工评测。
AI.result: 全模型OOF AUROC 0.768、AP 0.812；移除生物力学评分输入后AUROC升至0.809；内层选择跑AUROC 0.678(每外折约57而非76个训练片段，差异不构成选择偏差量化)；无监督方面头未学到可分离因子；外部探针二分类准确率0.412、Spearman -0.135；候选提示对两位教练精确率0.118、召回1.0，方向判断分歧明显。
AI.conclusion: 结果既不能支持与骑手无关的评分，也不能支持可靠纠正反馈；论文定位为诚实的负向/边界性实证，指出若要评估这两类用途所需的后续实验(骑手划分、嵌套选择、扩大外部评测)。

title: Alpha: Systematic Fault Injection and Robustness Evaluation for LLM-Driven Embodied Manipulation
comment: 9 pages, 7 figures, 6 tables. Code and reproduction artifacts: this https URL
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly integrated into embodied robotic planning, yet standard benchmarks primarily evaluate end-to-end task completion in nominal environments, obscuring failure origins across the execution stack. We present Alpha, a systematic fault-injection and robustness-evaluation framework for LLM-driven manipulation in simulation. Alpha injects calibrated faults across perception (sensor lag), actuation (grip slip), kinematics (unreachable targets), and planning (planner-output corruption), alongside concurrent conditions. To separate physical vulnerabilities from planner sensitivities, we introduce a matched methodology pairing an LLM agent (Llama-3 via Ollama) against a deterministic Scripted Oracle planner across a balanced 150-episode matrix under identical seeds, geometries, and safety criteria. Across the matrix, the Oracle achieves 64.0% (48/75) success while the LLM achieves 44.0% (33/75) (paired McNemar p = 3.01 x 10^-4). Crucially, excluding planner-output corruption, performance across all physical and kinematic conditions is identical: 55.0% (33/60) for both planners with zero discordant pairs (McNemar p = 1.00). This demonstrates that physical actuator slip, kinematic reach boundaries, and perceptual staleness affect deterministic controllers and LLM planners equivalently. The performance gap is driven entirely by planner-output corruption (100% Oracle vs. 0% LLM), isolating the prompt-to-JSON serialization and validation interface rather than a cognitive reasoning deficit. We also audit 169 historical pilot attempts for transparency.

AI.tldr: Alpha：面向LLM驱动机器人操作的仿真故障注入与鲁棒性评测框架，通过"脚本化Oracle vs LLM规划器"配对实验定位失效来源，发现性能差距并非源于物理鲁棒性而是提示到JSON序列化/校验接口。
AI.motivation: 现有具身LLM基准只评测端到端任务成功率，掩盖了执行栈中各层失效来源；需要区分"物理脆弱性"与"规划器敏感性"，把LLM的失败归因到具体环节而非笼统的"推理能力不足"。
AI.method: 在仿真中构建故障注入矩阵：感知（传感器时延）、驱动（夹爪滑移）、运动学（不可达目标）、规划（规划器输出损坏）及并发条件；采用匹配实验设计，将Llama-3（经Ollama）智能体与确定性Scripted Oracle规划器在同一随机种子、几何与安全准则下配对，共150个平衡回合；用配对的McNemar检验做统计推断，并公开审计169次历史试跑。
AI.result: 整体成功率Oracle 64.0%(48/75) vs LLM 44.0%(33/75)，McNemar p=3.01e-4显著；但剔除规划输出损坏后两者完全一致，均为55.0%(33/60)，零不一致对(p=1.00)。差异100%来自规划器输出损坏（Oracle 100% vs LLM 0%）。
AI.conclusion: 物理滑移、运动学可达边界与感知时延对确定性控制器和LLM规划器的影响等效；LLM差距应归因于提示到JSON的序列化与校验接口工程，而非认知推理缺陷——提示LLM机器人基准应做接口鲁棒性与分层归因评测。

title: EgoHand: Monocular 3D Hand Reconstruction from Egocentric Video
comment: Authors are listed alphabetically. Project leads are Chao-Yeh Chen, Tiffany Chen, and Umar Iqbal
summary: We introduce EgoHand, a monocular 3D hand reconstruction model that achieves state-of-the-art performance on egocentric video. Central to our approach is the curation of a high-quality training corpus of 14 million images, combining synthetic data, in-the-wild video, and multi-camera motion capture to balance scene diversity and supervision quality. The model adopts SOMA-Hand as its parametric representation and processes 2D hand crops with a transformer encoder, incorporating camera cues and an auxiliary 2D branch to improve geometric consistency and image alignment. Zero-shot evaluations on HOT3D, ARCTIC, and H2O demonstrate strong out-of-domain generalization, with lower joint-position, root-translation, and acceleration errors than competing baselines at an inference latency of approximately 9.69 ms. A blinded user preference study further shows that participants favor EgoHand's reconstructed hand poses over those from Apple EgoDex and Ropedia Xperience-10M. We release the EgoHand model and source code under the OpenMDW license, allowing free commercial use of the model.

AI.tldr: EgoHand：面向第一人称视频的单目3D手部重建模型，基于1400万张图像训练语料、SOMA-Hand参数化表示、Transformer编码器并用相机线索与辅助2D分支提升几何一致性；在HOT3D/ARCTIC/H2O零样本评测中误差最低，推理约9.69 ms，并开源可商用。
AI.motivation: 第一人称（egocentric）视角下相机运动大、手部尺度变化剧烈、遮挡严重，现有单目3D手部重建方法在域外场景泛化差；同时缺少兼有场景多样性与高质量监督标注的大规模训练语料。
AI.method: 构建约1400万张图像的训练语料（合成数据+互联网视频+多相机动捕），采用SOMA-Hand参数化表示；以Transformer编码器处理2D手部裁剪，并引入相机线索（camera cues）与辅助2D分支以增强几何一致性与图像对齐。
AI.result: 在HOT3D、ARCTIC、H2O上的零样本评测显示域外泛化强，关节位置、根节点平移与加速度误差均低于基线，推理延迟约9.69 ms；盲测用户偏好研究中，受试者更偏好EgoHand的重建姿态而非Apple EgoDex与Ropedia Xperience-10M；模型与源码以OpenMDW许可开源，允许免费商用。
AI.conclusion: 通过大规模混合数据策划+参数化表示+相机与2D辅助监督的简洁设计，EgoHand在第一人称单目手部重建上取得SOTA与实时性能，并开源可商用，可作为第一人称手—物交互与机器人示教数据采集的基础感知组件；但本文聚焦手部重建，未涉及物体接触或交互建模。

title: TerraTransfer++: Demonstration-Free End-to-End Planner
summary: End-to-end autonomous driving has achieved state-of-the-art performance on benchmarks and real-world deployments. Its standard training recipe, however, is expensive across all existing paradigms: imitation learning requires fleet-scale driving logs whose behavior distribution only thinly covers the safety-critical tail; closed-loop reinforcement learning in a photorealistic simulator, while offering diverse behaviors, is bottlenecked by sample-efficiency, per-step cost of rendering, and a forward pass through a large vision backbone. Self-play in vectorized simulators changes the economics: at millions of rollout steps per second, one can obtain a state distribution with natural diversity in collisions, near-misses, and recoveries that no driving log contains, and a highly reactive policy emerges from a basic driving-quality reward. Our approach exploits this asymmetry. We pretrain a single policy by self-play, distill its rollouts into a flow-matching trajectory teacher that also plans, and train lightweight adapters on a frozen pretrained vision backbone to reproduce the latent space of either teacher through the action KL divergence, a batch-relational low-rank structural loss, and, for the planner, a trajectory-matching loss. Every target traces back to the self-play policy, so alignment never supervises against a logged trajectory: a paired dataset of (image, scene-state) frames suffices, with no need for the curated expert demonstrations that imitation pretraining is built on. From this one self-play teacher we obtain two end-to-end students: a closed-loop policy that outperforms every published imitation-based end-to-end method on the photorealistic 3D Gaussian splatting closed-loop benchmark HUGSim, and a planner that reaches 59.4 EPDMS on NAVSIM navhard, above every published method including DriveZero-Scale (57.1), and 95.5 PDMS on navtest, without human demonstrations.

AI.tldr: 用向量化仿真器自博弈预训练单一策略，再蒸馏为流匹配轨迹教师，并通过冻结视觉主干上的轻量适配器训练两个端到端学生（闭环策略与规划器），无需人工驾驶示范即可在 HUGSim 与 NAVSIM 上超越已发表方法。
AI.motivation: 端到端自动驾驶现有训练范式代价高昂：模仿学习依赖车队级驾驶日志，行为分布对安全关键尾部覆盖稀疏；光真实感仿真器中的闭环强化学习受样本效率、渲染单步开销和大型视觉主干前向计算限制。作者希望利用向量化自博弈（每秒百万级 rollout 步）获得包含碰撞、近失与恢复等自然多样性的状态分布，并摆脱对精标专家示范的依赖。
AI.method: 1) 在向量化仿真器中进行自博弈，用基本驾驶质量奖励预训练单一高反应性策略；2) 将其 rollout 蒸馏为同时具备规划能力的流匹配（flow-matching）轨迹教师；3) 在冻结的预训练视觉主干上训练轻量适配器，通过三项损失复现教师潜空间：基于动作 KL 散度、批内关系型低秩结构损失、以及规划器的轨迹匹配损失；4) 所有监督目标均回溯到自博弈策略，仅需（图像，场景状态）配对帧数据集，无需专家轨迹。
AI.result: 从同一自博弈教师得到两个端到端学生：闭环策略在光真实感 3D 高斯泼溅闭环基准 HUGSim 上优于所有已发表模仿学习端到端方法；规划器在 NAVSIM navhard 上取得 59.4 EPDMS，超过包括 DriveZero-Scale（57.1）在内的所有已发表方法，在 navtest 上取得 95.5 PDMS，且全程未使用人类示范。
AI.conclusion: 该工作证明向量化自博弈可替代驾驶日志作为端到端自动驾驶的监督源，通过“自博弈策略→流匹配教师→冻结主干+适配器学生”的单向蒸馏链路，在无需专家示范条件下达到闭环与开环规划基准的领先性能，为端到端自动驾驶提供了低成本、可扩展的训练范式。

title: Self-Distilling Future Video Representations for World Action Models
comment: 27 pages; Project page: this https URL
summary: World Action Models (WAMs) have emerged as a promising approach to learning generalist robot policies using rich spatiotemporal priors from pre-trained video diffusion models. A recent line of WAMs improves inference efficiency by conditioning a separate action decoder on intermediate future video representations extracted from a single denoising step, avoiding costly iterative denoising required for video generation. This design makes action prediction depend directly on the quality of these future representations. In this paper, we introduce Future REpresentation learning via self-Distillation with temporal context (FRED), a framework that trains WAMs to improve the quality of future video representations from noise in a single denoising step. Specifically, FRED uses self-distillation to predict future representations from noise, using representations extracted from ground-truth future observations as targets. We further condition the video model on historical observations, providing temporal context for predicting future representations better. Across diverse real-world manipulation scenarios, FRED consistently outperforms competing WAMs. It achieves particularly large gains on long-horizon and out-of-domain tasks under zero-shot environment generalization, and substantially improves human-to-robot skill transfer, reaching 50.0% task success on tasks absent from robot training data and demonstrated only in human videos, compared with 19.4% for the best competing WAM.

AI.tldr: FRED：用带时序上下文的自蒸馏训练 WAM，使单步去噪即可从噪声预测高质量未来视频表征，显著提升长程/分布外操作与人到机器人技能迁移。
AI.motivation: 现有 WAM 让动作解码器仅依赖单步去噪得到的中间未来视频表征以提升推理效率，因此动作预测质量直接受限于该单步表征质量（从纯噪声出发、缺少历史信息），而迭代去噪代价过高。
AI.method: 提出 FRED 框架：(1) 自蒸馏——以真实未来观测提取的表征为目标，训练模型从噪声出发单步预测未来表征；(2) 将历史观测作为时序上下文条件注入视频模型，改善单步未来表征预测。
AI.result: 在多种真实机器人操作场景中稳定优于对比 WAM；在零样本环境泛化的长程与分布外任务上增益最大；人到机器人技能迁移达 50.0% 成功率（仅人类视频演示、无机器人训练数据），对比最佳 WAM 为 19.4%。
AI.conclusion: 将表征学习目标（自蒸馏+时序上下文）显式引入 WAM 的单步未来表征，是提升推理效率与泛化/迁移能力的有效途径，并验证了人类视频到机器人策略的可行性。

title: R4DGS: Referring Segmentation in 4D Gaussian Splatting
comment: 10 pages. Accepted at ACM Multimedia 2026. Project page: this https URL
summary: Dynamic representations based on 4D Gaussian Splatting (4DGS) have shown strong capabilities in reconstruction and rendering, yet current methods remain limited in supporting complex natural-language referring in dynamic scenes. Existing 4D Gaussian methods are primarily designed for rendering-oriented dynamic modeling, while current semantic extensions often rely on scene-specific semantic optimization or are evaluated on relatively simple query settings. In this paper, we study Referring 4D Gaussian Splatting (R4DGS), a task for grounding temporally varying, multi-target or reasoning-intensive, and zero-target or distractor expressions in dynamic 4D scenes. To support this task, we introduce R4D-Bench-QA, a benchmark with structured query annotations. We further present ReferGaussian, a unified framework built upon 4DGS that converts low-level dynamic Gaussians into persistent, language-addressable entities for training-free referring inference. ReferGaussian organizes mask-supported Gaussian entities in an EntityBank, uses Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) to decompose complex queries into trackable object phrases and structured referring constraints, and performs constraint-aware grounding without scene-specific semantic optimization. Experiments on R4D-Bench-QA and the 4D LangSplat protocol demonstrate improved temporal target selection and competitive spatiotemporal grounding without scene-specific semantic training. Project resources are available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Referring 4D Gaussian Splatting (R4DGS) 任务与 R4D-Bench-QA 基准，并给出 ReferGaussian 免训练框架，将 4DGS 低层高斯组织为语言可寻址实体，借助 MLLM 分解复杂指令并做约束感知的时空指代定位。
AI.motivation: 现有 4DGS 方法偏渲染导向，语义扩展多依赖场景特定语义优化，且测试查询过于简单；缺乏对动态场景中时序变化、多目标、推理型及零目标/干扰型自然语言指代的支持。
AI.method: 基于 mask 支撑的高斯构成 EntityBank，形成持久化语言可寻址实体；利用 MLLM 将复杂查询分解为可跟踪的物体短语与结构化指代约束；在无需场景特定语义优化的条件下执行约束感知的 4D 定位。
AI.result: 在 R4D-Bench-QA 与 4D LangSplat 协议上，时序目标选择能力提升，时空定位性能具竞争力，且无需场景特定语义训练。
AI.conclusion: 提出 R4DGS 新任务与结构化基准，并以免训练、实体化的 MLLM 驱动框架验证了动态 4D 场景中复杂语言指代的可行性。

title: MPBRS: Multi-Potential-Based Reward Shaping for Unified Reward Configuration in Humanoid Locomotion
summary: Designing and tuning reward functions remains one of the main challenges in building effective reinforcement learning (RL) pipelines for humanoid locomotion. While shaping rewards can accelerate learning, naively formulated terms often conflict with the desired behavior, overfit to a specific robot, or become unstable under small weight changes. Potential-Based Reward Shaping (PBRS) offers an alternative solution: shaping the reward via differences of a potential function to guide exploration without changing the optimal policy. In this paper, we study Multi-PBRS for humanoid locomotion and propose a unified reward configuration. We then evaluate the same reward structure and weights across nine humanoid robots, requiring only robot-specific metadata (joint/link mappings and default poses) rather than per-robot reward redesign. Our experiments show that, compared to standard shaping, MPBRS provides more consistent scaling behavior and reduced tuning sensitivity across robots, making it easier to tune without altering the optimal policy.

AI.tldr: 提出面向人形机器人行走的统一 Multi-PBRS（多势函数奖励塑形）奖励配置，仅需关节/连杆映射与默认姿态等元数据即可跨九种人形机器人复用同一奖励结构与权重。
AI.motivation: 人形机器人 RL 中奖励设计是主要瓶颈：普通 reward shaping 易与目标行为冲突、过拟合特定机器人、对权重变化敏感；PBRS 虽不改变最优策略，但缺乏可跨平台复用的统一配置。
AI.method: 采用基于势函数差分的 PBRS 框架并推广为 Multi-PBRS（多个势函数项的线性组合），设计一套统一奖励结构；跨九个人形平台仅替换机器人特定元数据（关节/连杆映射、默认姿态），无需逐机器人重新设计奖励。实验对比标准 shaping 与 MPBRS 的缩放行为与权重敏感性。
AI.result: 与标准奖励塑形相比，MPBRS 在不同机器人间表现出更一致的奖励尺度与更低的调参敏感性，且理论上不改变最优策略，因此调参更易迁移。
AI.conclusion: Multi-PBRS 为多平台人形行走提供了一种可复用的统一奖励范式，降低逐机器人奖励工程成本；未来可自然扩展至其他运动技能与更多本体。

title: MoRE: Motion-Regularized Encoding for Articulated 3D Generation
summary: Generating an articulated object from a single image requires recovering both its appearance and the mechanism governing its parts. A compact encoding of joint attributes does not by itself ensure that reconstruction preserves the resulting motion. We present MoRE, Motion-Regularized Encoding for articulated 3D generation. MoRE represents coordinate-aligned joint lines with axis classification and two axis-orthogonal Plücker moment coefficients, removing the arbitrary choice of an origin along the axis. During representation learning, decoded joint hypotheses are used to move corresponding three-dimensional anchors, and their motions are compared with those of annotated joints. A differentiable expectation over joint types and axis directions couples attribute reconstruction to the motion it induces. An image-conditioned flow learns the resulting functional latents, while a multi-state-adapted Gaussian model supplies appearance. At inference, recovered part assignments and joints articulate a single set of rest-pose Gaussians without regenerating the object for each state. Experiments on PartNet-Mobility and ACD show stronger part-box agreement, articulated-state geometry and visual similarity than the compared baselines, while joint prediction reduces axis, origin and range errors relative to ArtiLatent. Controlled ablations support the joint-line encoding and show that motion supervision reduces anchor-motion error. Code and pretrained checkpoints will be released in the future.

AI.tldr: MoRE 用"运动正则化"的关节线编码提升单图关节物体 3D 生成：以坐标对齐关节线+轴分类+两个轴正交 Plücker 矩系数表示关节，并用解码关节驱动 3D 锚点、与标注关节运动对齐做监督。
AI.motivation: 单图生成关节物体需同时恢复外观与部件运动机制；紧凑的关节属性编码并不能保证重建结果在被驱动时保持正确运动，属性重建与运动效果之间存在脱节。
AI.method: 提出 MoRE：关节用坐标对齐关节线表示，含轴类型分类与两个轴正交 Plücker 矩系数，消除轴上原点任意性；表示学习时用解码的关节假设移动对应 3D 锚点，并与真实标注关节引起的运动比较；对关节类型与轴方向做可微期望，将属性重建与诱导运动耦合；图像条件 flow 学习功能潜变量，多状态自适应高斯模型负责外观；推理时用恢复的部件分配与关节直接驱动单一 rest-pose 高斯集合，无需逐状态重新生成。
AI.result: 在 PartNet-Mobility 与 ACD 上，部件包围盒一致性、关节态几何与视觉相似度均优于对比基线；相比 ArtiLatent 降低轴、原点与关节范围误差；消融实验支持关节线编码有效性，并表明运动监督降低锚点运动误差。代码与权重后续开源。
AI.conclusion: 将关节表示与可微运动监督耦合，可在单图输入下生成可正确驱动的关节物体，并支持单一 rest-pose 高斯的运动学驱动渲染。

title: Foundation4D: Towards a unified perception and reconstruction model for autonomous vehicles
summary: We introduce Foundation4D, a unified feed-forward model for geometry estimation, 3D detection, semantic occupancy, and Gaussian reconstruction from multi-camera driving video. A shared backbone uses factorized spatiotemporal attention to efficiently combine observations across cameras and time. Our video inference pipeline uses pose graph optimization to refine camera trajectories and assembles object tracks across input windows. We also develop a data annotation pipeline and release PAI-Foundation4D, a benchmark with dense depth and semantic occupancy labels for 1,253 driving clips. With benchmark-specific fine-tuning, Foundation4D achieves the lowest depth AbsRel on Waymo and nuScenes, the highest detection mAP on nuScenes, and the highest occupancy mIoU on OpenOccupancy among the compared methods. Our task-combination study shows benefits for both detection and geometry: co-training detection with geometry and occupancy improves top-class mAP by 1.2 points over detection-only training, while co-training geometry with detection reduces camera-to-rig translation error by $13.4\%$ relative to geometry-only training. We further use the predicted geometry and trajectories as priors for lidarless NuRec, supporting reconstruction of driving scenes for simulation.

AI.tldr: Foundation4D: 统一前馈模型，从多相机行车视频同时做几何估计、3D检测、语义占用与高斯重建，并提出PAI-Foundation4D标注基准。
AI.motivation: 现有驾驶场景感知任务（深度、检测、占用、重建）多为分离模型；作者希望用单一共享主干实现多任务统一推理，并验证任务间协同增益，同时为无激光雷达仿真重建提供先验。
AI.method: 共享骨干使用分解式时空注意力（factorized spatiotemporal attention）融合跨相机与跨时间观测；视频推理管线采用位姿图优化（PGO）精修相机轨迹，并跨输入窗口组装目标轨迹；此外构建数据标注流水线，发布含稠密深度与语义占用标签的PAI-Foundation4D基准（1,253段驾驶片段）。
AI.result: 经基准特定微调后，在Waymo与nuScenes上取得最低深度AbsRel，nuScenes检测mAP最高，OpenOccupancy占用mIoU最高。任务组合研究：检测+几何+占用联合训练较仅检测提升top-class mAP 1.2；几何+检测联合训练较仅几何使相机-车体平移误差降低13.4%。预测几何与轨迹作为无激光雷达NuRec先验，支持驾驶场景重建用于仿真。
AI.conclusion: 统一前馈多任务架构在驾驶几何感知与重建上可行且具协同效应，可作为仿真数据构建的几何先验；但仍依赖各基准单独微调，跨域统一泛化性有待验证。

title: FiLM-CAM: Keyed Feature Modulation for Conditional-Access Watermarking
summary: We propose FiLM-CAM; a conditional-access image watermarking approach that enforces authorized encoding, decoding, and removal through keyed feature modulation. A secret key conditions a Feature-wise Linear Modulation (FiLM) mechanism that transforms the internal representation of the watermark signal before embedding, thereby coupling the payload to the key at the feature, rather than pixel level. The same key must be presented to condition the decoder to correctly recover the payload embedded in an image. To enforce conditional access, we train the system to maximize the performance gap between authorized and unauthorized use, ensuring reliable extraction under the correct key while inducing failure under incorrect keys. In addition, we design our encoder to estimate the watermark residual invariant to the presence of pre-existing watermarks. This design enables conditional watermark removal via simple re-encoding and subtraction of the residual using iterative refinement, contingent on knowledge of the secret key. We evaluate FiLM-CAM across multiple watermarking encoder-decoder backbones, demonstrating that keyed feature modulation serves as an effective, architecture-agnostic conditional access module (CAM) for image watermarking.

AI.tldr: FiLM-CAM: 用密钥驱动的 Feature-wise Linear Modulation 对水印信号做特征级条件调制，使编解码与移除均受密钥控制，并通过最大化授权/未授权性能差距来强制访问控制。
AI.motivation: 现有图像水印缺乏密钥级的访问控制：水印在像素层面对任何持有模型的人都可提取或移除，难以实现"仅授权方可编码/解码/去除"的条件访问。作者希望把载荷与密钥在特征层面耦合，并同时支持基于密钥的条件性水印去除。
AI.method: 1) 以秘密密钥条件化 FiLM 层，在嵌入前变换水印信号的内部表示，实现特征级（而非像素级）绑定的条件访问模块，架构无关；2) 训练目标为最大化正确密钥与错误密钥下的性能差距，保证正确密钥可靠提取、错误密钥失效；3) 编码器估计对已有水印鲁棒的残差，从而通过迭代细化"重新编码—相减残差"实现密钥条件下的水印去除；4) 在多种编解码 backbone 上验证。
AI.result: 在多个水印编解码 backbone 上，密钥化特征调制均能作为有效的条件访问模块，正确密钥下可靠提取、错误密钥下显著失败，并支持条件化去除；但摘要未给出定量指标（bit accuracy、PSNR/SSIM、跨 backbone 的具体差距数值）。
AI.conclusion: 将访问控制从像素域提升到特征域是一个思路清晰的密钥耦合机制，去除与嵌入共享同一残差估计设计也较自洽。不过工作本质是图像水印/安全方向，与 Physical AI、VLA、世界模型、3D 重建等核心领域无直接关联，仅可作为工具性参考。

title: Latent Space Jam: Layout Guided Video Synthesis
summary: Adding control to video generation often requires training, which demands additional computational resources, data, or architectural changes. We propose a training-free approach that utilizes pretrained video diffusion models to control object layout and motion using coarse layouts. Our method operates in two passes: first, it steers spatiotemporal placement through prompt-guided cross-attention to produce a coarse visual guide; second, this guide conditions the same model to generate a high-quality, layoutconsistent video. The approach enables coordinated motion with strong temporal consistency, supporting diverse trajectories and object interactions without additional training. Extensive experiments show that our method consistently outperforms prior work in overlap and trajectory accuracy, as well as visual quality across static, dynamic, and multi-object scene settings.

AI.tldr: 训练免费的视频扩散模型两阶段控制方法:先用提示引导的cross-attention生成粗略时空布局引导,再用该引导条件同一模型生成布局一致的高质量视频。
AI.motivation: 给视频生成加入布局/运动控制通常需要额外训练(额外算力、数据或改架构),作者希望零训练实现可控视频生成。
AI.method: 两阶段无训练流程:Pass 1 通过prompt引导的cross-attention steering实现对象时空定位,得到粗视觉引导; Pass 2 用该引导条件化同一预训练视频扩散模型,生成布局一致的高质量视频,支持多轨迹与对象交互。
AI.result: 在静态、动态和多对象场景下,重叠度、轨迹精度与视觉质量均优于先前工作,并保持较强时间一致性。
AI.conclusion: 无需额外训练即可用粗布局控制视频生成中的对象布局与运动,可作为通用可控视频生成前置工具。

title: VisCurate: Evaluating Behavioral Equivalence of Visual Skills
comment: Accepted at the IEEE/CVF Winter Conference on Applications of Computer Vision (WACV 2027), Main Conference
summary: Modern vision-based agents have shifted toward skill-based problem-solving, where a skill is an executable image-to-image operation, e.g., cropping, thresholding, or edge detection. As these skill libraries grow, they accumulate duplicated, mislabeled, and defective skills. The signals normally used to curate them (a skill's name, description, or source code) say little about how the skill visually changes the image. We present VisCurate, a framework and benchmark that curates visual skill libraries from observed execution rather than from text. VisCurate runs each candidate skill pair on a shared probe battery and assigns one of six behavioral relations, each tied to a library edit that is safe to make. The benchmark injects seven defect types into a clean library at controlled rates, producing 300 reproducible instances with ground-truth relations and repairs. While text baselines accept up to five of six false merges on hard negatives, our verifier accepts none and recovers 51.2% of the pairs that are truly mergeable. On two real, uncurated libraries, VisCurate finds that 92% of the skills a package shares with its downstream copy are redundant, while execution confirms only 10 of 17 published equivalence claims. The curation problem also remains open, as the strongest of the nine automated curators recovers only about half of the repairs. We emphasize that visual skill libraries should be curated by behavior, not by description.

AI.tldr: VisCurate提出以"执行行为"而非文本描述来治理视觉技能库：在统一探针集上两两执行技能，判定六种行为关系并映射为安全的库编辑操作，同时构建含7类缺陷、300个实例的基准。
AI.motivation: 视觉智能体的技能库规模扩大后积累了大量重复、错标与缺陷技能，而技能名称、描述、源码等文本信号几乎无法反映技能对图像的视觉改造效果，因此需要以可观测执行结果为依据的治理范式。
AI.method: VisCurate框架与基准：将候选技能对在共享探针图像批次上执行，依据输出图像的视觉变化判定六种行为关系，每类关系对应一种可安全执行的库编辑（如合并、重标、删除）；基准在干净库中按受控比例注入七类缺陷，生成300个可复现实例，附真值关系与修复标注。
AI.result: 文本基线在困难负样本上最多产生六类误合并中的五类，而行为验证器零误合并，并召回51.2%真正可合并的技能对；在两个真实未治理库上，包与其下游副本共享技能中92%为冗余，17条已发表等价声明仅10条经执行证实；九个自动治理器中最佳者仅恢复约一半修复，问题仍开放。
AI.conclusion: 视觉技能库应基于行为而非描述进行治理；执行级验证在误合并控制上显著优于文本信号，但完整自动治理仍是开放难题。

title: Integrated Longitudinal and Lateral Control for High-Speed Platooning of Articulated Vehicles
comment: Original manuscript of an article published in Vehicle System Dynamics on September 20, 2026. Published version: this https URL
summary: This paper presents an integrated control framework for high-speed platooning of articulated vehicles, combining advanced longitudinal and lateral control strategies to address the challenges of safe and efficient autonomous driving. A novel proof of string stability for the proposed longitudinal control algorithm, based on a PID framework, ensures robust inter-vehicle distance regulation even under dynamic operating conditions. Additionally, an arc-length-based longitudinal error formulation enhances the applicability of the control system for curved roads, making it realistic for diverse driving scenarios. For lateral control, significant improvements to the clothoid-based path tracking algorithm are introduced to mitigate oscillations and enhance stability at high speeds. These enhancements include a tangential criterion for oscillation reduction, trajectory segment classification for adaptive lookahead distance tuning, a dual-adaptive mechanism for regulating the rate of lookahead distance adjustments based on both cross-track error (CTE) and anticipated road curvature, and extensions for articulated vehicle dynamics. The proposed integrated control framework is validated through simulations, demonstrating its effectiveness in maintaining stability, minimizing tracking errors, and ensuring robust performance in high-speed and challenging platooning scenarios.

AI.tldr: 提出面向铰接式车辆高速队列行驶的纵横向集成控制框架：纵向采用基于PID的算法并给出队列稳定性（string stability）证明，引入弧长纵向误差以适应弯道；横向改进clothoid路径跟踪算法以抑制高速振荡。
AI.motivation: 铰接车辆高速队列在动态工况与弯道场景下面临车间距调节与高速横向振荡的双重挑战，现有纵向控制缺乏严格的队列稳定性保证，clothoid路径跟踪在高速下易振荡且未考虑铰接动力学。
AI.method: 纵向：PID框架下提出新的队列稳定性证明，并用弧长参数化纵向误差以适配曲线道路；横向：在clothoid路径跟踪上引入切向判据抑制振荡、轨迹段分类以自适应调节前视距离、基于CTE与预判道路曲率的双重自适应前视距离调整速率机制，并扩展到铰接车辆动力学模型。
AI.result: 仿真验证：在高速度和挑战性队列场景下保持队列稳定性、减小跟踪误差并具备鲁棒性；但未提供实车或硬件在环验证。
AI.conclusion: 该集成框架在仿真层面有效解决了铰接车辆高速队列的纵向间距与横向跟踪问题，具备可推广到弯道与动态工况的潜力；后续需实车验证与更强理论保证（如考虑执行器延迟与通信约束）。

title: Tactile-Based Robotic Manipulation: From Mechanics-Driven to Data-Driven Perspectives
comment: 30 pages. Author accepted manuscript. Posted with permission from the Annual Review of Control, Robotics, and Autonomous Systems, Volume 10; copyright 2027 the author(s), this https URL . Published version: this https URL
summary: Tactile sensing provides robots with direct access to physical interactions at the contact interface, making it a critical modality for robust and dexterous manipulation. Over the past several decades, tactile-based manipulation research has evolved from mechanics-driven approaches, which explicitly interpret tactile signals through contact mechanics and task-specific reasoning, to data-driven approaches that learn tactile representations and manipulation policies directly from data. This paper reviews the development of tactile-based manipulation from these two complementary perspectives. We first introduce the fundamentals of tactile sensing, and then review, from a mechanics-driven perspective, how those signals form manipulation-relevant state representations and subsequently influence the robot action. We then examine the recent advances in data-driven tactile manipulation, covering imitation learning, reinforcement learning, vision-language-action models, and predictive models. Finally, we discuss open challenges and future opportunities toward scalable, generalizable, and robust tactile-enabled robotic systems.

AI.tldr: 综述：从力学驱动与数据驱动两条路线梳理触觉感知驱动的机器人操作，涵盖触觉信号到操作状态表征与动作的映射、模仿学习/强化学习/VLA/预测模型，并展望可扩展、可泛化、鲁棒触觉系统。
AI.motivation: 触觉是接触界面上直接获取物理交互信息的模态，对鲁棒灵巧操作至关重要；但该领域研究范式经历了从接触力学显式建模到数据驱动表征学习的转变，缺乏横跨两条思路的系统梳理，需厘清信号—状态—动作的链路与未来方向。
AI.method: 综述性工作：先介绍触觉传感基础（传感原理与信号特性），再从力学驱动视角分析触觉信号如何构成与操作相关的状态表征并影响机器人动作；随后从数据驱动视角梳理模仿学习、强化学习、视觉—语言—动作模型与预测模型的最新进展；最后讨论开放挑战与机遇。
AI.result: 本文为综述与展望，未提出新方法或定量实验；主要产出为两条互补视角的分类框架、领域演进脉络的归纳，以及面向可扩展、可泛化、鲁棒触觉操作系统的开放问题清单。
AI.conclusion: 触觉操作研究正从力学驱动与数据驱动并行走向融合（力学先验与大规模学习结合），未来关键在于触觉表征的可迁移性、跨传感器与跨实体泛化、多模态融合以及真实世界规模化数据与评测体系。

title: Integrated Respiratory Sensing and Gated Control for Autonomous Needle Insertion Via CT Bore Robotic Arm
summary: Currently, CT-guided lung biopsy is a highly manual procedure requiring patient breath-holding, iterative manual needle insertions, and repeated CT confirmation scans to accurately target a tumor. Automating this process within the CT bore--without relying on manual needle placement or patient breath-holding--has the potential to reduce procedure time, patient discomfort, and radiation exposure. In this work, we present an integrated sensing and control system capable of performing a gated needle insertion within the CT bore. The experiments demonstrate the system's ability to track and predict patient breath cycles, perform autonomous respiratory-gated needle insertion, and detect breath cycle anomalies.

AI.tldr: 提出一套集成感知与控制系统，在CT孔径内实现呼吸门控的自主经皮肺穿刺进针：可跟踪并预测患者呼吸周期、自主完成门控进针，并检测呼吸周期异常。
AI.motivation: CT引导肺活检高度依赖人工：需患者屏气、反复手动进针、多次CT确认扫描，导致手术时间长、患者不适与辐射暴露大。作者希望在CT机架内无需手动置针与屏气即可自动化整个流程。
AI.method: 构建"感知+控制"一体化系统：对呼吸信号进行实时跟踪与周期预测，据此判断门控窗口，驱动针具执行机构在呼吸稳定窗口内自主进针，并在线检测呼吸节律异常以触发安全处理。
AI.result: 实验表明系统能够跟踪与预测呼吸周期、执行自主呼吸门控进针，并识别呼吸周期异常；摘要未给出靶点误差、成功率等定量指标。
AI.conclusion: 该工作验证了CT孔径内呼吸门控自主进针的可行性，有望缩短手术时间、减轻患者不适并降低辐射剂量；后续需补充定位精度与临床/体模验证的定量结果。

title: SplatLab: Autonomous Scientific Discovery for 3DGS Research
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. 14 pages, 4 figures. Project page: this https URL
summary: Reproducing a published 3DGS paper takes weeks of expert engineering before any extension can be proposed. Prior autonomous-research systems read papers, draft hypotheses, and write code, but are limited by short fixed templates, low executability, and weak traceability, and none has been demonstrated end-to-end in a live computer-vision subfield with intense activity. SplatLab is an autonomous research system for 3D Gaussian Splatting that addresses these limitations. Given a research prompt, a target-paper URL, or no input at all, it reproduces a published baseline, proposes an extension, trains and ablates across Mip-NeRF 360 and LLFF, writes the manuscript, and binds every reported number to a logged training run. Five design choices distinguish it: (i) candidates mutate plugins from a verified-reproduction backbone matched to published baselines; (ii) a cascade-weighted Elo tournament across eight islands scores candidates on measured GPU PSNR with verbal-gradient feedback; (iii) a standing falsifier subtracts Elo on failure, integrating stress-test survival into selection; (iv) every reported number is bound to a logged training run, and the run cannot terminate while any claim is unbacked; (v) a seven-category 3DGS taxonomy wraps EVOLVE-BLOCK markers in domain-aligned scaffolds transferable across 3DGS repositories. On PSNR-targeted runs, SplatLab's manuscripts beat their reproduced targets by +0.18 to +3.78 dB, including +3.78 dB on astrophotographic nebula rendering, for which no prior 3DGS method exists. The research cycle compresses from months of graduate-student time to days of mostly autonomous compute. Code, all manuscripts, experiment ledgers, and the cross-run paper store are available on the project page.

AI.tldr: SplatLab: 面向3DGS的自主科研系统，能从零复现基线、提出扩展、在Mip-NeRF 360/LLFF上训练与消融、撰写论文，并将每个数字绑定到日志化训练run。
AI.motivation: 复现一篇3DGS论文需数周专家工程，已有自主科研系统受限于固定模板、低可执行性、弱可追溯性，且未在活跃的CV子领域端到端验证。
AI.method: 五项设计：(i) 在已验证复现骨架上以插件形式变异候选；(ii) 八岛级联加权Elo锦标赛，以实测GPU PSNR加语言梯度反馈打分；(iii) 常驻falsifier在失败时扣Elo，将压力测试纳入选择；(iv) 数字与训练run强绑定，未支撑的claim阻止run终止；(v) 七类3DGS分类法将EVOLVE-BLOCK标记包裹在可跨仓库迁移的领域对齐scaffold中。
AI.result: PSNR目标run中稿件超越复现目标+0.18至+3.78 dB，含天体星云渲染+3.78 dB（此前无3DGS方法）；研究周期从数月人力压缩到数天算力。
AI.conclusion: 自动化科研流水线在3DGS上端到端可行，可追溯性与领域分类法是关键使能因素；但证据以范式与消融增益为主，缺泛化性与实时性验证。

title: Externalise the Memory: A Pre-Registered Study of Where an Embodied Agent's Experience Should Live
comment: 28 pages. A 5-page version appears at the CL4FMAgents workshop, NeurIPS 2026 (non-archival). Code and pre-registration: this https URL
summary: Should an embodied agent's experience be baked into its policy weights, or kept external and retrieved at inference? A memory-augmented teacher (a VLM that retrieves lessons, with their episode images, from its own past attempts) produces trajectories on a vision-conditioned reach task; from the same trajectories we distil LoRA student policies and evaluate them under matched protocols, including one that re-attaches the teacher's frozen retrieval buffer to a fixed set of student weights. We pre-registered the hypotheses, arms, tests, and analysis rules before training and before any p-value. Distilling the memory-augmented behaviour into weights beat an action-only control by +1 pp (n.s.); the registered test proves underpowered for its own minimum effect, so we withdraw - rather than refute - the memory-in-weights claim. Attaching retrieval to a fixed set of student weights added +34 pp (z=5.15), reaching the pooled memory-augmented teacher reference (49.3%); the pre-registered protocol contrast agrees (+23 pp, z=3.36); under a pre-registered auto-reset sensitivity count the two are +36 and +29 pp. An exploratory behavioural probe with pre-registered per-arm predictions is consistent with behavioural distillation transferring the marginal correction but not the conditional, situation-specific correction that retrieval supplies. The recipe that follows is to externalise the memory: in follow-up controls registered before they ran, the same frozen buffer lifts the base model with no adapter to 48% (sensitivity 48%) and the other three adapters from 19-26% to 53-55% (sensitivity 17-21% to 50-55%), and the adapter adds nothing detectable once the buffer is attached. On a second, harder task, the retrieval advantage points the same direction but falls short of significance (+6 pp, 95% CI [-4.5, +16.4]); exploratory diagnostics tie the attenuation to memory coverage.

AI.tldr: 对比"记忆蒸馏进策略权重"与"外部检索记忆"两种方案：在视觉条件到达任务上，把检索缓冲器外接于固定学生权重带来+34pp提升（z=5.15），而蒸馏仅+1pp不显著；结论是应将记忆外置。
AI.motivation: 具身智能体的经验应以何种形式存在：内化进策略权重（参数化记忆）还是外置为可检索的记忆库（检索式记忆）。作者希望通过预注册的严格对照实验给出因果性回答，而非笼统宣称"记忆有用"。
AI.method: 预注册假设、实验组、统计检验与分析规则（训练前、任何p值前完成）。用记忆增强教师VLM（从自身历史尝试中检索经验及对应episode图像）在视觉条件reach任务上生成轨迹；由同一批轨迹蒸馏LoRA学生策略；在匹配协议下评测，其中一组将教师冻结的检索缓冲器重新挂接到固定的学生权重上；另设auto-reset敏感性计数与带预注册逐组预测的探索性行为探针。
AI.result: 蒸馏记忆增强行为相对纯动作控制仅+1pp（不显著），且注册检验对自身最小效应量功效不足，故撤回而非否定"记忆进权重"假设。外接检索带来+34pp（z=5.15），达到记忆增强教师合并参考49.3%；预注册协议对比+23pp（z=3.36）；auto-reset敏感性下分别为+36/+29pp。后续控制中同一冻结缓冲器将无适配器基座提升至48%，将其他三个适配器由19–26%提升至53–55%，且缓冲器接入后适配器无可检测增益。第二个更难任务上检索优势方向一致但不显著（+6pp，95% CI [-4.5, +16.4]），探索性诊断将衰减归因于记忆覆盖率。
AI.conclusion: 行为蒸馏只迁移边际修正，无法迁移检索提供的条件化、情境特定修正；因此应外置记忆，经验以检索缓冲器形式在推理时注入，权重量化记忆的收益不成立（至少在功效不足的前提下无法证实）。

title: AVAtt: A Free-Viewing Eye-Tracking Dataset and Benchmark for Visual Attention on Paintings
comment: Extenstion of https://doi.org/10.1145/3649902.3655656 published at ETRA 2024
summary:
Saliency and scanpath models are developed almost exclusively on natural photographs, yet paintings are composed by artists to guide the viewer's eye and differ from photographs in texture, colour and abstraction. We introduce \avatt, a free-viewing eye-tracking dataset on 
Images{} paintings spanning sixteen art movements and five centuries, with 
Scanpaths{} scanpaths and 
Fixations{} fixations from 
Participants{} participants (\spPerImageMin--\spPerImageMax{} observers per painting). For every painting we release individual scanpaths with fixation timing and eye--screen distance, fixation maps, saliency maps smoothed at one degree of visual angle, temporal saliency videos and rich art metadata. We benchmark classic and deep saliency models against human agreement, revealing substantial headroom for art-aware models, and rank 44 scanpath-similarity measures, including a new language-free family of image-encoder metrics built on ten CNN, ViT and self-supervised encoders. With controls that remove viewing biases, we show that faces are fixated  aceEnrich$	imes$ more than expected and within half a second, that local structure draws the eye, that composition rules fitted from image content predict where people look, and that art style shapes how much viewers agree. Dataset, code and a Python package are available at: this https URL .

title: PhysibleMDM: Enforcing Inference-Time Physical Feasibility Constraints on Motion Diffusion Models via Noise Optimization
summary: Motion Diffusion Models (MDMs) can generate diverse and visually appealing human motion; yet, the resulting trajectories frequently violate physical constraints, limiting their downstream use in simulation and control. We present PhysibleMDM, a framework that promotes physical feasibility of MDM output by optimizing at inference time the diffusion noise without retraining the generative model. We introduce a set of surrogate feasibility constraints that can be evaluated without full trajectory simulation. These constraints combine kinematic checks (e.g., ground penetration, slip, and self-collision) with dynamic feasibility tests computed via an inverse-dynamics inner loop formulated as a cone program. We solve the resulting black-box noise optimization problem using the Separable Covariance Matrix Adaptation Evolution Strategy (Sep-CMA-ES), thereby avoiding reliance on computationally expensive and discontinuous gradients. An autoregressive scheme then chains optimized segments to synthesize long motion sequences. Across 100 motion styles on an SMPL humanoid, PhysibleMDM reduces mean ground penetration, self-collision penetration, and ground slip by 75%, 92%, and 74%, respectively, relative to unoptimized diffusion output. Across 11 sequences for a custom bipedal robot, it achieves median reductions of 89.5% in per-sequence mean acceleration-reconstruction error and 79.5% in the mean inverse-dynamics residual.

AI.tldr: PhysibleMDM: 无需重训，在推理阶段用 Sep-CMA-ES 优化扩散噪声，借助运动学+逆动力学(Cone Program)代理可行性约束，使MDM输出在物理上可行。
AI.motivation: 运动扩散模型生成的轨迹常违反物理约束（穿地、滑步、自穿、动力学不可行），限制其在仿真与控制中的下游使用；重训练代价高。
AI.method: 推理时黑盒噪声优化，不更新生成模型权重；构造可免全轨迹仿真的代理可行性约束：运动学检查（穿地、滑步、自碰撞）+ 以锥规划(Cone Program)形式求解内层逆动力学的动力学可行度检验；用 Sep-CMA-ES 规避昂贵且不连续的梯度；再用自回归分段链接生成长序列。
AI.result: SMPL 人形100种风格：穿地、自穿、滑步均值分别降 75%、92%、74%；自研双足机器人11条序列：单序列平均加速度重建误差中位下降 89.5%，平均逆动力学残差中位下降 79.5%。
AI.conclusion: 以测试时噪声优化加代理物理约束的方式低成本提升MDM物理可行性，跨人形与机器人形态有效，可作为下游仿真/控制的前处理。

title: Unified Trajectory and 3D Pose Forecasting for Multi-Agent Sports Analysis
summary: Forecasting future human motion requires jointly reasoning about an agent's global trajectory and 3D body pose, which are tightly coupled, particularly in team sports where multiple interacting players introduce complex social dynamics. We exploit a socio-temporal encoder that fuses trajectory and pose at the input level and models them jointly through shared factorized attention. The model is further enhanced by a per-joint loss reweighting scheme that emphasizes dynamic joints and prevents degenerate solutions, and a frequency-domain trajectory smoothing term that improves trajectory prediction while indirectly benefiting pose forecasting. To ensure fair comparison with prior joint forecasting methods, we identify and correct evaluation biases arising from overlapping sequence construction, adopting instead a non-overlapping protocol and a deterministic, oracle-free strategy for multi-future prediction. Our approach improves over prior joint forecasting methods on both WorldPose and 3DPW, with the largest gains on pose accuracy, demonstrating that the proposed joint formulation generalizes beyond the densely interactive scenarios that motivate it.

AI.tldr: 提出社会-时序编码器，在输入层融合轨迹与姿态并通过共享因子化注意力联合建模，配合逐关节损失重加权与频域轨迹平滑，并修正重叠序列评测偏差，在WorldPose与3DPW上提升联合人体运动预测。
AI.motivation: 未来人体运动预测需同时推理全局轨迹与3D人体姿态，二者强耦合；团队运动中多智能体交互带来复杂社会动态。已有联合预测方法还存在评测偏差（重叠序列构造导致信息泄漏式高估）。
AI.method: 1）社会-时序编码器：输入层融合轨迹与姿态，经共享因子化注意力联合建模多智能体交互；2）逐关节损失重加权，强调动态关节并避免退化解；3）频域轨迹平滑正则，间接改善姿态预测；4）采用非重叠评测协议与确定性、无需oracle的多未来预测策略以消除评测偏差。
AI.result: 在WorldPose与3DPW基准上优于既有联合预测方法，姿态精度增益最大，说明该联合建模可泛化到交互稀疏场景。
AI.conclusion: 轨迹与姿态的联合建模优于解耦方案，且评测协议修正对公平比较至关重要；但工作聚焦人体运动预测，未涉及机器人操作、具身导航或3D重建生成。

title: Decision Making and Ride Comfort Evaluation Based on Lane-Change Prediction for Autonomous Vehicles
summary: Predicting surrounding vehicles' lane-change intentions enables autonomous vehicles to anticipate potential hazards and respond proactively rather than relying solely on reactive maneuvers. This study investigates the benefits of integrating lane-change prediction, based on knowledge graph embeddings and Bayesian inference, into autonomous vehicle decision-making. Three driving strategies are evaluated in risky merging scenarios simulated in CARLA: reactive driving, prediction-based longitudinal action, and prediction-based lateral action. The proposed prediction model anticipates the surrounding vehicle's lane change approximately 3-4 seconds before its occurrence, allowing the ego vehicle to adjust its behavior accordingly. In the representative simulation records, reactive driving results in a collision accompanied by aggressive deceleration. In contrast, prediction-based longitudinal action initiates early braking to establish a safe gap, while prediction-based lateral action performs a lane change when a safe adjacent lane is available. Both predictive strategies avoid collisions in the evaluated records. Compared with reactive driving, peak deceleration before impact is reduced by 31.5% with longitudinal action and 91.0% with lateral action. Additionally, an ISO 2631-1-based horizontal vibration estimate is used to provide a ride comfort assessment. Overall, the results highlight the potential of lane-change prediction to support safer and smoother driving through proactive decision-making, with additional insights into ride comfort provided by vibration-based estimates.

AI.tldr: Integrating knowledge-graph-embedding + Bayesian lane-change intention prediction into AV decision-making; in CARLA risky merging scenarios, prediction-based strategies avoid collisions and reduce peak deceleration by 31.5% (longitudinal) and 91.0% (lateral) vs. reactive driving.
AI.motivation: Reactive AV planning only responds after hazards materialize; anticipating surrounding vehicles' lane-change intentions could enable proactive, safer and smoother maneuvers.
AI.method: Lane-change prediction via knowledge graph embeddings plus Bayesian inference, feeding three strategies (reactive; prediction-based longitudinal braking; prediction-based lateral lane change) evaluated in CARLA risky merging scenarios, with ISO 2631-1-based horizontal vibration ride-comfort estimate.
AI.result: Prediction anticipates lane changes 3–4 s in advance. Reactive driving collides with aggressive deceleration; both predictive strategies avoid collisions, cutting pre-impact peak deceleration by 31.5% (longitudinal) and 91.0% (lateral); ISO 2631-1 vibration estimates quantify comfort.
AI.conclusion: Lane-change prediction supports safer, smoother proactive AV decision-making; small-scale CARLA simulation only, no real-world validation or open code reported.

title: Motion Retargeting with Spatiotemporal Preferences for Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
summary: Human motion retargeting bridges the embodiment gap between humans and humanoid robots by converting human demonstrations into reference trajectories for whole-body control and loco-manipulation. For object-interaction tasks, successful execution depends on accurately preserving body--object relations at critical stages. However, uniform per-frame iteration budgets do not account for these localized accuracy requirements, limiting the computational efficiency of retargeting. To address this limitation, we present Spatiotemporal Retargeting (STR), which uses keyframes and key body parts to allocate optimization effort. Specifically, a vision-language model selects relevant motion signals and body parts, and keyframes are identified from changes in the selected signals. Based on these selections, STR assigns additional solver iterations to keyframes and higher interaction weights to the selected parts. To further improve contact fidelity, we introduce Mechanics-Aware Contact Anchoring (MCA) to refine object-surface contact positions using an approximate object-wrench model while retaining the selected surface directions. Building on the resulting references, we develop Spatiotemporal Reinforcement Learning (STRL), which combines adaptive key-stage sampling with a contact reward based on target proximity and object contact forces for downstream control. Simulation experiments on a Unitree G1 and real-world experiments on a Unitree R1 demonstrate that STR improves geometric contact coverage and continuity at lower computational cost, while the resulting references improve downstream task completion across diverse object-interaction motions.

AI.tldr: STR 用 VLM 选关键帧与关键身体部位来非均匀分配重定向优化预算，并用力学感知接触锚定（MCA）细化物体表面接触，再配时空强化学习（STRL）在 G1 仿真与 R1 真机完成物体交互任务。
AI.motivation: 人-人形机器人运动重定向中，物体交互任务只在少数关键时刻对躯干-物体关系敏感，但现有方法对每帧使用统一迭代预算，导致算力浪费且关键阶段精度不足。
AI.method: 1) VLM 选择相关运动信号与身体部位，并据信号变化检测关键帧；2) 对关键帧分配额外求解器迭代、对选定部位提高交互权重；3) Mechanics-Aware Contact Anchoring：用近似物体力螺旋模型在保留选定表面方向的前提下修正接触位置；4) Spatiotemporal RL：自适应关键阶段采样 + 基于目标接近度与接触力的接触奖励用于下游控制。
AI.result: Unitree G1 仿真与 Unitree R1 真机实验显示，几何接触覆盖率与连续性提升且计算开销更低；生成的重定向参考轨迹使下游多类物体交互任务完成率提高。
AI.conclusion: 将优化预算按时空重要性非均匀分配，是提升人形机器人重定向效率与接触保真度的有效途径，且能直接改善下游 loco-manipulation 性能。

title: Know When to Escalate: Critic-Guided Adaptive Execution for Cloud-Local Embodied Agents
summary: Recent advances in foundation-model agents have enabled increasingly capable embodied systems for long-horizon planning and interaction. However, embodied agents require fast, closed-loop decisions as they continuously perceive and act on a changing environment. Deploying strong cloud agents leaves the platform idle for seconds between consecutive actions, while lightweight local models respond quickly but are more vulnerable to errors. Existing hierarchical architectures typically assign models fixed roles, whereas conventional model routers make stateless per-request decisions. We present CARE, a critic-guided adaptive execution framework that dynamically determines when to escalate control from a local executor to a stronger cloud model. A lightweight critic model monitors execution reliability and triggers escalation when local execution becomes unreliable; once escalated, control persists until the agent recovers, avoiding step-wise switching. To support such control transfer, a shared handoff memory maintains execution context and task-level progress across executors, enabling the model to intervene without restarting from scratch. Across diverse embodied benchmarks, CARE improves task success by 6.3-18.3 percentage points over the strongest evaluated collaboration baseline. CARE further approaches or exceeds Cloud-only success while reducing median time-between-action latency by 28.8-82.6%.

AI.tldr: CARE：用轻量critic模型监测本地执行可靠性，不可靠时升级到云端强模型，并保持升级状态直到恢复；共享handoff memory跨执行器维持上下文，实现快慢模型自适应协作。
AI.motivation: 具身智能体需闭环快速决策：纯云端模型导致动作间数秒空闲，纯本地模型快但易出错；现有分层架构给模型固定角色，常规模型路由为无状态逐请求决策，均不适配长程具身任务。
AI.method: 提出critic-guided自适应执行框架：轻量critic监测本地执行可靠性并触发升级至云端模型；升级后控制权持久保持直至恢复，避免逐步切换；配套共享handoff memory维护执行上下文与任务级进度，使更强模型可直接接管而非从头重来。
AI.result: 在多个具身基准上，任务成功率较最强协作基线提升6.3–18.3个百分点，接近或超过Cloud-only方案，同时将动作间延迟中位数降低28.8–82.6%。
AI.conclusion: 状态化、由critic驱动的动态升级与持久化上下文共享，是兼顾具身智能体成功率与实时性的有效范式。

title: OASIS: Online Anchor-centric Scene Inference System for Open-Vocabulary Retrieval and Navigation in Dynamic Environments
comment: Accepted for oral presentation at ACM Multimedia (ACM MM) 2026. 17 pages, 10 figures, including supplementary material
summary: Reliable robotic mapping in dynamic real-world environments is essential for embodied intelligence and long-term autonomy. However, existing methods often involve a trade-off: lightweight online mapping is efficient but captures limited semantic context, while dense mapping provides richer semantics at higher computational cost and is more vulnerable to distractors. They also struggle to relocalize objects after scene changes. To address these challenges, we propose the Online Anchor-centric Scene Inference System (OASIS), a unified system for online mapping, complex open-vocabulary retrieval, and navigation in dynamic environments. Motivated by the observation that indoor scenes are organized around stable semantic anchors, OASIS represents the environment using a sparse set of anchor nodes, each maintaining a unified multimodal representation that integrates semantic descriptions, visual features, and geometric states for reasoning, verification, and navigation. Its compact anchor-centric memory supports on-demand evidence extraction and hierarchical retrieval, reducing redundant storage while improving retrieval reliability. To handle scene dynamics, OASIS further reuses transient observations collected during navigation to relocalize moved objects. Experiments in both simulation and real-world environments, including standard retrieval benchmarks and navigation tasks under both static and dynamic settings, demonstrate that our system can perform complex open-vocabulary retrieval and navigation, while also enabling relocation of displaced objects after scene changes.

AI.tldr: OASIS：以稀疏"语义锚点"节点表示环境的多模态在线建图系统，统一支持开放词汇检索、动态场景重定位与导航。
AI.motivation: 动态真实环境中的可靠建图是具身智能与长期自主性的基础。现有方法存在轻量在线建图（语义上下文有限）与稠密建图（算力高、易受干扰、场景变化后难以重定位物体）之间的权衡。
AI.method: 观察室内场景围绕稳定的语义锚点组织，故用稀疏锚点节点集合表示环境；每个节点维护融合语义描述、视觉特征与几何状态的统一多模态表示，用于推理、验证与导航。紧凑的锚点中心记忆支持按需证据提取与分层检索，减少冗余存储并提升检索可靠性；并复用导航中采集的瞬时观测实现被移动物体的重定位。
AI.result: 在仿真与真实环境（标准检索基准、静态与动态导航任务）中实验，系统可完成复杂开放词汇检索与导航，并在场景变化后重定位位移物体。
AI.conclusion: 锚点中心的稀疏多模态表示可作为动态场景在线建图、检索与导航的统一框架，兼顾效率与检索可靠性，并具备动态重定位能力。

title: Visual Grounding First, Multimodal In-context Learning Follows
summary: LLMs have shown strong in-context learning (ICL) capability, but extending it to Multimodal LLMs (MLLMs) remains challenging. Prior multimodal ICL methods often rely on ICL-specific datasets for additional training or task vector extraction, which can improve performance on the same ICL benchmark used for adaptation. However, they do not generalize well to other benchmarks and often induce forgetting in previously well-solved tasks. For this reason, we identify 'visual grounding' as the key bottleneck in multimodal ICL; MLLMs often fail to attend to task-relevant visual evidence in demonstrations, instead over-relying on textual cues and producing hallucinated outputs. To address this, we propose ProCoRe to enhance visual grounding through contrastive reinforcement learning on multimodal contrastive data for improving multimodal ICL. ProCoRe generates captions for contrastive image pairs, decomposes them into propositions, and optimizes contrastive rewards that encourage alignment with corresponding images while discouraging mismatched ones. Despite never seeing ICL-formatted training examples, ProCoRe improves average multimodal ICL classification accuracy by 5.6% and captioning ROUGE-L by 13.8% over the off-the-shelf Qwen-VL-3-8B model, outperforming ICL-data-dependent state of the arts across benchmarks. Finally, we introduce PICL, a personalized multimodal ICL captioning benchmark that tests whether MLLMs genuinely understand visual demonstrations rather than relying on pre-trained semantic priors.

AI.tldr: 本文指出多模态 ICL 的关键瓶颈是视觉接地失败，提出 ProCoRe：在对比图像对上生成 caption、分解为命题并施加对比强化学习奖励，从而在不使用 ICL 格式数据的情况下提升多模态 ICL 性能，并发布个性化多模态 ICL captioning 基准 PICL。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态 ICL 方法依赖 ICL 专用数据额外训练或任务向量提取，只在适配所用的同一基准上有效，跨基准泛化差且造成已有任务遗忘。作者将问题归因于 MLLM 在示范中无法关注任务相关的视觉证据、过度依赖文本线索并产生幻觉。
AI.method: ProCoRe 采用多模态对比数据上的对比强化学习：对成对对比图像生成 caption，将其分解为命题（propositions），并优化对比奖励——鼓励命题与对应图像对齐，惩罚与不匹配图像对齐。训练数据不含任何 ICL 格式样本。
AI.result: 在 Qwen-VL-3-8B 基础上，多模态 ICL 分类平均准确率提升 5.6%，captioning ROUGE-L 提升 13.8%，跨多个基准优于依赖 ICL 数据的最先进方法。此外提出 PICL 个性化多模态 ICL captioning 基准，用于检验模型是否真正理解视觉示范而非依赖预训练语义先验。
AI.conclusion: 视觉接地是多模态 ICL 的核心瓶颈，通过对比强化学习强化接地可带来可泛化且不引起遗忘的改进；但方法未涉及具身、机器人或 3D 任务，属于通用多模态 LLM 能力增强，非物理 AI 核心方向。

title: PATH: Preference-Aware Traversability Estimation for Robotic Teleoperation in Off-Road Navigation
summary: Traversability estimation is critical for ground vehicle teleoperation, yet existing methods often neglect the human operator's preferences for speed and risk tolerance. To address this gap, we propose PATH-Net, a Preference-Aware Traversability estimation Hierarchical Network that adaptively generates preference-conditioned traversability cost maps and speed profiles for off-road teleoperation. Our framework integrates visual and geometric bird's-eye-view features with short-term historical vehicle states through a multi-head shared-backbone architecture. Our PATH-Net infers traversability cost maps while optimizing speed recommendations by using maximum entropy inverse reinforcement learning and sparse speed supervision. Our method incorporates operator preference via an asymmetric feature aggregation mechanism, splitting inference into a cost branch that prioritizes high-risk traversability regions and a speed branch that outputs preference-adjusted recommended speeds. Experiments with 15 operators across 225 teleoperated trajectories show alignment with user-specific navigation strategies, achieving modified Hausdorff distance of 0.17 m (aggressive) and 0.15 m (conservative). In the questionnaire assessment, participants reported lower NASA-TLX workload scores with PATH-Net recommendations than without recommendations, decreasing from 34.7 to 22.2. These results support preference-conditioned trajectory and speed recommendation for off-road teleoperation.

AI.tldr: PATH-Net：偏好感知的分层可通行性估计网络，为越野遥操作生成随操作员"激进/保守"偏好变化的可通行代价图与速度剖面。
AI.motivation: 现有可通行性估计方法忽略操作员对速度与风险容忍度的个体偏好，导致遥操作推荐与实际导航策略不匹配、操作负荷高。
AI.method: 多视角视觉+几何BEV特征与短期历史车辆状态经多头共享骨干融合；用最大熵逆强化学习推断代价图，配合稀疏速度监督优化推荐速度；采用非对称特征聚合将推理拆为侧重高风险区域代价分支与偏好调整速度分支。
AI.result: 15名操作员、225条遥操作轨迹实验中，修正Hausdorff距离0.17 m（激进）/0.15 m（保守）；NASA-TLX负荷评分由34.7降至22.2。
AI.conclusion: 偏好条件化的轨迹与速度推荐可对齐用户个性化导航策略并降低遥操作认知负荷，支持越野遥操作场景。

title: CMAR-search: Commonsense and Memory Augmented Reasoning for Object Search in Dynamic Interactive Environments
summary: Dynamic interactive object search in large-scale human environments presents substantial challenges for existing methods. Current scene representations like 3D Scene Graphs (3DSG) only provide coarse-grained spatial segmentation and cannot identify functional areas such as storage or leisure areas. Without functional area understanding, existing methods are constrained to exhaustive sequential exploration at large scales, resulting in inefficient search behaviors -- particularly in open-layout environments with numerous interactive objects such as drawers and cabinets. Moreover, these methods lack adaptability to environmental dynamics such as object relocations. To address these limitations, this paper proposes CMAR-search, a novel framework built upon Commonsense and Memory Augmented Reasoning (CMAR). Our approach leverages commonsense about area functionalities and aggregates environmental memory to construct a Functional 3D Scene Graph (F3DSG), which organizes the environment into functional areas with their associated containers. Through this structured representation, CMAR enables hierarchical action planning at both macro-area and micro-container levels, empowering the system to efficiently identify and inspect semantically relevant areas for effective object search. Notably, CMAR continuously integrates real-time perception, accumulated memory, and commonsense to dynamically relocalize objects in changing environments. Extensive experiments in simulation and real-world settings demonstrate that CMAR-search significantly surpasses state-of-the-art baselines in both success rate and search efficiency for object search in dynamic interactive environments.

AI.tldr: 提出CMAR-search框架，结合关于区域功能的常识与环境记忆，构建功能3D场景图(F3DSG)，实现宏观区域与微观容器两级层次化规划，并持续融合实时感知、记忆与常识以动态重定位物体，在仿真与真实环境中显著提升物体搜索的成功率与效率。
AI.motivation: 现有3D场景图(3DSG)仅提供粗粒度空间分割，无法识别储物、休闲等功能区域，导致大尺度开放布局环境下只能穷举式顺序探索，效率低下；同时缺乏对环境动态（如物体被移动）的适应性。
AI.method: 以常识(区域功能语义)与环境记忆聚合构建Functional 3D Scene Graph，将环境组织为功能区域及其关联容器；基于该结构化表示做宏观区域级与微观容器级的层次化动作规划，定向检查语义相关区域；并在线持续融合实时感知、累积记忆与常识进行物体动态重定位。
AI.result: 在仿真与真实场景的实验中，CMAR-search在动态交互环境下物体搜索的成功率与搜索效率均显著优于现有最优基线。
AI.conclusion: 功能语义场景图+记忆增强推理是提升大规模动态环境中交互式物体搜索效率的有效途径，可作为具身导航与移动操作Agent的场景表示范式。

title: Continuous-Time Motion Planning and Steering with Global Convergence
summary: Motion planning is central to robotics, and it is increasingly used to correct the motions proposed by learned planners and policies. In both uses, constraints must hold at every instant of the motion, not only at sampled times. To our knowledge, no algorithm provably converges to a globally optimal motion once a smoothness cost is combined with such constraints. We cast planning and steering as a single continuous-time program: robots avoid one another and static or moving obstacles, and a learned proposal is steered by keeping the motion close to it. The program is elementary to state, yet nonconvex. We propose GlobMP (Global Motion Planning), a gradient projection method over piecewise-polynomial curves, on which each constraint is one polynomial per piece that must stay nonnegative over the whole motion; it alternates cost reduction with feasibility restoration. Under mild assumptions, we show that, from a fine grid start, its cost approaches the global optimum as the number of polynomial pieces grows, with every constraint met to any chosen tolerance, or exactly on stable instances. We demonstrate its superior performance over strong baselines in real and synthetic experiments, including teams of up to $200$ robots, multi-robot planning on the Robotarium testbed and an extended benchmark, maze navigation, and steering tactile-reactive policies on a bimanual humanoid.

AI.tldr: 提出 GlobMP：将运动规划与策略引导统一为连续时间规划问题，用分段多项式曲线上的梯度投影法交替进行代价下降与可行性恢复，并证明确保收敛到全局最优、约束严格满足。
AI.motivation: 现有学习式规划器/策略给出的轨迹需被修正，且约束必须在运动每一个瞬时（而非采样点）成立；同时，当平滑代价与连续时间约束结合时，尚无算法能可证明地收敛到全局最优解。
AI.method: 将避让（动/静态障碍、机器人间）与「贴近学习提案」表述为单一连续时间程序；在分段多项式曲线上，每条约束在每个分片上对应一个须整段非负的多项式。采用 GlobMP 梯度投影法，交替执行代价下降与可行性恢复，从细网格初值出发，随分段数增加使代价逼近全局最优。
AI.result: 在温和假设下证明：代价随多项式分段数增长趋近全局最优，约束达到任意指定容差或在稳定实例上精确满足。真实与合成实验中优于强基线，包括多达200个机器人的团队、Robotarium 多机器人实验与扩展基准、迷宫导航，以及在双臂人形上引导触觉反应式策略。
AI.conclusion: 连续时间多项式约束下的可证明全局最优规划是可行的，GlobMP 兼具理论保证与大规模、真实硬件上的实用性，并可作为学习策略的安全轨迹修正层。

title: KinoUAV: A Benchmark for Safe and Stable UAV Vision-Language Navigation with Kinodynamic Modeling
summary: Unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) have recently emerged as important remote sensing platforms, and UAV navigation has shown great potential in remote sensing applications. However, existing methods do not explicitly incorporate kinodynamic modeling or safety distances into trajectory generation, resulting in high absolute yaw rates, frequent collisions, and low navigation success rates, which limit safety and motion stability. To address this challenge, we introduce KinoUAV, a kinodynamic benchmark comprising a dataset and KinoUAV-Agent. First, we develop a hierarchical kinodynamic trajectory generation pipeline that drives UAV through acceleration actions. It uses waypoint chains from global planning and generates trajectories segment by segment under velocity, acceleration, and jerk constraints, reducing oscillations and improving trajectory stability. Furthermore, we introduce directional free-space distance (DFD) labels into the constructed dataset to describe the available clearance for safe motion decisions. The proposed KinoUAV-Agent predicts DFDs and uses them to generate safe actions, decoupling perception from action decision-making. This design enables autonomous obstacle avoidance and improves navigation safety. The benchmark incorporates the proposed Cruise-Seek task, in which the UAV first enters the target region and then searches for the target, reducing the difficulty of target search and improving navigation success. Experiments on KinoUAV show that KinoUAV-Agent outperforms existing methods, achieving the highest success rate while maintaining lower absolute yaw rates and collision rates. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of kinodynamic modeling for safe and stable UAV navigation.

AI.tldr: KinoUAV：引入运动动力学（kinodynamic）建模与安全距离的无人机导航基准，包含分层加速度动作轨迹生成流程、方向自由空间距离（DFD）标签数据集及KinoUAV-Agent，并提出Cruise-Seek任务。
AI.motivation: 现有UAV导航方法未显式融入运动动力学建模与安全距离约束于轨迹生成中，导致绝对偏航角速度高、碰撞频繁、导航成功率低，安全性与运动稳定性受限。
AI.method: 1) 分层运动动力学轨迹生成管线：由全局规划输出航点链，通过加速度动作驱动UAV并逐段生成轨迹，受速度/加速度/jerk约束；2) 数据集引入方向自由空间距离（DFD）标签描述安全运动可用间隙；3) KinoUAV-Agent预测DFD并据此生成安全动作，解耦感知与动作决策；4) 构建Cruise-Seek任务（先进入目标区域再搜索目标）。
AI.result: KinoUAV基准实验显示KinoUAV-Agent在成功率上优于现有方法，同时保持较低的绝对偏航角速度与碰撞率。
AI.conclusion: 运动动力学建模对安全、稳定的UAV导航有效；基准与Agent设计可提升自主避障与导航安全性。

title: GSHeadRelight: Fast Relightability for 3D Gaussian Head Synthesis
summary: Relighting and novel view synthesis of human portraits are essential in applications such as portrait photography, virtual reality (VR), and augmented reality (AR). Despite recent progress, 3D-aware portrait relighting remains challenging due to the demands for photorealistic rendering, real-time performance, and generalization to unseen subjects. Existing works either rely on supervision from limited and expensive light stage captured data or produce suboptimal results. Moreover, many works are based on generative NeRFs, which suffer from poor 3D consistency and low real-time performance. We resort to recent progress on generative 3D Gaussians and design a lighting model based on a unified neural radiance transfer representation, which responds linearly to incident light. Using only in-the-wild images, our method achieves state-of-the-art relighting results and a significantly faster rendering speed ($\times12$) compared to previous 3D-aware portrait relighting research. Project page: this http URL .

AI.tldr: 提出基于生成式3D高斯与统一神经辐射传输（NRT）表示的人像重光照与稀疏视角合成方法，仅用野外图像训练，实现SOTA重光照质量与约12倍渲染加速。
AI.motivation: 3D感知人像重光照要求照片级真实感、实时性能与对未见主体的泛化能力；现有方法依赖昂贵光stage监督数据，或基于生成式NeRF，存在3D一致性差、实时性低的问题。
AI.method: 设计一个基于生成式3D高斯的统一神经辐射传输表示作为光照模型，该表示对入射光呈线性响应；训练仅使用in-the-wild图像，无需光stage捕获数据，从而实现重光照与视角合成的联合建模。
AI.result: 在仅用野外数据训练的条件下取得SOTA重光照效果，渲染速度较此前3D感知人像重光照方法提升约12倍，并可泛化至未见主体。
AI.conclusion: 将3D高斯与线性响应的神经辐射传输结合，可在无光stage监督下兼顾真实感、实时性与泛化性，为3D感知人像重光照提供可实用的高效方案。

title: Refining Open-Vocabulary Semantic Segmentation via Regional Semantics and Visual Prototypes
summary: Contrastive Language-Image Pre-training (CLIP) has shown superior performance in the image-level open-vocabulary classification task, benefiting from its powerful alignment of visual features and text embeddings. However, dense prediction tasks require models to perform pixel-level predictions, necessitating modifications to CLIP for region-text alignment. In this paper, we adjust the attention layers within the vanilla visual encoder of CLIP. With a novel attention calculation method for selective attention features, the model retains more regional semantic information. To further mitigate the negative impact of the modality gap, we introduce additional visual prototypes to refine the original predictor solely based on text embeddings. Specifically, patch features with confident predictions are selected to form an additional auxiliary memory-based classifier for more accurate prediction. We further integrate an optimizable feature extractor with an exponential moving average updating strategy to enhance prediction quality. Extensive experiments on $5$ semantic segmentation datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of our method.

AI.tldr: 该文通过改进CLIP视觉编码器的注意力计算以保留区域语义，并引入基于置信patch特征的原型辅助分类器、可优化特征提取器与EMA更新，缓解模态鸿沟，提升开放词表语义分割性能。
AI.motivation: CLIP在图像级开放词表分类上表现优异，但密集预测任务需要像素级区域-文本对齐，直接迁移存在区域语义信息丢失与视觉-文本模态鸿沟问题。
AI.method: 修改CLIP视觉编码器中的注意力层，采用选择性注意力特征的新计算方式；在仅基于文本嵌入的原始预测器之外，利用高置信预测的patch特征构建记忆式原型辅助分类器，并加入可优化特征提取器及指数滑动平均（EMA）更新策略。
AI.result: 在5个语义分割数据集上的大量实验验证了方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 选择性注意力特征加原型辅助分类可有效将CLIP适配到区域级密集预测，缓解模态鸿沟，为开放词表分割提供可行方案。

title: FedBST: Bilateral Self-Training for Unsupervised Federated Classification
summary: Unsupervised federated learning with Vision-Language Models (e.g., CLIP) offers a promising solution for label-free classification, yet its performance often degrades under severe non-IID shifts. A pioneering method, FedCoPL, typically relies on self-training strategies that exclusively prioritize high-confidence predictions for pseudo-labeling. However, this selective approach neglects the information of ambiguous samples (often referred to as ``waist" samples), leading to the underutilization of data and biased decision boundaries. To address this limitation, we propose FedBST, a bilateral self-training framework that effectively exploits both high-confidence and ambiguous data. Specifically, for local optimization, we introduce uncertainty-aware confidence penalization (UACP). UACP targets ambiguous samples by penalizing overconfident predictions to implicitly promote higher uncertainty, thereby preventing erroneous pseudo-labeling. At inference, we employ a visual-text ensemble strategy. This approach aggregates uncertainty-aware local visual prototypes and ensembles them with textual prototypes, achieving lightweight adaptation to local distributions via prototype-based calibration. Experiments demonstrate that FedBST achieves consistent improvements over existing methods with standard federated aggregation protocols.

AI.tldr: FedBST：双边自训练联邦学习框架，同时利用高置信与模糊样本，通过不确定性感知置信惩罚(UACP)与视觉-文本原型集成提升CLIP无监督联邦分类在严重非IID下的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有CLIP无监督联邦学习（如FedCoPL）仅对高置信预测做伪标签自训练，忽略"腰部"模糊样本，导致数据利用不足与决策边界偏置；且严重非IID偏移下性能易退化。
AI.method: 双边自训练框架：(1) 本地优化引入不确定性感知置信惩罚(UACP)，对模糊样本惩罚过度自信预测，隐式提升其不确定性，避免错误伪标签；(2) 推理时采用视觉-文本集成，聚合不确定性感知的本地视觉原型并与文本原型集成，通过原型校准实现轻量级本地分布适配。采用标准联邦聚合协议。
AI.result: 在标准联邦聚合协议下，FedBST相对现有方法取得一致性提升（摘要未给出具体数值与数据集）。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式建模并利用模糊样本、结合原型级视觉-文本校准，可在不改变聚合协议的前提下缓解非IID下的伪标签偏差；本质仍是分类任务的联邦表征学习方法。

title: CODI: Improving Self-Supervised Vision Transformers with Cross Distillation
summary: Self-supervised Vision Transformers learn strong image-level representations, but their patch-level representations can be unreliable for dense prediction. We study this mismatch and find that the class token concentrates global semantics on a small number of representative patches, while dense prediction errors often occur on low-attention regions. We provide a local gradient analysis showing that, along the [CLS] attention readout, image-level self-distillation gradients are weighted by [CLS]-to-patch attention mass. To provide masked patches with global semantics without changing the architecture, we propose Cross Distillation (CODI), which mixes a small amount of the teacher class-token distribution into each teacher patch-token target. CODI gives every masked patch an attention-independent semantic correction while preserving the standard self-distillation architecture. Experiments on dense and image-level benchmarks show that CODI improves both dense and image-level performance under aligned pretraining settings. Code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: CODI（Cross Distillation）通过将教师 class-token 分布少量混入每个教师 patch-token 目标，为被 mask 的 patch 提供与注意力无关的全局语义监督，在不改动架构的前提下改善自监督 ViT 的稠密预测性能。
AI.motivation: 自监督 ViT 的图像级表示强，但 patch 级表示对稠密预测不可靠。作者发现 class token 将全局语义集中于少数代表性 patch，而稠密预测误差常出现在低注意力区域；沿 [CLS] 注意力读出路径的局部梯度分析表明，图像级自蒸馏梯度按 [CLS]-to-patch 注意力质量加权，导致低注意力区得不到有效语义监督。
AI.method: 梯度分析定位问题（注意力质量加权导致监督偏置）；提出 CODI：在标准自蒸馏框架内，将教师 class-token 分布以少量比例混合进每个教师 patch-token 目标，使所有被 mask 的 patch 获得注意力无关的语义校正；架构与训练流程不变，仅修改蒸馏目标。
AI.result: 在对齐的预训练设置下，于稠密预测基准与图像级基准上同时取得提升（稠密与图像级性能均受益）。
AI.conclusion: 图像级自蒸馏的监督偏置可通过目标端的小幅修改高效缓解；CODI 是一种零架构开销、可直接嵌入现有自监督 ViT 训练范式的通用改进。

title: Asking Less, Adapting Better: Feedback-Efficient Test-Time Adaptation for Vision-and-Language Navigation
summary: Vision-and-Language Navigation (VLN) requires agents to follow instructions and navigate to target locations. However, current VLN agents often suffer severe performance degradation in unseen environments due to distribution shifts. Test-Time Adaptation (TTA) offers a promising paradigm to bridge this gap, yet existing methods that rely on unsupervised entropy minimization can propagate errors through the trajectory, causing cascading failures in navigation. Recent methods mitigate this by incorporating human feedback, but they apply trajectory-level supervision uniformly across all steps without localizing the actions is truly informative, leading to inefficient feedback utilization and mismatched optimization granularity. To address these limitations, we propose FETA, a Feedback-Efficient Test-Time Adaptation method that improves both feedback efficiency and optimization reliability. To reduce unnecessary human interventions, we introduce a hierarchical sample selection strategy to localize informative samples. Specifically, we first filter trajectories whose normalized policy entropy exhibits large fluctuations. Within each selected trajectory, we further select the critical action via an entropy-gradient saliency criterion and query a single binary feedback on its correctness. A discrepancy-aware entropy optimization objective then updates the policy only at the queried step, with adaptive scaling that assigns larger relative weights to samples with greater prediction-feedback discrepancy. Extensive experiments across multiple benchmarks demonstrate that FETA achieves state-of-the-art performance with fewer human interventions, while remaining robust under noisy feedback and continual adaptation settings.

AI.tldr: FETA：一种反馈高效的视觉语言导航测试时自适应方法，通过层级样本选择定位关键样本、以熵-梯度显著性选取关键动作并只查询一次二值反馈，再用差异感知熵目标仅在查询步更新策略。
AI.motivation: 现有VLN智能体在未见环境中因分布偏移而性能显著下降。基于无监督熵最小化的TTA会沿轨迹传播错误导致级联失败；引入人工反馈的方法则在所有步上均匀施加轨迹级监督，未定位真正有信息量的动作，导致反馈利用低效、优化粒度不匹配。
AI.method: 1) 层级样本选择：先筛选归一化策略熵波动较大的轨迹；2) 轨迹内用熵-梯度显著性准则选出关键动作，就该动作正确性查询单个二值反馈；3) 差异感知熵优化目标仅在查询步更新策略，并按预测-反馈差异自适应缩放权重，差异越大相对权重越大。
AI.result: 多个基准上取得SOTA性能，且所需人工干预更少；在噪声反馈与持续自适应设置下保持鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 将测试时自适应从轨迹级均匀监督细化为动作级关键步监督，可在降低人工干预成本的同时提升优化可靠性并抑制级联误差。

title: One-shot federated unsupervised domain adaptation with Smoothed Knowledge Distillation and teacher refinement
comment: Published in Engineering Applications of Artificial Intelligence, Vol. 167, 113946 (2026). DOI: https://doi.org/10.1016/j.engappai.2026.113946 . Available at: this https URL and Code is available at: this https URL
summary: Federated unsupervised domain adaptation (FUDA) addresses the challenge of adapting models to an unlabeled target domain using decentralized source domains while preserving data privacy. However, existing FUDA methods typically require multiple communication rounds, rely on complex aggregation strategies, and often struggle with noisy pseudo labels and inconsistent source knowledge. To address these challenges, we propose SKD-ETR, a novel one-shot FUDA framework that combines Smoothed Knowledge Distillation (SKD) and Exponential moving average-based Teacher Refinement (ETR). SKD trains a student model on the target domain using smoothed soft pseudo labels generated by the ensemble of source models. This reduces overconfidence, mitigates noise, and improves robustness. ETR further refines each source model by interpolating its parameters toward the student via exponential moving average (EMA), thereby transferring target-domain knowledge back to the teachers. This bidirectional refinement enhances pseudo-label quality and student generalization without additional communication overhead. SKD-ETR eliminates complex aggregation by initializing the student model randomly and performing a single-round distillation process. Extensive experiments on OfficeHome, Office-Caltech, and DomainNet demonstrate that SKD-ETR achieves competitive performance while being communication- and computation-efficient, and robust under noisy supervision. The code for this paper is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: SKD-ETR：单轮联邦无监督域适配框架，用平滑知识蒸馏+EMA教师精化实现隐私保护下的高效跨域迁移。
AI.motivation: 现有联邦无监督域适配（FUDA）方法依赖多轮通信与复杂聚合策略，且受伪标签噪声与源域知识不一致困扰，通信与计算开销大。
AI.method: 学生模型随机初始化，目标域上用源模型集成产生的平滑软伪标签做单轮蒸馏（SKD），降低过自信与噪声；再用EMA将各源模型参数向学生插值（ETR），把目标域知识回流教师，形成双向精化；无需额外通信、无需复杂聚合。
AI.result: 在OfficeHome、Office-Caltech、DomainNet上取得有竞争力精度，通信与计算高效，并在噪声监督下保持鲁棒。
AI.conclusion: 单轮蒸馏+EMA教师精化可在联邦隐私约束下替代多轮复杂聚合，为高效FUDA提供简洁基线。

title: Residual Calibration via Local Feature-Space Refinement
summary: Deep neural networks often struggle to provide reliable confidence estimates, making post-hoc calibration essential for reliable decision-making. Existing post-hoc methods largely rely on score-based transformations, which improve marginal calibration but often fail to capture spatially varying miscalibration in local regions of the learned feature space. To address this gap, we propose Local Adaptive Probability Estimation (LAPE), a post-hoc residual calibration framework. Specifically, LAPE treats the global calibrator output as a stable anchor and refines the individual prediction by leveraging non-parametric local evidence from neighboring calibration samples. As a plug-and-play refinement module, LAPE effectively utilizes the information about feature-space geometry and can reuse the calibration data that are used to construct the global calibrator. Furthermore, we extend LAPE to the setting with multi-view inputs through Cascade Feature Augmentation Fusion (CFAF). Extensive experiments demonstrate that the proposed methods can improve the calibration quality of various existing baselines and remain efficient and robust across different settings.

AI.tldr: LAPE将全局校准器输出作为锚点，利用邻域校准样本的非参数局部证据对单条预测做残差式重校准，并以CFAF扩展到多视图输入。
AI.motivation: 现有事后校准方法多为基于分数的全局变换，只改善边缘校准，难以捕捉特征空间中局部区域的标定偏差。
AI.method: 事后残差校准框架：以全局校准器（如温度缩放等）输出为稳定锚点，在特征空间中检索近邻校准样本，聚合其非参数局部证据对预测概率进行残差修正；作为即插即用模块可复用构建全局校准器所用的校准数据；多视图场景下通过级联特征增强融合（CFAF）扩展。
AI.result: 实验表明该方法在多种现有基线上提升校准质量，且在不同设置下保持高效与鲁棒。
AI.conclusion: 局部自适应的残差式事后校准可弥补全局分数变换的不足，具有即插即用、数据复用与多视图可扩展性。

title: Class-Grounded Batik Captioning under Scarce Text Annotation: Label Retention and Source-Specific Error Propagation
summary: Class labels offer compact supervision for describing cultural-heritage images when expert text annotations are scarce. We investigate a batik-captioning cascade that integrates a LoRA-adapted DINOv2 classifier with Qwen2.5-VL-7B, adapted using LoRA and loaded in 4-bit NF4. A $3\times2$ evaluation combines three captioner conditions with two inference prompts to examine adaptation and predicted-class injection. Across 150 caption-evaluation images, all three injected conditions achieve a ground-truth class-label mention rate of 0.9067. The classifier's separate test yields 96.10% pooled accuracy, with 98.33% on 300 public-source images and 75.76% on 33 local images. Supported-class macro-F1 and balanced accuracy on the local subset are 0.8493 and 0.8302, respectively. The classifier and captioner use separate partitions, and their training--evaluation overlap remains unquantified. Differences in label semantics and training support also affect interpretation of the source-specific accuracy gap. Reference-based caption metrics and image--text compatibility scores produce different model rankings. Qualitative examples show both retention of correctly predicted identities and propagation of classification errors into fluent descriptions. These findings characterize how class conditioning preserves label information and transfers upstream errors into batik captions under scarce text annotation.

AI.tldr: 该文构建"LoRA-DINOv2分类器→Qwen2.5-VL-7B(4-bit NF4+LoRA)描述生成器"的蜡染图像描述级联，用3×2设置研究适配与预测类注入对标签保真度及上游错误传播的影响。
AI.motivation: 文化遗产图像缺乏专家文本标注，仅类别标签可用；需探究类别条件能否在稀缺文本监督下为图像描述保留正确标签信息。
AI.method: LoRA微调DINOv2分类器 + LoRA微调、4-bit NF4量化的Qwen2.5-VL-7B；3种描述器条件×2种推理提示的3×2评估；150张描述评估图像；分类器独立测试（300张公开源+33张本地图像，报告pooled accuracy、macro-F1、balanced accuracy）；对比参考式描述指标与图文兼容性评分。
AI.result: 注入条件下真值类别提及率均为0.9067；分类器池化准确率96.10%（公开源98.33%，本地75.76%），本地子集macro-F1 0.8493、balanced accuracy 0.8302；两类指标给出不同模型排序；定性可见正确身份保留与分类错误向流畅描述传播。
