AI.conclusion: 类别条件化可保留标签信息，但会把上游分类错误转移进描述；分类器与描述器使用独立数据划分、train-eval重叠未量化，源间准确率差异受标签语义与训练支持量影响，结论需谨慎解读。

title: Co^2Gen: Collaboratively Generating Task Plans for Decentralized Multi-Robot and Human Collaboration
summary: Visual Language Action (VLA) models are designed to be generalist robot models that can be implemented across embodiments, tasks and environments. However, their ability to collaborate with other robots and humans remains underexplored. In this work, we propose a framework to automate the generation of multi-robot collaborative data for decentralized VLA training without requiring human teleoperation. Our framework first utilizes a decentralized collaborative planning approach to generate multi-robot collaborative robot plans in the form of an executable function. We then utilize the collaborative plan to produce collaborative demonstration data to finetune VLA models in a decentralized manner. We show that our approach produces demonstration data that when used to finetune VLA models on decentralized collaboration tasks matches the task performance of VLA models finetuned on human-teleoperated collaborative data.

AI.tldr: 提出无需人类遥操作的框架：先用去中心化协同规划生成可执行的多机器人协同计划，再用该计划自动生成协同演示数据，去中心化微调 VLA 模型，性能可匹配人类遥操作数据微调的效果。
AI.motivation: VLA 模型被视为可跨本体、任务与环境通用的机器人模型，但其与其他机器人及人类的协作能力研究不足；同时多机器人协同数据依赖昂贵的人类遥操作采集，规模化困难。
AI.method: 1）去中心化协同规划方法：为多机器人生成以可执行函数形式表达的协同计划；2）利用该计划执行并自动采集协同演示数据；3）以去中心化方式微调 VLA 模型，形成从计划生成到数据生成再到策略训练的自动化闭环。
AI.result: 自动生成的协同演示数据在去中心化协同任务上微调 VLA 后，任务性能与使用人类遥操作协同数据微调的 VLA 相当（匹配水平，摘要未给出定量指标）。
AI.conclusion: 多机器人协同 VLA 数据可被规划器自动生成，替代人类遥操作示范，降低数据成本并支持去中心化协同策略训练；摘要未报告真机部署规模、泛化性与失败案例。

title: AgentDreamer: Agentic 3D Motion Reasoning for Text-Controllable Physics Simulation
summary: We propose AgentDreamer, an agent-guided optimization framework that aligns text instructions with simulated motion through explicit 3D motion planning. Given a text instruction and scene geometry, an off-the-shelf agent translates the instruction into a structured semantic motion prior, specifying what should move, in which direction, and in what temporal order. The agent represents this prior using parametric functions over a series of temporal chunks, yielding dense 3D trajectories. We then optimize the parameters of a differentiable MPM simulator such that its rollout best matches the prior while remaining constrained by the scene dynamics. This allows the agent to provide semantic guidance from language, while the simulator grounds it in physically feasible motion. We further introduce Motion-IG, an information-theoretic metric for text-motion alignment based on masked text recovery. By comparing the likelihood of recovering masked motion-related content with and without the simulated motion, Motion-IG measures the information contributed by the motion beyond that available from the remaining text and scene context. Experiments show that AgentDreamer improves text alignment over video-based guidance, producing simulations that more closely follow the requested physical behavior.

AI.tldr: AgentDreamer 用现成 LLM 智能体把文本指令转成结构化语义运动先验（参数化分段函数→稠密三维轨迹），再通过优化可微 MPM 模拟器参数使仿真轨迹匹配该先验，并引入 Motion-IG 信息论指标衡量运动对文本-运动对齐的贡献。
AI.motivation: 视频引导的文本到运动生成难以精确控制物理行为（如"往哪个方向、按什么顺序动"），且缺少对运动-文本对齐质量的定量度量。
AI.method: 两阶段：①智能体将指令+场景几何解析为语义运动先验（who/direction/temporal order），用时间分块上的参数函数表示，展开为稠密3D轨迹；②以该先验为目标、受场景动力学约束，反向优化可微 MPM 模拟器参数，使其 rollout 匹配先验。另提出 Motion-IG：基于掩码文本恢复的似然增益，量化仿真运动带来的额外信息量。
AI.result: 实验显示相比视频引导基线，AgentDreamer 提升文本对齐度，生成更符合所要求物理行为的仿真结果；Motion-IG 提供了可解释的对齐度量。
AI.conclusion: 语言语义引导 + 可微物理求解是实现可控物理仿真的有效路径，但证据主要为定性/指标级提升，缺少真实机器人验证与代码开源信息。

title: Zero-Shot Domain Generalization via Domain Prompt Learning
summary: Domain generalization (DG) aims to improve the generalization of the model to any unseen domains. Targeting this goal, existing DG methods mainly focus on learning domain-invariant features or prompts from the given source domains. However, these methods rely on source-domain data, and collecting and annotating large-scale single- or multi-source datasets is often infeasible, limiting the practical applicability of DG. To tackle this challenge, we propose {\underline{Do}}main \underline{P}rompt Learning (DoP), a method built on a large vision-language model (e.g., CLIP) for zero-shot domain generalization, which recognizes unseen classes in unseen target domains without access to source-domain data. DoP essentially learns the target domain knowledge via prompt both in text and visual modalities to overcome the domain shift in text-visual modalities under the test-time adaptation formulation. Specifically, DoP first takes text domain learning (TDL) to simulate various distribution shifts by learning diverse style tokens implicitly in the text space with inter-style diversity loss and intra-style consistency loss. Subsequently, DoP employs visual domain learning (VDL) to further refine the target-domain-relevant style token generated by TDL by making use of the test visual data with self-supervised learning. Extensive experiments on popular DG benchmark datasets (e.g., PACS, VLCS, OfficeHome, and DomainNet) and ImageNet show that our DoP consistently outperforms the state-of-the-art DG approaches. Codes are available at: this https URL .

AI.tldr: DoP：基于CLIP的零样本域泛化方法，无需源域数据，在测试时通过文本域学习（多样风格token + inter-style diversity/intra-style consistency损失）与视觉域学习（自监督精修风格token）实现目标域自适应。
AI.motivation: 现有域泛化（DG）方法依赖源域数据学习域不变特征或prompt，但大规模单/多源数据集的采集与标注常不可行，限制了DG的实际可用性。作者希望在无法访问源域数据的条件下，对未见目标域中的未见类别实现零样本域泛化。
AI.method: 构建于大型视觉-语言模型（如CLIP）之上，采用测试时自适应框架，在文本与视觉两个模态上学习目标域知识，以克服文本-视觉模态的域偏移。1）文本域学习（TDL）：在文本空间隐式学习多样风格token来模拟各类分布偏移，并配以inter-style diversity loss与intra-style consistency loss；2）视觉域学习（VDL）：利用测试视觉数据以自监督方式进一步精修TDL生成的与目标域相关的风格token。
AI.result: 在PACS、VLCS、OfficeHome、DomainNet等主流DG基准及ImageNet上，DoP一致优于当前SOTA域泛化方法。代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: 通过文本+视觉双模态的prompt学习，可在无源域数据的测试时自适应设定下有效实现零样本域泛化，为该场景提供了可行且效果领先的方案。

title: LoRA Superposition across Pretrained Models
summary: Low-rank adaptation (LoRA) is usually tied to the pretrained backbone on which it is learned. We ask whether LoRAs trained independently for the same task on different pretrained backbones can be summed and applied unchanged to all contributing backbones. We call this construction LoRA superposition. Across seven ViT-B/16 CLIP backbones and eight image-classification tasks, the exact sum improves all 56 backbone-task pairs and achieves a mean accuracy gain of 30.21 percentage points over the unadapted backbone. The exact sum achieves a mean accuracy only 0.28 percentage points below that of individually trained solo LoRAs. In contrast, a leave-one-model-out (LOMO) sum produces a mean gain of only 0.06 percentage points over the unadapted backbones. Backbone-specific solo LoRAs are nearly orthogonal in parameter space, while pairwise cross-backbone responses are strongly concentrated on the diagonal. These results support a component-wise non-interference hypothesis, under which the frozen backbone acts as an implicit selector of its own component without explicit routing or cross-model alignment.

AI.tldr: 在不同预训练骨干上独立训练的同一任务LoRA可以直接相加并原样应用到所有参与骨干，这一"LoRA叠加"在7个CLIP ViT-B/16与8个分类任务的全部56组合上均有效，见结果。
AI.motivation: LoRA通常与学习它的预训练骨干绑定，作者想探究同一任务在不同骨干上独立训练的LoRA能否求和后无缝迁移到所有贡献骨干，从而避免逐骨干存储与路由。
AI.method: 构造LoRA superposition：在7个ViT-B/16 CLIP骨干上分别独立训练8个图像分类任务的LoRA，将其精确求和后不改变地应用到各骨干；与单独训练的solo LoRA、留一模型(LOMO)求和做对照，并分析参数空间正交性与跨骨干响应分布。
AI.result: 精确求和在全部56个骨干-任务对上均提升性能，平均比未适配骨干高30.21个百分点，仅比各自solo LoRA低0.28个百分点；而LOMO求和仅带来0.06个百分点增益。solo LoRA在参数空间近乎正交，跨骨干两两响应强烈集中于对角线。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持"组件互不干扰"假设：冻结骨干充当隐式选择器，自动选出属于自身的组件，无需显式路由或跨模型对齐。

title: Live Thread Reconstruction for Autonomous Manipulation
summary: Autonomous robotic surgery has drawn increased attention in recent years due to its potential to relieve surgeons of time-consuming, mentally straining, and tedious tasks, particularly during prolonged operations. One suitable task for automation is suturing, which involves tracking the thread as it deforms during needle retrieval, de-tangling, knot tightening, and other tasks. Unlike rigid-object manipulation, deformable thread manipulation has no fixed pose to track and effectively infinite degrees of freedom, making its configuration difficult to predict and requiring the thread's state to be re-estimated rather than assumed. At the same time, thread manipulations involve sequential motions that depend on past and current thread contact points, which must be accurately and continuously tracked. This paper presents an image-to-manipulation pipeline that concurrently generates live thread reconstruction while conducting safe and optimized sequential manipulations to achieve long-horizon tasks.

AI.tldr: 面向缝线等可变形线状物体的机器人自动化缝合：提出“图像到操作”一体化管线，在连续执行长时序顺序操作的同时在线重建缝线形状（无需固定位姿假设），实现检索、解缠、收紧线结等任务。
AI.motivation: 自主手术机器人可减轻外科医生在长时间手术中的耗时、精神负荷大且重复性强的任务；缝合中的线状物体（缝线）在针回收、解缠、打结收紧过程中持续变形，与刚体操作不同，其无固定位姿、自由度近似无限，状态必须持续重估计而不能固化为假设；同时线操作是依赖历史与当前接触点的顺序动作，需精确、连续跟踪。
AI.method: 构建实时的图像到操作（image-to-manipulation）闭环管线：由图像持续进行缝线重建/状态估计，并将估计结果输入安全且优化后的顺序操作策略，使重建与操作并发进行，以支撑长时序任务。
AI.result: 摘要未给出量化结果；声称可在并发重建的前提下安全、优化地完成针检索、解缠、线结收紧等顺序操作并支持长时序任务（缺乏实验数据支持）。
AI.conclusion: 提出了将可变形缝线的在线状态估计与顺序操作规划耦合的思路，思路与可变形物体操作研究相邻；但摘要信息不足（无具体重建方法、控制表示、实验与真实验证），价值需以全文实验判断。

title: ParaLin++: Accelerating Parallel Diffusion Integrator via Intrinsic Partially Linear Structure
summary: Training-free few-step samplers are often described as nearly quality-lossless under conventional FID/CLIP-style evaluation. It remains unclear whether that conclusion transfers to more realistic and complex generation-quality benchmarks. We first systematize the quality metrics used to evaluate training-free sampling acceleration for diffusion and flow-matching models. We find that representative training-free step-shortening methods often remain nearly lossless under FID/CLIP-class metrics, yet can suffer substantial quality degradation when evaluated with semantic-composition, dense-instruction, and long-text-rendering benchmarks such as GenEval, DPG-Bench, and LongTextBench. Parallel sampling is a notable exception: by retaining the full-step discretization and removing only the solver's temporal dependency, it can preserve near-lossless quality while accelerating sampling. Building on this observation, we propose \textit{ParaLin++}, a step-parity parallel sampler that preserves the full-step discretization while accelerating the solver iterations. Experiments across Stable Diffusion-v2, LSUN Church, FLUX.1-dev, and Ming-Flash-Omni 2.0 show that ParaLin++ preserves the full-step Euler quality profile at $2.6\times$--$4.8\times$, $1.68\times$ on FLUX, and $1.21\times$ on Ming. Project page: this https URL .

AI.tldr: 系统梳理扩散/流匹配模型免训练采样加速的质量评测指标，发现少步方法在FID/CLIP类指标下"近乎无损"的结论在语义组合、密集指令、长文本渲染等基准下不成立；并行采样因保留全步离散化而近乎无损，据此提出步一致性并行采样器ParaLin++，在SD-v2、LSUN Church、FLUX.1-dev等上实现2.6×–4.8×（FLUX 1.68×、Ming 1.21×）加速并保持全步Euler质量。
AI.motivation: 现有文献普遍以FID/CLIP类指标宣称免训练少步采样"几乎无损"，但该结论可能无法迁移到更贴近真实使用场景的复杂生成质量基准；同时需要弄清为何并行采样能在加速的同时保住质量，从而指导更优的加速器设计。
AI.method: 先对免训练采样加速的质量评测指标做系统化梳理与对比实验，覆盖FID/CLIP类指标与GenEval、DPG-Bench、LongTextBench等语义/指令/长文本基准；识别出并行采样保留全步离散化、仅去除求解器时间依赖这一关键性质，进而提出ParaLin++：一种保持全步离散化的步一致性（step-parity）并行采样器，加速求解器迭代而非缩短步数。
AI.result: 代表性少步方法在FID/CLIP类指标下近乎无损，但在语义组合、密集指令与长文本渲染基准上出现显著质量退化；并行采样是显著例外。ParaLin++在Stable Diffusion-v2、LSUN Church上实现2.6×–4.8×加速，FLUX.1-dev 1.68×、Ming-Flash-Omni 2.0 1.21×，且保持全步Euler的质量分布。
AI.conclusion: "少步加速≈无损"的结论依赖于评测指标的选取，需用语义与指令遵循类基准重新审视加速器；保留全步离散化、仅并行化求解器迭代是兼顾加速与质量的更可靠路径，ParaLin++提供了可复用的步一致性并行采样框架。

title: PhyEvolve: Multi-Agent State-Evolution Planning for Physics-Aware Video Generation
summary: Recent advances in text-to-video generation have substantially improved visual fidelity, yet existing models still struggle to understand the physical evolution implicit in user prompts, making it difficult to generate videos with continuous physical state evolution. Here, we propose PhyEvolve, a multi-agent framework that enhances natural-language prompts through structured state-evolution planning. PhyEvolve consists of three agents: a Director, a Physical Evolver, and a Composer. Given a user prompt and an optional first frame, the Director grounds the scene and disentangles physical events from observation changes. The Physical Evolver uses scene evidence to identify physical mechanisms then constructs causally linked state transitions that unfold throughout the video, whether visible or not. The Composer utilizes these transitions to enhance the original prompts. Without retraining or model modification, PhyEvolve works directly with existing generators through prompt replacement. Extensive experiments on four major benchmarks show that PhyEvolve achieves state-of-the-art performance, outperforming the cutting-edge prior agentic baseline by 7.9 percentage points on average. These results demonstrate that explicit causal state-evolution planning improves physical consistency and state continuity in generated videos through natural-language prompt enhancement.

AI.tldr: PhyEvolve：多智能体（Director/Physical Evolver/Composer）通过结构化物理状态演化规划增强文本提示，无需重训练即可提升现成视频生成模型的物理一致性与状态连续性，四个基准平均超越前沿agentic基线7.9个百分点。
AI.motivation: 现有文生视频模型视觉保真度已较高，但难以理解用户提示中隐含的物理演化过程，导致生成的视频缺乏连续的物理状态演变。
AI.method: 三智能体框架：Director 依据用户提示与可选首帧进行场景落地并将物理事件与观测变化解耦；Physical Evolver 借助场景证据识别物理机制，构建贯穿全片、因果关联的状态转移（含不可见状态）；Composer 用这些转移改写原始提示。仅做提示替换，不重训练、不改模型。
AI.result: 在四个主流基准上取得SOTA，平均比最强agentic基线高7.9个百分点，物理一致性与状态连续性均有提升。
AI.conclusion: 显式的因果状态演化规划可作为通用提示增强手段，低成本地改善视频生成的物理合理性。

title: Learning from Next-Frame Prediction: Towards Unified and Scalable Visual Representation Learning
summary: Video provides a natural source of supervision: what happens next serves as a learning signal for visual world modeling. Yet masked video pretraining focuses on recovering missing content from surrounding context rather than predicting the future from the past. Autoregressive methods instead predict forward one token at a time, but have yet to match joint-embedding methods in representation quality. This gap motivates us to revisit the granularity and space of future prediction. In this work, we introduce VANE, a self-supervised visual pretraining framework built on next-frame prediction in embedding space. A causal encoder summarizes past observations for a state predictor that infers the representation of the entire next frame, making temporal evolution the primary learning signal. This prediction is carried out in a fixed embedding space provided by a frozen semantic tokenizer, emphasizing scene content and structure. To retain fine-grained spatial detail alongside semantic content, a lightweight auxiliary generative decoder reconstructs future-frame patches conditioned on the predicted representations. To unify visual modeling across images and videos, we construct a local-to-global crop sequence for still images, allowing the same encoder to predict newly revealed regions from earlier crops under the same objective. Experiments show that VANE improves with model and data scaling, achieving SOTA on most anticipation, recognition, and dense perception benchmarks among unified encoders. Especially on EPIC-KITCHENS-100 action anticipation, it surpasses V-JEPA 2.1 by 7.1 points in mean-class recall@5. These results demonstrate that next-frame prediction in embedding space is effective and scalable for visual world modeling.

AI.tldr: 提出 VANE 自监督视觉预训练框架：以冻结语义 tokenizer 的嵌入空间做整帧级“下一帧预测”，因果编码器汇总历史、状态预测器推断下一帧表示，辅以轻量生成解码器恢复空间细节，并将静图转为local-to-global裁剪序列统一图像视频建模。
AI.motivation: 掩码视频预训练侧重由上下文补全缺失内容，而非由过去预测未来；自回归方法逐token前向预测但表示质量逊于联合嵌入方法。作者据此重新审视未来预测的粒度（整帧 vs token）与空间（语义嵌入空间 vs 像素空间）。
AI.method: 在冻结语义tokenizer提供的固定嵌入空间中做next-frame prediction：因果编码器总结过去观测，状态预测器推断整个下一帧的表示；轻量辅助生成解码器以预测表示为条件重建未来帧patch以保留细粒度空间细节；静图通过local-to-global裁剪序列构造因果序列，用同一目标预测新揭示区域，实现图像/视频统一。
AI.result: 随模型与数据规模扩展性能提升；在统一编码器中于多数anticipation、recognition及dense perception基准取得SOTA；EPIC-KITCHENS-100动作预测上平均类recall@5较V-JEPA 2.1提升7.1点。
AI.conclusion: 嵌入空间中的整帧级下一帧预测是有效且可扩展的视觉世界建模范式，兼顾语义预测性与空间细节，并可统一图像与视频自监督预训练。

title: SmolVLA-MoE: Sparse Mixture-of-Experts for Efficient Multi-Task Robotic Manipulation
comment: 16 pages, 5 figures, 4 tables; conference paper prepared for IROS2027
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have shown promising results in multi-task robotic manipulation by leveraging visual and language understanding for action generation. However, existing lightweight VLA models employ a single dense action expert to handle all tasks, which limits their multi-task capability under constrained computational budgets. To address this issue, we propose SmolVLA-MoE, a novel framework that introduces sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) into the FFN layers of the action expert in VLA models. SmolVLA-MoE replaces dense FFN layers with multiple parallel expert FFNs and a token-level router, enabling each token to adaptively select the most suitable expert for action generation. We further introduce a shared expert with a tunable weight parameter to balance the inheritance of pre-trained capabilities and task-specific expert specialization. Through sparse activation, SmolVLA-MoE activates only a single expert FFN during inference, with a total activated parameter count of approximately 500M including the frozen VLM backbone, while benefiting from approximately 800M total stored parameters. We evaluate our method on four task suites of the LIBERO benchmark. SmolVLA-MoE achieves an average success rate of 84.25%, outperforming SmolVLA (82.75%) and OpenVLA-7B (76.5%), while maintaining comparable inference efficiency. Our code is publicly available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: SmolVLA-MoE 在轻量 VLA 的动作专家 FFN 层引入稀疏 Mixture-of-Experts，配合 token 级路由与可调权重的共享专家，约 500M 激活参数下在 LIBERO 四套任务上取得 84.25% 平均成功率。
AI.motivation: 轻量 VLA 模型受算力预算约束，普遍采用单一稠密动作专家处理所有任务，导致多任务能力受限；希望在不显著增加推理成本的前提下提升多任务表现与任务特化能力。
AI.method: 将动作专家的稠密 FFN 替换为多个并行的专家 FFN 加 token 级路由器；引入带可调权重参数的共享专家，以平衡预训练能力继承与任务特化；推理时每个 token 仅激活单个专家 FFN，实现稀疏激活（总存储约 800M 参数，激活约 500M，含冻结 VLM 主干）。
AI.result: 在 LIBERO 的四个任务套件上平均成功率达 84.25%，优于 SmolVLA 的 82.75% 与 OpenVLA-7B 的 76.5%，推理效率基本持平。
AI.conclusion: 在轻量 VLA 中引入稀疏 MoE 是提升多任务操作性能的高性价比路径，可在几乎不牺牲推理效率的情况下获得稳定增益；但仅报告仿真基准结果，缺少真机验证与更大规模泛化实验。

title: When One Step Is Enough: An Empirical Study of Euler Integration in Flow-Matching Policies
comment: Accepted at the 10th Conference on Robot Learning (CoRL 2026)
summary: Flow matching is now the dominant approach for vision-language action (VLA) robot policies, thanks to its expressiveness and simple training objective. However, inference for standard flow matching requires iteratively solving an ODE, limiting the control frequency at deployment. While several works have proposed novel methods to allow for single-shot action generation, we ask whether such additional objectives are actually necessary. We find that across six flow matching VLAs, one-step action generation largely matches multi-step sampling at scale: multi-step integration confers little to no consistent advantage at inference. We empirically find that this holds as long as models are sufficiently trained and have enough capacity. Practically, the implication is that for large VLAs, the single-step policy comes essentially for free from the multi-step model, enabling low-latency deployment without retraining, distillation, or auxiliary objectives.

AI.tldr: 研究发现，大规模训练充分的流匹配VLA策略无需额外目标，单步推理即可基本达到多步ODE积分的性能，可直接低延迟部署。
AI.motivation: 流匹配VLA虽表达力强、训练简单，但推理需迭代求解ODE，限制部署时的控制频率；已有的单步生成方法引入了额外目标与复杂度，作者质疑这些额外设计是否必要。
AI.method: 对六个流匹配VLA模型做系统性实证对比：单步生成 vs. 多步ODE积分，并分析模型训练充分度与容量对结论的影响。
AI.result: 在规模足够、训练充分且容量充足的模型上，单步动作生成与多步采样性能相当，多步积分在推理时几乎没有一致优势，且该结论跨六个模型成立。
AI.conclusion: 大VLA可直接从多步模型获得近乎免费的单步策略，无需重训、蒸馏或辅助目标即可实现低延迟部署；对追求推理效率的VLA研究具有较强实践指导意义，但缺乏真实机器人部署层面的系统性证据。

title: Causal Analysis of Failures of Cyber-Physical Systems with Continuous Inputs
summary: Modern autonomous Cyber-Physical Systems (CPSs), such as self-driving cars, operate in increasingly complex environments while expected to maintain high reliability. The black-box nature of many of these systems makes it impossible to fully verify their behavior prior to deployment. When a failure occurs, it is important to analyze it to guide improvements to system robustness. A recent work introduced the novel concept of leveraging the framework of actual causality for CPS failure explanation. However, that work considered only a discrete, binary causal model that cannot capture continuous changes in system inputs. In this paper, we address these limitations by extending the actual causality framework with the notion of distance to account for the continuous characteristics of the system. Specifically, we introduce the novel concepts of distance-weighted actual cause and distance-weighted degree of responsibility, enabling causal influence to account for the magnitude of changes required to avoid a failure, rather than only its cardinality. While motivated by the continuous nature of CPSs, this constitutes a general extension of the theory of actual causality and enables more fine-grained analysis of continuous inputs in any causal model. Building on these notions, we present an efficient, practical, system-agnostic explanation-derivation algorithm that uses distance-weighted responsibility to guide the explanation search. We experimentally evaluate our approach across a number of environments from two autonomous-driving simulators with black-box neural controllers. The results show that the proposed extension provides more effective guidance than the current discrete approach.

AI.tldr: 将实际因果框架从离散二值扩展为带距离权重的连续因果模型，提出距离加权实际原因与距离加权责任度，并给出系统无关的失败解释推导算法，在自动驾驶仿真器黑盒神经控制器上验证。
AI.motivation: 现有基于实际因果（actual causality）的CPS失败解释工作仅使用离散二值因果模型，无法刻画系统输入的连续变化幅度，导致解释粒度粗、指导性弱。
AI.method: 引入“距离”概念扩展实际因果理论：定义distance-weighted actual cause与distance-weighted degree of responsibility，用避免失败所需的输入改变幅度（而非仅改变的因素个数）衡量因果影响；并基于距离加权责任度设计高效、系统无关的解释搜索与推导算法。
AI.result: 在两个自动驾驶仿真器的多个环境、黑盒神经网络控制器上实验，距离加权扩展相较原始离散方法提供更有效的解释搜索指导。
AI.conclusion: 该工作是对实际因果理论的一般性扩展，可用于任意因果模型中连续输入的细粒度分析，并实际改善CPS失败解释的质量与效率。

title: Where Did the Light Come From? Diagnosing Cast-Shadow Reasoning in VLMs and Borrowing the Missing Shadow Prior from Image Generation Models
summary: Shadows are observable consequences of latent physical causes, arising from the interaction between illumination, object geometry, and scene structure. A model that understands shadows should be able not only to read a shadow's direction, but also to infer where a shadow should fall when it is absent, and to judge whether a shadow is physically consistent with the scene. We introduce ShadowBench, built from real photographs, which poses these three questions to vision-language models (VLMs). From each scene, we build a correct-shadow, a shadow-removed, and a human-annotated wrong-direction state. Evaluating 19 open VLMs (2B to 78B) and frontier proprietary models, we find that VLMs read a visible shadow's direction well above chance and improve with scale, yet infer the absent direction only weakly and fall to chance at judging physical consistency even under a bias-free two-alternative test that removes the yes-bias of single-image naturalness questions. Only Gemini-3.1-pro exceeds chance on validity, and even then only modestly and far below humans. Chain-of-Thought (CoT) does not help. The missing ingredient is not reasoning but knowledge that image generation models (IGMs) already hold. Routing a VLM through an IGM lifts its inference well above its direct attempt and helps it flag the wrong-direction shadows it otherwise accepts. Cast-shadow direction is a single facet of illumination understanding, but the sharp gap it reveals between VLMs and IGMs suggests image-generation or reconstruction objectives as a route toward illumination-aware VLMs.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 ShadowBench 基准（基于真实照片，涵盖正确阴影、去除阴影、错误方向阴影三种状态），系统评估 19 个开源 VLM 与前沿闭源模型理解投射阴影方向及物理一致性的能力，发现 VLM 强于读方向、弱于推断与校验，并提出经由图像生成模型（IGM）路由来弥补知识缺口。
AI.motivation: 阴影是光照、几何与场景结构交互的可观测结果；一个理解阴影的模型应能读方向、推断缺失阴影位置、判断阴影物理一致性。作者希望量化 VLM 在这三方面的能力差距，并探究差距来源是推理不足还是知识缺失。
AI.method: 构建 ShadowBench：从真实场景为每张图生成三种状态（正确阴影、去阴影、人工标注错误方向阴影）。设计三问任务评测 19 个开源 VLM（2B–78B）与闭源前沿模型，采用无偏二选一测试消除单图自然性判断的 yes-bias；测试 CoT 提示效果；并提出将 VLM 路由至图像生成模型（IGM）以借用其光照知识。
AI.result: VLM 读取可见阴影方向显著高于随机并随规模提升，但推断缺失阴影方向仅微弱有效；物理一致性判断在无偏二选一下退化至随机水平，仅 Gemini-3.1-pro 略超随机且远低于人类。CoT 无帮助。经 IGM 路由后推断与错误阴影检测均显著改善。
AI.conclusion: VLM 与 IGM 在阴影/光照理解上存在明显差距，缺的是知识而非推理；图像生成或重建目标可能是通向光照感知 VLM 的路径，同时给出可诊断的基准工具。

title: FilmFlow: Agentic System for 3D Virtual Film Cinematography
summary: Complex camera motion is central to visual storytelling, yet translating cinematographic intent into controllable, executable camera trajectories remains challenging. We introduce FilmFlow, an agentic framework that converts natural-language instructions or reference videos into explicit camera trajectories for dynamic 3D environments. To generate these trajectories, a Director agent constructs executable camera plans by composing high-level motions from concurrent atomic operations that jointly control translation, rotation, and framing. The Director is supported by three specialized agents: an Interpreter that extracts scene-grounded cinematographic intent, a Scout that selects initial viewpoints, and a Critic that evaluates rendered results and provides visual feedback for iterative plan refinement. We also introduce CinemaBench, comprising 150 Blender scenes from self-created and licensed sources, with five camera instructions per scene for 750 text-directed tasks and 60 reference videos associated with a subset of scenes. CinemaBench supports evaluation of both text-directed camera generation and video reference-directed camera generation. Across a diverse set of evaluated baselines, FilmFlow achieves the strongest benchmark performance and the highest user preference, demonstrating effective spatial reasoning, temporal coordination, and visual composition for executable 3D cinematography.

AI.tldr: FilmFlow：多智能体框架将自然语言指令或参考视频转化为3D动态环境中的显式相机轨迹（Director+Interpreter/Scout/Critic），并发布CinemaBench（150个Blender场景、750条文本任务、60段参考视频）。
AI.motivation: 电影级相机运动是视觉叙事核心，但从电影化意图到可控、可执行的相机轨迹的映射仍很困难，现有方法缺乏显式的轨迹级规划与视觉反馈闭环。
AI.method: Director智能体通过组合并发原子操作（同时控制平移、旋转、构图）生成可执行相机计划；Interpreter提取场景锚定的电影化意图，Scout选择初始视角，Critic评估渲染结果并提供视觉反馈以迭代优化计划。同时构建CinemaBench基准，支持文本引导与视频参考引导两类相机生成评测。
AI.result: 在多种基线对比中取得最强基准表现与最高用户偏好，展示出空间推理、时序协同与视觉构图能力。
AI.conclusion: 智能体式规划+渲染反馈闭环可有效实现可执行的3D电影摄影；基准与框架可作为可控相机生成的研究平台。

title: Evaluation of Front-End Feature Matching for Lunar Visual SLAM
comment: 16 pages, 8 figures, 5 tables. Submitted to the 2027 IEEE Aerospace Conference
summary: Lunar rovers will primarily rely on cameras for localization until navigation satellite services are deployed, and will continue to need them afterwards for relative navigation, hazard detection, and surface operations. Visual odometry (VO) and Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (SLAM) mostly estimate motion by matching features between frames. However, feature matchers are developed on urban, indoor and driving scenes, planetary studies compare them on orbital registration or within complete SLAM systems, and real lunar imagery with reference poses is scarce, so matching between rover frames on low-texture, harshly lit terrain, and its effect on VO, has not been compared. We benchmark eleven classical and learned detector-matcher combinations on nine synthetic, lunar-testbed, and terrestrial-analogue datasets, and a feature tracker, scoring pairwise pose accuracy against baseline and the trajectory error of the resulting VO. Under a common rotation-only metric, the SuperPoint pairings outperform SIFT with ratio-tested FLANN matching on both lunar testbeds and one analogue site, with smaller or unresolved differences on synthetic data. When rotation and translation direction are scored jointly, this SIFT pairing exceeds both SuperPoint pairings on four synthetic datasets, so synthetic results alone do not establish relative performance on real rover imagery. In stereo VO, the SuperPoint pairings are not consistently more accurate than SIFT, but only they keep tracking on all eight sequential datasets. Pairings with classical detectors depend on lighting while SuperPoint changes little: a low spotlight makes them more accurate than diffuse light on the same testbed views, consistent with more contrast and detected keypoints. SuperPoint with LightGlue is the fastest learned combination (16 ms per frame), and DINOv2 retrieval proposals still need geometric verification.

AI.tldr: 该文在9个合成、月面试验场与地球类比数据集上基准测试11种经典与学习型特征检测-匹配器组合，比较成对位姿精度与视觉里程计轨迹误差。SuperPoint类组合在月面低纹理场景更优，但联合评分时SIFT在合成数据更好；立体VO中仅SuperPoint类能在全部8个序列上持续跟踪。属于特征匹配/视觉里程计的基准评估研究。
AI.motivation: 月球车在导航卫星服务部署前主要依赖相机定位，之后仍需相机做相对导航、障碍检测与表面作业。VO/SLAM多依赖帧间特征匹配，但现有特征匹配器多在城市场景、室内和驾驶场景上开发，行星研究多在轨道配准或完整SLAM系统内比较，且缺乏带参考位姿的真实月面影像，因此低纹理、强光照下的月球车帧间匹配及其对VO的影响尚未被系统比较。
AI.method: 在九个数据集（合成月面、月面试验场、地球类比场地）上对十一种经典与学习型检测器-匹配器组合以及一个特征跟踪器进行基准测试；以成对相对位姿精度（分别用旋转单一指标和旋转+平移方向联合指标）对基线评分，并评估所得VO的轨迹误差；另测试立体VO下的连续跟踪能力，以及不同光照条件（聚光灯 vs 漫射光）对匹配精度的影响。
AI.result: 在旋转单一指标下，SuperPoint类组合在两个月面试验场与一个类比场地上优于带比值检验FLANN匹配的SIFT，合成数据上差异更小或未决；在旋转+平移方向联合评分下，SIFT组合在四个合成数据集上优于两种SuperPoint组合，说明仅靠合成数据不足以确定真实月面影像上的相对性能。立体VO中SuperPoint组合并非持续更准，但只有它们能在全部八个序列上保持跟踪。经典检测器组合依赖光照，而SuperPoint变化很小：同一试验场视角下低角度聚光灯使其更准，与对比度更高及检测到的关键点更多一致。SuperPoint+LightGlue是速度最快的学习型组合（16 ms/帧），DINOv2检索候选仍需几何验证。
AI.conclusion: 合成数据与真实月面类比场景上的特征匹配排序不一致，评估必须使用接近真实的光照与纹理条件；SuperPoint类组合在真实/类比影像及鲁棒跟踪上更有优势且对光照不敏感，而SIFT在特定联合度量下仍具竞争力。研究为月球车视觉定位的特征匹配器选型与后续VO系统设计提供了有条件的实证依据。

title: DeXplicit: Making Physical State Explicit in Dexterous Manipulation World Models
summary: Before acting on an object, a robot needs to anticipate how its hand motion will change the physical world and what the resulting scene will look like. Existing approaches typically entangle action-conditioned dynamics, camera motion, and visual synthesis within a video generation model, or represent dynamics as point trajectories without explicit object structure. We introduce DeXplicit, a dexterous manipulation world model that instead predicts how the world evolves explicitly in metric 3D before rendering its visual consequences. Given an initial scene and a future hand trajectory, a lightweight 3D dynamics network predicts object-centric motion and deformation, providing structured and geometrically grounded future world states. These predictions then serve as a strong scaffold for video generation: appearance is transported through the predicted 3D motion and projected into future views, allowing the renderer to focus on completing uncertain and newly visible content rather than implicitly learning world dynamics from pixels. This explicit-3D-first decomposition also enables efficient causal generation, requiring only two denoising steps per block while conditioning on generated history. Across HOT3D, OakInk2, and PhysTwin, DeXplicit reduces moved-point error by 27-40% relative to PointWorld and improves object fidelity IoU+ by 47% on HOT3D under a shared renderer. Our design with two-step causal generation achieves a 57x speedup from our 14B bi-directional configuration in video synthesis.

AI.tldr: DeXplicit 是一个"显式3D优先"的灵巧操作世界模型：先用轻量3D动力学网络在度量空间预测物体中心的运动与形变，再将外观沿预测的3D运动传输并投影到未来视角，最后用仅两步去噪的因果视频生成器补全新可见区域。
AI.motivation: 现有机器人预测模型把动作驱动动力学、相机运动与视觉合成纠缠在视频生成模型中，或仅用点轨迹表示动力学而缺乏显式物体结构，导致几何不 grounding、推理代价高。
AI.method: 输入初始场景 + 未来手轨迹；轻量3D动力学网络预测以物体为中心的运动与形变，得到结构化、几何一致的三维未来状态；以此作为视频生成的"脚手架"，将外观沿3D运动传输并投影至未来视角，渲染器只需补全不确定与新可见内容；采用显式3D优先分解实现因果生成（每块仅2步去噪，条件于已生成历史），并与14B双向配置对比。
AI.result: 在HOT3D、OakInk2、PhysTwin上，相对PointWorld降低运动点误差27–40%；共享渲染器下HOT3D物体保真度IoU+提升47%；两步因果生成相对14B双向配置取得57倍视频合成加速。
AI.conclusion: 将世界演化预测与视觉合成解耦、先显式3D后渲染，可同时提升几何精度、物体保真度与生成效率，为灵巧手-物交互世界模型提供了可扩展到实时因果生成的范式。

title: EBV-CAN: Vision--Language Grounding for Contact-Aided Endoscope Navigation
summary: Flexible endoscopes exploit structural compliance to traverse narrow lumens, pipes, and cavities, where navigation involves distributed environmental contact. This compliance makes tip motion depend on the evolving support configuration. We present external bird's-eye-view contact-aided navigation (EBV-CAN), a vision-language policy that combines one initial global static bird's-eye image with evolving endoscopic observations and motor state. Three supervised semantic queries locate the tip, next waypoint, and instructed target on the cached global image; their residual representations predict bending and insertion commands. We introduce the Vision-Language Contact-Aided (VLCA) dataset, linking 517 demonstrations and 75k action samples to 958k spatial entries and 93k remaining-route records. On 50 held-out episodes, tip-coordinate and waypoint localization reach 97.5% and 94.8%. Swapping the target instruction under identical observations changes target attention and motor output across 17 dual-target episodes. Across 1,920 physical trials of eight policies trained under a shared protocol, EBV-CAN achieves 183/240 successes (76.25%) under automatic blue-area scoring. Gated recurrent unit behavior cloning (GRU-BC) achieves the lowest matched-task offline mean absolute error (MAE), 0.056, and 1/240 physical successes, establishing distinct rankings for action imitation and task completion. Successful multi-guide executions and representative failures connect spatial progress, steering transitions, and visibility to physical navigation.

AI.tldr: 提出EBV-CAN：用一张初始鸟瞰全局图像加实时内窥镜观测与电机状态，通过三个监督式语义查询定位镜尖、下一路标与指令目标，预测弯曲/插入动作的视觉-语言策略；并构建VLCA数据集。
AI.motivation: 柔性内窥镜因结构柔顺，其尖端运动依赖不断变化的环境接触支撑构型，传统端到端策略难以显式利用全局空间参照与接触状态，需要一种能融合全局鸟瞰先验与局部 endoscopic 观测、并响应语言指令的导航方法。
AI.method: EBV-CAN：缓存一张初始全局鸟瞰静态图，结合演化中的内窥镜图像与电机状态；在全局图上执行三个有监督语义查询（镜尖、下一路标、语言指定目标），用其残差表征回归弯曲与插入命令，形成视觉-语言策略。构建VLCA数据集（517条演示、75k动作样本、958k空间条目光、93k剩余路径记录）；并在统一协议下训练8个策略进行1,920次实体试验对比，含GRU-BC基线。
AI.result: 50个held-out回合中镜尖坐标与路标定位分别达97.5%与94.8%；17个双目标回合中仅替换语言指令即可改变目标注意力与电机输出；实体试验中EBV-CAN成功183/240（76.25%），而离线MAE最低的GRU-BC（0.056）实体成功率仅1/240，说明动作模仿精度与任务完成度排名不同。
AI.conclusion: 将局部观测与全局鸟瞰图通过语义查询对齐、并以残差方式驱动动作，可有效处理接触主导的柔顺机器人导航；同时揭示离线行为克隆误差不能可靠反映实体任务成功率，需以真实导航指标评估。

title: WovenAnchor Matcher: Specialized Intra- and Inter-Image Context Modeling for Feature Matching
summary: Semi-dense local feature matching commonly aggregates contextual information before coarse-to-fine correspondence estimation. However, intra-image and inter-image aggregation serve different roles: the former should propagate spatial evidence within each image while retaining structured two-dimensional dependencies, whereas the latter should gather information from plausible corresponding regions while limiting noise from unrelated locations. We propose WovenAnchor Matcher (WAM), a semi-dense matching framework based on role-specialized context aggregation. WAM introduces two complementary operators. WovenMamba performs intra-image aggregation through horizontal-then-vertical state-space propagation, allowing vertical updates to operate on horizontally contextualized features and thereby encouraging a structured two-dimensional receptive-field bias. AnchorCrossAttention performs inter-image aggregation by using cross-attention to gather context from plausible corresponding regions across the image pair. It performs this exchange over local representative anchors that aggregate feature evidence within each window. On MegaDepth, WAM achieves 66.1 pose AUC@5$^\circ$, improving on the JamMa baseline by 2.0 AUC points under the same evaluation setup. Ablations show that removing or replacing either specialized component reduces accuracy, providing evidence that intra-image propagation and inter-image retrieval benefit from role-specific aggregation designs. Code and pretrained weights are available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: WAM：角色分工的半稠密匹配框架。WovenMamba用"先水平后垂直"的状态空间传播做图内聚合（结构化2D感受野偏置），AnchorCrossAttention用局部代表锚点做图间交叉注意力检索。MegaDepth上66.1 pose AUC@5°，较JamMa提升2.0。
AI.motivation: 现有半稠密匹配器在粗到细估计前统一聚合上下文，未区分图内上下文传播（需保留结构化二维依赖）与图间信息交换（需从潜在对应区域取信息并抑制无关噪声）两种不同角色，导致聚合设计缺乏针对性。
AI.method: 提出WAM半稠密匹配框架，包含两个互补算子：(1) WovenMamba——以"先水平后垂直"的状态空间扫描顺序做图内聚合，使垂直更新作用在已水平上下文化的特征上，形成结构化的二维感受野偏置；(2) AnchorCrossAttention——在每个窗口内用局部代表锚点聚合特征证据，再在锚点层面做跨图像交叉注意力，从而只在可能对应的区域间交换上下文、限制无关位置噪声。之后接粗到细的对应估计。
AI.result: 在MegaDepth上达到66.1 pose AUC@5°，在相同评测设置下比JamMa基线提升2.0个AUC点。消融表明移除或替换任一专门化模块都会降低精度。
AI.conclusion: 图内传播与图间检索各自受益于角色专门的聚合设计，验证了"角色分工"这一聚合范式的有效性；代码与预训练权重已开源。

title: Adaptive Aerial Loco-Manipulation Policy Learning via LLM-Assisted Proactive Task Generation
summary: Loco-manipulation extends the workspace of conventional manipulation by combining mobility with physical interaction, while aerial loco-manipulation further expands this capability into three-dimensional space, enabling robots to reach environments inaccessible to ground-based systems. Moving to an aerial platform, however, gives rise to a demanding control problem, since the vehicle must track trajectories accurately in three dimensions while the motion of the arm and its interaction with the environment continuously shift the center of mass, alter the inertia, and impose force and moment disturbances on the body. Conventional controllers address these effects through explicit models and estimation, whereas learning-based controllers infer dynamics from experience, yet control rewards provide no direct target for the response information retained from history, and fixed task sampling can leave persistent tracking difficulties insufficiently explored. We present ALMA, an aerial loco-manipulation framework for adaptive flight control under external arm commands. ALMA employs a contextual flight policy that adapts from recent measurements and actions, using action-conditioned prediction of future measurement representations to train its context to retain response information relevant to flight control. To expand the experience available for this adaptation, an evolutionary process uses a large language model (LLM) to analyze observed control difficulties and propose new structures of arm motion for subsequent training. In simulation, ALMA reduces position root-mean-square error (RMSE) by up to 24.7% relative to the strongest baseline, while the same policy transfers zero-shot to the aerial manipulator and reduces hover position RMSE by 79.6% during periodic arm motion relative to the real-world baseline.

AI.tldr: ALMA 提出空中"移动-操作"自适应飞行控制框架:用动作条件预测未来量测表征来训练上下文飞行策略,并用 LLM 驱动的进化式任务结构生成扩展训练经验;仿真位置 RMSE 最高降 24.7%,真机零样本迁移在周期摆臂下悬停 RMSE 降 79.6%。
AI.motivation: 空中机械臂在跟踪三维轨迹时,手臂运动与环境接触会持续改变质心、惯量并引入力/力矩扰动,形成强耦合控制难题。传统控制依赖显式建模与状态估计,学习式控制器虽可从经验推断动力学,但控制奖励无法为历史响应的保留提供直接监督信号,且固定任务采样使持续存在的跟踪难点探索不足。
AI.method: 提出上下文飞行策略(contextual flight policy):以近期量测与动作为条件,通过动作条件预测未来量测表征(action-conditioned prediction of future measurement representations)来塑造隐上下文,使其保留与飞行控制相关的响应信息。训练侧引入进化流程,由 LLM 分析已观测到的控制困难并提出新的手臂运动结构,扩充自适应所需经验分布。
AI.result: 仿真中相对最强基线位置 RMSE 降低至多 24.7%;同一策略零样本迁移至真实空中机械臂,在周期性手臂运动下悬停位置 RMSE 相对真机基线降低 79.6%。
AI.conclusion: 将"表征预测式自监督上下文学习 + LLM 驱动的任务结构进化"结合,可提升空中 loco-manipulation 在外部手臂指令扰动下的自适应飞行控制性能,并具备仿真到真机的零样本迁移能力。

title: DRILL: Training World Models to Improve Policies, Not Predict Pixels
summary: World models are increasingly used to reduce environment interaction when post-training vision-language-action (VLA) policies with reinforcement learning. Yet they are typically trained to predict pixels one step ahead, even though their role here is not merely to render visually faithful videos but to produce learning signals from imagined rollouts that improve the policy. We show that this mismatch is substantial: lower pixel MSE can produce worse policy gradients, and a world model trained for policy utility can yield better downstream policies despite 17% higher pixel MSE on the next frame. We propose the Downstream-Return Imagination Learning Loop (DRILL), a bilevel framework that updates the world model to maximize the policy's return after an inner GRPO update on imagined rollouts. DRILL has two instantiations. DRILL-VWI is a closed-form surrogate, requiring no additional simulator rollouts, that reweights prediction errors by policy visitation, the group-relative GRPO advantage, and model confidence. DRILL-IMG is a full meta-gradient method that differentiates through the inner update using truncated Hessian-vector products. We show that DRILL-VWI recovers the local one-step component of the DRILL-IMG meta-gradient under score-compatibility and small-residual assumptions. Across five manipulation simulators and two VLA backbones, DRILL-IMG raises mean success rate by 13.1 points over WMPO and 7.9 points over RLVR-World, and complements RLVR pretraining rather than competing with it. More broadly, we believe video world models for VLA reinforcement learning can be productively trained by the policy gradients they produce, not only by pixel-level prediction.

AI.tldr: 提出 DRILL 双层框架，用策略在想象 rollout 上的下游回报（而非像素MSE）来训练视频世界模型：DRILL-VWI 为闭式重加权代理，DRILL-IMG 为经截断 Hessian-向量积的元梯度方法。在两套 VLA 主干、五个操作仿真上平均成功率超 WMPO 13.1 点、超 RLVR-World 7.9 点。
AI.motivation: 视频世界模型在 VLA 强化学习后训练中被用于减少真实环境交互，但其训练目标仍是单步像素预测，而实际用途是产生能改进策略的学习信号。作者指出这一错配很显著：更低的像素 MSE 可能给出更差的策略梯度；按策略效用训练的世界模型即使下一帧像素 MSE 高 17%，也能得到更好的下游策略。
AI.method: 将世界模型训练表述为双层优化：内层在想象 rollout 上做 GRPO 更新策略，外层更新世界模型以最大化更新后策略的回报。两种实例化：(1) DRILL-VWI，闭式代理，无需额外仿真 rollout，用策略访问分布、GRPO 组相对优势和模型置信度对预测误差重加权；(2) DRILL-IMG，完整元梯度，用截断 Hessian-向量积穿透内层更新微分。作者证明在 score-compatibility 与小残差假设下，DRILL-VWI 可恢复 DRILL-IMG 元梯度的局部单步分量。
AI.result: 五个操作仿真环境、两个 VLA 主干下，DRILL-IMG 相比 WMPO 平均成功率提升 13.1 个百分点，相比 RLVR-World 提升 7.9 个百分点；且与 RLVR 预训练互补而非竞争（可叠加增益）。实验也量化了像素 MSE 与策略效用之间的弱/负相关。
AI.conclusion: 面向 VLA 强化学习的视频世界模型可以按其产生的策略梯度（下游效用）来训练，而不只按像素级预测训练；这为世界模型目标设计提供了原则性路径。局限在于仅在仿真中验证，未见真实机器人部署证据，且外层元梯度计算成本与长时程信用分配仍有待检验。

title: Robot Motion Transition with Human Motion Prior
summary: Humanoid motion-tracking policies can reproduce diverse behaviors, yet connecting independently acquired motions into a continuous sequence remains challenging. Interpolation connects boundary poses without considering whether their relative position, heading, and timing provide suitable conditions for a transition. A generative motion prior can produce richer motion, but poorly arranged boundaries may cause it to generate excessive locomotion, turning, or another unintended action. We present Spatio-Temporal Alignment with a Motion Prior (STAMP), a framework for connecting independently acquired humanoid motions through a Robot-to-Human-to-Robot process. STAMP uses human motion space to draw on rich motion priors and reuse transition knowledge across robot embodiments. Its key component is a learned alignment model that determines the boundary conditions for motion inbetweening. Given the two motions retargeted to a human rig, the alignment model ranks candidate positions, headings, and transition durations for the following motion. A human motion prior generates the transition under the selected alignment. The completed sequence is retargeted to the robot and used as a reference to train a motion-tracking policy. We evaluate the tracking success of the generated transitions on Unitree~G1 and~ROBOTIS K1. Physical robot demonstrations further show that STAMP connects independently acquired motions into long-horizon sequences. Project page: this https URL

AI.tldr: STAMP通过“机器人→人体→机器人”流程连接独立采集的人形动作：先重定向到人体骨架，学习一个对齐模型为后续动作排序候选位置、朝向与时长的过渡边界，再由人体运动先验生成过渡片段，重定向回机器人作为参考训练跟踪策略。
AI.motivation: 独立获得的人形动作片段可直接跟踪，但拼接成连续长序列困难：简单插值只连接边界姿态，不考虑相对位置、朝向与时序是否适合过渡；而生成式运动先验在边界安排不佳时会产生多余的行走、转向等非预期动作。
AI.method: 提出STAMP框架，核心是学习到的对齐模型：输入两段已重定向到人体rig的动作，对候选位置、朝向和过渡时长进行排序打分，选择最佳边界条件；随后由人体运动先验在该对齐条件下生成过渡动作；完整序列重定向到机器人并作为参考训练运动跟踪策略，实现跨本体迁移。
AI.result: 在Unitree G1与ROBOTIS K1上评估生成过渡的跟踪成功率，并通过实体机器人演示验证STAMP能将独立采集的动作拼接为长时程连续序列。
AI.conclusion: 将运动过渡问题转化为“对齐条件选择+先验生成”，借助人体运动空间可获得丰富先验并复用过渡知识，是连接人形动作片段、构建长时程行为的可行方案。

title: TEAR: Task-Evidence Authority Routing for Robotic Manipulation
summary: Reliable robotic manipulation in field-deployed settings requires more than executing a capable controller. As the execution conditions change, the system must decide, online and on the robot side, which control source should hold authority. Human teleoperation adapts readily to contact-rich and semantically ambiguous situations but depends on a stable communication link. Local autonomy is executed without continuous human intervention, but may fail under semantic ambiguity, long-horizon drift, and unforeseen contingencies. These two control sources exhibit complementary reliability profiles. We formulate this complementarity as a control authority routing problem and present Task-Evidence Authority Routing for Robotic Manipulation (TEAR), an edge-deployable framework that allocates authority between human teleoperation and local autonomy. TEAR arbitrates on the robot side using network-state evidence, which governs the usability of teleoperation, and task-semantic evidence, which reflects whether autonomous execution remains consistent with the current task. A lightweight temporal arbitrator observes both forms of evidence together with robot state and current authority to time authority transfers. Across simulated and real-world trials under dynamic network conditions, TEAR achieves task success rates close to pure teleoperation while limiting teleoperation to 19.8-27.4% of control steps and improves success by 30-40% over autonomy-only execution in our settings. These results demonstrate the potential of complementary authority routing to sustain successful manipulation with substantially reduced dependence on continuous human control.

AI.tldr: 提出 TEAR 框架，在机器人端根据网络状态证据与任务语义证据在线仲裁"人类遥操作"与"本地自主"两种控制源的权限分配，实现少量遥操作步数下接近纯遥操作的抓取成功率。
AI.motivation: 遥操作适应接触丰富/语义模糊场景但依赖通信链路；本地自主无需人工但易在语义歧义、长时漂移和意外情况下失败。二者可靠性互补，需在机器人端在线决定"谁掌握控制权"。
AI.method: 将问题形式化为控制权限路由（control authority routing）问题；TEAR 用网络状态证据（遥操作可用性）与任务语义证据（自主执行是否仍与任务一致）两类证据，配合机器人状态与当前权限输入轻量级时序仲裁器，在边缘端预测/决定权限切换时机。
AI.result: 在动态网络条件的仿真与真实试验中，成功率接近纯遥操作，遥操作仅占控制步的19.8%–27.4%；相比纯自主执行成功率提升30–40%。
AI.conclusion: 互补控制源的路由机制可在显著降低持续人工控制依赖的同时维持操作成功率，具备边缘部署潜力。

title: Loop to Look Better: Learning Adaptive Depth for Question-Guided Perception in Vision-Language Models
summary: Visual perception should be iterative and task-directed, with representations refined in response to the question and the need for further processing. While Vision-Language Models (VLMs) increasingly support extended reasoning, their visual tokens are still typically acquired in a single, task-agnostic encoder pass. This creates an evidence-acquisition bottleneck: models may reason longer without refining the visual evidence needed to answer the question. We propose LoopLook, a lightweight encoder-side recurrent perception framework that equips pretrained VLMs with adaptive visual depth. LoopLook recurrently revisits a middle-to-late window of the vision encoder, injecting question representations at each loop to guide visual refinement. A learned stopping mechanism adaptively determines the recurrent depth, while a token-wise Mixture-of-Looks (MoL) combines representations from different loops, allowing each visual token to selectively integrate information acquired across recurrent steps. Across four backbones and eight benchmarks, LoopLook consistently improves performance over the baseline, yielding gains of up to 8.6% on MMStar and 8.1% on HallusionBench. Our analysis shows that LoopLook progressively refines visual attention and adaptively allocates depth according to task difficulty. It also better preserves task-relevant visual information under reduced input resolution, while increasing time to first token (TTFT) by only 5.1-6.5%. By bringing recurrence from reasoning back into perception, LoopLook transforms visual perception from a one-shot glimpse into an adaptive process of recurrent refinement.

AI.tldr: LoopLook 在视觉编码器中段引入循环递归，逐轮回注问题表征以自适应精化视觉token，配合学习式停止机制与token级 Mixture-of-Looks 融合多轮表征。
AI.motivation: 现有VLM虽支持长链推理，但视觉token仍由编码器一次性、任务无关地获取，形成"证据获取瓶颈"：模型可以想得更久，却不能获得更贴合问题的视觉证据。
AI.method: 轻量编码器侧循环感知框架：在预训练视觉编码器的中后层窗口上反复回访（recurrent pass），每轮注入问题表征引导视觉精化；学习式停止机制自适应决定递归深度；token级 MoL 按token选择整合各轮表征。训练开销低，可插拔于预训练VLM。
AI.result: 在4个骨干、8个基准上稳定优于基线，MMStar +8.6%、HallusionBench +8.1%；分析显示视觉注意力逐轮精化、递归深度随任务难度自适应分配、低分辨率下更好保留任务相关信息；首token时延仅增5.1-6.5%。
AI.conclusion: 将循环机制从推理阶段回移到感知阶段，把一次性"瞥见"式视觉编码转为自适应迭代精化，为VLM提供按需分配的视觉计算深度。

title: One Evaluation Is Enough: Inversion-Free Image Editing with Trajectory Correction
summary: Real-image editing commonly relies on inversion and iterative sampling, while efficient one-step editors often stabilize a large update by estimating and averaging editing fields at multiple noise levels. We ask a stricter question: is a single temporal field evaluation sufficient for reliable inversion-free editing? Our answer rests on a previously underused duality in a variance-preserving (VP) one-step model: one source-target query at a shared noisy state simultaneously determines a local angular semantic tangent and a clean endpoint displacement. We integrate the tangent over the analytically known remaining VP angle to obtain a nominal one-step transport, and use the endpoint displacement to correct its long-horizon extrapolation through a constrained projection. This transport-first, correction-second construction yields Endpoint-Calibrated Transport (ECT), a closed-form, training-free editor requiring only one noise level, two text conditions packed into one denoiser batch, and one latent update. ECT requires no image inversion, trajectory integration, second temporal observation, or iterative optimization, and can be directly applied to pretrained epsilon-prediction VP one-step generators. Across the reported benchmark settings, ECT delivers stable gains in editing quality within an extremely short editing time.

AI.tldr: 提出端点校准传输(ECT)：单次时间场评估即可实现无反转的单步图像编辑，利用VP一步模型中"局部角语义切向量"与"干净端点位移"的对偶性，闭式、免训练、单次潜变量更新。
AI.motivation: 真实图像编辑依赖反转与迭代采样，代价高；现有一步编辑器需在多个噪声层级上估计并平均编辑场才稳定，仍非真正单次评估。作者追问：单次时间场评估是否足够支撑可靠的无反转编辑。
AI.method: 利用VP一步模型中被忽视的对偶性：共享噪声状态下同一源-目标查询同时给出局部角语义切向与干净端点位移。将切向沿解析已知的VP剩余角度积分得到名义一步传输，再用端点位移通过约束投影校正其长程外推，形成"先传输—后校正"的闭式构造。仅需一个噪声层级、两个文本条件打包进单批去噪器、一次潜变量更新；无需反转、轨迹积分、第二次时间观测或迭代优化，可直接用于预训练epsilon预测的VP一步生成器。
AI.result: 在所述基准设置下，ECT在极短编辑时间内取得稳定的编辑质量提升。
AI.conclusion: 单次时间场评估足以支撑可靠的无反转编辑，前提是以解析VP角度积分构造传输并用端点位移做约束校正；由此得到一个免训练、闭式、极低延迟的一步编辑框架。

title: RECAP: Looking Once Is Not Enough for Vision-Language Reasoning
summary: Long chain-of-thought reasoning improves vision-language models (VLMs), but it also exposes a temporal grounding failure: as generation unfolds, models may drift from image evidence while reinforcement learning still provides only a final-answer reward. We study this gap through visual revisit, a temporally localized reactivation of image evidence during reasoning. Across three VLM backbones, revisit peaks are predictive of correctness and causally linked to performance: masking them degrades accuracy more than masking non-peaks, while injecting revisit-like peaks into failed rollouts partially restores correct answers. Control analyses show that this signal is not explained by raw attention strength, uncertainty, logit margin, or hidden-state norm. We propose RECAP, a GRPO-compatible training method that turns detached revisit traces into a credit-assignment signal. RECAP uses revisit-conditioned advantage estimation, dynamic discounting, and gated value prediction to propagate final rewards through visually important reasoning steps, without extra rewards, additional rollouts, or inference-time changes. Across Qwen2.5-VL-7B, InternVL3-8B, and LLaVA-OV-7B, RECAP consistently improves over GRPO and VPPO, yielding $+6.1$--$+6.5$ HallusionBench gains over the SFT base while preserving reasoning and text-only performance. Results on larger LoRA-tuned models, Chinese zero-shot benchmarks, visual perturbations, and human evaluation further demonstrate robust improvements in image-grounded reasoning.

AI.tldr: 该文发现VLM长链推理过程中存在"视觉重访"(visual revisit)现象——推理中局部、时间上重新激活的图像证据峰值可预测答案正确性并可因果干预;提出RECAP,一种与GRPO兼容的信用分配训练法,将重访轨迹转化为优势估计信号,在三个VLM骨干上稳定优于GRPO/VPPO。
AI.motivation: 长链思维链提升VLM推理能力,但带来"时间接地失效"(temporal grounding failure):随着生成推进,模型可能偏离图像证据,而RL仅给最终答案奖励,无法定位哪些推理步真正依赖视觉信息,导致信用分配粗粒度、视觉接地难以被强化。
AI.method: 先以"视觉重访"作为可观测诊断量(跨时间定位的图像证据再激活峰值),通过掩蔽/注入峰值的因果实验与对照分析(原始注意力强度、不确定性、logit margin、隐状态范数)排除替代解释。随后提出RECAP:用脱离梯度的重访轨迹做重访条件优势估计、动态折扣与门控价值预测,将最终奖励传播到视觉重要的推理步;无需额外奖励、额外rollout或推理期改动,与GRPO兼容。
AI.result: 在Qwen2.5-VL-7B、InternVL3-8B、LLaVA-OV-7B三个骨干上,相对GRPO与VPPO一致提升;相较SFT基座在HallusionBench上取得+6.1~+6.5的增益,同时保持推理与纯文本性能;在更大LoRA微调模型、中文零样本基准、视觉扰动与人工评测上验证了图像接地推理的稳健改进。
AI.conclusion: 视觉重访作为细粒度、可解释的视觉接地信号,能有效改造RLVR中的信用分配粒度;RECAP以低成本(无额外reward/rollout/推理开销)实现更强的图像接地推理,为VLM多模态RL后训练提供通用插件。

title: ProTrav: Probabilistic Traversability with Elevation Uncertainty Propagation for Risk-aware Off-road Navigation
summary: Reliable traversability estimation is essential for autonomous navigation on unstructured terrain. State-of-the-art approaches typically evaluate traversability from deterministic terrain elevation, thereby overlooking spatial correlations in the terrain and failing to account for how elevation uncertainty propagates through nonlinear traversability mappings. We propose ProTrav, a probabilistic terrain representation that uses function-space sampling to generate spatially correlated terrain realizations and propagate elevation uncertainty to traversability cost. First, a Sparse Variational Gaussian Process (SVGP) reconstructs a probabilistic elevation field from observations. Then, posterior function-space sampling generates spatially correlated terrain realizations, preserving spatial dependencies between neighboring locations while propagating elevation uncertainty through geometric features into traversability cost. Consequently, a distribution of traversability cost at arbitrary location is established, where the mean and standard deviation quantify the expected traversability cost and associated uncertainty, respectively. A risk term is defined by moment-based Upper Confidence Bound (UCB) and incorporated into a Model Predictive Path Integral (MPPI) controller for risk-aware navigation. Simulation experiments demonstrate navigation success rates exceeding 90\% on different terrains, compared with below 40\% for a baseline, while reducing attitude variations. Furthermore, the proposed approach is validated on a robot traversing real-world off-road terrain.

AI.tldr: ProTrav 用稀疏变分高斯过程重建概率高程场，经函数空间后验采样生成空间相关地形实现，将高程不确定性传播到可通行性代价，得到均值+标准差的代价分布，并用矩上置信界风险项接入 MPPI 实现风险感知导航，仿真成功率>90%（基线<40%），并有真实越野地形验证。
AI.motivation: 现有可通行性估计基于确定性高程图，忽略地形空间相关性，且未刻画高程不确定性经非线性可通行性映射的传播，导致非结构化地形上导航风险不可量化。
AI.method: 1) SVGP 从观测重建概率高程场；2) 后验函数空间采样生成保持邻域空间依赖的地形实现；3) 将样本地形经几何特征映射为可通行性代价，得到任意位置的代价分布；4) 以均值/标准差构造基于矩的 UCB 风险项，嵌入 MPPI 控制器。
AI.result: 多类地形仿真中导航成功率>90%，基线<40%，且姿态波动更小；在真实越野地形上完成机器人验证。
AI.conclusion: 函数空间采样可有效传播地形高程不确定性并量化可通行性风险，风险感知 MPPI 显著提升非结构化地形导航鲁棒性。

title: CAVC: Convergence-Adaptive Audio-Visual Cache for Modality-Asymmetric Diffusion Generation
summary: Diffusion-based audio-visual generation methods typically perform joint denoising of audio and video latents throughout the entire sampling trajectory, repeatedly executing modality-specific denoising branches and cross-modal attention at every timestep. However, we observe that such uniform joint computation is not always necessary. The key is a modality-asymmetric recoverability: audio-side drift introduced by mid-stage caching can be substantially reduced by only a few terminal joint denoising steps, whereas video-side degradation caused by caching leads to persistent loss of motion and temporal details. This asymmetry suggests that inference acceleration should selectively cache recoverable audio-side computation while preserving full video refinement. Motivated by this observation, we propose \textbf{Convergence-Adaptive Audio-Visual Cache (CAVC)}, a training-free modality-asymmetric caching framework. CAVC adopts a sandwich-structured computation allocation: after detecting that audio denoiser outputs enter a cache-tolerant regime, it caches and reuses the audio denoiser output to bypass audio denoising and cross-modal attention in the middle stage, while the video branch continues independent spatio-temporal refinement; a few joint steps are then restored at the end to reduce accumulated cross-modal drift and improve synchronization. Experiments across multiple public benchmarks demonstrate that CAVC achieves 1.10--1.35x wall-clock acceleration, improves several visual dynamics and temporal statistics, and maintains competitive audio fidelity and audio-visual alignment.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练的模态非对称缓存框架CAVC，利用"音频侧漂移可恢复、视频侧漂移不可恢复"的可恢复性不对称，在中段缓存音频去噪与跨模态注意力、全过程保留视频精修，末段恢复少量联合步以修正漂移。
AI.motivation: 扩散式音视频联合生成在每个时间步都重复执行模态去噪分支与跨模态注意力，计算冗余严重。作者观察到统一联合计算并非必要：中段缓存引入的音频漂移可通过末端少量联合去噪步大幅恢复，而视频缓存导致的运动与时间细节损失则是持续性的。这种非对称可恢复性提示应有选择地缓存音频侧计算、保留视频侧完整精化。
AI.method: CAVC为三重"三明治"式算力分配：(1)检测音频去噪器输出进入"缓存容忍区"后，缓存并复用音频去噪输出，从而跳过中段音频去噪与跨模态注意力；(2)中段视频分支继续进行独立的时空精化；(3)末端恢复若干联合去噪步，以减小累积的跨模态漂移并改善音画同步。全程免训练，无需额外参数或微调。
AI.result: 在多个公开基准上取得1.10–1.35倍实际耗时（wall-clock）加速，若干视觉动态与时间统计指标有所提升，同时保持有竞争力的音频保真度与音画对齐水平。
AI.conclusion: 模态非对称的缓存策略是音视频扩散生成加速的一个有效且低成本方向；"缓存可恢复模态+保留不可恢复模态完整计算+末端联合修正"的三明治范式可推广到其他多模态扩散生成任务。

title: Direct Forcing: A Single-Stage Training Recipe for Few-Step Autoregressive Text-to-Video Generation
summary: Few-step autoregressive video generation enables low-latency streaming, yet prevailing training pipelines separate causal adaptation from distribution matching. Recent representation-based text-to-video methods retain this separation by starting from ODE-initialized checkpoints, even when the target distribution is defined directly by reference videos. We introduce Direct Forcing, a single-stage framework that uses reference videos both as paired examples of how a history continues and as a target population for self-generated rollouts. Causal Continuation Alignment learns paired spatiotemporal correspondence under reference histories, while Rollout Distribution Matching uses maximum mean discrepancy to align the representation distributions of self-generated and reference videos. Together, these complementary signals allow a pretrained video model to learn causal continuation and the target video distribution in a single training stage. Dynamic Gradient Balancing adapts the relative gradient contributions of continuation alignment and distribution matching during training. Starting from bidirectional Wan2.1-1.3B, Direct Forcing learns a four-step autoregressive generator in 250 updates without a separate initialization stage or online diffusion-score supervision, achieving 84.63 VBench Total and 86.01 Quality. Ablation studies further demonstrate the benefits of dynamic gradient balancing and reveal distinct representation preferences: deeper features benefit continuation alignment, whereas intermediate features yield better performance for rollout distribution matching.

AI.tldr: Direct Forcing：单阶段少步自回归视频生成框架，用参考视频同时作为"历史延续的配对样本"和"自生成rollout的目标分布"，结合因果延续对齐与MMD rollout分布匹配，从双向Wan2.1-1.3B在250次更新内学到四步自回归生成器。
AI.motivation: 少步自回归视频生成可实现低延迟流式生成，但现有训练流程把"因果适配"与"分布匹配"分成两个阶段（如先ODE初始化再蒸馏），即使目标分布由参考视频直接定义也仍保留这一分离，导致流程冗长、依赖扩散分数监督。
AI.method: 提出Direct Forcing单阶段框架：(1) Causal Continuation Alignment，在参考历史条件下学习配对时空对应；(2) Rollout Distribution Matching，用最大均值差异（MMD）对齐自生成rollout与参考视频的表示分布；(3) Dynamic Gradient Balancing，训练中自适应调节两项损失的梯度贡献。以双向Wan2.1-1.3B为起点直接训练四步自回归生成器，无需独立初始化阶段或在线扩散分数监督。
AI.result: 250次更新即获得四步自回归生成器，VBench Total 84.63、Quality 86.01。消融显示动态梯度平衡有效，且表示偏好分化：更深层特征利于延续对齐，中间层特征更适合rollout分布匹配。
AI.conclusion: 因果适配与目标分布匹配可在单一训练阶段统一完成，参考视频的双重角色（配对示例+目标人群）提供了互补监督信号。

title: Cross-Spectral Feature Fusion for Multispectral Document Binarization
summary: Historical document binarization remains challenging when faded ink, bleed-through, and background degradation exhibit wavelength-dependent behavior across visible and near-infrared observations. This study investigates whether adaptive cross-spectral feature fusion and targeted structural guidance can improve multispectral document binarization beyond fixed fusion and generic attention mechanisms. Four registered SMADI bands at 500, 600, 700, and 1000 nm are processed using a multi-branch conditional generative adversarial network (cGAN). Visible, NIR, and structural feature streams are fused at encoder depth L = 3 using spatial- and channel-wise softmax gating, while auxiliary edge maps derived from selected VIS-NIR band pairs provide targeted structural guidance. Nine controlled fusion and structural configurations are evaluated using five-fold document-level cross-validation, DIBCO-standard metrics, and Holm-corrected statistical testing. The F3 + NIR edge-guided configuration provides the strongest overall performance among the evaluated models, achieving mean F1 = 0.7916, p-FM = 0.8044, and IoU = 0.6654. Relative to the fixed Mid AVG baseline, it improves F1 by 0.0269, p-FM by 0.0360, and IoU by 0.0321, with all three gains remaining statistically significant after Holm correction. Mean NRM and DRD are also reduced, although these reductions are not statistically significant after correction. Targeted cross-spectral structural guidance provides an effective mechanism for regulating intermediate multispectral fusion, improving primary foreground-overlap performance while retaining the complete four-band observation.

AI.tldr: 该文提出多分支条件GAN，在编码器深度L=3处对可见光、近红外与结构特征流进行空间/通道软门控融合，并用特定VIS-NIR波段对导出的边缘图做结构引导，系统比较9种融合与结构配置，发现F3+NIR边缘引导在SMADI四波段历史文献二值化上最佳。
AI.motivation: 历史文献二值化中褪色墨迹、背面渗透与背景退化在可见光—近红外波段上表现不同，固定融合与通用注意力难以充分利用跨光谱信息；作者希望验证自适应跨光谱特征融合与定向结构引导是否能超越这两类常规做法。
AI.method: 对500/600/700/1000 nm四个配准的SMADI波段使用多分支cGAN；在编码器深度L=3以空间与通道softmax门控融合可见光、NIR与结构特征流；由选定VIS-NIR波段对生成辅助边缘图作定向结构引导；以五折文档级交叉验证、DIBCO标准指标与Holm校正统计检验评估9种受控融合/结构配置。
AI.result: F3+NIR边缘引导配置综合最优：平均F1=0.7916、p-FM=0.8044、IoU=0.6654；相对固定Mid AVG基线分别提升0.0269、0.0360、0.0321，且Holm校正后仍显著；NRM与DRD均值亦下降但不显著。
AI.conclusion: 定向跨光谱结构引导是调控多光谱中间层融合的有效机制，可在保留完整四波段观测的前提下提升前景重叠性能；结论限于历史文献二值化这一领域特定任务。

title: Verus-Insight: Towards Explainable Artifact Detection in AI-Generated Videos
summary: Recent advances in video generation have made synthetic videos increasingly realistic, placing greater demands on reliable AI-generated video detection. Existing artifact-based detectors typically identify generation artifacts as evidence for source prediction, yet they may either fail to recognize subtle artifacts or reach the correct source decision without faithfully identifying the evidence underlying it. In this work, we systematically investigate how to design and train effective artifact detectors and formulate artifact detection as a structured process comprising three complementary capabilities: Inspection Planning, which determines what should be examined; Evidence Verification, which verifies whether the inspected content exhibits genuine generation artifacts; and Evidence Aggregation, which integrates the verified evidence into the final source decision. Building on this formulation, we introduce Verus-Insight, trained with human-anchored full-process supervision and progressive capability training to strengthen both fine-grained artifact detection and video-level detection. We further introduce Verus-Bench, a benchmark with fine-grained human annotations of perceptible artifacts for evaluating artifact detection. Extensive experiments across diverse benchmarks demonstrate that Verus-Insight achieves strong performance in both fine-grained artifact analysis and AI-generated video detection, with substantial gains in recovering human-perceived artifacts. Further analyses reveal that the three capabilities are complementary yet distinct, and that Verus-Insight more reliably converts relevant inspection targets into supported artifact evidence without increasing spurious artifact claims.

AI.tldr: 提出将AI生成视频检测形式化为"检查规划—证据验证—证据聚合"三阶段结构化过程，并给出带全过程人工监督的模型Verus-Insight及细粒度人工标注基准Verus-Bench。
AI.motivation: 现有基于伪影的生成视频检测器要么漏检细微伪影，要么虽给出正确来源判断却未真正定位支撑证据，缺乏对"证据是否可信"的显式建模；同时缺少评测细粒度、人类可感知伪影的基准。
AI.method: 将伪影检测拆解为Inspection Planning（决定检查什么）、Evidence Verification（验证被检内容是否含真实生成伪影）、Evidence Aggregation（聚合证据得出来源判断）三项互补能力；采用以人类标注为锚的全过程监督与渐进式能力训练（progressive capability training）训练Verus-Insight；构建Verus-Bench，提供可感知伪影的细粒度人工标注用于评测。
AI.result: 在多个基准上，Verus-Insight在细粒度伪影分析与AI生成视频检测两方面均表现强劲，在还原人类可感知伪影方面有显著提升；消融/分析显示三项能力互补但可区分，且能在不增加虚假伪影断言的前提下更可靠地将检查目标转化为有支撑的证据。
AI.conclusion: 结构化、可解释的证据链式设计优于端到端伪影分类，为生成视频取证提供可验证的中间证据；但属视频取证/安全检测方向，与Physical AI、VLA、世界模型、3D重建等核心方向关联较弱。

title: HimmBO: High-Dimensional Interactive Model-Merging Bayesian Optimization for Image Generation
summary: Fine-tuning has become a common way to customize text-to-image models, leading to community collections of over 100K lightweight adapters. Adapters sharing a base model can be merged with continuous coefficients. This turns a large collection into a high-dimensional continuous design space, which recent work explores interactively using preferential Bayesian optimization (PBO). However, existing approaches are limited to a few dozen preselected adapters and require expensive image generation in every interaction round. We introduce HimmBO, a two-stage method that scales preference-driven adapter merging to much larger collections while reducing image-generation cost. Its screening stage recovers the active adapter set through level-set estimation over pre-generated images, requiring no image generation. The refinement stage then optimizes merge coefficients in the recovered low-dimensional subspace. Both stages use a style-aware kernel, allowing preference information to transfer between visually similar adapters. In simulated-user image-matching experiments, HimmBO achieves higher final similarity than all comparisons while reaching a given similarity with under one tenth of the image generations required by prior work. Its performance remains stable as the collection grows to 1080 adapters, while competing methods degrade substantially.

AI.tldr: HimmBO：两阶段的偏好驱动 adapter 合并方法，先用预生成图像上的水平集估计筛出活跃 adapter 子集（零图像生成），再在低维子空间用 style-aware kernel 的贝叶斯优化学习合并系数，可扩展至 1080 个 adapter 且图像生成开销降至先前工作的 1/10 以下。
AI.motivation: 社区已有超 10 万个轻量 adapter，共享基座模型的 adapter 可用连续系数合并，从而构成高维连续设计空间；现有偏好贝叶斯优化（PBO）方法只能处理数十个预选 adapter，且每轮交互都需昂贵的图像生成，难以扩展。
AI.method: 两阶段框架：(1) 筛选阶段——在预生成图像上做水平集估计，恢复活跃 adapter 集合，无需任何图像生成；(2) 精化阶段——在恢复出的低维子空间中优化合并系数。两阶段均使用风格感知核（style-aware kernel），使偏好信息可在视觉相似的 adapter 间迁移。
AI.result: 在模拟用户图像匹配实验中，最终相似度高于所有对比方法；达到给定相似度所需的图像生成次数不足先前工作的十分之一；扩展到 1080 个 adapter 时性能保持稳定，而对比方法显著退化。
AI.conclusion: 通过"离线筛选 + 低维子空间精化"分解，可把偏好驱动的 adapter 合并且可扩展性与计算成本问题解耦；实验为模拟用户而非真实人类评测，且任务限定在文生图模型定制，尚未涉及机器人/3D 等物理 AI 场景。

title: LocoManiLab: A Unified Testbed for Data, Policies, Controllers, and Deployment in Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
summary: Humanoid robots must coordinate locomotion and manipulation in everyday environments, yet progress is difficult to assess across differing policies, controllers, and task settings. LocoManiLab provides an integrated testbed spanning data collection and generation, policy training, evaluation, and physical deployment. Its task suite covers 234 atomic and compositional tasks across five household scene categories, supported by 51.5 hours of simulated teleoperation. The evaluation covers twelve policies with a shared controller across task and scene splits and perturbation levels, two policies across five controllers, and studies of demonstration scale and data-source mixtures. Success rates fall on unseen tasks and scenes and generally decline as visual perturbations increase, with differences in generalization and robustness across policies. For data generation, a humanoid motion generation model is fine-tuned for loco-manipulation to study the alignment of its outputs with task execution requirements and its integration into the data generation pipeline. Three simulated loco-manipulation tasks closely match real-world setups, enabling evaluation of three policies in both domains. Similar policy rankings support the reliability of simulation-based evaluation.

AI.tldr: LocoManiLab：覆盖数据采集/生成、策略训练、评估与真机部署的人形机器人全身运动-操作一体化测试平台，含234个任务、51.5小时仿真遥操作数据、12种策略×多控制器×扰动条件的系统评测。
AI.motivation: 人形机器人需在真实家庭环境中协同行走与操作，但不同策略、控制器与任务设置之间缺乏可比的评估基准，导致进展难以衡量。
AI.method: 构建五类家庭场景、234个原子与组合任务的仿真任务套件及51.5小时仿真遥操作数据；统一控制器下评测12种策略（任务/场景划分与视觉扰动分级）、2种策略×5种控制器，并研究示教规模与数据源混合；微调人形运动生成模型用于loco-manipulation数据生成，并将其接入数据生成流水线；选3个仿真任务对齐真实装置进行真机验证。
AI.result: 在未见任务与场景上成功率显著下降；视觉扰动增强时性能普遍退化；不同策略在泛化性与鲁棒性上存在明显差异；仿真与真机的策略排序基本一致，支持仿真评测的可靠性。
AI.conclusion: LocoManiLab提供了标准化的人形loco-manipulation评测与数据生成基础设施，仿真排名与真机一致，可作为该方向的可比基准，但仍以基准与工程集成贡献为主。

title: When Annotation Patterns Are Learned: Skin-Tone Dependence in Dermatology Concepts
summary: Concept bottleneck models (CBMs) let clinicians inspect and correct skin disease diagnoses through clinical concepts, but only if the concept annotations are reliable. We therefore audit the reliability of SkinCon, a widely used dermatology concept dataset, across skin tones. Within the same disease and with near duplicates removed, erythema is annotated far less often on dark than on light skin, with an odds ratio of 0.17. In contrast, hyperpigmentation and hypopigmentation are annotated more often, with odds ratios of 6.2 and 4.5, respectively. We refer to this pattern as tone-dependent concept annotation. An evidential concept model trained on these annotations learns the same pattern and reproduces it on unseen images. Such a model may agree with potential erythema omissions rather than contradict them. Consistent with this, three label error detectors underperform a disease-only baseline at finding erythema that dermatologist captions mention but SkinCon labels as absent. The three detectors are based on confident learning, training dynamics, and the model's own evidential uncertainty. Concept annotations should thus be audited within each subgroup before explanations built on them can be trusted.

AI.tldr: 论文审计皮肤科概念数据集 SkinCon 的标注可靠性，发现同一疾病下深色皮肤的红斑（erythema）标注显著少于浅色皮肤（OR=0.17），而色素沉着/色素减退标注更多（OR=6.2/4.5），称"色调依赖的概念标注"；证据概念模型会学到并复现该偏差，三种标签错误检测器在找回被漏标的红斑上均不如仅用疾病标签的基线。
AI.motivation: 概念瓶颈模型（CBM）依赖概念标注的可靠性才能让临床医生检查并纠正诊断，但 SkinCon 这类广泛使用的皮肤病概念数据集是否存在跨肤色系统性标注偏差尚未被审计；若标注本身有偏差，基于其构建的解释不可信。
AI.method: 在控制同一疾病类别并去除近重复图像后，按肤色分组统计各概念标注率并计算优势比；训练证据式概念模型（evidential concept model）检验其是否内化并泛化该偏差；在皮肤科医生描述中提及红斑但 SkinCon 标注为缺失的样本上，比较基于置信学习（confident learning）、训练动态（training dynamics）与模型自身证据不确定性的三种标签错误检测器与仅疾病基线的检出性能。
AI.result: 同一疾病内红斑在深色皮肤上的标注优势比仅 0.17，而色素沉着与色素减退分别为 6.2 与 4.5；证据概念模型在未见图像上复现相同偏差模式，可能与潜在的红斑漏标相一致而非相矛盾；三种标签错误检测器的检出性能均低于仅用疾病标签的基线。
AI.conclusion: 概念标注存在显著的肤色依赖偏差并会被概念模型继承，且现有标签错误检测方法无法有效修复；因此在信任基于概念标注的模型解释前，必须按子群体（如肤色）分别审计概念标注质量。

title: Query-Time Calibration of CLIP Features for Open-Vocabulary 3D Segmentation
summary: Lifting vision-language features such as CLIP into 3D Gaussian reconstructions enables open-vocabulary segmentation through natural-language queries. Although CLIP represents a broad range of semantic concepts, the lifted features of individual scenes can exhibit strong directional concentration, while raw cosine similarity does not account for the scene-specific feature distribution. We show that substantial segmentation gains can be obtained by changing how a fixed lifted feature field is compared with text. Our method partially subtracts a shared scene direction from visual features and text prototypes and whitens text prototypes using a fixed reference vocabulary of generic terms. It then uses soft clustering for multiclass prediction and CSLS with a relevance margin against the reference vocabulary for single-query prediction. Beyond reducing directional concentration, scene centering improves class-relative feature separation in every evaluated scene. Across seven lifting methods and four datasets, the resulting query-time calibration consistently improves mean intersection over union in both multiclass and single-query segmentation. These gains require no retraining, source-image re-encoding, or feature re-lifting, demonstrating the value of scene-conditioned comparison for making better use of existing lifted representations.

AI.tldr: 对3D高斯重建中已提升的CLIP等视觉-语言特征场，在查询时做场景方向去中心化与文本原型白化，并用软聚类与CSLS提升开放词汇分割，无需重训练或重编码。
AI.motivation: 提升到3D高斯中的CLIP特征常呈现强烈的方向集中（各向异性），而原始余弦相似度未考虑场景特定的特征分布，导致开放词汇查询分割效果受限。
AI.method: 对视觉特征与文本原型部分减去共享的场景主方向（scene centering），并用固定通用词汇表对文本原型做白化；多类预测用软聚类，单查询预测用带相关性边界的CSLS与参考词汇表对比。仅修改比较度量，不改变特征场。
AI.result: 在7种lifting方法与4个数据集上，多类与单查询分割的mIoU均一致提升；场景中心化在每个评估场景中都改善了类间相对特征可分性；无需重训练、源图像重编码或特征重提升。
AI.conclusion: 场景条件化的特征比较是充分利用已有lifted表征的低成本有效手段，可作为开放词汇3D分割的通用后处理校准步骤。

title: H-2DGS: Height-Field Gaussian Splatting for Sharp and Deformable Neurosurgical Surface Reconstruction
summary: Neurosurgical navigation commonly presents magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) as 2D slices, making it difficult to relate the anatomy in those slices to the cortical surface observed through the surgical microscope. We seek a common 3D visualization that combines a photorealistic reconstruction of the exposed cortex during tumor surgery with whole-brain MRI context and diffusion tractography pathways. This requires the reconstructed cortex to form a clear boundary around the brain anatomy rather than a diffuse volume that obscures internal structures. Conventional 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) can reproduce observed views but, under limited surgical view coverage, may distribute opacity through a thick and geometrically ambiguous band. We introduce height-field 2D Gaussian Splatting (H-2DGS), a three-stage pipeline that concentrates a robust 3DGS reconstruction, fuses its depth into a shared truncated signed distance field (TSDF) surface, and represents that surface with curved, surface-oriented Gaussian primitives. Separate height, color, and opacity bases provide local geometry and appearance, while a neighbor-transition objective coordinates overlapping patches. The explicit surface further supports postoperative alignment: MRI-derived depth deforms the reconstruction, and tracked-color supervision with alternating optimization preserves its appearance. Across five real neurosurgical cases, H-2DGS gives low multi-view depth inconsistency, a compact 7.97MB representation, and interactive rendering at 29--42ms per frame. The resulting sharp, deformable surface integrates clearly with tractography and MRI anatomy, including a postoperative resection cavity.

AI.tldr: H-2DGS：三段式流水线先用3DGS做鲁棒重建，再把深度融合进TSDF表面，最后用曲面导向的2D高斯基元表达该表面；高度/颜色/不透明度分离基+邻域过渡损失，得到锐利、可形变、约8MB的皮层表面，可与纤维束和MRI解剖对齐。
AI.motivation: 神经外科导航用2D MRI切片难以与显微镜下可见的皮层表面对应；希望在术中有限视角覆盖下获得既写实又有明确内外边界的3D皮层表面，而非弥散的体积高斯带，从而能叠加全脑MRI与弥散示踪纤维。
AI.method: （1）带遮挡约束/深度的鲁棒3DGS重建；（2）将3DGS深度融合为共享TSDF，提取闭合表面；（3）用曲率贴合表面的2D高斯基元表达该表面，分解高度、颜色、不透明度三类基函数并加邻域过渡目标以协调重叠patch；术后用MRI导出深度形变重建，并以交替优化下的跟踪颜色监督修正外观。
AI.result: 5例真实神经外科手术：多视角深度不一致低、表示仅7.97MB、交互渲染29–42ms/帧；锐利可形变表面能与纤维束、MRI解剖及术后切除腔清晰整合。
AI.conclusion: 用TSDF表面约束下的显式曲面2DGS替代弥散体积表示，可在稀疏手术视角下得到紧凑、可实时渲染且可形变的皮层重建，为术中导航与多模态影像融合提供可行方案。

title: Hierarchical Fine-Grained Cross-Modal Alignment via Dynamic Granularity Discovery and Optimal Transport
comment: 8 figures, 6 tables. Code available at this https URL
summary: Fine-grained image-text retrieval requires a model not only to assess global semantic consistency between an image and a text, but also to model visual evidence for local textual semantics, including objects, attributes, quantities, actions, and relations, so as to distinguish semantically similar candidates. Existing methods commonly use fixed image patches, detected regions, or text tokens as the basic matching units and then aggregate local interactions through max pooling, cross attention, or similarity accumulation. Such strategies remain limited in semantic unit construction and global matching consistency. This paper proposes a hierarchical fine-grained cross-modal alignment framework, termed HFCMA. The framework progressively transforms low-level patch and token representations into adaptive visual regions and textual phrases, and then performs structured region-phrase matching within a global retrieval scoring process. Specifically, HFCMA first adopts dynamic granularity discovery (DGD) to aggregate raw patches and tokens into semantically compact visual regions and textual phrases. It then formulates region-phrase matching as an entropy-regularized optimal transport problem, thereby estimating a structured alignment matrix under global marginal constraints. To reduce background noise and local semantic drift, HFCMA further introduces background debiasing, textual importance weighting, and prototype consistency regularization. Experiments on Flickr30K and MS-COCO show that HFCMA effectively combines dynamic semantic unit construction with OT-based structured matching under a dual-encoder retrieval framework. The resulting fine-grained score provides structured local alignment information for candidate ranking and improves the discrimination of subtle semantic differences.

AI.tldr: 提出层次化细粒度跨模态对齐框架 HFCMA，通过动态粒度发现将 patch/token 聚合为自适应视觉区域与文本短语，并以熵正则化最优传输求解结构化区域-短语对齐，提升图文检索细微语义判别力。
AI.motivation: 现有细粒度图文检索依赖固定图像块、检测区域或文本 token 作为匹配单元，仅靠 max pooling、cross attention 或相似度累加进行局部交互聚合，在语义单元构造的合理性（与语义粒度不对齐）与全局匹配一致性（缺乏全局约束、易受背景噪声与语义漂移影响）两方面存在不足。
AI.method: 1) 动态粒度发现（DGD）：将原始 patch 与 token 自适应聚合为语义紧凑的视觉区域与文本短语；2) 将区域-短语匹配建模为熵正则化最优传输问题，在全局边际约束下估计结构化对齐矩阵；3) 引入背景去偏、文本重要性加权与原型一致性正则以抑制背景噪声和局部语义漂移；整体嵌入双编码器检索框架。
AI.result: 在 Flickr30K 与 MS-COCO 上验证，HFCMA 有效结合动态语义单元构造与 OT 结构化匹配，细粒度得分可为候选排序提供结构化局部对齐信息，提升细微语义差异的判别能力（摘要未给出具体数值提升）。
AI.conclusion: HFCMA 表明"自适应语义单元 + 全局约束的结构化匹配"是改进细粒度跨模态检索的有效路径，但其价值限于检索任务，未涉及机器人、3D 重建或具身智能场景。

title: Watch and Learn: Teaching Visual In-Context Learning by Removing Textual Shortcuts
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) struggle with in context learning compared to their textual counterparts. Our preliminary study shows that VLMs rely on textual shortcuts and underutilize the visual demonstrations. We therefore hypothesize that VLMs are insufficiently trained to perform visual in-context learning (vICL). To this end, we construct MIME, a task-agnostic vICL training set without textual shortcuts. We ensure the instruction does not state the rule linking the demonstration images to their answers, so the model must infer it from the visual demonstrations. Fine-tuning on MIME improves vICL accuracy by 8.1 to 18.0 points across three VLMs, preserves single-image performance, and improves multi-image and text only in-context learning. In contrast, stating the rule in the training data sharply reduces this gain. We further propose DTAD (Demonstration Text Attention Dropout), which randomly withholds demonstration labels during training so that the VLM must infer the rule from the demonstration images. While achieving comparable vICL accuracy to fine-tuning on MIME, DTAD yields more consistent attention to the demonstration images. On TrueMICL, Qwen3-VL-8B trained on MIME matches frontier models such as Claude Opus 5, and surpasses them with DTAD. Finally, adding MIME to the instruction-tuning mix of LLaVA 1.5 13B more than doubles its vICL accuracy without hurting single-image abilities, whereas a same-size multi-image set improves it only slightly. These results suggest that vICL data should be a standard component of VLM training.

AI.tldr: 提出无文本捷径的 vICL 训练集 MIME 与演示标签注意力丢弃 DTAD，显著提升 VLM 视觉上下文学习能力。
AI.motivation: VLM 在上下文学习上弱于纯文本模型，作者初步实验发现 VLM 依赖文本捷径、未充分利用视觉演示，因而假设其缺乏视觉上下文学习（vICL）训练。
AI.method: 构建任务无关、无文本捷径的 vICL 训练集 MIME：指令不陈述演示图像与答案间的规则，迫使模型从视觉演示推断；并提出 DTAD，在训练中随机丢弃演示标签，强制模型依赖演示图像。另在 LLaVA 1.5 13B 指令微调混合数据中加入 MIME 做验证。
AI.result: MIME 微调使三个 VLM 的 vICL 准确率提升 8.1–18.0 点，保持单图能力，并改善多图与纯文本 ICL；训练数据中显式给出规则会显著削弱增益。DTAD 精度与 MIME 相当但注意力更集中于演示图像；TrueMICL 上 Qwen3-VL-8B 加 MIME 可媲美前沿模型，加 DTAD 则超越；LLaVA 1.5 13B 加入 MIME 使 vICL 准确率翻倍以上，同等规模多图数据仅小幅提升。
AI.conclusion: vICL 数据应成为 VLM 训练的标准组成部分；视觉演示的有效利用需要专门设计的数据与训练机制。

title: Making MLLM Latents Matter: Factor-Aware Predictive Learning for Cinematic Video Generation
summary: Cinematic video generation requires both temporal inference from limited inputs (i.e., sparse rather than frame-by-frame guidance) and factor-aware control of character, scene, action, and camera.
