Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) offer useful priors for both capabilities, but their representations are not automatically actionable for video generation: a Video Diffusion Transformer (DiT) may bypass them through native conditioning pathways, and using them does not ensure either factor-aware control or generation-compatible temporal prediction. We propose Factor-Aware Predictive Learning (FAPL), which establishes effective MLLM latent use as a shared prerequisite and then targets the two capabilities with complementary learning signals. First, latent-only generator grounding trains the DiT with a frozen MLLM and connector, strengthening the DiT's use of MLLM latents for generation. Second, for factor-aware control, paired videos specify a target-factor change and non-target preservation, and factor-span replacement trains the DiT to realize this relationship in its output. Third, for temporal inference, text-only and text-plus-complete-video observations share a video target, and the trained DiT is then frozen while the MLLM and connector are optimized through it. This final stage trains limited-input representations for generation while retaining complete-observation reconstruction as a complementary training mode. Extensive experiments demonstrate our consistently better performance on three cinematic video generation tasks (i.e., sparse-to-video, factor-aware editing, and multi-shot generation) over baselines and validate FAPL's contributions to MLLM feature use, temporal control, and factor coordination.

AI.tldr: FAPL：先验证 DiT 能有效利用冻结 MLLM 潜变量（latent-only grounding），再用成对视频做 factor-span replacement 实现角色/场景/动作/相机因子解耦控制，最后冻结 DiT、经其优化 MLLM+connector 以支持稀疏输入的时间预测。
AI.motivation: 电影级视频生成需同时具备稀疏输入下的时间推理能力与角色、场景、动作、相机的因子感知控制。MLLM 虽提供先验，但其表征对 video DiT 未必"可用"——DiT 可能通过原生条件通路绕过它们，且无法保证因子控制或生成兼容的时间预测。故需先解决 MLLM latent 有效性这一共享前提。
AI.method: 三阶段互补训练：(1) latent-only generator grounding：冻结 MLLM 与 connector 训练 DiT，强制其依赖 MLLM latent；(2) factor-span replacement：成对视频定义目标因子变化与非目标保持，训练 DiT 在输出中复现该关系；(3) 时间推理：文本 alone 与文本+完整视频两种观测共享同一视频目标，冻结 DiT、反向优化 MLLM 与 connector，同时保留完整观测重建作为辅助训练模式。
AI.result: 在三个电影级视频生成任务（稀疏到视频、因子感知编辑、多镜头生成）上一致优于基线，并消融验证 FAPL 对 MLLM 特征利用、时间控制与因子协调三方面均有贡献。
AI.conclusion: 将"MLLM 表征对 DiT 的可落地性"作为显式前提，并把因子控制与稀疏时间推理拆分为互补学习信号，是提升可控视频生成的有效范式。

title: ICGF-CXRMate: Image-Conditioned Clinical Context Compression and Gated Fusion for Chest X-ray Report Generation
summary: Auxiliary patient data can improve chest X-ray report generation, but directly concatenating heterogeneous clinical information with visual tokens produces long, variable-length decoder prompts and may expose the model to redundant or image-irrelevant context. We propose ICGF-CXRMate, an image-conditioned clinical context compression and gated fusion framework. Learnable queries are first conditioned on the current chest X-ray representations and then attend to the patient-data sequence, compressing it into a fixed number of clinical context tokens. Gated cross-attention selectively integrates these tokens into the visual stream, while the compressed tokens are retained in the decoder prompt as a direct clinical pathway. Experiments on linked MIMIC-CXR and MIMIC-IV-ED examinations show that ICGF-CXRMate improves report quality while reducing the average prompt length. In Stage~2, it improves RadGraph-F1 from 24.00 to 28.86, CXR-BERT similarity from 56.86 to 62.80, and BLEU-4 from 5.14 to 7.96 compared with CXRMate-ED, while reducing the average prompt length from 373.89 to 288.37 tokens, corresponding to a 22.9\% reduction. After self-critical sequence training, ICGF-CXRMate outperforms CXRMate-ED on six of eight report-quality metrics in Stage~3. Ablation studies confirm the complementary contributions of image-conditioned compression, gated fusion, and direct retention of the compressed clinical tokens.

AI.tldr: 提出ICGF-CXRMate：用图像条件化的可学习查询将变长患者临床数据压缩为固定数量临床token，经门控交叉注意力融入视觉流，并将压缩token保留在解码器提示中，显著提升胸片报告质量并缩短提示长度。
AI.motivation: 辅助患者数据可改善胸片报告生成，但直接把异构临床信息与视觉token拼接会造成解码器提示冗长且变长，并引入冗余或与图像无关的上下文。
AI.method: 以当前胸片视觉表示为条件初始化可学习查询，对患者数据序列做注意力压缩为固定数量临床上下文token；通过门控交叉注意力选择性注入视觉流，同时压缩token作为直接临床通路保留在解码器提示中。基于关联的MIMIC-CXR与MIMIC-IV-ED数据实验，并进行自批判序列训练与消融。
AI.result: Stage 2相较CXRMate-ED：RadGraph-F1 24.00→28.86，CXR-BERT相似度56.86→62.80，BLEU-4 5.14→7.96，平均提示长度373.89→288.37 token（降22.9%）；Stage 3经自批判序列训练后在8项指标中6项优于CXRMate-ED；消融验证三种组件互补有效。
AI.conclusion: 图像条件化的临床上下文压缩与门控融合能兼顾报告质量与提示效率，是好用的多模态压缩范式，但属医学影像报告生成这一领域CV任务，与核心Physical AI/VLA/3D重建/世界模型方向无直接方法关联，优先级偏低。

title: Vision Transformers for Estimating Irradiance Using Data Scarce Sky Images
summary: Accurate estimation of diffuse horizontal irradiance (DHI) is critical for optimising photovoltaic system performance and energy forecasting yet remains challenging in regions lacking comprehensive ground-based instrumentation. Recent advancements using Vision Transformers (ViTs) trained on extensive sky image datasets have shown promise in replacing costly irradiance measurement equipment, but the scarcity of long-term, high-quality sky imagery significantly restricts practical implementation. Addressing this critical gap, this study proposes a novel dual-framework approach designed for data-scarce scenarios. First, calculated atmospheric parameters, including extraterrestrial irradiance and cyclic time encodings, are integrated to represent sky conditions without utilising any instrumentation. Next, a sequential pipeline initially predicts synthetic global horizontal irradiance (GHI) and uses it as a feature, to refine DHI estimation. Finally, a dual-parallel architecture simultaneously processes raw and overlay-enhanced fisheye sky images. Overlays are generated through unsupervised, physics-informed cloud segmentation to highlight dynamic sky features. Empirical validation is performed using data from the Chilbolton Observatory, chosen for its temperate climate and frequent cloud variability. To simulate data-scarce conditions, models are trained on a single month (e.g., January) and evaluated across a temporally disjoint, full-year test set. Under this setup, the sequential and dual-parallel frameworks achieve RMSE values within 2-3 W/m^2 and 1-6 W/m^2, respectively, of a state-of-the-art ViT trained on the complete dataset. By combining physics-informed modelling with unsupervised segmentation, the proposed method provides a scalable and cost-effective solution for DHI estimation, advancing solar resource assessment in data-constrained environments.

AI.tldr: 提出双框架方法，在天空图像匮乏条件下估计散射水平辐照度(DHI)：融合计算型大气参数与时间编码，先合成GHI再作为特征细化DHI，并用无监督物理引导云分割生成叠加图，与原始鱼眼图像双分支并行处理。
AI.motivation: ViT+大规模天空图像可替代昂贵辐照测量设备，但长期高质量天空图像稀缺，导致难以实际部署；需在数据匮乏场景下保持精度。
AI.method: (1) 无仪器化的大气参数建模：地外辐照度、循环时间编码；(2) 顺序管线：先预测合成GHI，再作为特征输入估计DHI；(3) 双并行架构：一路处理原始鱼眼图，一路处理无监督物理引导云分割生成的叠加增强图。仅在单月(如1月)数据上训练，在时间不重叠的整年测试集评估（Chilbolton天文台）。
AI.result: 顺序框架RMSE仅比全数据训练的SOTA ViT高2–3 W/m²，双并行框架高1–6 W/m²，在单月训练条件下保持接近全量数据的估计精度。
AI.conclusion: 物理先验建模与无监督分割结合，可在数据受限环境下实现可扩展、低成本的DHI估计，推进太阳能资源评估。

title: GateFormer: Forecast-Space Decomposition for Intra-Hour Solar Irradiance Prediction from Sky Images
summary: Sub-hourly dispatch, balancing, and storage control increasingly depend on forecasts that anticipate rapid variability in solar generation. Accurate sky-image-based irradiance forecasting requires a combination of visual cloud dynamics with recent irradiance state while adapting to different short-term irradiance-change regimes. To address this, we introduce GateFormer, a GHI-conditioned dual-decoder ViT for intra-hour global horizontal irradiance (GHI) forecasting through forecast-space decomposition. GateFormer embeds observed GHI into the visual token stream, allowing interaction with sky-image patch features through self-attention. From this shared representation, a Trajectory Head predicts future GHI sequence, while a Delta Head predicts final-horizon change from the latest observed GHI. The two final-horizon forecasts are adaptively weighted in prediction space, with magnitude- and direction-supervision targeting the remaining error. On the NREL-TSI benchmark, GateFormer attains 125.01 W/m^2 RMSE at +30 min, improving over a state-of-the-art transformer baseline by 9.6% under paired-timestamp evaluation. Across NREL-TSI, Chilbolton, and SIRTA, GateFormer achieves the lowest final-horizon RMSE among the evaluated baselines, with forecast skill of 22.97-28.86% relative to smart persistence. Component ablations show adaptive weighting outperforms both individual decoders and fixed averaging, distinguishing GateFormer from conventional forecast combination, while the supervised correction further reduces RMSE by 1.68 W/m^2 and MAE by 4.86 W/m^2. Ramp-regime diagnostics show larger gains during operationally important positive ramps, reducing RMSE by 26.27 W/m^2. These results identify forecast-space decomposition as an alternative forecasting formulation, with potential relevance to other multimodal short-horizon forecasting tasks and deployment using only sky images and measured GHI.

AI.tldr: GateFormer：以观测GHI为条件、双解码器ViT的分钟级太阳辐照度预报，通过“预测空间分解”联合轨迹预测与终值变化量预测并自适应加权。
AI.motivation: 亚小时级调度/储能控制依赖能捕捉光伏快速波动的预报；天空图像法需同时融合云动态视觉信息与近期辐照状态，并适应不同短期波动工况。
AI.method: 将观测GHI嵌入视觉token流与天空图像patch通过自注意力交互；共享表示上设Trajectory Head预测未来GHI序列，Delta Head预测相对最新观测的终值变化；两路终值预测在预测空间自适应加权，并辅以幅值与方向的监督对残差做校正。
AI.result: NREL-TSI上+30min RMSE 125.01 W/m²，较SOTA Transformer基线降9.6%；在NREL-TSI/Chilbolton/SIRTA终值RMSE最低，相对smart persistence预报技巧22.97–28.86%；消融显示自适应加权优于单解码器与固定平均，监督校正降RMSE 1.68、MAE 4.86 W/m²；正爬坡段RMSE降低26.27 W/m²。
AI.conclusion: 预测空间分解可作为替代性预报范式，具向其他多模态短时预测任务迁移的潜力，部署仅需天空图像与实测GHI。

title: Attention-guided classification and tumor localization of combined hepatocellular-cholangiocarcinoma
summary: Combined hepatocellular-cholangiocarcinomas (cHCC-CCA) are a type of cancer that share components of two other primary liver cancers: hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) and cholangiocarcinoma (CCA). Accurate diagnosis of cHCC-CCA, of which the behavior may resemble that of either HCC or CCA, remains a challenge due to strong intratumoral heterogeneity. Since the prognoses differ between liver cancer types, it is necessary to improve their morphological characterization and recognition in order to accurately identify cHCC-CCA. In this work, we use whole slide images (WSIs) of the two main types of liver cancer (HCC and CCA) and cHCC-CCA, stained with Hematoxylin-Eosin-Safran (HES), to train a classification model that can distinguish between these subtypes and provides a potential solution for localizing different types of tumors in the combined liver cancer images.

AI.tldr: 利用HES染色全切片图像训练分类模型，区分HCC、CCA与混合型肝癌(cHCC-CCA)，并为混合肿瘤图像中的不同肿瘤成分定位提供思路。
AI.motivation: cHCC-CCA兼具HCC与CCA成分，瘤内异质性强、诊断困难，且不同肝癌类型预后差异显著，因此亟需改善其形态学刻画与识别以准确判定cHCC-CCA。
AI.method: 基于HCC、CCA和cHCC-CCA三类HES染色全切片图像(WSI)，训练一个多类别分类模型以区分三种肝癌亚型，并探索在混合型肿瘤切片中定位不同肿瘤区域。
AI.result: 摘要未给出具体量化结果，仅指出该分类模型可为在混合肝癌图像中定位不同肿瘤类型提供潜在方案。
AI.conclusion: WSI级别的深度分类模型在区分HCC、CCA与cHCC-CCA上具有可行性，并有望辅助混合型肝癌的成分定位与病理诊断。

title: A Transparent 3-DoF Assistive Device for Upper-Limb Tremor and Ataxia Compensation: Design and Experimental Validation
summary: Assistive devices for patients with neurodegenerative movement disorders must combine high mechanical transparency with the ability to generate corrective interaction forces. Achieving both properties simultaneously remains challenging. This paper presents the completed iAssistADL platform, a 3-DoF assistive device for future tremor and ataxia compensation during activities of daily living. The system employs a transparency-oriented mechanical architecture with all actuators located at the base, resulting in low moving mass, decoupled kinematics, and high mechanical transparency. To compensate for friction-induced transparency limitations along the vertical axis, a hybrid control strategy is proposed that combines open-loop force rendering in the horizontal plane with closed-loop force control in the vertical direction. The platform is experimentally evaluated through transparency measurements and static and dynamic force-rendering experiments at representative configurations. Results demonstrate resistive torques below 0.1 Nm in the horizontal plane, end-effector forces of up to approximately 10 N throughout the workspace, and accurate horizontal force rendering up to 4 Hz. While the vertical axis remains limited by friction-induced dynamics at higher frequencies, the proposed system successfully combines high transparency with controlled force generation, establishing a promising hardware platform for future tremor and ataxia compensation.

AI.tldr: iAssistADL：用于未来震颤/共济失调补偿的3自由度助动平台，采用底座集中驱动的高透明机械结构与"水平开环力渲染+垂直闭环力控"混合控制，实现水平面阻力矩<0.1 Nm、末端力约10 N、4 Hz内精确水平力渲染。
AI.motivation: 神经退行性运动障碍患者的辅助装置需同时具备高机械透明度与生成纠偏交互力的能力，二者兼得困难；现有方案常因驱动器上臂布置、摩擦等牺牲透明度。
AI.method: 透明度导向的机械架构：所有执行器置于基座，降低运动质量、实现运动学解耦与高机械透明度；针对竖直轴摩擦导致透明度受限，提出混合控制策略——水平面开环力渲染、竖直方向闭环力控制；通过透明度测量及典型位姿下的静/动态力渲染实验评估。
AI.result: 水平面阻力矩低于0.1 Nm；工作空间内末端力可达约10 N；水平力渲染在4 Hz以内准确；竖直轴在高频仍受摩擦动力学限制。
AI.conclusion: 系统成功兼顾高透明度与可控力输出，为后续震颤与共济失调补偿提供有前景的硬件平台；尚属平台级验证，未展示真实患者闭环补偿效果。

title: Bound-Conditioned Latent Inference for Progressive Image Compression
summary: Progressive image compression reconstructs images from prefixes of a single bitstream and therefore involves sequential latent inference under partial observations. Existing trit-plane codecs mainly treat decoded trits as discrete symbols for probability prediction, without fully exploiting their role as interval constraints on the underlying continuous latents. We propose bound-conditioned latent inference (BLI), a framework that reformulates progressive trit-plane coding as sequential latent inference under shrinking interval constraints. At each coding step, the trits decoded so far define lower and upper bounds for each latent element. BLI uses the center and width of these bounds, together with hyperprior information shared by the encoder and decoder, to jointly refine the Gaussian parameters $(\mu,\sigma)$ for entropy modeling and the latent estimate $\hat{y}$ for reconstruction. As additional trits are decoded, the feasible intervals shrink monotonically, yielding tighter constraints for the next inference step and enabling flexible in-plane refinement schedules. Experiments on Kodak, CLIC, and JPEG-AI show that BLI achieves state-of-the-art rate-distortion performance among progressive image codecs, reducing BD-rate by $17.78\%$ over DPICT and by $7.96\%$ over CTC on Kodak, while replacing CTC's plane-specific predictors with a shared model that uses about $5.3\times$ fewer parameters and achieves lower latency than CTC.

AI.tldr: 提出 bound-conditioned latent inference (BLI)，将渐进式 trit-plane 图像压缩重新表述为区间约束逐步收缩下的序列潜变量推断。
AI.motivation: 现有 trit-plane 编解码器仅把已解码 trit 当作离散符号做概率预测，未利用其作为连续潜变量区间约束的作用，导致部分观测下的潜变量推断不充分。
AI.method: 每步解码的 trit 为每个潜变量元素给出上下界；BLI 用界的中心与宽度，结合编解码共享的 hyperprior，联合更新高斯熵模型参数 (\mu, \sigma) 与重构用的潜变量估计 \hat{y}。随 trit 增加区间单调收缩，支持灵活的 in-plane 细化调度，并以单一共享模型替代 CTC 的逐平面预测器。
AI.result: 在 Kodak、CLIC、JPEG-AI 上取得渐进式图像编解码 SOTA 率失真性能：Kodak 上相对 DPICT BD-rate 降低 17.78%，相对 CTC 降低 7.96%；参数量约为 CTC 的 1/5.3，延迟更低。
AI.conclusion: 把 trit 解码结果显式建模为潜变量的收缩区间约束，可显著提升渐进式压缩的率失真效率与模型紧凑性。

title: IORA: Irregular Object Immobilization under Restricted Actuation
summary: Stable grasping under task-specific disturbances is important for robotic manipulation. However, most dexterous grasp synthesis methods are developed for highly actuated hands in free space, and low-DoF hands may not be able to realize the contact topologies required by these grasps. Meanwhile, support surfaces can provide useful contact forces, but are often treated only as geometric constraints. We present a support-aware grasp synthesis framework for object immobilization with low-DoF coupled hands. Given irregular object geometry, our method represents both hand and object local surface regions as graphs and searches for kinematically feasible matchings between them. We then refine the wrist pose and motor state for geometric contact feasibility and validates the refined grasps through physical rollouts. Starting from the validated grasp pose, an optional task-guided local search explores nearby grasp configurations by varying the wrist pose and motor state, and selects one according to the specified task condition. Experiments on diverse objects show that our method generates various grasp configurations that achieve high grasp success and strong disturbance resistance. Real-world experiments further demonstrate physically executable grasps which enable object immobilization in cooking scenario.

AI.tldr: 提出面向低自由度耦合手的支撑面感知抓取合成框架：将手与不规则物体局部表面表示为图并搜索运动学可行的匹配，再优化腕位姿与电机状态，用物理仿真rollout验证，并可选任务引导局部搜索。实验显示高抓取成功率与抗扰性，并在烹饪场景真机验证物体固定。
AI.motivation: 多数灵巧抓取合成方法针对高自由度手且假设自由空间，低自由度手难以实现其所需的接触拓扑；同时支撑面仅被当作几何约束，而未用于提供有效接触力。
AI.method: 图表示手与物体局部表面区域并进行图匹配搜索运动学可行配准；细化腕位姿与电机状态以满足几何接触可行性；通过物理rollout验证；可选任务引导的局部搜索在验证位姿附近改变腕位姿与电机状态，按任务条件挑选最终构型。
AI.result: 多物体实验表明可生成多样化抓取构型，抓取成功率高、抗扰动能力强；真机实验在烹饪场景中实现可执行的抓取并完成物体固定。
AI.conclusion: 显式利用支撑面接触可显著扩展低自由度耦合手的可抓取空间，图匹配+物理验证+任务引导精化的流程在仿真与真机上均有效。

title: GraphCAD: Geometry-Aware Diffusion on Edge-Adjacency Graphs for CAD Generation
summary: Generative modeling for Computer-Aided Design (CAD) remains fundamentally challenged by the need to capture the intricate interplay between discrete topological connectivity and precise spatial geometry inherent in Boundary Representations (B-reps). Existing generative approaches largely formulate CAD construction as a sequence modeling problem, but consequently lack an explicit topological inductive bias. In this work, we present GraphCAD, a geometry-aware generative framework that centers modeling on the Edge-Adjacency Graph (EAG), a novel graph-based CAD representation tailored for generative tasks. GraphCAD adopts a hybrid graph diffusion formulation to jointly model the discrete and continuous components of EAG and introduces a geometry-aware denoising mechanism that renders node attributes into spatial point sets. These point sets are encoded by an SE(3)-equivariant backbone and fused into the node representations, thereby grounding the generative process in physical geometry. To support this study, we construct EAGBench, a large-scale dataset of engineering CAD models. Extensive experiments show that GraphCAD can generate complex CAD models with more than 50 faces and achieves state-of-the-art performance in geometric fidelity and distributional alignment compared with sequence-based baselines.

AI.tldr: GraphCAD 提出以边邻接图(EAG)为表示、混合图扩散联合建模离散拓扑与连续几何、并用 SE(3) 等变点集编码做几何感知去噪的 CAD B-rep 生成框架，同时构建 EAGBench 数据集。
AI.motivation: 现有 CAD 生成方法多把 B-rep 构造表述为序列建模问题，缺乏显式的拓扑归纳偏置，难以刻画离散拓扑连通性与精确空间几何之间的耦合。
AI.method: 以 Edge-Adjacency Graph 作为面向生成任务的图表示；采用混合图扩散同时建模节点的离散属性与连续属性；引入几何感知去噪机制，将节点属性渲染为空间点集，经 SE(3) 等变骨干编码后融合回节点表示；并构建大规模工程 CAD 数据集 EAGBench。
AI.result: 可生成面数超过 50 的复杂 CAD 模型，在几何保真度与分布对齐指标上相较序列类基线取得 state-of-the-art。
AI.conclusion: 显式图拓扑表示加等变几何融合是 CAD 生成的有效路线；但目前主要为离线数据集上的定量评估，缺少下游 CAD 编辑/约束求解闭环验证。

title: LAST-V2X: Language-Driven Adaptive Scenario Synthesis and Testing for Communication-Induced Failures in V2X Safety Applications
summary: Vehicle-to-everything (V2X) communication enables connected vehicles to make safety-critical decisions, but delayed, missing, or incorrect information can compromise driving safety. Systematically testing such failures is challenging because traffic interactions, communication conditions, and application responses must be jointly configured to produce meaningful scenarios. This paper presents LAST-V2X, a language-driven, adaptive framework for automated scenario synthesis and safety testing of V2X applications. LAST-V2X leverages large language models (LLMs) to translate natural-language test descriptions into executable scenarios grounded in roadway geometry, V2X communication semantics, and vehicle behavior. The framework integrates physical traffic simulation with spatially aware communication modeling and message-level fault injection to evaluate how information degradation affects vehicle decisions. To establish whether an observed safety failure is caused by communication rather than the underlying traffic conditions, LAST-V2X employs matched executions under degraded and ground-truth information. Furthermore, an execution-guided refinement mechanism combines parameter search and LLM self-reflection to identify ineffective test configurations, improve scenario effectiveness, and produce minimal reproducible failure cases. Experiments across diverse CARLA environments and V2X safety applications demonstrate the framework's ability to generate reliable scenarios, distinguish communication-induced failures from unrelated safety violations, and substantially improve failure discovery through adaptive refinement. These results establish LAST-V2X as a systematic approach to language-driven, causally verified, and adaptive safety testing for connected vehicle systems.

AI.tldr: LAST-V2X：LLM 驱动的 V2X 应用自动化场景生成与安全测试框架
AI.motivation: V2X 通信中延迟、丢包、错误信息会危及行车安全，但现有测试难以联合配置交通交互、通信条件与应用响应，难以产生有意义的失效场景。
AI.method: 用 LLM 将自然语言测试描述翻译为可执行场景（绑定道路几何、V2X 通信语义、车辆行为）；将物理交通仿真与空间感知通信建模、消息级故障注入相结合；采用退化信息与真值信息下的配对执行（matched executions）来归因故障是否源于通信；再用执行引导的细化机制（参数搜索 + LLM 自我反思）淘汰无效配置并生成最小可复现失败用例。
AI.result: 在多种 CARLA 环境与多类 V2X 安全应用上，框架能生成可靠场景、区分通信导致的失效与无关安全违规，并通过自适应细化显著提升失效发现率。
AI.conclusion: LAST-V2X 提供了语言驱动、因果可验证、自适应的车联网安全测试范式，但仅在 CARLA 仿真内验证，缺少真实车路协同数据与实车部署证据。

title: Diagnostic Loss: Asymmetric Supervision for Radiology Report Generation
comment: 26 pages, 6 figures, 7 tables. Code available at this https URL
summary: Automated radiology report generation requires models to do more than produce fluent clinical narratives: they must explicitly state supported diagnoses while avoiding unsupported ones. However, existing medical vision-language models (MedVLMs) are typically trained with token-level maximum likelihood objectives, which prioritize text agreement over diagnostically critical terms. As a result, models can miss key diagnoses and introduce wrong ones. We identify this as an objective misalignment between conventional language modeling and the asymmetric diagnostic requirements of radiology reporting. To encode these requirements, we introduce Diagnostic Loss (DLoss), a differentiable, architecture-agnostic objective that operates directly on decoder token probabilities. DLoss separately aggregates probability mass over vocabularies associated with diagnoses supported by the reference report and with unsupported alternatives. Using asymmetric pooling across token positions in the report, it encourages supported diagnoses to receive sufficient probability in at least one position while suppressing spurious probability spikes for unsupported diagnoses across all positions during training. The loss can be applied to existing 3D MedVLMs without modifying their vision backbones, language decoders, or inference procedures, and introduces no additional inference-time computation. We train and evaluate DLoss on 50,000 abdominal CT scans across several 3D MedVLM architectures on both in-distribution and out-of-distribution report-generation benchmarks. Across these settings, DLoss improves diagnostic faithfulness while maintaining competitive performance on conventional language-generation metrics, showing the value of asymmetric sequence-level supervision for radiology report generation. The code for DLoss is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 该论文指出医学视觉语言模型（MedVLM）的token级最大似然目标与放射报告的非对称诊断需求错位，提出Diagnostic Loss（DLoss）：在解码器token概率上分别聚合“支持诊断”与“不支持诊断”词表的概率质量，用跨位置的对称/非对称池化实现序列级监督，提升诊断忠实度且零推理开销。
AI.motivation: 现有MedVLM以token级MLE训练，只优化文本一致性而非临床关键术语，导致漏诊关键诊断、引入错误诊断。作者将这一现象归因于常规语言建模目标与放射报告“必须表述有据诊断、必须排除无据诊断”的非对称需求之间的目标错位。
AI.method: DLoss为可微、与架构无关的目标函数，直接作用于解码器token概率：分别对参考报告支持的诊断词表与不支持候选诊断词表做概率质量聚合；并采用跨token位置的非对称池化——对支持诊断只需在至少一个位置获得足够概率（max式池化），对不支持诊断则在所有位置抑制虚假概率尖峰（sum/soft-min式池化）。可直接接入现有3D MedVLM，无需改动视觉骨干、语言解码器或推理流程。
AI.result: 在50,000例腹部CT、多种3D MedVLM架构上，于分布内与分布外报告生成基准评测：DLoss提升诊断忠实度，同时在常规语言生成指标上保持有竞争力表现。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，面向放射报告生成的序列级非对称监督是有价值的：把临床诊断需求编码进损失函数比单纯提升token似然更能保证诊断正确性，且该方法即插即用、无额外推理成本。

title: In-Context Learning World Models for Robot Dual-Arm Manipulation of Soft Garment with Partial Observations
summary: Robust manipulation of soft objects, such as garments, is a critical skill for service and household robots to adopt, but remains challenging due to its high-dimensional state space, and material-dependent deformations. Humans address this challenge by using mental world models that "imagine" the shape and material properties from partial observations, which enables them to predict how actions affect future states. As such, embedding such world models in robots allows for better generalization in manipulating a wide variety of garments in the real world. However, learned world models typically require large amounts of real world data that is strenuous to collect, and a mechanism to infer latent properties that govern dynamics. We present a Soft-Object World Model that performs generative full-state estimation and action-conditioned dynamics prediction using a transformer backbone trained on large-scale simulated soft object interactions, with measures to mitigate the sim-to-real gap. By learning to infer latent shape and material cues through in-context learning over a variable-length partial point-cloud history, the model generalizes across robot embodiments, material parameters, garment types and shapes, and manipulation coordination modes without weight updates. The world model is then integrated with a Goal-Conditioned action planner for motion synthesis. We validate the approach in simulation and real world for bimanual garment folding, reporting improvements in reconstruction fidelity, prediction accuracy, and task success.

AI.tldr: 提出软物体世界模型（Soft-Object World Model）：基于大规模仿真软体交互数据训练的Transformer，通过变长部分点云历史进行上下文学习来推断潜在形状与材料属性，实现全状态生成式估计与动作条件动力学预测，并与目标条件动作规划器结合实现双臂衣物折叠。
AI.motivation: 衣物等软体操作面临高维状态空间与材料相关形变难题；人类依靠"心理世界模型"从部分观测想象形状与材料以预测动作后果。机器人若具备类似世界模型可提升泛化性，但学习世界模型需大量真实数据且缺乏推断隐属性（如材料参数）的机制。
AI.method: 1) 在仿真中大规模采集软体交互数据，训练Transformer骨干网络；2) 采用缓解sim-to-real差距的措施；3) 以变长部分点云历史为输入，通过上下文学习隐式推断形状与材料线索；4) 模型执行生成式全状态估计（补全遮挡/未观测区域）与动作条件动力学预测；5) 将世界模型接入目标条件动作规划器进行运动合成，无需权重更新即可跨本体、材料参数、衣物类型形状及操作协同模式泛化。
AI.result: 在仿真与真实世界双臂衣物折叠任务中进行验证，重建保真度、预测精度与任务成功率均有提升。
AI.conclusion: 仿真训练的软物体世界模型配合上下文学习式隐属性推断，可作为软体操作的可泛化"想象"模块，有效支撑真实机器人双臂形变物体操作。

title: UniFlowWAM: A Unified World-Action Model with Visual Semantics and 4D Geometry
comment: 14 pages, 5 figures, 4 tables. Project page: this https URL
summary: Robot demonstrations record what the robot saw and what it did. They do not specify how the 3D world changed in between. Scene-level 3D flow describes it by tracking 3D scene points, providing the world representation with 4D geometry. Prior work has used flow to improve robot policies. Flow served as an intermediate prediction that a separate model converts into actions, as a prior injected at inference time, or as an extra output learned together with the action. In all of these designs, flow stays outside the policy, as a separate module or as an extra prediction head. We introduce UniFlowWAM, a Unified World-Action Model that makes 3D scene flow a third modality on par with vision and action. Its world representation therefore covers both visual semantics, through future visual features, and 4D geometry, through 3D flow, and flow receives its own supervision. UniFlowWAM is a diffusion transformer with one expert per modality, and the three experts exchange information through joint attention. We train UniFlowWAM under a ten-objective role grid, where each objective assigns every modality exactly one of three roles, namely target, condition, or absent. The same model thus serves as a policy, as forward and inverse dynamics, and as a predictor of future visual features or 3D flow. We evaluate UniFlowWAM on RoboCasa-GR1, LIBERO, and LIBERO-Plus in simulation, and on four real-world bimanual manipulation tasks. On RoboCasa-GR1, UniFlowWAM raises the success rate of its base model without flow from 52.1% to 56.4%. It preserves in-distribution success on LIBERO at 98.1% and reaches 87.7% zero-shot on LIBERO-Plus. On the real robot, it achieves 87.0% average success, compared with 68.5% for the strongest baseline.

AI.tldr: UniFlowWAM将3D场景流作为与视觉、动作同等的第三模态，用每模态一个专家的扩散Transformer联合注意力训练，在RoboCasa/LIBERO/真机上提升成功率。
AI.motivation: 以往工作把3D场景流当作策略外的独立模块：中间预测再转动作、推理期先验、或额外预测头，流始终未进入策略本体，世界表示缺乏显式4D几何监督。
AI.method: 统一世界-动作模型（WAM）：扩散Transformer，视觉/动作/3D流各设一个专家，经联合注意力交换信息；以"十目标角色网格"训练，每个目标为每模态分配target/condition/absent三选一角色，使单一模型同时充当策略、前向/逆向动力学、未来视觉特征与3D流预测器；流有独立监督。
AI.result: RoboCasa-GR1成功率52.1%→56.4%；LIBERO分布内98.1%；LIBERO-Plus零样本87.7%；真实双臂四项任务平均87.0%，最强基线68.5%。
AI.conclusion: 将3D流内化为策略原生模态、以角色网格实现多任务自监督，可在仿真与真机上一致提升成功率，验证了几何流作为核心世界表示的可行性。

title: TRACE: Traversability-aware Reactive Navigation via VLM-driven Adaptive Constraints Estimation
summary: This paper presents TRACE, a traversability-aware reactive navigation framework designed for the autonomous operation of ground robots in unstructured forest environments. Unlike traditional approaches, TRACE leverages VLM-based confidence maps from positive and negative natural-language prompt sets and combines them through evidential fusion to produce a dense traversability map that prioritizes the terrain based on signs of previously traversed paths. Traversability-annotated points are then extracted and used to derive the left and right boundaries of the traversable path via percentile binning followed by spline or regularized polynomial fitting. These boundaries are then incorporated as soft barrier constraints within an NMPC formulation, enabling safe and adaptive path following in complex natural environments. Rigorous experimental trials carried out in real-life forest environments demonstrate TRACE ability for smooth navigation in cluttered, deformable, and visually ambiguous terrains.

AI.tldr: TRACE: 用VLM正/负文本提示生成置信图并经证据融合得到稠密可通行性地图，提取路径左右边界作为软约束嵌入NMPC，实现非结构化森林中的反应式导航。
AI.motivation: 非结构化森林环境中地形杂乱、可变形且视觉歧义强，传统几何/语义可通行性方法难以泛化，需要利用"曾被走过"的隐式线索来做地形优先级判定。
AI.method: VLM-based confidence maps：对正、负自然语言提示集分别推理，用证据融合(evidential fusion)合成稠密可通行性图；对高可通行性点按百分位分箱(percentile binning)后以样条或正则化多项式拟合，导出左右路径边界；边界作为软障碍约束(soft barrier constraints)嵌入NMPC优化。
AI.result: 在真实森林环境开展实验，可在杂乱、可变形、视觉歧义地形中实现平滑导航与自适应路径跟踪。
AI.conclusion: 将VLM语义先验与模型预测控制以"软约束+边界拟合"方式紧耦合，是野外地面机器人可通行性感知-控制一体化的一种轻量可行方案；但抽象层面缺少定量指标、基线与失败案例分析。

title: Revisiting Distribution Matching for State-to-Vision Policy Distillation in Laparoscopic Robotic Manipulation
summary: End-to-end control policies trained via Reinforcement Learning (RL) have emerged as an alternative to conventional surgical robotic control approaches, with recent studies exploring state-based policies trained on privileged state observations. However, such approaches rely on precise physical states that are difficult to obtain reliably in surgical environments. Vision-based RL provides an alternative by learning manipulation policies directly from RGB observations, avoiding explicit state estimation and manually engineered perception pipelines while enabling policies to acquire task-relevant visual representations. Nevertheless, obtaining vision-based policies via pure RL methods for surgical manipulation remains challenging. Thus, imitation learning (IL) becomes another solution, yet it requires a large number of expert demonstrations, which are difficult to obtain in minimally invasive surgery. In this work, we propose a framework for state-to-vision policy distillation in laparoscopic robotic manipulation. Specifically, a state-based policy with privileged observations is employed as the teacher, and a vision-based policy learns from RGB observations and robot proprioceptive information, which requires less expert demonstrations than IL and introduces superior performance than RL methods. We conduct extensive experiments on various surgical manipulation tasks in the simulated environment. Experimental results show that, in the context of laparoscopic robotic manipulation, training vision-based policies with general-purpose RL methods is challenging, whereas our proposed state-to-vision policy distillation leads to more consistent and stable performance across tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出腹腔镜机器人操作的"状态到视觉"策略蒸馏框架：用带特权状态观测的状态策略作教师，视觉策略从RGB与本体感知蒸馏学习，性能优于纯RL且所需专家示范少于IL。
AI.motivation: 手术场景中精确物理状态难以可靠获取，基于状态的RL策略依赖特权观测而不实用；纯视觉RL在手术操作上难以训练；IL则需要大量难以获得的专家示范。因此需要一种兼顾示范效率与视觉部署可行性的方案。
AI.method: 教师-学生蒸馏：教师在特权状态观测上训练（RL），学生策略输入RGB图像+机器人本体感知，通过策略蒸馏对齐教师行为，避免显式状态估计与手工感知管线，同时获得任务相关视觉表征。在仿真环境中跨多个腹腔镜操作任务验证。
AI.result: 实验表明腹腔镜机器人操作中通用RL直接训练视觉策略较为困难；所提状态到视觉蒸馏在多个任务上表现更一致、更稳定，且示范需求低于IL。
AI.conclusion: 状态到视觉策略蒸馏为手术机器人视觉控制提供了一条比纯RL更稳、比IL更省示范的可行路径，但验证限于仿真，未见真实机器人部署或开源证据。

title: Multi-Tool Selection for Robotic Systems: Comparing Semantic Retrieval and LLM
summary: Natural-language interfaces allow users to command robotic systems without interacting directly with mission planners or robotics middleware. Their reliable use depends on robot tool routing, defined here as the selection of the smallest complete subset of predefined executable capabilities required to satisfy a request. This task is particularly difficult for compound instructions, where incomplete selection may omit necessary sensing or monitoring capabilities, while excessive selection may expose irrelevant tools. We compare four routing strategies: three progressively refined ChromaDB-based methods - fixed-threshold retrieval, relative-distance retrieval, and clause-aware aggregated retrieval - and a cloud-hosted 120-billion-parameter language-model baseline. The methods are evaluated on 164 manually annotated prompts organised into three complexity levels, from direct single-tool requests to compound requests requiring at least three tools. Using exact-match accuracy, completeness, precision, a completeness-weighted composite score, and routing latency, CDB-v3 achieves the best macro-average score among the retrieval-only methods, with 0.7822, compared with 0.8869 for the large-model baseline. Although the LLM provides higher routing quality, CDB-v3 exhibits substantially lower latency and can be deployed locally without requiring cloud connectivity. These results identify a quality-latency trade-off between direct large-model selection and clause-aware semantic retrieval for privacy-sensitive, connectivity-constrained, and resource-constrained robotic systems.

AI.tldr: 比较四种机器人工具路由策略（三种ChromaDB检索变体与云托管120B大模型基线），在164条人工标注、三档复杂度提示词上评测；CDB-v3宏平均分0.7822，逊于LLM基线的0.8869，但延迟显著更低且可本地部署。
AI.motivation: 自然语言接口要让用户直接指挥机器人系统，依赖可靠的工具路由——即选出满足请求的最小完整可执行能力子集。复合指令下，选少了会漏掉必要感知/监控能力，选多了会暴露无关工具，因此需要研究路由策略的质量与延迟权衡。
AI.method: 提出并对比四条路由路径：固定阈值检索、相对距离检索、子句感知聚合检索（三级逐步精化的ChromaDB方案，最终为CDB-v3），以及120B参数云托管LLM基线。在164条人工标注提示词上评测，覆盖三档复杂度（单工具直请到需至少三个工具的复合请求），指标包括精确匹配准确率、完整性、精确率、完整性加权综合分与路由延迟。
AI.result: CDB-v3在纯检索方法中取得最佳宏平均综合分0.7822，大模型基线为0.8869；LLM路由质量更高，但CDB-v3延迟显著更低且无需云端连接即可本地部署。
AI.conclusion: 大模型直接选择与子句感知语义检索之间存在质量-延迟权衡；对隐私敏感、连通受限与资源受限的机器人系统，本地检索方案具有实用价值。局限在于评测规模较小（164条提示词）、以离线指标为主，未见真实机器人闭环部署验证。

title: Demonstration-Based Robotic Feeding Using Dynamic Movement Primitives
summary: This paper presents a demonstration-based robotic feeding framework that integrates human demonstration, Dynamic Movement Primitive-based motion planning, vision-based scene perception, and robot control. A human operator first demonstrates the scooping and feeding motions while the position and Euler-angle orientation of the spoon are recorded using a motion-capture system. The recorded trajectory is segmented into scooping and feeding motions, which are encoded using separate Dynamic Movement Primitives. Before task execution, an RGB-D camera estimates the participant's mouth position, while two AprilTags are used for robot-frame registration and tray localization. The detected tray pose is used to position the scooping motion, whereas the detected mouth position defines the positional goal of the feeding motion. The approach, scooping, and feeding trajectories are then executed sequentially by a Kinova Gen3 manipulator through a ROS~2-based framework. A real-world experiment demonstrates the feasibility of the integrated pipeline and shows that the learned spoon motions can be reproduced within the detected experimental scene.

AI.tldr: 用动作捕捉记录人类舀食/送食示教轨迹，分段后分别用DMP编码，配合RGB-D嘴部定位与AprilTag托盘/机器人坐标系配准，由Kinova Gen3在ROS 2上顺序执行舀取—接近—送食。
AI.motivation: 辅助进食是行动受限人群的刚性需求，需要机器人能稳定复现勺取的细腻动作并在真实场景中自适应定位目标（食物托盘与受试者嘴部），而纯手工编程轨迹难以迁移、纯学习方法数据成本高，故采用示教+DMP的低数据方案。
AI.method: 动捕系统记录勺子位置与欧拉角；轨迹按语义切分为scooping与feeding两段，各用独立DMP编码以保留轨迹形状并支持目标点泛化；执行前RGB-D相机估计嘴部位置（送食运动的目标位姿），两枚AprilTag分别完成机器人基座配准与托盘定位（舀取运动的起始位姿）；随后按approach→scooping→feeding顺序由Kinova Gen3在ROS 2框架下执行。
AI.result: 真实实验验证了整条感知—规划—控制流水线可行，学到的勺子运动可在检测到的场景中被复现。
AI.conclusion: 示教+DMP+视觉目标定位是构建进食机器人"够用"闭环的可行工程路径；但仅演示一次可行性，缺少成功率统计、多受试者/多食物泛化与失败恢复，且DMP需预知嘴部与托盘位姿，动态场景鲁棒性未知。

title: Multimodal Progress-Residual Fusion for Anticipating Navigation Retreat in Robotic Flexible Endoscopy
summary: Flexible robotic endoscopes provide access through tortuous anatomy, where friction, deformation, and wall interaction separate commanded insertion from useful distal progress. Operators interpret this mismatch and retreat to recover a navigable configuration. Recognizing the approach to that decision requires relating motor intent to distal response and the local visual scene. We introduce Multimodal Progress-Residual Fusion (MPRF), a causal model that anticipates operator retreat from commands, electromagnetic (EM) tracking, and endoscopic video. A nominal-progress model predicts the response expected in normal or successful navigation; a temporal predictor combines its EM residual with all three observed modalities. In a 150-episode colon-phantom collection, MPRF achieves 0.580 +/- 0.007 AUPRC across three seeds, compared with 0.511 for the strongest reduced-modality control. Complete multimodal histories provide the principal ranking advantage, while the residual adds an explicit intent-response representation with a small, uncertain increment over raw fusion. Analysis of frozen alarms relates warning timing to the behavioral label and explains the increase in event recall under a longer matching window. These results establish a basis for behavioral assistance during operator-controlled navigation.

AI.tldr: 提出多模态进度残差融合(MPRF)因果模型，用指令、EM跟踪与内窥镜视频预测操作员何时后退，在150例结肠体模数据上AUPRC 0.580。
AI.motivation: 柔性机器人内窥镜在迂曲解剖中插入，摩擦、形变与壁面交互使"指令插入量"与"有效远端推进"分离；操作员需识别这种失配并后退恢复可导航构型，需要将运动意图、远端响应与局部视觉关联起来以提前预警。
AI.method: MPRF因果模型：先用标称进度模型预测正常导航下应有的EM响应，得到EM残差；再由时序预测器将残差与指令、EM跟踪、内窥镜视频三模态观测融合，预测后退事件；另分析冻结报警的预警时机与匹配窗口对事件召回的影响。
AI.result: 150例结肠体模采集上，MPRF三seed平均AUPRC 0.580±0.007，最强削减模态对照为0.511；完整多模态历史贡献主要排序增益，残差提供显式意图-响应表征但相对原始融合仅小幅且不确定提升；更长匹配窗口提升事件召回。
AI.conclusion: 建立了操作员主导导航中行为辅助的基础，但仅限体模数据、无真人/真机部署，属医疗内窥镜领域的状态预测工作。

title: ResGVC: Residual Coding for High-fidelity Generative Video Compression
summary: Generative video compression (GVC) methods usually employ decoder-side diffusion models to denoise reconstructed signals based on generative priors. Besides, most of these methods perform denoising in latent space rather than directly in pixel domain. In this paper, we propose ResGVC, a residual coding framework for GVC that guides denoising toward original pictures by transmitting residual signals. ResGVC first encodes the original pictures within a learned video codec, and then decomposes the distortion between the codec reconstruction and the original pictures into a sequence of residual segments, where each residual segment is acquired at each denoising step. Residual segments can further be compressed by a novel residual codec with a diffusion transformer as an entropy model. Unlike prior methods, ResGVC introduces explicit source constraints throughout denoising rather than relying on decoder-side generation alone. The diffusion-based entropy model also enables more effective distribution modeling capability based on the powerful generative priors. Moreover, denoising directly in pixel space avoids the irreversible information loss caused by latent representation bottlenecks. Experimental results show that, compared with the previous state-of-the-art method, ResGVC achieves 63.7% and 83.8% BD-rate reductions in terms of LPIPS and PSNR, respectively, while also delivering superior visual quality.

AI.tldr: ResGVC 提出一种面向生成式视频压缩的残差编码框架，通过在每个去噪步传输残差片段为去噪过程提供显式源约束，并用扩散Transformer作为残差熵模型，实现像素域直接去噪。
AI.motivation: 现有生成式视频压缩(GVC)多依赖解码端扩散模型基于生成先验去噪，且通常在潜空间而非像素域进行，存在潜表示瓶颈导致的不可逆信息损失，并缺乏对原始信源的显式约束，易产生生成幻觉偏差。
AI.method: 1) 先用学习型视频编解码器编码原图；2) 将编解码重建与原图之间的失真分解为一系列残差片段，每个去噪步对应一个残差片段；3) 设计新的残差编解码器，以扩散Transformer作为熵模型对各残差片段进行压缩；4) 去噪全程引入显式源约束，并直接在像素空间去噪以规避潜空间瓶颈。
AI.result: 相比此前最优方法，在LPIPS和PSNR上分别取得63.7%和83.8%的BD-rate降低，同时视觉质量更优。
AI.conclusion: 将残差编码与扩散去噪耦合、以扩散Transformer作熵模型，可在像素域实现受源约束的生成式视频压缩，显著提升率失真性能与感知质量。

title: Tilt-Rotor Quadcopter with Learned Residual Control and Mode-Dependent State Estimation
summary: Tilt-rotor quadcopters redirect thrust for translation without banking, but complicate modeling, state estimation, and disturbance rejection. This paper presents a simulation-based flight stack for a \SI{2.00}{\kilo\gram} tilt-rotor quadcopter. The system uses a six-degree-of-freedom nonlinear model with first-order motor dynamics and two-axis rotor tilt, parameterized using a 3D CAD model. A cascaded PD controller commands forward and lateral tilt angles. A 14-state EKF fuses sensor data across hover, early-transition, and transition modes using a hysteretic (Schmitt-trigger) classifier to prevent covariance discontinuities. Because the proportional position loop leaves a steady-state offset under constant wind, a small bounded neural residual is added on top of the unmodified PD controller. It is trained by behavioral cloning from a teacher with privileged access to the true wind, while the deployed network never observes wind. In simulation, the EKF achieves a post-settling position root mean square error (RMSE) of \SI{0.226}{\metre} (horizontal) and \SI{0.03}{\metre} (vertical) and an attitude RMSE below \SI{0.8}{\degree}, and it estimates a wind velocity of $(\num{2.0}, \num{-1.2})\,\unit{\metre\per\second}$ to within \SI{0.15}{\metre\per\second} per axis. The residual reduces steady-state station-keeping error under wind by approximately \SI{49}{\percent}, from \SI{0.117}{\metre} to \SI{0.060}{\metre} at \SI{1.5}{\metre\per\second} and from \SI{0.319}{\metre} to \SI{0.162}{\metre} at an out-of-distribution \SI{3.9}{\metre\per\second}. The framework provides a basis for hardware-in-the-loop and flight-test studies.

AI.tldr: 一个2kg倾转旋翼四旋翼的仿真飞行栈：六自由度非线性模型+级联PD控制+14状态EKF（滞回模式切换）+基于特权蒸馏的有界神经残差，抑制风扰下稳态误差约49%。
AI.motivation: 倾转旋翼四旋翼通过直接偏转推力实现平移而不需机身倾斜，但带来建模、状态估计与抗扰难题；纯比例位置环在恒定风扰下存在稳态偏差。
AI.method: 基于3D CAD参数化的六自由度非线性模型（含一阶电机动态与双轴桨盘倾转）；级联PD控制器输出前向/侧向倾转角；14状态EKF融合悬停、早期过渡、过渡三模态传感器数据，用Schmitt触发器滞回分类避免协方差跳变；在未修改的PD上叠加小幅有界神经残差，由可观测真实风速的教师策略行为克隆训练，部署网络不观测风速。
AI.result: 仿真中EKF稳态后位置RMSE为0.226m（水平）/0.03m（垂直），姿态RMSE<0.8°，风速估计(2.0,-1.2)m/s每轴误差<0.15m/s；残差使风下定点误差从0.117m降至0.060m（1.5m/s，约-49%），分布外3.9m/s时从0.319m降至0.162m。
AI.conclusion: 提出一套可复用的倾转旋翼仿真飞行栈与轻量特权蒸馏抗扰方案，为硬件在环与实飞试验奠定基础；目前仅在仿真中验证，无实机结果。

title: AstroBench: Benchmarking Free-Floating Capture and Space Robotic Manipulation
comment: 12 pages, 5 figures, 9 tables. Code and assets: this https URL ; project website: this https URL
summary: Capturing a loose object inside a spacecraft requires a robot to approach a target that can translate and rotate, and whose motion changes when contact is made. These conditions motivate evaluation beyond manipulation of supported objects. We introduce AstroBench, an open benchmark for free-floating capture and space robotic manipulation with a fixed-base arm. The task suite combines four initial-motion tracks with sample-storage operations based on MELFI hardware and cap and captive-screw servicing based on the Robotic Refueling Mission. The two workcells provide nine task definitions and 29 task-target combinations. A metadata-filtered Objaverse inventory supplies 8,414 object instances for asset expansion, alongside five cabin visual contexts and versioned task instructions. We report two acquisition-focused experiments using existing checkpoints. A frozen $\pi_{0.5}$ DROID joint-position policy captures 2 of 200 static targets and 4 of 200 moving targets across twenty object identities. A cube-specific ACT policy captures 8 of 10 static targets and 6 of 10 moving targets in a separate experiment. Each experiment retains its recorded observation, action and capture configuration. The results document difficult direct transfer for the tested generalist checkpoint and successful task-specific capture behavior, while identifying concrete settings for studying motion-aware perception and contact-sensitive control. Code, task definitions and editable workcell assets are available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: AstroBench：面向固定基座机械臂的自由漂浮目标捕获与空间操作开源基准，含9个任务定义、29种任务-目标组合与8414个可扩展资产，并给出两个捕获实验的基线结果。
AI.motivation: 空间目标可平动+转动，且接触后运动状态改变，传统"支撑物操作"评测范式无法覆盖这类接触敏感、运动感知需求强的场景，因此需要专门基准。
AI.method: 构建两套工作单元（基于MELFI硬件的样品存储、基于Robotic Refueling Mission的端盖与系留螺钉维护），四条初始运动轨迹；用元数据过滤的Objaverse资产库（8414个实例）、5种舱内视觉上下文和版本化任务指令支撑资产扩展；报告两个仅用已有checkpoint的捕获实验：冻结的π0.5 DROID关节位置策略与cube-specific ACT策略。
AI.result: π0.5 DROID策略在20类物体上仅成功捕获200个静态目标中的2个、200个运动目标中的4个；ACT策略在独立实验中捕获10个静态目标中的8个、10个运动目标中的6个。所有实验保留观测、动作与捕获配置记录。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明通用checkpoint直接迁移困难，而任务专用策略可具备有效捕获行为，并明确了研究运动感知与接触敏感控制的具体实验设置。

title: A General-Purpose Dual-Path Interaction Framework for Multi-View Medical Image Segmentation: Alleviating Data Volume Dependency in Small-Sample Regimes
summary: The performance of medical image segmentation depends on a large amount of annotated data, and most segmentation models experience a significant drop in performance in low-sample-size scenarios. Existing semi-supervised and weakly supervised methods rely on specific network architectures, while traditional multi-view-assisted segmentation methods require strictly paired samples, which limits their clinical applications. To address these issues, we propose DPIF, a general-purpose plug-and-play dual-path interaction framework compatible with arbitrary encoder-decoder segmentation networks, which leverages cross-view anatomical complementarity to reduce annotation reliance. DPIF first performs Sinkhorn optimal transport-based cross-view distribution alignment to establish global semantic correspondence without sample-level pairing. It then adopts conditional mutual information-guided feature decoupling to enable bidirectional knowledge transfer only within the shared semantic space, suppressing view-specific noise. Finally, persistent homology-based topological regularization encodes anatomical invariants as unsupervised priors to mitigate overfitting. Experiments were conducted using 24 baseline models on a private multicenter echocardiography dataset and two public datasets. The results show that DPIF-enhanced models outperform single-view baseline models when trained on comparable amounts of data. Notably, most dual-path variants trained on 40\% - 60\% of the data achieve performance comparable to that of single-view models trained on the full dataset. This demonstrates that DPIF provides a general-purpose and scalable solution for data-scarce multi-view medical image segmentation problems.

AI.tldr: DPIF：通用即插即用的双路交互框架，通过Sinkhorn最优传输跨视角对齐、条件互信息引导特征解耦与持续同调拓扑正则，实现无需严格配对样本的多视角辅助半监督医学分割。
AI.motivation: 医学图像分割依赖大量标注，小样本下模型性能显著下降；现有半监督/弱监督方法绑定特定网络结构，传统多视角辅助方法要求严格配对样本，限制临床落地。目标是构建与任意编码器-解码器兼容、无需样本级配对的通用框架。
AI.method: 1) 基于Sinkhorn最优传输的跨视角分布对齐，建立全局语义对应而无需样本级配对；2) 条件互信息引导的特征解耦，仅在共享语义子空间内进行双向知识迁移，抑制视角特有噪声；3) 基于持续同调（persistent homology）的拓扑正则，将解剖不变性编码为无监督先验以缓解过拟合。
AI.result: 在私有 multicenter 超声心动图数据集与两个公开数据集上，用24个基线模型验证：同等训练数据量下 DPIF 增强模型优于单视角基线；多数双路变体仅用40%–60%数据即可达到单视角全量数据模型的性能。
AI.conclusion: DPIF 为数据稀缺场景下的多视角医学图像分割提供了通用、可扩展的即插即用方案，显著降低标注依赖且不牺牲网络结构自由度。

title: I$^2$-KAN: Interpretable Intra- and Inter-Modal Multi-Pathway Representation Learning for Multimodal Sentiment Analysis
summary: Multimodal sentiment analysis (MSA) aims to infer sentiment by integrating linguistic, acoustic, and visual information. However, many fusion methods integrate modality-specific representations and cross-modal interactions into joint representations, making it difficult to determine whether predictive utility arises from a modality itself or from its interactions with others. More fundamentally, a modality's standalone predictive utility may not faithfully reflect its interaction-conditioned predictive utility. To address this issue, we propose I$^2$-KAN, an interpretable multi-pathway framework that explicitly maintains intra-modal and pairwise inter-modal information in separate structural pathways. Each pathway is refined by a Task-Decoupled Linear-Gated Denoising Bottleneck (TDL-GDB) to learn compact and task-relevant representations, followed by structured Kolmogorov-Arnold Network fusion that retains explicit pathway associations and supports multi-level interpretation. Extensive experiments on CMU-MOSI, CMU-MOSEI, and CH-SIMS v2 demonstrate strong overall performance. Ablation and interpretability analyses consistently show across the three benchmarks that low standalone predictive utility does not necessarily imply low interaction-conditioned predictive utility: a modality that appears weak in isolation can remain informative through pairwise interactions. These findings highlight the interaction-dependent nature of multimodal utility and suggest that modality utility should be characterized from both standalone and interaction-conditioned perspectives.

AI.tldr: 提出可解释多通路框架I²-KAN，将单模态内与成对跨模态信息分离建模，每条通路用TDL-GDB降噪瓶颈精炼，再由结构化KAN融合，揭示模态"交互条件效用"与"独立效用"可背离。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态情感分析融合方法把模态表征与跨模态交互混合进联合表征，难以判断预测效用来自模态本身还是其交互；且单模态独立效用未必反映交互条件下的效用。
AI.method: 多通路结构分别保留模态内信息与成对模态间信息；每条通路经任务解耦线性门控降噪瓶颈（TDL-GDB）获得紧凑、任务相关的表示；采用结构化Kolmogorov-Arnold网络融合，保留显式通路关联并支持多层次解释。
AI.result: 在CMU-MOSI、CMU-MOSEI、CH-SIMS v2上取得较强整体性能；消融与可解释性分析一致显示：单模态独立预测效用低并不必然意味着交互条件效用低，弱模态可通过成对交互贡献信息。
AI.conclusion: 多模态效用具有交互依赖性，应从独立效用与交互条件效用两个视角刻画模态价值；通路分离+结构化KAN是可解释融合的有效途径。

title: To Route or to Adapt? Multi-Expert Diffusion Planners in Unseen Regions
comment: Accepted to the 10th Conference on Robot Learning (CoRL 2026). 36 pages. Code and weights: this https URL
summary: Diffusion trajectory planners with domain-specific experts face a practical question in unseen regions: can they rely on selecting among existing experts, or must the planner itself adapt? We study this question using a planner with a shared adapter and per-domain expert adapters. Across three real-world held-out maps, none of eight test-time routing schemes improves the fleet-mean lateral offset over the static default, which uses the same expert for every scene. Even an oracle that selects the best expert for each scene reduces the mean offset by only 0.9 m. In contrast, reward-based fine-tuning on just 20 target-region scenes yields substantially larger gains. On matched evaluation slices, joint replay achieves a fleet-mean offset of 6.9 m, compared with 12.4 m for the static default. Comparisons under the same target-region training budget show that target-region training drives the improvement, while replaying training scenes limits forgetting on the original ODDs. On nuPlan, fine-tuning across training cities also improves open-loop offsets, although closed-loop performance deteriorates. Further diagnostics reveal that two test-time adaptation baselines achieve low offsets by producing degenerate trajectories. These results show the limited headroom for selecting among existing experts and the greater open-loop gains available from adapting the planner.

AI.tldr: 研究扩散轨迹规划器中"选择已有专家"与"让规划器自适应"的取舍：12种基线中8种测试时路由在三个真实留出地图上均无法超过静态默认专家，而仅用20个目标区域场景做奖励微调可将车队平均横向偏移从12.4 m降至6.9 m。
AI.motivation: 域特定专家组成的扩散轨迹规划器在未见区域部署时面临实际决策：是依赖现有专家间的选择（路由/集成），还是必须让规划器本身适应新域？作者希望定量厘清"选择"的收益上限与"自适应"的实际增益。
AI.method: 采用共享适配器+每域专家适配器的规划器架构。在三个真实世界留出地图上评估8种测试时路由方案（含逐场景最优专家的oracle上界）。对比奖励驱动的微调方案，并区分目标区域训练数据与原始ODD训练场景回放的作用（joint replay）。在nuPlan上做训练城市间微调，报告开环偏移与闭环表现。另设两个测试时自适应基线作诊断。
AI.result: 8种测试时路由方案均未超过静态默认；oracle逐场景最优专家仅降低平均偏移0.9 m。奖励微调20个目标区域场景带来显著增益：匹配评估切片上joint replay车队平均偏移6.9 m vs 静态默认12.4 m。同预算对比显示增益主要来自目标区域训练，回放训练场景可限制原ODD遗忘。nuPlan上跨城市微调改善开环偏移但闭环性能退化。两个测试时自适应基线虽偏移低，但产生退化轨迹。
AI.conclusion: 现有专家间的选择空间有限（headroom小），规划器层面的自适应（少量目标域场景微调）在开环指标上收益更大；同时警示低偏移指标可能掩盖退化轨迹，需闭环/质量诊断配合评估。

title: DRAFT: Decoding and Reconstructing 3D Room Layouts from fMRI and Camera Trajectories
summary: While functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) decoders reconstruct images and 3D objects, recovering the metric geometry of rooms from a moving viewpoint remains an open challenge. We introduce, to our knowledge for the first time, the task of reconstructing 3D layouts of held-out scenes using only the known camera trajectories and the fMRI signals of participants watching indoor walkthroughs, without any visual frames. The task is hard because of the temporal mismatch between rapid visual changes and blurred fMRI signals. Our method, DRAFT (Decoding and Reconstructing 3D room lAyouts from fMRI and Trajectories), extracts a compact layout representation from the early visual cortex and fuses this neural code with the geometric free space derived from camera motion. To evaluate it, we propose layout r, the Pearson correlation between predicted and ray-cast log depths. On ten held-out scenes (20 participants), DRAFT reaches a layout r of 0.480, outperforming the camera path alone (0.446) and seven fMRI decoders (at most 0.429). DRAFT also works as a plug-in that improves all seven decoders without retraining, raising their layout r from 0.171-0.429 to 0.487-0.493. Brain activity and camera motion can thus recover the metric layout of unseen rooms, a first step toward reconstructing the 3D spaces people see.

AI.tldr: DRAFT 利用已知相机轨迹与观看室内漫游视频的 fMRI 信号，在无视觉帧输入的情况下重建留出场景的三维房间布局，通过融合早期视觉皮层解码的紧凑布局编码与相机运动导出的几何自由空间实现。
AI.motivation: fMRI 解码已能重建图像与 3D 物体，但从移动视角恢复房间的度量几何仍是空白；核心难点在于快速视觉变化与模糊 fMRI 信号之间的时间失配。
AI.method: 提出 DRAFT：从早期视觉皮层提取紧凑布局表示，与由相机运动推导的几何自由空间进行融合；提出布局相关系数 layout r（预测深度与光线投射对数深度的 Pearson 相关）作为评价指标；在 10 个留出场景、20 名被试上评估，并与仅相机路径及 7 种 fMRI 解码器对比，同时作为免重训练的插件式模块使用。
AI.result: DRAFT 达到 layout r = 0.480，优于仅相机路径（0.446）与七种 fMRI 解码器（最高 0.429）；作为插件可将七种解码器的 layout r 从 0.171–0.429 提升至 0.487–0.493，且无需重训练。
AI.conclusion: 脑活动与相机运动可共同恢复未见房间的度量布局，是迈向重建人类所见三维空间的第一步。

title: Where Do Long Captions Fail? Position-Aware Diagnosis and Reinforcement Learning for Detailed Image Captioning
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. 38 pages, 3 figures; includes references, appendices, and the paper checklist
summary: Detailed image captioning is usually framed as an amount problem: a model should mention more visual facts while avoiding hallucination. However, autoregressive VLMs generate captions as ordered sequences, and later generations may be produced under weaker or noisier visual grounding. We therefore argue that long-form captioning should be studied not only by what facts are mentioned, but also by where they appear. We introduce a position-aware rubric representation that decomposes dense human references into atomic visual claims, verifies generated captions against those claims, and induces a quartile-wise composition of supported, hallucinated, and generic content. This lens reveals two qualitatively different failures in long captions: models tend to produce unsupported specificity in the middle, while the final portion often escapes into vague, non-evidential language rather than simply accumulating more hallucination. A same-reference human control does not exhibit these patterns; additional human audits examine the visual validity of the induced labels. Motivated by this diagnosis, we propose PAGER (Position-Aware Grounded Evidence Reinforcement), a GRPO training objective with separate signals for supported fine-grained middle evidence, evidence-bearing tail continuation, claim coverage, and content-aware length control. The result is a closed loop: the same ordered claim representation identifies where long captions fail and supplies the position-specific reward needed to repair those failures. Experiments on detailed-caption benchmarks show that PAGER improves position-wise grounding and pairwise caption preference while preserving competitive global caption quality.

AI.tldr: 提出位置感知评分细则（position-aware rubric），将长图像描述分解为原子视觉声明并按四分位统计支持/幻觉/泛化内容，发现中段"无支撑细节化"与尾段"空洞化"两类失败，进而用带位置特异奖励的GRPO（PAGER）修复。
AI.motivation: 长描述常被当作"数量问题"（多覆盖事实、少幻觉），但自回归VLM按序生成，后段生成的视觉定位更弱。因此应同时研究"提到什么事实"与"事实出现在哪里"。
AI.method: 用位置感知rubric将密集人类参考分解为原子视觉声明，逐条校验生成描述，得到四分位粒度的支持、幻觉与泛化内容构成；据此设计PAGER——GRPO目标，包含细粒度中段证据支持、带证据的尾部续写、声明覆盖率与内容感知长度控制等多个独立奖励信号。
AI.result: 诊断显示中段倾向产生无支撑的具体化、尾段转为模糊非证据性语言；同参考的人类对照无此模式，人工审计验证了标签的视觉有效性。PAGER在细节描述基准上提升位置级grounding与成对偏好，同时保持有竞争力的全局描述质量。
AI.conclusion: 同一有序声明表示既定位失败位置又提供位置特异奖励，形成诊断-修复闭环；长描述评测应从"数量"扩展到"位置"维度。

title: Through a PRISM, Clearly: Step-Sequence Reasoning for Mistake Recognition in Procedural Videos
summary: Procedural mistake recognition requires identifying deviations from valid multi-step activities. We study post-completion recognition from videos with benchmark-provided step boundaries. We introduce PRISM (Procedural mistake Recognition via Interpretable Semantic Modeling), which grounds video segments in language and maps their descriptions to procedural states using a lightweight hidden Markov model trained on correct executions. Reference alignment and semantic checks identify errors in step content and order. To support evaluation across heterogeneous benchmarks, we map dataset-specific annotations to four edit-based error types: insertion, deletion, substitution, and transposition. Across three benchmarks, we compare gold and VLM-generated descriptions in raw, semantic-role, and action-object forms. Decoder controls show consistent gains from the trained local decoder over nearest-candidate matching, with additional, dataset-dependent benefits from sequence decoding. Semantic role labeling improves Any-F1 in all six matched grounded comparisons, although the gains vary across datasets and do not translate into uniform improvements under separate configuration selection. These results establish language grounding as an effective interface for explicit procedural mistake reasoning and characterize the contributions of representation and decoding.

AI.tldr: PRISM 用 VLM 生成的分段语言描述 + 语义角色标注，将视频片段映射到轻量 HMM 建模的正确流程状态，通过参考对齐与语义检查识别步骤内容与顺序错误（插入/删除/替换/换位四类）。
AI.motivation: 程序性错误识别需要检测多步活动中的偏离，现有方法缺乏可解释性和跨异构数据集的统一错误类型定义。
AI.method: 以语言为接口：将视频分段用语言描述 grounding，用仅由正确执行训练的轻量 HMM 把描述映射为流程状态；通过参考对齐与语义检查判定步骤内容/顺序错误；把各数据集标注统一映射为四种编辑式错误类型；比较 gold 与 VLM 描述在原始、语义角色、动作-宾语三种表征下的效果，并对比局部解码器与最近候选匹配。
AI.result: 三个基准上，训练得到的局部解码器较最近候选匹配有一致提升，序列解码带来数据集相关增益；语义角色标注在六个匹配的 grounded 对比中均提升 Any-F1，但增益随数据集变化，且在统一配置选择下未带来一致改善。
AI.conclusion: 语言 grounding 可作为显式程序性错误推理的有效接口，并厘清了表征与解码各自的贡献；但结论仍属基准内评测，缺乏真实部署验证。

title: RGraph-Eval: Task-Grounded Scene Graphs for Evaluating Robot Video Generation
summary: Generated robot videos can look convincing while depicting the wrong interac- tion: a different object is moved, a grasp disappears, or a placement ends out- side its destination. We introduce RGraph-Eval, a reference-based framework that makes these discrepancies explicit through task-grounded temporal scene graphs. Unlike approaches that construct separate evidence representations for different evaluation dimensions, we organize task entities, interactions, and motion within a unified, interpretable scene graph representation. A foundation-model pipeline identifies manipulation roles, grounds persistent object masks, infers and verifies state transitions and action intervals, and reconstructs manipulated- object motion in three dimensions. Applying this representation to a generated video and a reference demonstration supports an interpretable RGraph-Eval score with visible-object, relation-change, and 3D path-shape components. We also introduce ShareRobot-SG, a collection of 1,000 manipulation scenes from ten ShareRobot sources annotated with the multimodal representation. Our eval- uation separates graph-generation quality from agreement with human video judgments, and includes comparisons with adapted SVG2 and SG-Ego, a bench- mark of three video generators. The framework connects robot-video assessment to the observable entities and interactions underlying a task, while making the graph annotations reusable beyond evaluation. Code will be publicly available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: RGraph-Eval：以参考演示为基准，用任务级时序场景图统一表示实体、交互与运动，检测生成机器人视频中的交互错误。
AI.motivation: 生成式视频模型产出的机器人视频视觉逼真但交互语义可能错误（换错物体、抓取消失、放置越界），且现有评测为不同维度分别构造证据表示，缺乏统一可解释的任务级评估。
AI.method: 构建统一、可解释的任务时序场景图：基础模型流水线识别操作角色、锚定持久物体掩码、推断并校验状态转移与动作区间、重建被操作物体的三维运动；对生成视频与参考演示分别建图并对比，得到含可见物体、关系变化、3D 路径形状分量的 RGraph-Eval 分数；同时发布 ShareRobot-SG（10 个来源、1000 个操作场景的多模态标注）。
AI.result: 评估将图生成质量与和人判断的一致性分开考察，并与改适的 SVG2、SG-Ego 对比，另对三种视频生成器做了基准测试；图标注可复用于评测之外。
AI.conclusion: 将机器人视频评估与任务可观测实体及交互相连，提供可解释、分解式的参考式评分框架。

title: WildDepth-v2: A Synchronized RGB--LiDAR--Radar Dataset and Benchmark for Metric Depth, Motion, and Tracking of Wildlife
summary: Measuring animal distance and motion in metric units underpins abundance estimation, morphometrics, and movement ecology, yet monocular video lacks metric scale and wildlife datasets lack metric ground truth. We present WildDepth 2, extending the synchronized RGB-LiDAR WildDepth dataset in three directions. (i) Imaging radar: 37 RGB-LiDAR-4D-radar sequences (19,716 frames) with per-point Doppler velocity and a measured error budget, to our knowledge the first imaging-radar wildlife recordings. (ii) Benchmarking: a frozen, checksummed hidden test set for RGB-only distance estimation and RGB+sparse-LiDAR depth completion, evaluated separately on animal and background pixels. (iii) Motion and tracking: metric 3D trajectories obtained by lifting 2D tracks using LiDAR, radar, or monocular depth. Across 48,723 animal frames, object-level radar calibration improves monocular depth over scene-level LiDAR calibration without requiring LiDAR at inference (AbsRel 0.120 vs. 0.198), although animal-level LiDAR remains more accurate (0.052). Across 431 tracks, once-per-track radar scaling reduces 3D position error four-fold (2.20 to 0.58 m) and distance-sampling detection-function bias from -13% to -2%, matching once-per-track LiDAR calibration. Transferring radar Doppler onto LiDAR produces motion masks 3.7 times denser than radar alone at 72% precision, reduces moving-animal LiDAR accumulation error by 37%, and estimates radial speed (r = 0.60), albeit with approximately 50% underestimation.

AI.tldr: WildDepth 2 将同步 RGB-LiDAR 野生动物数据集扩展至包含 37 段 RGB-LiDAR-4D 毫米波雷达序列，并构建冻结的隐藏测试集，用于单目测距与 RGB+稀疏 LiDAR 深度补全；同时给出基于 LiDAR/雷达/单目深度的度量 3D 轨迹与检测函数偏差评测。
AI.motivation: 单目视频缺乏度量尺度，野生动物数据集缺少度量真值，限制了丰度估计、形态测量与运动生态学中的距离与运动量化。作者希望用成像雷达的逐点多普勒速度弥补 LiDAR 成本高、单目尺度不可靠的缺陷。
AI.method: 在同步 RGB-LiDAR 的 WildDepth 基础上加入 4D 成像雷达（19,716 帧，含逐点多普勒速度与误差预算）；建立带校验和的冻结隐藏测试集，区分动物像素与背景像素分别评估；通过 LiDAR、雷达或单目深度将 2D 轨迹提升为度量 3D 轨迹；提出对象级雷达标定替代场景级 LiDAR 标定，并把雷达多普勒迁移到 LiDAR 以生成运动掩码。
AI.result: 48,723 个动物帧上，对象级雷达标定的单目深度 AbsRel 0.120，优于场景级 LiDAR 标定的 0.198，但动物级 LiDAR 仍最佳（0.052）；431 条轨迹上，每轨迹一次雷达缩放将 3D 位置误差从 2.20 m 降至 0.58 m（约 4 倍），距离采样检测函数偏差由 -13% 改善至 -2%，与每轨迹一次 LiDAR 标定相当；雷达多普勒迁移到 LiDAR 生成的运动掩码密度为纯雷达的 3.7 倍、精度 72%，使运动动物 LiDAR 累积误差降低 37%，径向速度相关系数 r=0.60，但约低估 50%。
AI.conclusion: 低成本成像雷达在无 LiDAR 推理时仍能显著改善单目度量深度与 3D 轨迹精度，可作为 LiDAR 的实用补充；但其速度估计存在约半数低估，精度仍不及动物级 LiDAR 标定。该工作以数据集与基准为主，方法论贡献有限。

title: Pos4CHD: A Positive-Free Mask-Guided Counterfactual Synthesis Framework for Fetal Congenital Heart Defect Analysis
comment: Submitted to IEEE TMI, under review
summary: The scarcity of positive cases remains a major bottleneck in developing automated diagnostic systems for fetal Congenital Heart Defects~(CHDs), particularly for rare subtypes. Although normal cases are accessible with effort, positive cases are hard to collect due to low incidence rates and privacy concerns, causing severe class imbalance or absence of positive training samples. Existing works resort to synthesizing positives with conditional generative models, but they are task-specific and require positive training samples, hindering application for fetal CHDs. To this end, we propose a positive-free mask-guided counterfactual generation framework for fetal echocardiography, namely Pos4CHD, which enables realistic, high-quality synthesis of pseudo-positive samples from semantic masks, with only normal samples at hand. Technically, we first develop FE-Gen, a mask-guided generative model tailored for fetal heart ultrasound synthesis that mitigates histogram drift and enhances image-mask spatial alignment. Building on FE-Gen, Pos4CHD employs a mask-to-image generation paradigm for CHD synthesis. It first manipulates semantic masks to simulate fetal-heart structural anomalies and then renders anatomically consistent images. Extensive experiments on in-house datasets, together with expert evaluations, demonstrate the visual fidelity~($-12.97$ FID) and anatomical consistency~($+3.96\%$ DSC) of synthesized images. Further validations across diverse real-world CHD diagnosis tasks exhibit promising results and consistent increments, including zero-shot classification~(achieving $93.25\%$ ACC on EbA and $72.92\%$ ACC on TAPVC), lesion detection~($+6.95\%$ mAP50 on VSD), and anatomy segmentation~($+10.49\%$ DSC on fetal heart) compared with baselines. Codes and models are publicly available on \href{ this https URL }{GitHub}.

AI.tldr: Pos4CHD 提出无正样本的掩码引导反事实生成框架，仅用正常样本从语义掩码合成胎儿先心病伪正样本，并配套为胎心超声定制的 FE-Gen 生成模型。
AI.motivation: 胎儿先心病罕见亚型正样本稀缺（低发病率+隐私限制），导致严重类别不平衡甚至训练集中缺少正样本；现有条件生成方法任务特定且仍需正样本训练，难以迁移到胎心超声。
AI.method: 先训练 FE-Gen 掩码引导生成模型，缓解直方图漂移并增强图像-掩码空间对齐；再以 mask-to-image 范式构造反事实：操作语义掩码模拟胎心结构异常，渲染得到解剖一致的伪正样本；伪正样本用于下游零样本分类、病灶检测与解剖分割。
AI.result: 自有数据集上 FID 改善 12.97、DSC 提升 3.96%，结合专家评估验证视觉保真度与解剖一致性；零样本分类 EbA 93.25% ACC、TAPVC 72.92% ACC，VSD 检测 mAP50 +6.95%，胎心分割 DSC +10.49%。
AI.conclusion: 掩码级反事实合成可在无正样本条件下为医学诊断提供有效数据增广，代码模型开源；但属领域专用生成方法，可迁移性主要在掩码引导反事实增广思路而非通用具身/3D 任务。

title: GM-GReFEL: Geometry-Guided Spatiotemporal State-Space Learning for Robust Dynamic Facial Expression Recognition
summary: Recognizing facial expressions in unconstrained video suffers from two coupled problems: self-attention grows quadratically in cost with clip length, and crowdsourced labels are noisy. We present GM-GReFEL, a spatiotemporal state-space network with a geometry-aware decision stage. Its Modulated GroupMamba backbone replaces a spatiotemporal Vision Transformer. Six channel groups are scanned separately, four over the frame plane and two over time, so the cost grows linearly with sequence length ($\mathcal{O}(N)$); after each layer, a Channel Affinity Modulation gate mixes the groups again. On top of the backbone, a GReFEL reliability module turns the normalized entropy of each prediction into a mixing weight between the classifier output and a vote from trainable geometric anchors, so that facial geometry counts for more when the network is unsure. The model is initialized by static-to-dynamic weight transfer and trained with a Triple Loss. In five-fold cross-validation, the best fold scores 66.57\%/76.46\% UAR/WAR on DFEW, 0.3 points or less below the strongest compared method, and 45.66\%/62.27\% on MAFW, ahead of all compared methods; on FERV39k the mean over five splits, 42.30\%/52.66\%, is competitive. The five-fold means are 64.07\%/74.54\% on DFEW, on par with recent large pre-trained models, and 38.90\%/54.37\% on MAFW, below the best of them. A paired $t$-test on DFEW indicates a modest benefit of temporal modeling (+1.61 UAR points, one-sided $p=0.031$). Attention stays on plausible facial regions, and latency is close to a ViT-B/16 baseline (47.4 vs.\ 46.8 ms per clip). Code: this https URL .

AI.tldr: GM-GReFEL：用分组状态空间（GroupMamba）骨干替换时空 ViT，实现线性复杂度视频面部表情识别，并加入基于归一化熵的几何锚点投票可靠性门控。
AI.motivation: 无约束视频表情识别存在两个耦合问题：自注意力成本随片段长度二次增长；众包标签噪声大（不可靠）。需要同时解决效率与标签可靠性。
AI.method: 1) Modulated GroupMamba 骨干：六个通道组分别扫描（4 组沿帧平面、2 组沿时间），复杂度 O(N)；每层后用 Channel Affinity Modulation 门控重新混合各组。2) GReFEL 可靠性模块：以预测的归一化熵作为混合权重，在分类器输出与可训练几何锚点投票之间加权，熵高（不确定）时更依赖面部几何。3) 静态到动态权重迁移初始化，Triple Loss 训练。
AI.result: 五折交叉验证：DFEW 最佳折 66.57%/76.46% UAR/WAR（落后最强对比方法≤0.3 点）；MAFW 45.66%/62.27% 超过所有对比方法；FERV39k 五折均值 42.30%/52.66% 具竞争力。五折均值 DFEW 64.07%/74.54% 与近期大预训练模型相当，MAFW 38.90%/54.37% 低于最优者。DFEW 配对 t 检验显示时序建模收益 +1.61 UAR（单侧 p=0.031）。注意力集中于合理面部区域；延迟 47.4 ms/clip，接近 ViT-B/16 的 46.8 ms。
AI.conclusion: 线性复杂度的分组 SSM 骨干配合熵驱动的几何投票门控，可在与 ViT 相当的延迟下取得有竞争力（但非全面领先）的动态表情识别性能；收益幅度中等，主要价值在于效率-精度折中与对噪声标签的鲁棒性设计。

title: RankAlign: Vision-Language Representation Alignment via Rank Transformation
summary: While the Platonic Representation Hypothesis posits that vision and language models converge toward compatible latent geometries, recovering class-level correspondences between unpaired modalities without cross-modal supervision remains challenging. Existing relational matching methods compare within-modality similarity kernels directly, although the same semantic structure may be represented through different numerical parameterizations across modalities. We propose RankAlign, a rank-based normalization strategy for class-level unpaired vision-language matching. RankAlign transforms each within-modality similarity kernel into an ordinal relational representation before permutation matching, while leaving the correspondence space and matching solver unchanged. The resulting representation is invariant to strictly increasing reparameterizations of similarity values while preserving the ordinal structure used for matching. We provide exact-recovery and stability guarantees that characterize correspondence recovery under both exact and partial ordinal agreement. Experiments across diverse frozen vision and language encoders and multiple datasets demonstrate improved and more stable class-level correspondence recovery, including under label corruption and domain shift.

AI.tldr: 提出 RankAlign：在类别级无配对视觉-语言匹配前，将模态内相似度核转为序关系表示（秩归一化），使匹配对相似度的严格单调重参数化不变，并给出精确恢复与稳定性保证。
AI.motivation: Platonic Representation Hypothesis 认为视觉与语言模型隐空间趋于兼容，但在无跨模态监督下恢复类别级对应仍然困难；现有关系匹配方法直接比较模态内相似度核，而同一语义结构在不同模态中可能由不同数值参数化表示。
AI.method: 秩基归一化：对每个模态内相似度矩阵按秩（序数）标准化为序关系表示，再做置换匹配；不改变对应搜索空间与匹配求解器。理论分析给出在完全序一致与部分序一致下的精确恢复与稳定性界。实验覆盖多种冻结视觉/语言编码器与多数据集，含标签污染与域偏移设置。
AI.result: 在多种冻结编码器与数据集上，类别级对应恢复精度更高且更稳定，在标签污染和域偏移下同样有效。
AI.conclusion: 序数化（秩归一化）是消除跨模态数值参数化差异、提升无监督类别级匹配鲁棒性的有效且轻量手段，并有理论支撑。

title: Navigating human-robot interaction challenges in private and residential aged care homes
comment: Author-accepted manuscript of a book chapter published online in Elsevier's Reference Module in Materials Science and Materials Engineering (2026). Scheduled for inclusion in Comprehensive Robotics for Extreme and Challenging Environments (June 2027)
summary: This chapter explores how robotic systems and ambient intelligence can enhance care for older adults in residential aged care (RAC) homes and private homes. Although these settings differ, we frame both as extreme and challenging environments for human-robot interaction (HRI), characterised by cluttered and dynamic layouts, diverse resident needs, and limited on-site technical support. We review embodied and non-embodied systems that assist with daily living, safety monitoring, and social engagement, highlighting hybrid deployments where robots complement fixed and wearable sensors. To ensure these technologies are usable and effective, design considerations consider the cognitive, physical, and social needs of older adults. Interaction design prioritises accessibility for older adults with low digital literacy, using robust but simple voice interfaces, small sets of non-verbal cues, accessible screen-based companions, and safe object handovers. Privacy, trust, and acceptability are addressed via practical strategies such as on-device inference, data minimisation, visible consent controls, and transparent data handling aligned with emerging artificial intelligence (AI) and privacy regulation. Evaluation emphasises real-world metrics including false alarms per day, time to recover from faults, staff workload, and long-term system reliability. We close by outlining open research challenges and future directions for scalable, regulation-ready deployments that support aging with dignity, safety, and independence.

AI.tldr: 该章节综述机器人与环境智能在养老机构及居家场景中照护老年人的应用，将两类场景统一视为具有杂乱动态布局、需求多样、缺乏现场技术支持的"HRI极端环境"，讨论辅助生活、安全监测与社交互动的具身/非具身系统及混合部署，并提出面向低数字素养的交互设计、隐私信任策略与真实世界评估指标。
AI.motivation: 人口老龄化使RAC机构与家庭成为老年人照护的主要场所，但这两类环境对HRI高度不友好；同时需要兼顾可用性、可接受性与隐私合规，才能推动技术落地。
AI.method: 综述性章节：以"HRI极端环境"为框架统合两类场景，梳理具身机器人（含机器人+固定/可穿戴传感器的混合部署）与非具身系统，归纳交互设计要点（稳健简单语音接口、少量非语言线索、可及性屏幕伴侣、安全物体交接）及隐私策略（端上推理、数据最小化、可见的同意控制、透明的数据处理），并提出以误报次数/天、故障恢复时间、员工工作量、长期可靠性为核心的真实世界评估指标。
AI.result: 给出该领域的系统分类、面向老年人的可用性与可接受性设计原则，以及一套落地导向的评估指标体系；未报告新的实验或定量结果。
AI.conclusion: 提出可扩展、符合监管要求的部署方向与开放研究挑战，目标是支持有尊严、安全且独立的老年生活。

title: WildFakeToolBench: Benchmarking AI-Generated Image Detectors with Web-Sourced Image Processing
summary: As AI generated images are getting popular these days, discussions on such generations are widely existed in current public forums, software repositories, and photography tutorials. Moreover, with the help of LLM-assisted code translation, malicious actors can adopt such information to evade detectors without specialized knowledge or local GPU execution of the resulting tools. To evaluate such risks, we introduce \textsc{WildFakeToolBench}, a benchmark suite of $156$ executable image-processing tools derived from $220$ public sources across $142$ domains. Each tool retains its source evidence and passes syntax, execution, and output-distortion checks without using feedback from the evaluated detectors. On $105$ generated images from five generators, we evaluate six state-of-the-art detectors with images processed by the tools in our collected bench to assess their effectiveness against such in-the-wild risks. The strongest individual tools achieve attack success rates of $25.25\%$--$100\%$ across detectors, exceeding the strongest of six selected image-processing baselines for each detector. Evaluating subsets of an eight-tool pool yields worst-case coverage above $80\%$ for every detector. Effectiveness is sparse and detector-specific: high coverage across candidates does not imply reliable one-shot evasion. These findings not only highlight the potential of such web-sourced risks, but also show the potential on establishing AI-image detector robustness evaluation framework based on those in-the-wild information.

AI.tldr: 提出 WildFakeToolBench：从公共来源采集 156 个可执行图像处理工具，用于评测 AI 生成图像检测器在真实网络可得攻击手段下的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: AI 生成图像的识别知识在论坛、仓库、教程中广泛流传，且 LLM 辅助代码翻译使无专业知识、无本地 GPU 的攻击者也能复现规避手段，现有检测器鲁棒性评测未覆盖这类"野外"风险。
AI.method: 构建覆盖 142 个领域、源自 220 个公开资源的 156 个可执行工具；每个工具保留来源证据并通过语法、执行、输出失真三项检查（不使用待评检测器反馈）；在五类生成器产生的 105 张图上，用六种 SOTA 检测器评测工具处理后的检测效果，并与六种图像处理基线对比，分析多工具子集组合覆盖。
AI.result: 最强单工具在各检测器上攻击成功率达 25.25%–100%，均超过对应最强基线；八工具池的任意子集在最坏情况下对每个检测器覆盖率超 80%；有效性稀疏且检测器相关，候选高覆盖率并不意味单次规避可靠。
AI.conclusion: 网络来源的真实风险显著存在，可据此建立基于野外信息的 AI 图像检测器鲁棒性评测框架。

title: Calibration-free IMU-based Relative Orientation Estimation under Dynamic Human Motion
comment: 8 pages, 7 figures, 1 table. Submitted to IEEE Sensors Journal
summary: Recent magnetometer-free inertial measurement unit (IMU) methods can reduce drift in joint motion estimation using rigid-body constraints, but they typically require pre-calibrated sensor locations, assumptions of specific joint models (e.g., hinge joints) or limited motion types, or an external reference for global orientation. Furthermore, challenges related to high-frequency impacts (e.g. at foot strikes during gait) and numerical differentiation of noisy measurements have not been explicitly addressed. We propose an extended Kalman filter that estimates relative IMU orientation and sensor location simultaneously, requiring neither offline sensor location calibration nor a global orientation anchor. A systematic simulation study shows that the quality of the relative orientation and the sensor location estimates depends on different motion-intensity sources: the joint center acceleration and the relative angular velocity, respectively. A low-pass filter (LPF) is used to mitigate real-signal outliers before applying the rigid-body constraint. When applied to the OpenSense dataset with real IMU measurements across four subjects with three lower-body joint types during walking and complex tasks including various motion types, the proposed method achieves an overall relative orientation error of 2.61°, compared with 10.40° for a baseline using offline-estimated sensor locations and 7.43° for a baseline using marker-derived sensor locations. These results show that the proposed calibration-free estimation framework handles real IMU data effectively and achieves accurate relative orientation without offline sensor location calibration.

AI.tldr: 提出一种扩展卡尔曼滤波框架，在无磁力计情况下同时在线估计相对IMU朝向与传感器安装位置，无需离线标定或全局朝向参考，结合低通滤波抑制冲击离群值，在OpenSense真实数据上相对朝向误差降至2.61°。
AI.motivation: 现有无磁力计IMU关节运动估计依赖预标定的传感器位置、特定关节模型假设（如铰链关节）或有限运动类型，或需外部参考确定全局朝向；同时高频冲击（如足跟触地）与噪声微分问题未被显式处理。
AI.method: 构建扩展卡尔曼滤波器，将相对IMU朝向与传感器安装位置作为联合状态同时在线估计，摆脱离线标定与全局朝向锚点；通过系统仿真分析指出相对朝向精度主要受关节中心加速度驱动、位置估计主要受相对角速度驱动；在施加刚体约束前使用低通滤波器抑制真实信号中的冲击离群值。
AI.result: 仿真系统揭示不同运动强度来源对两类估计量的差异化影响；在OpenSense数据集（4名受试者、三类下肢关节、行走及含多种运动的复杂任务）上，整体相对朝向误差为2.61°，显著优于使用离线估计位置的基线（10.40°）与使用标记点反推位置的基线（7.43°）。
AI.conclusion: 该免标定估计框架可有效处理真实IMU数据，在无离线传感器位置标定的前提下实现高精度相对关节朝向估计，且对高频冲击与数值噪声具备鲁棒性。

title: Beyond Watching and Searching: Benchmarking Agents for Video-centered Deep Research Reports
summary: Deep research agents synthesize open-web evidence into long reports, but current benchmarks do not evaluate research centered on a source video. We introduce Video-Centered Deep Research Report Generation. Given a video and user request, an agent identifies research questions, retrieves external multimodal evidence, and produces an interactive report linked to relevant video moments. This task has direct practical value because it helps users locate relevant moments, verify claims, reproduce demonstrated procedures, and make informed decisions from video content. We present a skill-based workflow and OmniDR-Bench for this task. For evaluation, we propose Omni Atomic Rubric Trees (Omni-ARTs). Each tree contains three dimensions, 23 shared directions, and task-specific atomic binary criteria. The directions test audiovisual grounding, multimodal evidence use, and interactive presentation. Audited Rubric Construction (ARC) builds these trees through independent evidence collection, automated checks, behavioral calibration, and iterative human review. OmniDR-Bench contains 50 Chinese and English tasks across 19 realworld subcategories. It includes 6,414 criteria. Across 18 agent configurations, the best system scores 63.3 out of 100. Current agents still need broader content coverage, stronger causal and logical analysis across modalities, and more accurate citation support. We further analyze models, harnesses, skill configurations, video categories, and research trajectories. The code and data are released at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 提出以视频为中心的深度研究报告生成任务，构建OmniDR-Bench基准（50个中英任务、19个真实子类、6414条原子评分标准）与Omni-ARTs评分树，18种agent配置最优仅63.3分。
AI.motivation: 现有深度研究agent基准只评估开放网络文本证据的综合，未覆盖以源视频为中心、需检索外部多模态证据并生成可交互报告的研究场景；该能力对用户定位关键片段、验证主张、复现操作流程有直接实用价值。
AI.method: 形式化定义Video-Centered Deep Research Report Generation任务；提出技能化（skill-based）工作流；构建OmniDR-Bench基准与Omni Atomic Rubric Trees（每树3维度、23个共享方向、任务特定原子二元判据），通过Audited Rubric Construction（独立证据收集、自动检查、行为校准、迭代人工复审）生成评分树。
AI.result: OmniDR-Bench含50个任务、19个真实子类、6,414条判据；18种agent配置中最优系统仅63.3/100，普遍存在内容覆盖不足、跨模态因果与逻辑分析薄弱、引用支撑不够准确的问题；并分析了模型、harness、技能配置、视频类别与研究轨迹。
AI.conclusion: 当前agent在视频中心深度研究上能力仍有限，该基准与原子评分树为后续agent系统与评估方法提供可复用工具与诊断依据。

title: HiSTEVE 1.0: Harnessing Human-Interface VLA Agents for Open-World Games
