summary: Building virtual embodied agents that operate in open-ended games like human players is a long-standing goal requiring both long-horizon autonomy and reliable native-interface control. As a procedurally generated open world, Minecraft provides a natural testbed for studying the integration of these capabilities. Existing agents typically provide either native visuomotor control without long-horizon autonomy or high-level planning executed through environment APIs or predefined skills. To bridge this gap, we propose HiSTEVE, a hierarchical VLA agent with a capability-aware agent harness. At the orchestration level, we equip the harness with structured memory for tracking progress and a VLM planner for selecting subtasks within the VLA's capabilities. To reliably determine subtask completion, we further introduce a policy-coupled task completion state detector that conditions on VLA policy context to signal candidate completion. At the control level, a single VLA executes all subtasks with vision-only perception and native keyboard-and-mouse actions. To mitigate interference between heterogeneous GUI and non-GUI interactions, we introduce regime-specific RMSNorm branches and separate mouse-movement token embeddings. We also train the VLA through world knowledge injection, imitation learning, and reinforcement learning with environment feedback to improve reliability and recovery. HiSTEVE achieves state-of-the-art atomic-task performance, scoring 85.0% on MineStudio Bench and a 37.4% average success rate on OpenHA, while also completing long-horizon tasks such as crafting an iron pickaxe from scratch like human players.

AI.tldr: HiSTEVE：面向Minecraft开放世界的分层VLA智能体，上层用结构化记忆+带能力感知的VLM规划器做子任务编排，下层单一VLA以纯视觉输入和原生键鼠动作执行；引入策略耦合的任务完成检测器，并用regime-specific RMSNorm分支与独立鼠标移动token嵌入缓解GUI/非GUI干扰，经世界知识注入、模仿学习与RL训练。
AI.motivation: 现有Minecraft智能体要么只有原生视觉运动控制但缺乏长时程自主性，要么依赖环境API/预定义技能做高层规划，二者割裂；目标是让智能体像人类玩家一样同时具备长时程自主与可靠的原始接口控制。
AI.method: 分层VLA架构：orchestration层由capability-aware harness（结构化进度记忆+VLM规划器，仅在VLA能力范围内选子任务）构成；提出policy-coupled task completion state detector，以VLA策略上下文为条件判定子任务完成；控制层为单一VLA，视觉only感知+原生键鼠动作；架构上加入GUI/非GUI专用的RMSNorm分支与分离的鼠标移动token embedding；训练流程为世界知识注入+模仿学习+基于环境反馈的RL（含恢复行为）。
AI.result: 原子任务达到SOTA：MineStudio Bench 85.0%，OpenHA平均成功率37.4%；并能完成从零制作铁镐等长时程任务。
AI.conclusion: 将能力感知的编排harness与单一原生接口VLA耦合，可打通长时程自主与底层控制，为开放世界具身智能体提供可行范式。

title: Memory before Goal: Role of Pre-History Memory for Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
comment: 8 pages, 4 figures, 5 tables. Submitted to IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters (RA-L). Project page: this https URL
summary: Humanoid loco-manipulation in dynamic scenes is non-Markovian: cues vanish as objects change or are hidden, or leave the view as the robot turns and walks, yet whole-body vision-language-action (VLA) policies see only the present. We present WholeBodyMem, an object-guided perceptual memory that keeps the pre-history of object events seen before the robot acts on its goal. SAM3 tracks the task objects, and their events causally select key frames within an adaptive budget, which the action expert reads by cross-attention together with object tokens encoding appearance, geometry and time. We also contribute HuMeGo, a humanoid memory benchmark with six simulated and six real-world Unitree G1 tasks. Keeping the right frames rather than more frames, WholeBodyMem surpasses memoryless and uniform-memory baselines, raising its base policy's success from 29.1% to 72.6% in simulation and from 36.7% to 88.3% on the real robot, while also improving the standard SIMPLE tasks (70.2% to 86.9%).

AI.tldr: WholeBodyMem：面向人形全身VLA的“对象引导感知记忆”，用SAM3跟踪任务对象并以对象事件因果筛选关键帧，使动作专家可通过跨注意力访问机器人动作前的历史观测；配套HuMeGo基准（6仿真+6真实Unitree G1任务）。
AI.motivation: 动态场景下的人形loco-manipulation本质是非马尔可夫的：目标物体变形/被遮挡后线索消失，机器人转身行走时目标离开视野，而现有全身VLA策略只看当前帧，导致在需要历史信息的任务上失败。
AI.method: 以对象为中心的感知记忆模块：SAM3分割跟踪任务相关物体；由物体事件（出现、状态变化等）因果地触发关键帧选择，并在自适应预算下保存“动作前”的历史关键帧；关键帧经跨注意力注入动作专家，并与编码外观、几何与时间的对象token联合使用。机器人侧为全身VLA策略（视觉-语言-动作）+记忆读取模块。
AI.result: 在HuMeGo（6个仿真+6个真实Unitree G1任务）上，相对无记忆与均匀采样记忆基线，将基策略成功率从仿真29.1%提升至72.6%、真机36.7%提升至88.3%；标准SIMPLE任务亦从70.2%提升至86.9%。
AI.conclusion: “选对帧”优于“多存帧”：对象事件驱动的稀疏记忆足以解决全身VLA的非马尔可夫问题，并在真实人形平台上得到验证。

title: RaSFNet: Ray-aligned and Scan-aware Fusion Network for LiDAR Semantic Segmentation
summary: LiDAR point cloud semantic segmentation is a fundamental component of 3D perception for autonomous driving and robotics. Projection-based methods map 3D point clouds into 2D representations for feature extraction using 2D networks. However, aggregating multiple points during projection can obscure geometric differences within each frustum, while local feature extraction limits the modeling of spatial relationships across scanning regions. Moreover, proximity in the projected representation does not necessarily imply proximity in 3D space, and interactions between point and projected features may mix features from different ranges, reducing semantic discriminability. To address these challenges, we propose the Ray-aligned and Scan-aware Fusion Network (RaSFNet), which incorporates point cloud geometry and LiDAR scanning characteristics into projection-based semantic segmentation. Specifically, the Ray-Aligned Geometric Distribution Encoding (RAGDE) module characterizes point distributions within each frustum using a ray-aligned coordinate system. To model spatial context, a Scan-Topology-Aware Mamba (STAM) block organizes frustum features according to the LiDAR azimuth sampling pattern and captures long-range dependencies across scanning regions. In addition, a Range-Constrained Point-Frustum Fusion (RCPFF) mechanism uses shared range information to guide feature exchange between point and frustum representations while maintaining spatial correspondence. RaSFNet achieves mIoU scores of 70.2% and 77.7% on the SemanticKITTI and nuScenes validation sets, respectively, indicating competitive segmentation performance compared with the evaluated methods.

AI.tldr: RaSFNet：将射线对齐几何分布编码（RAGDE）、扫描拓扑感知Mamba（STAM）与范围约束的点-视锥融合（RCPFF）结合，提升基于投影的LiDAR点云语义分割。SemanticKITTI 70.2% mIoU，nuScenes 77.7% mIoU。
AI.motivation: 投影式LiDAR语义分割存在三重缺陷：(1) 投影聚合多点在单个frustum内丢失几何差异；(2) 局部特征提取限制跨扫描区域的空间关系建模；(3) 投影近邻≠3D近邻，点特征与投影特征交互会混入不同距离范围的特征，削弱语义可判别性。
AI.method: 提出RaSFNet，将点云几何与LiDAR扫描特性注入投影式分割框架：(1) RAGDE在射线对齐坐标系下刻画每个frustum内的点分布，保留几何差异；(2) STAM按LiDAR方位角采样模式组织frustum特征，用Mamba建模跨扫描区域长程依赖；(3) RCPFF以共享range信息引导点与frustum表示之间的特征交换，维持空间对应关系。
AI.result: SemanticKITTI验证集mIoU 70.2%，nuScenes验证集mIoU 77.7%，与所评估方法相比具有竞争力；摘要未给出与SOTA的明确差距、效率指标或开源信息。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式编码射线几何、扫描拓扑与range约束，可缓解投影式方法的几何信息损失与跨区域上下文不足问题，属于对投影式LiDAR分割范式的有效增强。但方法属感知层面的增量改进，缺乏下游机器人任务验证与代码公开说明，优先级中等。

title: Inside-JEPA: From Prediction to Relational Grounding in Latent World Models
summary: Joint-embedding predictive architectures (JEPAs) learn world models in latent space, enabling efficient planning but leaving their states opaque. We introduce Inside-JEPA, which places relational channels for ordered entity pairs inside the JEPA latent state and shows that an inverse-dynamics loss can ground these channels without relation labels when its head reads them, either alone or as part of the full state. On Something-Something V2, latent prediction alone performs no better than a random relation head, while inverse-dynamics supervision that recovers actions from channel changes improves relational AUROC by .065-.103 across ten settings with annotated boxes, by .081 on RH20T robot episodes with held-out tasks, and by .050-.061 across five relations using off-the-shelf detection and tracking. An inverse head on entity latents decodes actions more accurately but barely improves relational grounding; shuffled labels, two label-free objectives, and action labels on only 5% of the pairs also fail to ground the channels. Given an action, predicted relational changes approach the quality of observed future relations (AUROC .599 vs .621). For one-step relational goals, a supervised readout of the 16 channels ranks the correct action among the top five of 65 in 43% of cases, compared with 24% for prediction-only latents and 17% for a frequency prior.

AI.tldr: Inside-JEPA在JEPA隐状态中为有序实体对加入关系通道，并用逆动力学损失在无关系标签下接地这些通道，实现可解释、可规划的关系化世界模型。
AI.motivation: JEPA在潜空间学习世界模型，规划高效但状态不透明（opaque），缺乏实体间关系的显式表征，难以进行关系化目标规划与解读。
AI.method: 在JEPA潜状态内插入面向有序实体对的关系通道；用逆动力学损失（从通道变化反推动作）监督这些通道，无需关系标签；配合标注框、检测+跟踪及机器人数据，并对比随机关系头、打乱标签、两种无标签目标、仅5%动作标签等消融。
AI.result: SSv2上纯潜预测仅相当于随机关系头；逆动力学监督在十种设置下关系AUROC提升.065-.103，RH20T跨任务提升.081，检测跟踪五类关系提升.050-.061；实体潜变量上的逆头解码动作更准但几乎不改善接地；给定动作，预测的关系变化接近观测未来关系（AUROC .599 vs .621）；一步关系目标下top-5命中率43%（预测-only 24%，频率先验17%）。
AI.conclusion: 逆动力学读出可无标签地接地JEPA潜空间中的关系通道，使其支持关系化预测与目标规划，但依赖于head读取通道的方式，纯预测目标不足以产生关系结构。

title: A Visual Grounding Benchmark for Retinal OCT with Multimodal Large Language Models
comment: Under review at npj digital medicine
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can answer clinical questions about medical images, but trustworthy use requires visual grounding: models should localize the pathology they report rather than rely on spurious shortcuts. Whether MLLMs can visually ground clinical findings in retinal optical coherence tomography (OCT), the most widely used imaging modality in ophthalmology, remains largely unexplored. To address this gap, we introduce RetinaGroundBench, the first benchmark for biomarker visual grounding in retinal OCT. It comprises 815 B-scans exhaustively annotated by ophthalmologists with 4,537 bounding boxes covering 13 biomarkers across 8 diseases. Because MLLMs often fragment a single lesion into multiple partial predictions, we propose AggIoU, a metric that evaluates whether the union of overlapping predicted boxes covers the annotated region. Across 27 open-source MLLMs (0.8-38B parameters), we find that visual grounding remains largely unsolved: the best general-purpose model achieves a macro F1 of just 23.7%, with consistently low recall, despite reaching up to 73% balanced accuracy on biomarker presence questions. To narrow this gap, we developed RetGrounder, an MLLM fine-tuned using an OCT-specific strategy integrating grounding and textual information. Despite its relatively small size (8B), RetGrounder improves grounding F1 to 33.9%, a 43% relative improvement. Our benchmark provides a reference point for measuring progress in the field of OCT diagnosis with MLLMs.

AI.tldr: 提出RetinaGroundBench——首个视网膜OCT生物标志物视觉定位基准（815张B-scan、4537框、13类标志物、8种疾病），并提出AggIoU指标解决病灶碎片化预测问题；评估27个开源MLLM发现定位普遍未解决（最佳通用模型macro F1仅23.7%），进而微调出8B的RetGrounder将F1提升至33.9%（相对+43%）。
AI.motivation: MLLM可回答医学影像临床问题，但可信使用需要视觉定位（指出报告病灶所在），以避免依赖虚假捷径。视网膜OCT是眼科最常用模态，MLLM在该模态上的视觉定位能力尚属空白，缺少可量化的评测基准与指标。
AI.method: 构建RetinaGroundBench：815张B-scan由眼科医生穷尽标注4537个框，覆盖8种疾病的13类生物标志物。针对模型将单一病灶拆成多个局部预测的现象，提出AggIoU指标，以预测框并集对标注区域的覆盖度进行评价。在27个开源MLLM（0.8–38B）上评测；并以OCT专用策略（融合定位与文本信息）微调得到RetGrounder（8B）。
AI.result: 视觉定位整体仍未被解决：最佳通用模型macro F1仅23.7%，召回率持续偏低，尽管其在生物标志物"是否存在"问题上的平衡准确率可达73%。RetGrounder以8B规模将定位F1提升至33.9%，相对提升43%。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为OCT诊断中的MLLM视觉定位提供了可复现的参考基准与更合理的评价指标，并表明小规模专用微调可显著缩小定位差距，但绝对性能仍远未达到临床可信水平。

title: Moving Regions, Not Moving Objects: Segmenting What Actually Moves under Camera Motion
comment: Project page and video demonstrations: this https URL
summary: Moving object segmentation is conventionally formulated at the sequence and object level, marking an entire instance as moving once it moves anywhere in a video. Recent instantaneous formulations distinguish moving from stationary intervals, but still generate masks at the object level through frozen segmentation foundation models. Because the mask is derived from an instance-level proposal, motion is typically attributed to the entire instance rather than localized to the regions that actually move. Moreover, such instance-level predictions can produce masks even when no part of the instance is actually moving, revealing a more fundamental issue: motion is not an intrinsic property of an instance; it can only be determined by comparing at least two frames. Building on this premise, we introduce MoRSe, which jointly interprets two frames to predict a moving-region mask, distinguishing actual scene motion from apparent motion induced by the camera. A single RGB encoder replaces multi-stage foundation stacks, so no optical flow, point tracks, or separate mask generator is needed at inference. We release MoRSe-5K, a benchmark of 42 sequences with Static, Dynamic-Static, and Dynamic settings designed to evaluate the model's ability to distinguish and localize moving and stationary regions under different camera and scene motion conditions. MoRSe outperforms both specialized moving object segmentation methods and dense 4D reconstruction methods with motion-thresholded predictions, while producing the fewest false positives on sequences where nothing moves.

AI.tldr: MoRSe 用单个 RGB 编码器联合解读两帧，直接预测"移动区域"掩码（而非实例级掩码），无需光流、点轨迹或分割基础模型，并发布 MoRSe-5K 基准以评估静止/运动区域区分与定位能力。
AI.motivation: 现有多数运动目标分割在序列/实例层级建模，只要实例在视频中任一处运动就把整个实例标为运动；近期的瞬时（instantaneous）方法虽区分运动区间，但仍依赖冻结的分割基础模型输出对象级掩码，导致运动被归因到整个实例而非真正运动的区域，甚至在实例完全静止时也输出掩码。作者强调更根本的问题：运动不是实例的固有属性，必须通过至少两帧比较才能判定。
AI.method: MoRSe 以两帧 RGB 作为联合输入，直接回归移动区域掩码，用单一 RGB 编码器替代多阶段基础模型堆叠，推理时不需要光流、点跟踪或独立掩码生成器；设计上区分真实场景运动与相机运动引起的表观运动。同时构建 MoRSe-5K 基准：42 段序列，涵盖 Static、Dynamic-Static、Dynamic 三类设置，考察不同相机/场景运动条件下的运动-静止区域辨别与定位。
AI.result: MoRSe 优于专用运动目标分割方法，也优于"密集 4D 重建 + 运动阈值"的预测方式；在完全无运动的序列上产生最少的假阳性。
AI.conclusion: 把运动建模从实例级下移到区域级、并以最小两帧比较为判定基础，是可行且更准确的公式化方式；该方法以更轻量的单编码器架构取得更强性能，同时提供了针对该问题的评测基准。

title: Consistent Distributed Invariant EKF SLAM with Point and Object Features
comment: Submitted to IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters (RA-L)
summary: Multi-robot SLAM allows robots to improve their estimates by exchanging map information, but repeated exchanges create unknown correlations between local estimators. Covariance intersection (CI) can fuse estimates without tracking these correlations. In right-invariant extended Kalman filter (RI-EKF) SLAM, however, point features obtain their invariant errors through the robot rotation, so a neighbor's map estimate is expressed in its own error coordinates and is correlated with its pose, and cannot be fused by CI directly. This paper presents Joint-CI, a unified fusion method for distributed RI-EKF SLAM with point, object, and mixed point--object maps. Using a neighboring robot's local posterior and an inter-robot observation, a joint estimate of the receiving robot's pose and the common features is constructed in the receiving robot's error coordinates, retaining the robot--feature and feature--feature correlations. Partial-state CI then fuses this estimate with the receiving robot's local posterior. We show that the unified formulation and the fusion preserve the six unobservable directions associated with global rotation and translation, and that communication and fusion preserve first-order covariance consistency given consistent local posteriors. Monte Carlo simulations and a real-world dataset-derived experiment show that Joint-CI improves estimation accuracy while maintaining consistent, mildly conservative uncertainty.

AI.tldr: 提出Joint-CI，面向分布式RI-EKF SLAM（点、物体及混合地图）的统一融合方法：在接收机器人的误差坐标中构造位姿与公共特征的联合估计以保留相关性，再用部分状态CI与本地后验融合，并证明其保持六个不可观方向与一阶协方差一致性。
AI.motivation: 多机器人SLAM反复交换地图信息会引入未知相关性；CI虽可免相关性追踪地融合，但在RI-EKF中点的不变误差依赖机器人旋转，邻居的地图估计位于其自身误差坐标并与位姿相关，无法直接使用CI。且点/物体/混合地图缺乏统一处理框架。
AI.method: 利用邻居机器人局部后验与机器人间观测，在接收机器人的误差坐标下构造"接收机器人位姿+公共特征"的联合估计，显式保留机器人与特征、特征与特征的相关性；随后对该联合估计与本地后验执行部分状态CI融合，形成点、物体、混合地图通用的统一公式。
AI.result: 理论分析表明统一建模与融合保持全局旋转与平移对应的六个不可观方向，且在局部后验一致时通信与融合保持一阶协方差一致性；蒙特卡洛仿真与基于真实数据集的实验显示精度提升，同时不确定性保持一致且轻度保守。
AI.conclusion: Joint-CI为分布式不变EKF SLAM提供了可处理未知相关性的统一融合方案，兼顾一致性、可观测性维护与精度提升，适用于点多机器人协同建图与状态估计。

title: GLOW-FM: Efficient Generative Low-Light Image Enhancement with One-Step Latent Flow Matching
summary: Low-light image enhancement (LLIE) aims to recover well-exposed and perceptually faithful images from severely degraded observations. Recent diffusion-based generative methods achieve strong perceptual quality by leveraging powerful image priors, but their iterative sampling incurs substantial computational cost, limiting practical deployment. Despite recent efficiency gains in generative LLIE, high-quality enhancement with a single function evaluation and low overall computation remains challenging, particularly under diverse real-world low-light conditions. We introduce GLOW-FM, a one-step latent flow-matching framework for efficient generative LLIE. GLOW-FM performs conditional transport in the latent space of a frozen Tiny-VAE and leverages Terminal Velocity Matching (TVM) to enable enhancement with a single function evaluation. Matched comparisons with alternative one-step objectives support TVM as an effective design choice, and, to the best of our knowledge, this is its first adaptation to image restoration and specifically to LLIE. Extensive experiments on challenging real-world benchmarks demonstrate that GLOW-FM achieves competitive image quality and state-of-the-art cross-dataset generalization while requiring only a single function evaluation and 34 GFLOPs for the small variant. These findings highlight the potential of GLOW-FM to bring generative LLIE closer to practical deployment through single-step inference and compact latent modeling. Code will be made publicly available upon publication.

AI.tldr: GLOW-FM：在冻结的 Tiny-VAE 潜空间做单步条件流匹配（终端速度匹配 TVM），实现单次函数评估、34 GFLOPs 的低光照图像增强生成式方法。
AI.motivation: 扩散类生成式 LLIE 感知质量强，但迭代采样计算开销大；现有高效方案仍难以在多样化真实低光条件下同时做到单次函数评估与高质量增强。
AI.method: 冻结 Tiny-VAE 的紧凑潜空间中进行条件传输；提出 Terminal Velocity Matching (TVM) 目标，使单步推理即可完成增强；与其它单步目标做匹配对比，并将 TVM 首次适配到图像复原/LLIE。
AI.result: 在多个挑战性真实世界基准上取得有竞争力的图像质量与最优跨数据集泛化，小模型变体仅需单次函数评估与 34 GFLOPs。
AI.conclusion: 单步潜空间流匹配可显著降低生成式 LLIE 的推理成本，推动其走向实际部署；代码将在发表后公开。

title: Lightweight Frame Compensation for Real-Time Polyp Segmentation under Frame Skipping
summary: Real-time polyp segmentation in computer-assisted colonoscopy is hampered by the difficulty of deploying high-accuracy models under strict latency budgets. Frame skipping, which performs inference every K frames and reuses or interpolates the rest, improves throughput but introduces motion blur and lesion misalignment that degrade temporal consistency. To close this gap, we propose the Lightweight Frame Compensator (LFC), a 77K-parameter plug-and-play module inserted before a frozen segmentation backbone. Operating on a three-frame window, LFC fuses consecutive frames via spatio-temporal attention into a single compensated frame, and is trained only on pseudo-labels generated by a differently seeded model, without any expert annotation. Experiments on three polyp video benchmarks show that LFC recovers most of the accuracy degraded by direct frame skipping and, in several settings, reaches the accuracy of frame-by-frame inference, while retaining a 2.05X--2.55X throughput gain. We further evaluate the temporal stability of three backbones spanning CNN, pyramid Transformer, and global-attention Transformer architectures, revealing a spectrum of sensitivity to frame skipping that arises from how locally or globally each architecture aggregates misaligned input. The compensation gain of LFC follows this spectrum: it is largest for high-capacity Transformer backbones, which achieve the best static accuracy but suffer the most under skip-frame inference. LFC thus offers a lightweight, pluggable, and deployment-friendly route to real-time polyp segmentation.

AI.tldr: 提出77K参数即插即用模块LFC，插在冻结分割主干前，用三帧窗口经时空注意力融合为补偿帧，缓解跳帧推理带来的运动模糊与错位，保持2.05X–2.55X吞吐增益。
AI.motivation: 结肠镜实时息肉分割需在严格延迟预算下部署高精度模型；跳帧推理虽提升吞吐，但造成运动模糊和病灶错位，破坏时间一致性。
AI.method: Lightweight Frame Compensator（LFC），77K参数，即插即用于冻结分割主干之前；对连续三帧做时空注意力融合，输出单一补偿帧；仅用不同随机种子模型生成的伪标签训练，无需专家标注。并在CNN、金字塔Transformer、全局注意力Transformer三类主干上评估时间稳定性。
AI.result: 在三个息肉视频基准上，LFC基本恢复跳帧造成的精度损失，部分设置达到逐帧推理精度，同时保留2.05X–2.55X吞吐增益；补偿收益随主干对跳帧的敏感度谱系变化，在高容量Transformer上最大。
AI.conclusion: LFC为实时息肉分割提供轻量、可插拔、易部署的方案；架构局部/全局聚合方式决定跳帧敏感度，据此可指导补偿模块的部署取舍。

title: Reinforcing intra-operative tumour localisation with weak supervision from pre-operative appearances
summary: Limited tumour visibility on intra-operative images complicates surgical navigation, including liver hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) targeting on computed tomography (CT) imaging. This makes labelled datasets difficult to curate for deep learning, and transferring pre-operative delineations through registration remains challenging due to intra-operative deformation and lack of paired pre- and intra-operative data. We propose to transfer tumour appearances learned from pre-operative magnetic resonance (MR) images to guide localisation on intra-operative CT through weak supervision. A classifier is trained to classify tumour presence on pre-operative images. This is applied to windows on intra-operative images, and despite the domain gap, it assigns higher tumour-presence probabilities on average to tumour-containing windows. These weak cross-domain signals guide a reinforcement learning agent to localise tumours on intra-operative images. We compare direct transfer, few-shot adaptation and synthetic transfer (trained using unpaired MR and CT), which translates CT into synthetic MR before localisation. On an external HCC cohort, synthetic transfer outperformed other tested methods and CT-only baselines. Our framework enables cross-modality tumour localisation without paired MR-CT training images.

AI.tldr: 提出跨模态弱监督框架：在术前MR上训练肿瘤存在性分类器，将其作为弱信号（RL奖励）引导智能体在术中CT上定位HCC肿瘤；比较直接迁移、few-shot适配与合成迁移（CT→合成MR）三种策略。
AI.motivation: 术中影像肿瘤可见性差、缺乏带标注的术中数据、配准迁移受术中形变影响且缺少配对MR-CT数据，导致手术导航中的肿瘤定位困难。
AI.method: 术前MR训练滑窗级肿瘤存在性分类器；尽管存在域间差异，该分类器在术中CT含肿瘤窗口上给出更高平均肿瘤概率，据此作为弱跨域信号，驱动强化学习智能体在术中CT上搜索/定位肿瘤。对比三种迁移方式：直接迁移、few-shot适配、合成迁移（用非配对MR与CT训练，先将CT翻译为合成MR再定位）。
AI.result: 在外部HCC队列上，合成迁移优于直接迁移、few-shot适配以及仅用CT的基线。
AI.conclusion: 该框架实现了无需配对MR-CT训练图像的跨模态肿瘤定位，为术中导航中的弱监督跨域目标定位提供可行路径；但验证规模有限，缺乏临床部署层面的证据。

title: Learning Robot Behavior Priors from Non-Robotic Synthetic Data
summary: Real robot data, rich across tasks and morphologies, is often treated as the bottleneck for training robot learning models, including embodied foundation models that aim for zero-shot physical transfer. In this paper, we investigate the degree to which such models can acquire necessary structure using data from systems without embodiment. To this end, we test if inexpensive, procedurally generated synthetic data can yield useful priors before a model observes any real-world behavior. We study this through robot action prediction, a natural pretraining objective and a direct test of whether structure learned from arbitrary synthetic tasks transfers to embodied settings. We introduce three data generation pipelines that model mathematical abstractions of robotic control, and use them as pretraining priors for a Transformer. We demonstrate that a model trained purely on this non-robotic data attains non-trivial zero-shot prediction performance on unseen physical robot tasks via an in-context learning mechanism, and that our specialized control priors notably improve upon generic causal priors. We also compare against a compute-matched baseline trained on real robot data, and find that it outperforms our model but only on the datasets it was trained on. These findings suggest that procedurally generated, mathematical abstractions can yield useful robotic priors, offering a potential complement to expensive embodied data collection.

AI.tldr: 用程序化生成的非具身数学抽象数据（三种控制先验）预训练Transformer，可在未见过的真实机器人任务上通过上下文学习获得非平凡零样本动作预测能力，并优于通用因果先验与真实数据模型在分布外任务上的表现。
AI.motivation: 真实机器人数据（跨任务、跨形态）被视为具身基础模型训练瓶颈；作者希望探究模型能否从"无具身"系统中获取必要结构先验，从而降低对昂贵真实数据采集的依赖。
AI.method: 以机器人动作预测作为预训练目标与结构迁移检验手段；设计三条程序化数据生成管线，对机器人控制做数学抽象建模，作为Transformer预训练先验；与通用因果先验以及同等算力、基于真实机器人数据训练的基线对比，并在未见真实机器人任务上做零样本评估。
AI.result: 纯非机器人数据训练的模型在未见真实机器人任务上取得非平凡零样本预测性能，机制为上下文学习；专用控制先验显著优于通用因果先验；算力匹配的真实数据基线仅在其训练过的数据集上占优。
AI.conclusion: 程序化生成的数学抽象可提供有用的机器人先验，可作为昂贵具身数据采集的潜在补充，而真实数据优势主要体现为分布内专精而非广泛泛化。

title: ReCoG: Relational Concept Graph for Training-Free Personalization
summary: Training-free personalization adapts a frozen vision-language model (VLM) to recognize user-defined concepts from only a few exemplars by retrieving concept entries at inference time. While recent retriever-based methods enrich each concept with descriptive evidence, they largely treat concepts in isolation, so the retrieved information can be plausible yet non-discriminative, especially when the personalized concept set contains highly confusable, fine-grained categories. We argue that personalization is inherently relational: correct recognition depends on the specific distinctions between a concept and its nearest alternatives. To this end, we propose ReCoG, a Relational Concept Graph for retrieval-augmented personalization. ReCoG represents concepts as nodes and augments them with directed edges that explicitly capture discriminative cues between concept pairs, elicited by a frozen VLM during database construction. At inference, ReCoG retrieves a shortlist and resolves ambiguity via explicit pairwise comparisons conditioned on the corresponding relational edges, selecting the concept that consistently wins against competing candidates. We also introduce FINGER benchmark to test personalized recognition on confusable concept sets. Across FINGER, ReCoG substantially outperforms prior methods, with the largest gains in the most confusable regimes. ReCoG also achieves consistently best performance on established personalization benchmarks including captioning and VQA, confirming that relational evidence is broadly beneficial beyond fine-grained settings. Project Page: this https URL

AI.tldr: 提出ReCoG关系概念图，用VLM自动挖掘概念对之间的可区分线索作为有向边，推理时通过显式成对比较消解混淆，并构建FINGER易混概念基准。
AI.motivation: 现有免训练个性化检索方法将每个概念孤立建模、仅补充描述性证据，检索到的信息看似合理但对相近细粒度类别缺乏判别性；作者认为个性化本质上是关系性的，识别取决于概念与其最近邻候选之间的具体差异。
AI.method: 将概念表示为图节点，利用冻结VLM在数据库构建阶段为概念对生成有向边，编码二者间的判别性线索；推理时先检索候选短列表，再在对应关系边条件下进行显式成对比较，选出能持续战胜竞争候选的概念。同时提出FINGER基准用于评估易混概念集上的个性化识别。
AI.result: 在FINGER上显著优于先前方法，且在混淆程度最高的情形下增益最大；在captioning与VQA等既有个性化基准上也取得一致最优结果。
AI.conclusion: 关系性证据是免训练视觉语言个性化的重要且普适的增强方向，不仅适用于细粒度场景，也惠及一般个性化任务。

title: Retrieval-Augmented Online Textual Memory for Episodic Memory Video Question Answering
summary: Long egocentric videos pose a central challenge for multimodal language models: the visual stream must be compressed into a memory representation that can be searched efficiently while still preserving the evidence needed for question answering. Building on an online textual-memory framework in which first-person videos are converted into temporally grounded captions, this work systematically studies the role of retrieval in episodic-memory video question answering. We evaluate how different retrieval units, query formulations, context budgets, and reranking strategies affect multiple-choice answering on QAEgo4D-Closed, isolating retrieval as the main variable while keeping the underlying generated memory fixed. Our best configuration, Parent, matches fine-grained caption subchunks, then provides their full parent captions to the reasoner. It achieves 56.4 % accuracy, matching strong full-memory and retrieval baselines while exposing only a small fraction of the textual memory at question time. More importantly, our analysis shows that better temporal coverage does not necessarily translate into better answers: increasing the retrieval budget improves temporal Hit@K and Recall@K, but can reduce accuracy by introducing visually plausible distractors and uncertain caption evidence. These findings suggest that retrieval-augmented egocentric memory should not be optimized only for evidence recall, but also for the reliability, specificity, and answer-discriminative value of the retrieved context. The study motivates more structured episodic memories that move beyond raw caption retrieval toward evidence-aware representations for long-form egocentric reasoning.

AI.tldr: 该文系统研究在线文本记忆框架中检索环节对长时第一人称视频问答的影响，提出Parent检索配置（用细粒度子块匹配、喂父字幕给推理器），以56.4%准确率追平全记忆基线，并揭示检索预算增大提升Hit@K/Recall@K却可能降低准确率。
AI.motivation: 长自我中心视频需压缩为可高效检索、又能保留答题证据的记忆表示；作者希望在保持生成式文本记忆不变的前提下，单独隔离"检索"这一变量，系统分析其设计选择对情景记忆问答的影响。
AI.method: 基于将第一人称视频转为带时间戳字幕的在线文本记忆框架，在QAEgo4D-Closed多选问答上系统性消融检索单元、查询表述、上下文预算与重排序策略；提出Parent策略：以细粒度字幕子块做匹配，再将其所属的完整父字幕提供给推理器。
AI.result: Parent配置达56.4%准确率，匹配强全记忆与检索基线，且答题时仅暴露少量文本记忆；分析显示增大检索预算可提升时间Hit@K与Recall@K，却会因引入视觉上合理但错误的干扰项和不确定字幕证据而降低准确率。
AI.conclusion: 检索增强的自我中心记忆不应只以证据召回为优化目标，还需考虑所检索上下文的可靠性、具体性与答案区分度；应发展超越原始字幕检索、面向证据感知的结构化情景记忆。

title: RecallGS: Geometry-Grounded Recall for Online Semantic Gaussian Splatting
summary: Online semantic 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) enables open-vocabulary scene understanding from streaming observations. However, existing methods recover geometric context missing from image-derived semantic features using an additionally learned 3D network, incurring extra training and runtime overhead. We observe that such geometric-semantic evidence may already exist in the agent's observation history and can be retrieved rather than learned. Based on this insight, we introduce RecallGS (Geometry-Grounded Recall for Online Semantic Gaussian Splatting), a lightweight, training-free mechanism that treats past observations as a non-parametric geometric-semantic prior. RecallGS follows a recall-ground-fuse pipeline: CLIP retrieves relevant observations, alpha-compositing weights identify geometrically supported views, and aggregate their semantic features over each Gaussian's rendered footprint. On ScanNet and ScanNet++, RecallGS achieves strong semantic segmentation performance at 2.48 FPS, demonstrating that geometric-semantic context can be effectively recovered from observation history without an additional learned 3D branch.

AI.tldr: RecallGS: 在线语义 3DGS 中，用"召回-几何筛选-融合"的无训练机制，从历史观测中检索几何-语义证据，替代额外学习的 3D 网络分支。
AI.motivation: 现有在线语义 3DGS 依赖从图像语义特征中缺失的几何上下文，需额外训练一个 3D 网络来补全，带来训练与推理开销。作者观察到这类几何-语义证据其实已存在于智能体的历史观测中，可"检索"而非"学习"。
AI.method: 将历史观测视为非参数化的几何-语义先验，采用 recall-ground-fuse 三步流水线：CLIP 检索相关历史观测；用 alpha 合成权重识别几何上被支持的视角；将这些视角的语义特征在每个高斯渲染足迹上聚合。整个机制无需训练。
AI.result: 在 ScanNet 与 ScanNet++ 上取得较强语义分割性能，运行速度达 2.48 FPS，证明无需额外学习式 3D 分支即可从观测历史恢复几何-语义上下文。
AI.conclusion: 几何-语义上下文可由观测历史的非参数检索获得，为在线开放词汇 3DGS 提供轻量、免训练的替代方案；但速度（2.48 FPS）与仅室内静态数据集评估限制了其通用性与实时性。

title: PiHand: Latent Hand-Object Interaction Priors for Physics-Based Policy Learning
summary: Synthesizing physically grounded dexterous hand-object interactions is important for VR/AR, gaming, and robotics, yet remains challenging because subtle contact dynamics, diverse object geometries, and target trajectories must be jointly respected while maintaining natural grasps. Existing methods either track mocap trajectories with limited transfer to novel objects, or rely on hand-only generative priors that fail to capture coupled hand-object motion, sacrificing contact fidelity and sample efficiency. To tackle these challenges, we introduce PiHand, a Physically grounded Interaction-aware Hand motion synthesis framework. PiHand first trains expert policies that track mocap demonstrations in simulation, distills them into a unified hand-object interaction prior using a goal-conditioned VAE, and finally solve diverse dexterous manipulation tasks through bounded residual exploration in its latent space. With only a single reward and no complex curriculum training, this yields general tabletop manipulation policies that generalize to unseen objects and trajectories on GRAB and DexYCB. The same prior transfers to object catching and bimanual handover, two tasks that are rarely seen in its training data. Across all tasks, PiHand consistently outperforms baselines in all metrics. We will release the processed data and model checkpoints.

AI.tldr: PiHand：先训练仿真中的专家策略跟踪动捕，再用目标条件VAE蒸馏为统一的手-物交互先验，最后在隐空间做有界残差探索求解灵巧操作任务。
AI.motivation: 合成物理可信的灵巧手-物交互对VR/AR、游戏与机器人很重要，但需同时满足细微接触动力学、多样物体几何与目标轨迹，并保持自然抓握。现有方法要么依赖动捕轨迹跟踪（难以迁移到新物体），要么仅用单手生成先验，无法刻画手-物耦合运动，接触保真度与样本效率不足。
AI.method: 三阶段框架：1) 在仿真中训练专家策略跟踪动捕演示；2) 用目标条件VAE将这些专家策略蒸馏为统一的手-物交互先验；3) 在该隐空间中做有界残差探索，以单一奖励、无复杂课程学习求解多样化灵巧操作任务。
AI.result: 在GRAB与DexYCB上可泛化到未见物体与轨迹；同一先验可迁移到物体抓接与双手交接这两类训练数据中罕见的任务；所有任务的全部指标均优于基线。
AI.conclusion: 以专家蒸馏+隐空间残差探索的方式获得通用灵巧操作策略，验证了统一手-物交互先验的可迁移性；作者将开源处理后的数据与模型权重。

title: Whole-Body Motion Guided Reference Generation for Uncertainty-Aware Compliant Assistance
summary: Exoskeletons have shown great potential for augmenting human physical capabilities, yet generating reliable assistance remains challenging because human motion patterns and interaction requirements vary substantially in practice. To address this problem, a dual-loop assistance strategy is proposed to couple multimodal exoskeleton trajectory generation with variable admittance control, where trajectory variance links the outer-loop generator and the inner-loop controller. The generator synthesizes future exoskeleton trajectories through denoising, primarily using whole-body human motion and exoskeleton proprioception, with task descriptions as auxiliary semantic cues. To reduce cross-modal representation mismatch, a three-stage training pipeline is introduced to progressively optimize the human motion encoder, the exoskeleton proprioception encoder, and the trajectory generator. In the inner loop, multiple future trajectories are sampled from the generator to estimate the trajectory mean and variance. The mean is used as the control reference, while the variance provides an uncertainty measure for prediction reliability. This measure is further incorporated into a stiffness regulation law, enabling compliant assistance with input-to-state stability under bounded lumped interaction input. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method significantly reduces muscle activation levels compared with standard baselines, while also decreasing users' metabolic energy expenditure relative to the unassisted condition.

AI.tldr: 提出双环外骨骼辅助策略：外层用扩散式生成器基于全身人体运动、外骨骼本体感知与任务语义生成未来轨迹，内层采样多条轨迹求均值与方差，以均值作控制参考、方差作不确定性用于刚度调节的自适应导纳控制。三阶段训练缓解跨模态表征不匹配，实验显示肌电与代谢消耗显著降低。
AI.motivation: 人体运动模式与交互需求在实用中变化大，固定轨迹或规则化生成难以给出可靠助力；需要既能预测多样化未来运动、又能对预测不确定性做出合规柔顺响应的统一框架。
AI.method: 双环结构，以轨迹方差耦合外/内环。外层：去噪生成模型，输入为全身人体运动、外骨骼本体感知（主）+ 任务描述（辅助语义线索）；采用三阶段流水线依次优化人体运动编码器、本体感知编码器与轨迹生成器。内层：从生成器采样多条未来轨迹估计均值与方差，均值为控制参考，方差经刚度调节律映射为变导纳刚度，在有限集总交互输入下保证输入-状态稳定性（ISS）。
AI.result: 与标准基线相比显著降低肌肉激活水平，且相对无助力条件降低用户代谢能耗。
AI.conclusion: 以生成式多模态轨迹预测的不确定性驱动变导纳控制，可实现可靠且柔顺的人机协同助力，为可穿戴机器人的意图预测-控制一体化提供了可复用范式。

title: Data-Driven Vision-Language Models for Remote Sensing: A Survey
summary: During the deep learning era, innovations in remote sensing (RS) vision models primarily focused on optimizing network architectures for specific tasks and conducting end-to-end training. However, with the advent of the Vision-Language Models (VLMs) era, constrained by substantial computational resource demands, the mainstream research paradigm has shifted towards adapting general-purpose VLMs using RS vertical domain data for fine-tuning, rather than modifying their core architectures. This transition marks a change in the innovation pathway from model-centric to data-centric. Despite the increasing importance of data, the academic community still lacks a systematic, data-centric survey to guide researchers in constructing high-quality RS vision-language datasets for various application scenarios and in conducting effective model fine-tuning and performance evaluation based on these datasets. To address this gap, this paper presents a systematic review of the development status of RS datasets tailored for VLMs. It further provides a comprehensive practical guide for RS researchers in the large model era, covering the entire pipeline from data construction to fine-tuning and evaluation. This paper aims to encourage the academic community to build more diverse and higher-quality vision-language datasets for specialized RS sub-fields. Ultimately, the goal is to converge these efforts into a comprehensive RS vision-language corpus that offers extensive task coverage and a wide geographical distribution, thereby laying a solid data foundation for advancing towards general artificial intelligence in RS.

AI.tldr: 本文是对遥感视觉语言模型（RS-VLM）数据体系的系统性综述，提出从"模型中心"转向"数据中心"的研究范式，并给出从数据集构建到微调与评测的全流程实践指南。
AI.motivation: 大模型时代受算力约束，遥感研究范式由改造网络架构转向用领域数据微调通用VLM，但学界缺乏以数据为中心的系统性综述来指导高质量RS视觉语言数据集的构建、微调与评测。
AI.method: 综述性研究：梳理面向VLM的遥感数据集发展现状，归纳数据构建、数据组织与标注模式，并整理基于数据的微调策略与性能评测流程，形成全链条实践指南。
AI.result: 提出以数据为中心的研究框架与实用指南（数据构建—微调—评测全流程），指出当前RS视觉语言数据集在任务覆盖与地理分布上的不足。
AI.conclusion: 应推动构建更多样、更高质量的遥感子领域视觉语言数据集，并汇聚为任务覆盖广、地理分布广的综合RS视觉语言语料库，为遥感通用人工智能奠定数据基础。

title: Stream4D: Streaming 4D Reconstruction with Training-free Motion Decoupling via Causal KV-Cache Attention
comment: 10 pages, 8 figures. Accepted to ACM Multimedia 2026
summary: 4D scene reconstruction requires robust handling of dynamic objects, yet existing streaming methods commonly assume static scenes, leading to pose drift and ghosting artifacts over long sequences. We introduce Stream4D, a training-free, motion-decoupled streaming reconstruction framework that can be directly integrated into causal Transformer backbones (e.g., StreamVGGT, Stream3R). Our key observation is that causal attention implicitly encodes rich temporal motion cues within the KV cache. We adaptively aggregate these cues from multiple attention layers and across temporal windows, and fuse them with depth priors to handle challenging cases such as occlusions and textureless regions, producing precise dynamic masks that decouple static and dynamic regions. We then apply a soft key masking scheme that leverages these dynamic masks to suppress interference from dynamic regions in causal attention, thereby improving camera pose estimation accuracy. Stream4D inherits the efficiency of causal attention and remains compatible with existing streaming architectures. On diverse dynamic-scene benchmarks, Stream4D significantly improves camera pose estimation and static-scene reconstruction quality, yields reliable dynamic masks, and effectively mitigates long-sequence ghosting.

AI.tldr: Stream4D：免训练、运动解耦的流式4D重建框架，利用因果注意力KV缓存中的时序线索生成动态掩码，并对动态区域做软键掩码，提升位姿估计与静态重建质量。
AI.motivation: 现有流式重建方法多以静态场景为假设，长序列下动态物体会导致位姿漂移与鬼影（ghosting）伪影。
AI.method: 观察到因果注意力在KV缓存中隐式编码时序运动线索；从多层注意力与多时间窗口自适应聚合这些线索，并与深度先验融合以应对遮挡与弱纹理区域，得到精确动态掩码实现动静解耦；再用软键掩码（soft key masking）抑制动态区域对因果注意力的干扰。可直接嵌入StreamVGGT、Stream3R等因果Transformer骨干。
AI.result: 在多个动态场景基准上显著提升相机位姿估计精度与静态场景重建质量，输出可靠动态掩码，并有效缓解长序列鬼影。
AI.conclusion: Stream4D以免训练、模块化方式为流式4D重建引入动态处理能力，保持因果注意力效率与原架构兼容性，但实验证据目前主要停留在摘要层面，需核实真实场景泛化性与代码开放情况。

title: MVLoMa: Multi-View Local Feature Matching with Any Geometry Foundation Model
summary: Local feature matching is typically formulated for image pairs, although structure-from-motion and visual localization commonly match one reference image against many retrieved or covisible neighbours. Applying a pairwise matcher independently to these centre-neighbour edges duplicates reference-side computation and prevents the matcher from exploiting complementary multi-view geometric evidence from the remaining observations. To address these limitations, we introduce MVLoMa, a sparse star-graph matcher that extends LoMa from image pairs to multiple views. MVLoMa first uses a frozen multi-view geometry model to jointly describe all images in a star, then injects the resulting cross-view geometric context into local descriptors. It then matches the centre image to all neighbours in a single forward pass through per-view self-attention and bidirectional centre-neighbour cross-attention. For supervision, we derive positive correspondences only from depth-valid, mutually visible dense warps and explicitly penalize high-confidence matches that violate epipolar geometry. On 25-view star graphs from HyperSim, ScanNet++, Mip-NeRF 360, and Tanks and Temples, MVLoMa obtains the best macro-average relative-pose AUC among the compared methods at all three thresholds (58.65/85.41/90.99). Its matcher is 2.20 times faster than sequential evaluation of the 24 centre-neighbour edges. The same design supports four tested frozen geometry encoders -- DA3, $\pi^3$, VGGT, and VGGT-$\Omega$ -- with DA3-Giant performing best on all reported encoder-ablation metrics. Controlled ablations further isolate the effects of geometry-aware descriptors, visibility filtering, geometric negative supervision, and joint multi-view inference.

AI.tldr: MVLoMa 将稀疏匹配器 LoMa 从图像对扩展到星形多视图图，用冻结多视图几何模型提供跨视图上下文，单次前向完成中心图与全部邻居的匹配。
AI.motivation: SfM 与视觉定位通常需要一张参考图对多个检索/共视邻居匹配，独立地对每条中心-邻居边做成对匹配会重复计算参考侧特征，且无法利用其余观测提供的互补多视图几何证据。
AI.method: 先用冻结的多视图几何模型（DA3、π³、VGGT、VGGT-Ω）联合描述星形图中所有图像，将跨视图几何上下文注入局部描述子；再通过逐视图自注意力与双向中心-邻居交叉注意力，在一次前向中完成中心图对全部邻居的匹配。监督上仅从深度有效且互相可见的稠密 warp 中提取正对应，并显式惩罚违反极几何的高置信度匹配。
AI.result: 在 HyperSim、ScanNet++、Mip-NeRF 360、Tanks and Temples 的 25 视图星形图上，三个阈值下宏平均相对位姿 AUC 均为最优（58.65/85.41/90.99）；匹配器比顺序评估 24 条中心-邻居边快 2.20 倍；四种冻结几何编码器均适用，DA3-Giant 表现最佳；消融验证了几何感知描述子、可见性过滤、几何负监督与联合多视图推理的贡献。
AI.conclusion: 将稀疏局部匹配从成对范式推广为星形多视图联合匹配，可同时获得精度与效率收益，且与现成多视图几何编码器即插即用。

title: WeVisOne-VL: Unified Visual Perception from Objects to Pixels
summary: Existing vision-language models (VLMs) remain unreliable for fine-grained visual perception. In this report, we present WeVisOne-VL (WeChat Vision All-in-One), a powerful VLM that unifies object-level and pixel-level perception through structured next-token prediction. It supports multiple visual tasks including object detection, referring localization, counting, OCR, segmentation, and matting, enabling localization at any user-specific granularity, from points and boxes to masks and alpha mattes. Architecturally, we integrate a lightweight pixel decoder into the VLM via a special <OBJ> token to generate instance-level pixel outputs. We train the model with a three-stage curriculum SFT followed by mixed-task RL. Across over 30 benchmarks, WeVisOne-VL demonstrates leading performance on both object-level and pixel-level tasks, while maintaining robust rejection for object-absent queries. By releasing WeVisOne-VL to the open-source community, we hope to advance VLMs from broad visual understanding toward truly reliable perception systems for real-world deployment.

AI.tldr: WeVisOne-VL 通过结构化下一 token 预测统一物体级与像素级感知，支持检测、指代定位、计数、OCR、分割与抠图，并用三阶段课程 SFT 加混合任务 RL 训练。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉语言模型在细粒度视觉感知上仍不可靠，难以输出任意粒度的定位（点、框、掩码、alpha matte），需要统一物体级与像素级感知的模型。
AI.method: 在 VLM 中通过特殊 <OBJ> token 接入轻量像素解码器，以结构化下一 token 预测生成实例级像素输出；训练采用三阶段课程式 SFT 加混合任务强化学习。
AI.result: 在 30 多个基准上，物体级与像素级任务均取得领先性能，并对目标缺失查询保持稳健拒答能力。
AI.conclusion: 将多粒度视觉感知统一进 VLM 是可行且有效的路径，开源后可推动 VLM 从广义理解走向可靠的真实部署感知系统。

title: GelSlim 5.0: Unifying Vision and Touch with a Single Fingertip Camera
summary: Vision and touch provide complementary cues for object pose and local contact geometry, but external cameras are often occluded at the contact site. We present GelSlim 5.0, a fingertip sensor that acquires visual and tactile observations with one fixed camera and a continuous UV-responsive contact layer. By switching illumination, the camera sequentially acquires through-membrane visual images and contact-sensitive tactile images from a shared viewpoint, avoiding inter-camera extrinsic calibration. To combine these observations, we introduce VisTacFusion, a multimodal transformer with separate prediction paths for planar object pose and contact geometry. Asymmetric bottleneck fusion incorporates visual context while preserving tactile spatial features for depth and surface-normal estimation. Modality dropout enables inference with paired inputs or either modality alone. On real validation data from 12 known objects, paired inputs reduce depth MSE, angular error, and translation $L_1$ by 61.2%, 72.3%, and 61.3%, respectively, relative to tactile-only inference with the same model. Relative to visual-only inference, the corresponding reductions are 93.7%, 6.1%, and 8.6%.

AI.tldr: 提出单相机指尖传感器 GelSlim 5.0（交替照明同时采集透膜视觉图像与接触敏感触觉图像，共享视点免标定），并设计 VisTacFusion 多模态 Transformer，以非对称瓶颈融合与模态丢弃联合预测平面位姿和接触几何。
AI.motivation: 视觉与触觉对物体位姿与局部接触几何提供互补线索，但外部相机在接触处常被遮挡；多相机方案还面临外参标定与视点不一致问题。
AI.method: 硬件：单固定相机 + 连续 UV 响应接触层，通过切换照明顺序采集成像，实现同视点视觉-触觉对齐。算法：VisTacFusion 多模态 Transformer，双预测头分别输出平面物体位姿与接触几何；非对称瓶颈融合注入视觉上下文，同时保留触觉空间特征用于深度与表面法向估计；模态丢弃支持配对或单模态推理。在 12 个已知物体的真实数据上验证。
AI.result: 配对输入相较同模型仅触觉推理，深度 MSE、角度误差、平移 L1 分别降低 61.2%、72.3%、61.3%；相较仅视觉推理分别降低 93.7%、6.1%、8.6%。
AI.conclusion: 硬件层面的同视点视觉-触觉对齐可消除外参标定并保留接触区信息，配合非对称融合能在位姿与接触几何上显著优于单模态，属触觉感知与多模态融合的实用增量工作；但验证限于已知物体、无开集泛化与机器人闭环操作，新颖性主要体现在传感器设计与融合结构。

title: Probabilistic Energy Modeling Unifies Versatile Swarm Control
summary: Robotic swarms must coordinate across diverse missions, yet existing controllers often require redesign, retuning, or retraining when objectives change. Here we show that probabilistic energy modeling provides a unifying representation for versatile swarm control, in which diverse missions emerge from compositions of shared interaction principles rather than task-specific control formulations. By exploiting the correspondence between Gibbs random field energy minimization and structured reward maximization, we encode fundamental swarm behaviors as reusable energy terms within a unified probabilistic objective. Decentralized policies trained within this representation are composed into a single controller through lightweight policy gating, without retraining. An interpretable action-attention mechanism captures non-uniform local interactions, while dimensionless normalization supports transfer across swarm scales and platforms. Demonstrated on aerial swarms, the unified policy generalizes zero-shot across six mission classes, 10-100 agents, two hardware platforms, and indoor cluttered and GPS-denied woodland environments. Large-scale simulations achieve 0.96-1.00 task success rates with 1-10 ms per-agent inference latency, while physical deployments confirm zero-shot transfer to real platforms and unstructured environments. These results establish probabilistic energy modeling as a scalable and transferable framework for decentralized swarm control.

AI.tldr: 用概率能量模型统一表示集群行为：将基本行为写成吉布斯随机场能量项，用策略门控组合成单一控制器，实现跨任务、规模、平台与环境零样本泛化。
AI.motivation: 现有群体机器人控制器在任务目标变化时需重新设计、调参或再训练，缺乏可复用、可组合的统一表示。
AI.method: 借助吉布斯随机场能量最小化与结构化奖励最大化的对应关系，把基础群体行为编码为可复用能量项构成统一概率目标；在此表示下训练的去中心化策略通过轻量级策略门控组合成单一控制器而无需再训练；引入可解释动作注意力建模非均匀局部交互，并用无量纲归一化支持跨规模与跨平台迁移。
AI.result: 在空中集群上验证：统一策略零样本泛化到6类任务、10–100个智能体、两种硬件平台，以及室内杂乱与GPS拒止林地环境；大规模仿真成功率0.96–1.00，单智能体推理延迟1–10 ms；实物部署证实零样本迁移。
AI.conclusion: 概率能量建模可作为可扩展、可迁移的去中心化集群控制框架，通过共享交互原理的组合取代任务专用控制设计。

title: CoHelix: Event-Based Multi-Propeller Rotation-Rate Tracking with Shared Projective Geometry
summary: Estimating propeller rates from a moving event camera requires separating blade rotation from the changing image geometry. Background activity mixes with blade events, while repeated blade appearances admit half- and double-rate ambiguities. We propose CoHelix, a recursive filter that estimates one shared homography and separate rotation states for four rigidly mounted, coplanar propellers. Each admitted event updates its assigned rotation state, and its accepted geometry measurements correct the shared homography used to interpret later events from every propeller. We report lock, the fraction of evaluated time for which an estimate remains within 2% of synchronized ground truth, because mean error alone does not show how long a tracker follows the true rate. With fixed-rate initialization, leave-one-recording-out evaluation on moving-camera data gives CoHelix 62.9% lock, compared with 39.8% for HelixTrack and 22.2% for EventPro. With other settings fixed, allowing four geometry contributors instead of one raises lock from 3.4% to 62.9%. On a private target-follower dataset with a different target quadcopter, CoHelix retains the measurement settings selected on moving-camera data and uses a fixed initial rate. It reaches 95.9% lock, compared with 56.2% for HelixTrack and 61.1% for EventPro.

AI.tldr: CoHelix：用递归滤波器在多桨无人机上联合估计共享单应性与各桨转速的事件相机方法，新提出"锁定率"指标，移动相机数据上锁定率62.9%（HelixTrack 39.8%、EventPro 22.2%）。
AI.motivation: 从运动中的事件相机估计螺旋桨转速需同时解耦桨叶旋转与图像几何变化；背景活动与桨叶事件混杂，且重复桨叶外观导致半速/倍速歧义（half-/double-rate ambiguity）。既有方法（HelixTrack、EventPro）在相机运动下易失锁，且仅报告平均误差无法反映跟踪持续时间。
AI.method: CoHelix为递归滤波器：对四个刚性共面安装的螺旋桨，估计一个共享单应（共享相机-桨平面几何）与各自独立的旋转状态。每个被接纳事件更新其所属旋转状态，其被接受的几何测量反过来修正共享单应，用于解释后续所有螺旋桨事件；即四桨互为几何约束来源。数据关联采用事件接纳机制（含背景剔除），并以固定速率初始化。
AI.result: 移动相机数据、留一录段交叉验证：锁定率62.9% vs HelixTrack 39.8% vs EventPro 22.2%。消融显示将几何贡献桨数由1提升至4，锁定率从3.4%升至62.9%。在另一款目标四旋翼的私有跟飞数据集上，沿用移动相机数据选定的测量参数与固定初始速率，达到95.9%锁定率（HelixTrack 56.2%、EventPro 61.1%）。新指标 lock = 估计值保持在同步真值2%以内的评估时间占比。
AI.conclusion: 多桨共享几何的多源耦合是消除运动相机下速率歧义的关键；提出以"锁定率"替代平均误差评价速率跟踪稳定性，并展现出跨机型、跨平台的参数可迁移性。

title: A Task-Centric Survey of Long-Document Visual Question Answering: Taxonomy, Evolution, and Future Directions
summary: Visual document understanding is essential for acquiring knowledge from visually rich documents and is attracting growing research interest. Existing surveys emphasize architectures or technical approaches, with limited attention to how task bottlenecks shape technical choices and research priorities. We present a task-centric survey that decomposes long-document visual question answering (VQA) into four components: document parsing, evidence organization and retrieval, generator organization and learning, and evaluation. For each, we develop a fine-grained taxonomy and trace motivations, technical responses, and cross-component connections. We focus on explicit retrieval while covering direct reading. Our temporal analysis traces expanding priorities from multimodal content understanding to sufficient, high-fidelity evidence acquisition and sustained evidence management. We outline future directions in evidence sufficiency, verifiable and correctable understanding, and budget-aware coordination, with an outlook on continual document understanding.

AI.tldr: 一篇以任务为中心的综述，将长文档视觉问答(VQA)分解为文档解析、证据组织与检索、生成器组织与学习、评测四个组件，并给出细粒度分类与时间演进分析。
AI.motivation: 现有综述多聚焦架构与技术路线，较少关注任务瓶颈如何塑造技术选择与研究优先级，缺乏以任务为中心的视角。
AI.method: 以任务为中心进行综述：将长文档VQA拆为四个组件，对每个组件建立细粒度分类，梳理动机、技术应对与跨组件联系；重点讨论显式检索，兼顾直接阅读；并进行时间维度的优先级演进分析。
AI.result: 揭示研究优先级从多模态内容理解，扩展到充分、高保真的证据获取与持续的证据管理；提出证据充分性、可验证与可纠正理解、预算感知协调等未来方向，并展望持续文档理解。
AI.conclusion: 长文档VQA的关键瓶颈在于证据链的充分性与管理，而非单纯的架构改进；未来应朝可验证、可纠正且资源受限下的协同理解发展。

title: FocusVLA: Future-Intent Guided Dynamic View Routing for Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have become an important paradigm for robotic manipulation by unifying visual perception, language understanding, and action generation. Since reliable manipulation requires sufficient observation of objects, end-effectors, and their spatial relationships, multi-view inputs are widely used to provide complementary spatial information. However, our experiments show that existing VLA models do not fully exploit such multi-view complementarity. The policy tends to persistently rely on the wrist view, lacking the ability to dynamically adjust global-local view dependency across manipulation stages, which limits stage adaptability and robustness. To address this issue, we propose FocusVLA, a stage-aware multi-view routing framework. FocusVLA predicts future interaction intent from historical actions and uses it to guide dynamic view routing during action generation. By adaptively coordinating global and local observations across different task stages, FocusVLA improves multi-view utilization. On RoboTwin 2.0, FocusVLA improves the average success rate over the strongest baseline $\pi_{0.5}$ by 10.10 pp. In real-world evaluation, FocusVLA improves the success rate from 71.7\% to 85.0\%, achieving a 13.3\% gain over $\pi_{0.5}$. Moreover, the intent prediction and dynamic routing modules of FocusVLA can be integrated into existing VLA frameworks without modifying their core architectures.

AI.tldr: FocusVLA：一种阶段感知的多视角路由框架，用未来交互意图预测动态调节全局/局部视角依赖，提升VLA多视角利用效率。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA虽引入多视角输入，但实验发现策略持续偏好腕部视角，无法随操作阶段动态切换全局-局部依赖，限制阶段适应性与鲁棒性。
AI.method: 由历史动作预测未来交互意图，并以其指导动作生成过程中的动态视角路由，实现跨任务阶段的全局与局部观测自适应协调；意图预测与路由模块可作为插件嵌入现有VLA框架，无需改动核心架构。
AI.result: RoboTwin 2.0上平均成功率较最强基线π0.5提升10.10个百分点；真机评测成功率由71.7%提升至85.0%（相对提升13.3%）。
AI.conclusion: 多视角互补性未被充分利用是VLA的关键瓶颈，阶段感知的动态路由是有效且可插拔的改进方向；具备仿真+真机双重验证。

title: FastHarness: Experience-Driven Review Scheduling for Vision-Language-Action Policies
summary: Agentic robot systems combine language-model reasoning with robot policies to monitor execution and recover from failures. However, reviewing every action chunk incurs substantial overhead, even in familiar situations. We introduce FastHarness, an experience-driven execution harness that adaptively schedules GPT-6 Astra supervision of a {\pi}0.5 policy. A fast path uses stage memory and reviewed outcomes to reduce review frequency as experience accumulates, while a complementary recovery path focuses supervision on correcting errors. Once recovery is verified, routine execution resumes, with failure experience retained to guide future interventions. The policy remains frozen and generates fresh actions from current observations. Across four simulated manipulation tasks, reviewer token use decreases by an average of 57.2% per task from the first evaluated episode to the mean of the final five episodes. Mean episode time decreases from 85.5 to 52.0 minutes over the same interval. On the same tasks, mean success increases from 80% for GPT-as-Policy ({\pi}0.5 + GPT-6 Astra) to 97.19% with FastHarness. These results highlight adaptive supervision as a practical route to more efficient agentic robotics without additional model training.

AI.tldr: FastHarness 是一种经验驱动的执行框架，用阶段记忆与已审核结果自适应地调度 GPT-6 Astra 对冻结的 π0.5 策略进行监督，在四个仿真操作任务上将逐任务审查 token 用量平均降低 57.2%、平均回合时长由 85.5 降至 52.0 分钟，同时成功率由 80% 提升至 97.19%。
AI.motivation: 语言模型与机器人策略结合的 agentic 系统需逐块审查动作以确保监控与失败恢复，但即便在熟悉场景中，全量审查也带来巨大开销；作者希望在冻结策略、不额外训练的前提下降低监督成本并保持或提升任务成功率。
AI.method: 提出体验驱动的执行框架 FastHarness：快速路径利用阶段记忆与已审查结果，随经验积累逐步降低复审频率；互补的恢复路径将监督集中于纠错，恢复验证通过后回归常规执行，并保留失败经验用于后续干预；底层 π0.5 策略保持冻结，每步基于当前观测生成新动作。
AI.result: 四个仿真操作任务上，从首个评估回合到末五个回合均值，审查 token 用量平均下降 57.2%；平均回合时长由 85.5 分钟降至 52.0 分钟；平均成功率由 GPT-as-Policy（π0.5 + GPT-6 Astra）的 80% 提升至 97.19%。
AI.conclusion: 自适应监督可作为提升 agentic 机器人效率的实用路径，且无需额外模型训练；但证据仅限仿真操作任务，缺乏真实机器人验证与更广泛任务泛化分析。

title: PhysTrace: Interpretable Temporal Evaluation of Physical Consistency in Video Generative Models
comment: 17 pages, 7 figures (including supplementary material). Code: this https URL
summary: World action models increasingly rely on pretrained video models assumed to capture physical dynamics for prediction, planning, and action generation. Existing evaluations assess plausibility, probe representations, or measure predictive surprise, but rarely identify which history-conditioned physical expectations conflict with observations. We introduce PhysTrace, a training-free framework aligning MLLM-generated, history-conditioned expectations with observed video windows to temporally localize physical violations and provide interpretable descriptions without task-specific probes or classifiers. We also introduce IntPhys2-Timing, adding violation intervals to IntPhys2. PhysTrace achieves a Hit Rate of up to 70.7% across physical principles on IntPhys2-Timing and outperforms the compared methods in overall possible-impossible discrimination accuracy on IntPhys2. Applied to reconstructed videos along the trajectories of pretrained diffusion/flow-based video models, PhysTrace reveals attribute- and noise-dependent patterns in physical violation localization, enabling interpretable physical consistency analysis across timesteps.

AI.tldr: PhysTrace：无需训练的框架，用MLLM生成"历史条件下的物理期望"并与观测视频窗口对齐，从而在时间上定位物理违背并给出可解释描述；配套发布IntPhys2-Timing（为IntPhys2添加违背时间区间）。
AI.motivation: 视频世界模型/动作模型依赖预训练视频模型隐含的物理动力学，但现有评测多关注合理性、表征探针或预测惊奇度，很少指出"哪一时刻、哪一历史条件化的物理期望与观测冲突"。
AI.method: Training-free：由MLLM基于历史帧生成条件化物理期望描述，再与滑动观测窗口进行对齐/匹配，实现违背的时间定位与可解释说明；不使用任务专用探针或分类器。新增IntPhys2-Timing基准，带违背区间标注。
AI.result: 在IntPhys2-Timing上各物理原则最高命中率70.7%；在IntPhys2上整体"可能/不可能"判别准确率优于对比方法；用于预训练扩散/流匹配视频模型轨迹重建视频时，揭示违背定位对属性与噪声的依赖模式。
AI.conclusion: 提供了一种可解释、免训练的视频物理一致性时序诊断工具，适合作为视频世界模型的评测/分析组件；但属评测方法，与下游可控生成或机器人决策的结合尚未验证。

title: A Sparse Topometric Graph for Scalable Cross-Session Indoor Navigation
summary: A conventional embodied agent in an indoor environment builds a map by accumulating noisy real-world measurements and results from heavy inference to guide navigation. While the detailed measurements may differ due to scene changes or sensor settings, the unique topological structure of navigable passages or the connectivity between rooms may provide training-free guidance that complements local observations. We propose a sparse topometric graph as an efficient structural representation for robust indoor navigation, alleviating the need for fine-grained matching, which is computationally expensive, memory-intensive, and prone to real-world variations. The map consists of nodes that encode local 3D geometry and distance-weighted edges that capture traversable connectivity. A learned graph-matching network finds consistent subgraph structures across sessions by considering both node-level geometric descriptors and neighborhood connectivity. The holistic contextual matching is robust to local ambiguities caused by weak distinctiveness or repetitive structure, and establishes stable correspondences despite local scene changes, different sensor modalities, or limited spatial overlap. We analyze the practicality of the graph through cross-session point-goal navigation, where a goal specified in a prior reference map must be reached from an unknown initial pose in a later session. Experiments show that our method achieves the highest success rates (77.1% on Gibson and 40.0% under 3D-FRONT scene changes), while reducing memory by more than two orders of magnitude compared to point-level representations. The proposed approach further supports cross-session alignment and goal-directed navigation with strong scalability and robust real-world transfer.

AI.tldr: 提出稀疏拓扑度量图（sparse topometric graph）作为室内导航的轻量结构化表示，节点编码局部3D几何、边以距离加权刻画可通行连通性，并用学习式图匹配网络跨会话寻找一致子图，实现免训练目标的跨会话点目标导航。
AI.motivation: 传统具身智能体依赖累积噪声测量与重推理构建稠密地图，细粒度匹配计算昂贵、内存占用大且对场景变化/传感器差异敏感；而房间连通性等拓扑结构具有跨会话稳定性，可作为互补的免训练引导信号。
AI.method: 稀疏topometric图：节点编码局部3D几何描述子，边为距离加权的可通行连接；学习式图匹配网络同时利用节点几何描述子与邻域连通性做整体上下文匹配，从而在局部弱显著性、重复结构、不同传感器模态与有限空间重叠下仍建立稳定对应。
AI.result: 跨会话点目标导航任务（先前参考图中给定目标，于后续会话未知初始位姿下到达）上取得最高成功率：Gibson 77.1%，3D-FRONT场景变化下40.0%；内存较点级表示降低两个数量级以上；并支持跨会话对齐，具备良好可扩展性与真实世界迁移能力。
AI.conclusion: 拓扑-度量混合的稀疏图结构可替代细粒度点级匹配，为具身导航提供鲁棒、轻量、可跨会话复用的结构先验，兼顾性能、内存效率与泛化性。

title: MixPT: Point Transformer with Interleaved Window and Global Attention
comment: 23 pages, 14 figures, 12 tables. Project page: this https URL
summary: Point cloud transformers aim to capture detailed local geometry and relationships across a scene at a manageable computational cost. Two common approaches are window attention and global attention. They differ in how they enable scene-wide interaction, which refers to information exchange among tokens across a scene. Window attention reduces computational cost by restricting self-attention to groups of tokens called windows; in serialized designs, each window contains a fixed number of consecutive tokens from a spatially ordered sequence. Because each block only directly connects tokens within the same window, information exchange across windows relies on changes in window membership across blocks and hierarchical pooling. Global attention, in contrast, directly connects all tokens within a scene, but computing attention over all token pairs can be costly when the number of tokens is large. To balance computational cost and scene-wide interaction, we introduce MixPT, a point transformer that uses a mix of window and global attention blocks in an interleaved schedule, while retaining a single fixed serialization pattern for its window blocks. For scenes with a large number of tokens, MixPT applies global attention to spatially pooled tokens and returns residual updates to the original-resolution stream. Across indoor and outdoor benchmarks, MixPT achieves competitive accuracy with lower latency than representative window and global attention baselines. We further demonstrate the feasibility of scaling the attention stage in depth by repeating the interleaved pattern of window and global attention blocks.

AI.tldr: MixPT 交替堆叠窗口注意力与全局注意力块，窗口块保持单一固定序列化模式，并对大场景的池化 token 施加全局注意力、以残差回写原分辨率流，在室内外点云基准上以更低延迟取得有竞争力精度，并演示加深注意力阶段的可行性。
AI.motivation: 窗口注意力与全局注意力在"场景级交互"上的机制差异导致前者跨窗信息传递依赖窗口成员变化与层级池化、后者在大 token 数下计算开销高。目标是同时兼顾计算成本与全场景交互。
AI.method: 提出 MixPT 点云 Transformer：按交错调度混合窗口注意力块与全局注意力块；窗口块使用单一固定序列化模式（不靠改变窗口划分来扩散信息）；对 token 规模大的场景，全局注意力只在空间池化后的 token 上计算，并将残差更新回注到原始分辨率的特征流；按交错模式重复以加深注意力阶段。
AI.result: 在室内与室外点云分割/检测基准上，精度与代表性窗口注意力、全局注意力基线相当或具竞争力，同时延迟更低；重复交错模式扩展注意力深度仍可行。
AI.conclusion: 用"交错混合 + 池化上的全局注意力 + 残差回注"可在固定序列化下实现高效的全场景交互，为点云 Transformer 的成本-交互权衡提供了可扩展的设计范式。

title: AnyGameRenderer: Entity-Consistent Generative Rendering Across Games and an Entity-Level Benchmark
summary: AI coding agents can now build small playable games in minutes, but the results usually look like programmer art: gray blockouts, colored geometric primitives, and flat semantic blobs. We present AnyGameRenderer, a video-to-video generative renderer that turns such footage into high-quality visuals with characters, motion detail, and effects. Throughout, it keeps the layout, camera, and every entity's position and timing intact. Our AnyGameRenderer generalizes across a wide range of genres that agents build, such as tower defense, auto-battlers, top-down survivors, turn-based battles, kart racing, and crowd runners. AnyGameRenderer takes plain video as its game-state input, with no complex representations such as engine G-buffers, per-object class labels, or low-poly proxies. Gray blockouts, colored primitives, semantic maps, and wireframes all work as input. It also preserves entity correspondence: group counts stay correct, and entities appear and disappear on the right frame. We implement AnyGameRenderer by LoRA fine-tuning MiniMax-H3 ref2va, a 33B reference-video-conditioned video generation model. Training uses $\sim$10k paired clips from three sources: (i) multi-stream rendering data from 38 agent-made games exported from GEAR, an AI game-creation tool; (ii) two-stream rendering data from Unreal Engine, with programmatically controlled crowds, count changes, and entity scales; and (iii) real gameplay recordings, with pairs reconstructed via 3D-box detection. To evaluate the entity correspondence, we propose an entity-level benchmark of 59 held-out cases with 753 entities, scored against ground-truth boxes. Compared with the base model, AnyGameRenderer better preserves entity correspondence: temporal match rises from 50.9\% to 62.9\%, missed count changes fall from 34.7\% to 21.3\%, and fewer entities are hallucinated or left unrendered.

AI.tldr: AnyGameRenderer 是一个视频到视频的生成式渲染器，将以灰模/几何体/语义图/线框等"程序员美术"形式呈现的游戏画面，转换为具备角色、运动细节与特效的高质量画面，同时保持布局、相机以及每个实体的位置与时序不变。通过对 33B 的参考视频条件生成模型 MiniMax-H3 ref2va 进行 LoRA 微调实现，训练数据约 1 万对片段（38 个 GEAR 智能体制作游戏的多流渲染、Unreal Engine 程序化双流渲染、真实游玩录像经 3D 框检测配对）。并提出 59 例、753 个实体的实体级基准，时序匹配率 50.9%→62.9%，漏检计数变化 34.7%→21.3%。
AI.motivation: AI 编码智能体已能快速产出可玩小游戏，但视觉呈现停留在程序化占位风格（灰块、彩色几何体、扁平语义色块）。直接使用通用视频生成模型重绘会破坏游戏可玩性所需的关键结构信息——布局、相机、每个实体的位置、数量与出现/消失时序。作者希望在不引入 G-buffer、逐物体类别标签、低模代理等复杂引擎表示的前提下，仅凭普通视频输入完成高质量风格化渲染，并严格保持实体对应关系。
AI.method: (1) 框架：以普通视频（灰模、彩色图元、语义图、线框图均可）作为游戏状态输入进行 video-to-video 风格化渲染，不依赖引擎 G-buffer 或逐物体标签；(2) 模型：对 33B 参考视频条件视频生成模型 MiniMax-H3 ref2va 做 LoRA 微调；(3) 数据：约 10k 配对片段，来源三类——GEAR（AI 游戏创作工具）导出的 38 个智能体自制游戏多流渲染数据；Unreal Engine 双流渲染数据，含程序化人群控制、数量变化与实体尺度变化；真实游玩录像，通过 3D 框检测重建配对；(4) 评测：构建含 59 个留出案例、753 个实体的实体级基准，基于真值框对时序匹配、计数变化漏检、幻觉实体与未渲染实体的比例进行打分。
AI.result: 相较基座模型，AnyGameRenderer 的实体对应保持能力显著更好：时序匹配率由 50.9% 提升至 62.9%，漏检计数变化由 34.7% 降至 21.3%，被幻觉生成或未被渲染的实体数量也更少。方法覆盖塔防、自走棋、俯视幸存者、回合制战斗、卡丁车竞速、人群跑酷等多种智能体常见游戏类型。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明，通过 LoRA 微调大规模参考视频条件生成模型即可获得具备实体级保真度的可控游戏渲染，且无需引擎内部表示；同时提出了针对实体对应性的专用评测基准。其局限在于评测相对基座提升幅度中等（时序匹配仍约 63%），实体对应主要在合成/程序化数据上验证，距离完全可信的游戏可玩性渲染仍有空间。

title: Ask About the Right Moment: Training-Free Object Identity Reasoning for Video-Language Models
summary: Many questions about a video concern one physical object. Where does the ball end up after the cups are shuffled? Which card is the queen? How often was the mug covered? Video-language models (Video-LMs) recognise such objects in single frames but do not keep them apart over time. On real shell-game videos, open models from 8B to 235B parameters, their thinking variants, a reinforcement-learned tool agent and three training-free tool agents all stay within ten points of chance. We separate semantic identity binding from temporal identity maintenance. An object's identity should be fixed at a moment when the evidence for it is visible, and carried afterwards by a tracker. \emph{Track, Then Bind} implements this principle without training. A promptable video tracker follows every candidate object and draws it with a track number. A frozen vision-language model answers a static question about the identifying evidence, which binds the target to a track. The answer is then derived from the tracked state in text, without asking the model to reinterpret the original video during read-out. A single configuration covers all benchmarks. With Qwen3-VL-32B it solves both VET-Bench tasks, where a fine-tuned trajectory model reaches 92\% and 90\% and the same VLM voting over 16 samples stays at 30--32\%. It answers 55.4\% of the hardest Perception Test cup games, where the best published model answers 41.5\%, and, using track-derived timelines, 48.6\% of TOC-Bench questions, against 37.1\% for the same model answering directly. Drawing the same tracks on the video and asking the question directly falls 12--19 points short of the agent on real cup games.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练的“Track, Then Bind”框架：用可提示视频跟踪器为候选物体编号并持续跟踪，用冻结VLM在关键帧回答身份绑定问题，再由跟踪状态派生答案，从而分离“语义身份绑定”与“时序身份保持”。
AI.motivation: 视频语言模型能在单帧中识别物体，却在时间上无法保持物体身份区分（如杯中猜球、找皇后牌），导致强模型在真实壳牌游戏上接近随机猜测。
AI.method: 无训练两阶段流程：promptable video tracker 跟踪所有候选物体并绘制轨道编号；冻结VLM仅回答静态识别问题，将目标绑定到某条轨迹；随后在文本层面基于被跟踪状态推导答案，避免让模型重新解读原视频。
AI.result: Qwen3-VL-32B下解决VET-Bench两项任务，对比微调轨迹模型92%/90%与同VLM 16次投票30–32%；Perception Test最难杯赛达55.4%（最佳公开模型41.5%）；TOC-Bench 48.6%对直接回答37.1%；在视频上直接画出轨道并提问比该智能体低12–19分。
AI.conclusion: 显式解耦语义绑定与时序追踪的结构化智能体显著优于端到端VLM与工具智能体，且单一配置跨基准通用，说明“先跟踪再绑定”是提升视频物体恒常理解的有效免训练范式。

title: VecTile: A Low-Cost Flexible Tactile Array for 3-DoF Force Sensing
comment: 8 pages, 8 figures. Submitted to IEEE International Conference on Robotics and Automation (ICRA) 2027
summary: Tactile sensing provides robots with contact information difficult to obtain from vision alone. Shear force is particularly important for understanding tangential contact, guiding corrective motions, and maintaining grasp stability, yet flexible and low-cost tactile arrays often measure only normal force. We introduce VecTile, a low-cost, 6 mm thin, flexible tactile array capable of three-axis force sensing. VecTile combines a piezoresistive layer with passive silicone nubs that convert normal and shear forces into distinguishable pressure patterns. The sensor can be fabricated in-house without specialized equipment. The complete system costs less than 35 USD for a 4x4 array. We validate the sensing mechanism through finite element analysis and hardware experiments. In controlled single-taxel tests over 1-5 N normal force and up to 1.5 N shear force, VecTile achieves root-mean-square errors of 0.39 N and 0.16 N for normal and shear forces. A VecTile calibrated while flat retains accuracy when curved, while a five-minute manual calibration is sufficient for practical use. Two applications demonstrate its utility. First, shear readings are sensitive enough to stop a sharp scalpel from puncturing a balloon after contact. Second, the sensor substantially improves Diffusion Policy-guided power-plug insertion. All designs and code will be released upon paper acceptance. Project website: this https URL .

AI.tldr: VecTile: a low-cost (under $35 for 4x4), 6 mm thin, flexible piezoresistive tactile array with passive silicone nubs that decodes three-axis (normal + shear) force from distinguishable pressure patterns, validated in FEA, hardware, and two manipulation demos.
AI.motivation: Shear force is key for tangential contact understanding, corrective motion, and grasp stability, but flexible low-cost tactile arrays typically measure only normal force. Existing three-axis solutions are costly or require specialized fabrication.
AI.method: Design: piezoresistive sensing layer plus passive silicone nubs that convert normal/shear loads into asymmetric pressure patterns across taxels; in-house fabrication without specialized equipment. Sensing mechanism validated by finite element analysis and hardware experiments; single-taxel characterization over 1–5 N normal and up to 1.5 N shear; evaluation of calibration transfer from flat to curved state; two applications (scalpel-on-balloon contact stop; Diffusion Policy-guided power-plug insertion).
AI.result: RMSE 0.39 N (normal) and 0.16 N (shear) in single-taxel tests; flat-calibrated model retains accuracy when curved; 5-minute manual calibration suffices; shear sensing halts a scalpel before balloon puncture; improves Diffusion Policy plug insertion.
AI.conclusion: VecTile offers an accessible, repairable, low-cost three-axis tactile array practically usable on curved robot surfaces, with shear feedback benefiting both safety-critical contact control and learned manipulation policies; designs and code to be released.

title: Skeleton-Grounded Latent Action Model for Robot World Models
summary: Robot world models simulate how environments evolve in response to robot actions. Latent action models enable learning dynamics from videos by encoding visual transitions as proxy actions. However, reconstruction-driven latent actions mix robot motion with object responses and other scene changes, complicating their correspondence with robot controls. We propose SkeLAM, a skeleton-guided latent action model for controllable robot world modeling. SkeLAM decomposes latent actions into a kinematic component grounded by robot skeleton supervision and a residual component retaining complementary visual dynamics. Cross-modal swap reconstruction encourages RGB-derived and skeleton-derived kinematic representations to be interchangeable during video reconstruction. The world model incorporates both components through separate conditioning pathways, while branch dropout reduces its dependence on future-derived residual information. A lightweight adapter maps robot actions to the kinematic space, and subsequent world-model fine-tuning adapts generation to these predicted conditions. At inference, the model generates future observations from the current observation and robot actions. On DROID, SkeLAM reduces end-effector ADE by 19.5% and LPIPS by 11.1% compared with DreamDojo. Motion probing supports kinematic specialization, while qualitative results demonstrate zero-shot human-to-robot motion transfer in generated rollouts. Policy evaluation shows agreement between predicted success rates and those measured in real robot executions.

AI.tldr: SkeLAM 将视频潜动作分解为骨架监督的运动学分量与残留视觉动态分量，构建可被机器人动作条件化的可控世界模型。
AI.motivation: 重建驱动的潜动作把机器人运动与物体响应、场景变化混在一起，难以与真实机器人控制信号对应，限制了世界模型的可控性。
AI.method: 以机器人骨架作为运动学监督，将潜动作解耦为运动学子空间与残差子空间；采用跨模态交换重建（RGB 与骨架派生的运动学表示可互换）约束一致性；世界模型用两条独立条件通路注入两分量，并用分支 dropout 降低对含未来信息的残差依赖；轻量 adapter 将机器人动作映射到运动学空间，随后微调世界模型适配预测条件；推理时由当前观测与动作生成未来观测。
AI.result: 在 DROID 上相比 DreamDojo，末端执行器 ADE 降低 19.5%、LPIPS 降低 11.1%；运动探针实验支持运动学专门化；定性结果展示生成 rollout 中的零样本人类到机器人动作迁移；策略评估中预测成功率与真机执行成功率一致。
AI.conclusion: 显式的运动学-残差分解为视频学习的世界模型提供了与机器人控制对齐的可控接口，且生成式 rollout 可用于策略评估。

title: Point-Level Refinable Semantic Mapping for Spatial Understanding
summary: Open-vocabulary 3D semantic maps have emerged as a key spatial memory representation for long-horizon robot autonomy, enabling robots to reason about objects, their spatial relationships, and past observations across time. However, existing object-centric semantic maps are primarily designed for static environments and rely on an append-only point integration strategy, where newly observed points are accumulated but previously integrated points are rarely reevaluated. Consequently, perception errors accumulate over time, and outdated points persist after objects move or disappear. Although recent dynamic mapping methods update object-level representations in changing scenes, they do not explicitly revise noisy or obsolete points within each object. We propose an online refinable semantic mapping framework that continuously refines object representations through probabilistic point-level confidence updating. Each object point maintains a confidence score that is updated online using multi-view temporal evidence: consistent observations reinforce reliable points, while inconsistent segmentation masks, depth measurements, and visibility cues suppress spurious and outdated points. Combined with object tracking and re-identification to preserve instance identities under motion and relocation, our framework enables object-centric semantic maps to be continuously refined rather than monotonically accumulated. Experiments demonstrate improved mapping accuracy over the previous method by 3.46% on Replica and 2.55% on ScanNet, show robustness in dynamic environments and under perception noise, and provide an effective spatial memory for object navigation and embodied question-answering with success rates of 82.4% and 76.7%.

AI.tldr: 提出可在线精修的开词汇3D语义地图框架，对每个物体点维护概率置信度，融合多视角时序证据进行增量更新，抑制噪声与过时点。
AI.motivation: 现有物体中心语义地图多为静态环境设计，采用只追加不重估的点积分策略，导致感知误差随时间累积，物体移动后陈旧点残留；近期动态建图方法只在物体级更新，未显式修正物体内部噪声/过时点。
AI.method: 点级概率置信度在线更新：一致观测强化可靠点，不一致的分割掩码、深度测量与可见性线索抑制虚假/过时点；结合物体跟踪与重识别在运动和重定位下保持实例身份。
AI.result: 建图精度较先前方法在Replica提升3.46%、ScanNet提升2.55%；在动态环境与感知噪声下表现稳健；作为空间记忆支撑物体导航与具身问答，成功率82.4%与76.7%。
AI.conclusion: 物体中心语义地图可从单调累积转变为持续精修，为长程机器人自主提供更可靠的空间记忆。

title: MoG-VLM: Efficient Video Anomaly Detection through Motion-Guided Vision-Language Models
comment: Accepted at BMVC 2026. Includes supplementary material
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have shown strong potential for video anomaly detection, but dense frame-level inference makes them impractical for real-time deployment. Existing acceleration commonly relies on uniform sampling, which ignores content dynamics and can either waste computation on static segments or miss localized anomalies. We propose MoG-VLM a motion-adaptive anomaly detection framework that leverages motion purely as a lightweight control signal to decide when VLM inference is necessary. To this end, we introduce Temporal Gradient Magnitude (TGM) which performs content-aware sampling to concentrate computation on informative regions while avoiding redundant processing. We further introduce a hierarchical dual-stream design in which dense multi-frame VLM reasoning is activated only around frames with elevated anomaly likelihood, via anchor-triggered context-window expansion with early termination. A fusion module then reconciles these instantaneous semantic cues with temporal action dynamics. Across four benchmarks, our method achieves 91.91%, 84.30%, 87.88%, and 78.96% AUC-ROC on XD-Violence, UCF-Crime, MSAD, and ShanghaiTech, respectively, establishing new state of the art on three benchmarks under the zero-shot, training-free setting. On XD-Violence, we improve over the previous best result by +0.57% while delivering a 1.31x inference speedup. These results demonstrate that content-aware allocation of VLM capacity, processing fewer frames more intelligently rather than all frames uniformly, is a more effective axis of progress than uniformly densifying VLM inference across frames. Code is available on GitHub: this https URL .

AI.tldr: MoG-VLM is a motion-adaptive, training-free video anomaly detection framework that uses Temporal Gradient Magnitude (TGM) as a lightweight control signal to decide where to invoke VLM inference, plus an anchor-triggered hierarchical dual-stream VLM reasoning scheme with early termination and fusion of semantic cues with temporal action dynamics.
AI.motivation: Dense frame-level VLM inference is too slow for real-time video anomaly detection, while uniform sampling ignores content dynamics—wasting compute on static frames and missing localized anomalies. Content-aware allocation of VLM capacity is argued to be a better progress axis than uniformly densifying inference.
AI.method: (1) Temporal Gradient Magnitude (TGM): content-aware motion-based sampling concentrating computation on informative regions; motion used only as a cheap control signal, not as a primary feature. (2) Hierarchical dual-stream design: dense multi-frame VLM reasoning triggered only around high-anomaly-likelihood anchors, with context-window expansion and early termination. (3) Fusion module reconciling instantaneous semantic cues with temporal action dynamics. Zero-shot, training-free.
AI.result: AUC-ROC of 91.91% / 84.30% / 87.88% / 78.96% on XD-Violence, UCF-Crime, MSAD, ShanghaiTech; SOTA on three benchmarks in the zero-shot training-free setting; +0.57% over previous best on XD-Violence with 1.31x inference speedup.
AI.conclusion: Sparse, motion-guided, content-aware scheduling of VLM inference exceeds uniform dense inference in both accuracy and efficiency, indicating adaptive compute allocation is a more effective research direction for VLM-based video anomaly detection.

title: Self-Supervised Multibeam Sonar Restoration via Coherent Forward Modeling
summary: Multibeam imaging sonar produces intensity images degraded by coherent speckle and system-induced blur, while clean reflectivity targets are rarely available. Existing despeckling methods often rely on simplified intensity-domain noise models, synthetic clean targets, or blind-spot self-supervision, and typically do not jointly model deblurring and speckle suppression. We propose a physics-consistent self-supervised framework for joint despeckling and deblurring of multibeam imaging sonar. A stochastic coherent image-formation model yields a conditional-mean forward operator that relates latent scene reflectivity to expected intensity through the squared magnitude of the system point spread function. We then use registered multi-frame sonar sequences to train without clean ground truth images, showing that, under an idealized inter-frame conditional-mean condition, the expected paired loss equals the corresponding forward-prediction loss up to a network-independent constant. To stabilize the ill-conditioned inverse problem, we further adapt robust equivariant imaging using stochastic coherent simulation and introduce a paired forward prediction error metric for ground-truth-free evaluation. Experiments on two real multibeam sonar datasets demonstrate a favourable balance between forward-prediction agreement, homogeneous-region speckle suppression, and preservation of visible structural boundaries compared with representative baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出物理一致的自监督框架，实现多波束成像声呐的联合去斑与去模糊；用相干成像模型导出条件均值前向算子，并用配准多帧序列实现无干净真值训练，同时引入鲁棒等变成像与无真值评估指标。
AI.motivation: 多波束成像声呐图像受相干斑点噪声与系统模糊双重退化，而干净反射率真值几乎不可得；现有去斑方法多基于简化的强度域噪声模型、合成干净目标或盲点自监督，且很少联合建模去模糊与去斑。
AI.method: 1) 基于随机相干成像模型推导条件均值前向算子：隐场景反射率经系统点扩散函数平方幅值映射到期望强度；2) 利用配准的多帧声呐序列训练，在理想化帧间条件均值假设下证明期望配对损失与对应前向预测损失仅相差与网络无关的常数，从而无需干净真值；3) 针对病态逆问题，适配鲁棒等变成像并引入随机相干仿真；4) 提出配对前向预测误差指标用于无真值评估。
AI.result: 在两个真实多波束声呐数据集上，相比代表性基线，在前向预测一致性、均匀区域斑点抑制与可见结构边界保持之间取得更优平衡。
AI.conclusion: 物理一致的建模方式可在无干净真值条件下联合完成声呐图像去斑与去模糊，并具备可用的无参考评估手段；属于特定传感模态的图像复原方法。

title: AgentVQA: A Unified Benchmark for Agentic Visual Understanding
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) can perform a broad range of tasks across diverse settings, yet their performance in agentic contexts remains poorly understood. Although online evaluations in simulators and real-world environments are essential for measuring interactive agent performance, they are costly and challenging to scale.
