Complementary offline VQA benchmarks can enable faster and more reliable comparisons across agentic domains, yet existing benchmarks remain limited and fragmented. To address this gap, we introduce AgentVQA, an offline benchmark for evaluating VLMs on realistic agentic scenarios across five agent domains: Web Agents, Robotics, Egocentric Videos, Games, and Spatial Planning. We build AgentVQA by manually selecting 1000 challenging, real-world agent examples from 23 source datasets and adapting them for reliable offline evaluation. The resulting benchmark preserves realistic scenarios from interactive environments across diverse domains, and its model rankings track those from corresponding online evaluations. Across the 22 evaluated models, the best achieves only 58.5% accuracy. Our cross-domain analysis shows that errors are driven primarily by failures to ground and maintain accurate representations of the current and evolving visual state, including localizing relevant UI elements, interpreting motion, tracking state changes over time, and inferring 3D spatial relationships, rather than by task misinterpretation or downstream logical reasoning.

AI.tldr: AgentVQA：跨五大智能体域（Web、机器人、自我中心视频、游戏、空间规划）的离线VQA基准，从23个源数据集人工挑选1000例，模型排名与在线评测一致；22个模型中最佳仅58.5%。
AI.motivation: 在线交互式智能体评测昂贵且难以规模化，现有离线VQA基准零散有限，无法可靠反映智能体场景下的模型能力。
AI.method: 人工从23个源数据集筛选1000个高难度真实智能体样本并改造为可离线评测的VQA形式；覆盖Web、机器人、自我中心视频、游戏、空间规划五域；评测22个VLM并做跨域错误分析。
AI.result: 最佳模型准确率仅58.5%；基准排名与对应在线评测排名一致；错误主因是视觉状态grounding与维持（UI元素定位、运动理解、状态跟踪、3D空间关系推断），而非任务误解或下游逻辑推理。
AI.conclusion: 离线智能体VQA可作为可扩展的代理评测手段，且揭示当前VLM核心短板在于动态视觉状态表征。

title: Evaluation of Uncertainty-Aware Multi-Software Ensembles for Hippocampal Segmentation
comment: Accepted for publication at the Journal of Machine Learning for Biomedical Imaging (MELBA) this https URL
summary: Accurate hippocampal segmentation can be a useful tool for diagnosing and monitoring neurological conditions such as Alzheimer's disease and epilepsy. While numerous automated segmentation methods exist, their clinical adoption remains limited. Reliable uncertainty assessment can enhance trust and facilitate clinical translation. This study evaluates ensembles of five heterogeneous hippocampal segmentation methods - InnerEye, ASHS, FastSurfer, HippoSeg, and FreeSurfer - across two dementia datasets and one epilepsy dataset. The sub-ensemble containing InnerEye, FastSurfer, and HippoSeg emerged as both accurate and efficient, highlighting the feasibility of balancing computational cost and performance. Additionally, ensemble-derived uncertainty quantification with sample variance, mutual information, and predictive entropy is shown to reduce inaccurate segmentations by flagging low-confidence cases, potentially providing a mechanism for automatically escalating ambiguous cases for expert assessment. Lastly, this study explores the downstream clinical utility of ensemble-derived uncertainty, finding a significant correlation with motion artefact severity and a modest contribution to Alzheimer's disease classification.

AI.tldr: 评估五种异构海马体分割方法（InnerEye、ASHS、FastSurfer、HippoSeg、FreeSurfer）的集成，发现由InnerEye、FastSurfer、HippoSeg组成的子集成兼具精度与效率，其不确定性（样本方差、互信息、预测熵）可标记低置信度样本以减少错误分割，并与运动伪影严重度显著相关、对阿尔茨海默病分类有微弱贡献。
AI.motivation: 自动化海马体分割方法众多，但临床采纳受限；可靠的不确定性估计可提升信任度、推动临床转化。同时需在计算成本与性能之间取得平衡，并验证不确定性指标的下游临床实用性。
AI.method: 在两个痴呆数据集和一个癫痫数据集上，对五种异构分割方法的集成与子集成进行精度—效率评估；使用样本方差、互信息、预测熵进行集成衍生的不确定性量化，并分析其与运动伪影严重度及阿尔茨海默病分类的相关性。
AI.result: InnerEye+FastSurfer+HippoSeg子集成在精度与效率上最优；不确定性量化可通过标记低置信度病例减少不准确分割，形成对疑难病例自动转交专家复核的机制；不确定性与运动伪影严重度显著相关，对AD分类贡献有限。
AI.conclusion: 异构集成可在临床分割任务中兼顾成本与精度，集成不确定性具备病例分级（自动升级至专家）的实用价值，并可作为数据质量/运动伪影的间接指标。

title: SCOPE: Scene-graph Construction Optimized by Plan Error-correction for Robot Long-term Planning Datasets
comment: 8 pages. Accepted at IROS 2026. Project page: this https URL
summary: Task and Motion Planning (TAMP) stands as a fundamental challenge in robotics, essential for enabling autonomous agents to execute complex, long-horizon tasks in diverse environments. While Large Language Models (LLMs) introduce a new paradigm for TAMP by leveraging extensive common sense, their inherent reasoning limitations hinder direct application, and fine-tuning strategies to enhance these capabilities are currently bottlenecked by the scarcity of high-quality datasets. Existing automated generation methods often suffer from homogeneity, limiting model generalization, and unsolvability, where hallucinated scene graphs create physical mismatches with task goals. To address these issues, we propose Scene-graph Construction Optimized by Plan Error-correction (SCOPE), an automated framework designed to generate diverse and executable TAMP datasets. SCOPE incorporates multi-level diversity metrics to maximize the information entropy of scenarios. Crucially, it introduces a Plan Feedback Error-correction pipeline that utilizes planner execution failures as feedback signals to retroactively rectify logical inconsistencies in scene graphs, ensuring physical feasibility. Experimental results demonstrate that SCOPE exhibits greater robustness to erroneous scene graphs and generates higher-quality data. When utilized for LLM fine-tuning, SCOPE-generated data yield a downstream TAMP model that achieves an absolute 12.33% gain in success rate over its counterpart fine-tuned with data generated by DELTA, a state-of-the-art PDDL-based planner.

AI.tldr: SCOPE：用规划执行失败信号回修场景图的自动化TAMP数据生成框架，产出多样且可执行的训练数据，微调后下游TAMP成功率比DELTA数据提升12.33%。
AI.motivation: LLM用于TAMP受限于推理能力，微调又缺高质量数据；现有自动生成方法存在场景同质化（泛化差）与幻觉场景图导致目标物理不可解两大问题。
AI.method: 提出多级多样性度量以最大化场景信息熵；并设计Plan Feedback Error-correction流水线，将规划器执行失败作为反馈信号，反向修正场景图中的逻辑不一致，保证物理可行性。
AI.result: 对错误场景图更鲁棒，生成数据质量更高；用于LLM微调后，下游TAMP模型成功率较DELTA（SOTA PDDL规划器数据）绝对提升12.33%。
AI.conclusion: 以规划可行性反馈闭环校正符号场景图，是提升TAMP数据可执行性与多样性的有效途径，可作为LLM微调数据引擎。

title: Diffusion-Based Synthesis of Complete 3D Biparametric Prostate MRI
comment: Presented at the 6th Deep Generative Models Workshop (DGM4MICCAI), MICCAI 2026
summary: Synthetic biparametric MRI (bpMRI) may help alleviate the limited availability of large and representative prostate MRI datasets for deep learning applications. In this work, we present a conditional 3D diffusion framework for anatomy-conditioned synthesis of complete prostate bpMRI from anatomical masks. The framework supports sequential synthesis, in which T2w and diffusion modalities are generated by separately trained models, and joint synthesis, in which all bpMRI modalities are generated simultaneously within a single model. Five configurations were trained using PI-CAI, FastMRI Prostate, and PROSTATEx datasets to investigate different conditioning schemes, target modalities, and synthesis strategies. Evaluation using distribution-based metrics, paired-image similarity, and qualitative assessment demonstrated the feasibility of both synthesis pathways. Joint synthesis achieved competitive distributional fidelity while generating complete bpMRI, whereas direct synthesis of ADC and computed high-b-value DWI outperformed their derivation from synthetic diffusion-weighted images.

AI.tldr: 提出条件3D扩散框架，从解剖掩膜合成完整前列腺bpMRI；支持顺序合成（T2w与DWI分模型）与联合合成（单模型同时生成全部bpMRI模态），并比较不同条件方案、目标模态与合成策略。
AI.motivation: 大规模、具代表性的前列腺MRI数据集稀缺，限制深度学习应用；以解剖掩膜为条件的合成bpMRI可缓解数据不足问题。
AI.method: 基于条件3D扩散模型，在PI-CAI、FastMRI Prostate、PROSTATEx上训练五种配置，考察不同条件方案（掩膜条件方式）、目标模态（直接合成ADC与计算高b值DWI vs. 由合成DWI推导）及合成策略（顺序 vs. 联合）。
AI.result: 分布度量、配对图像相似度与定性评估均表明两种合成路径可行；联合合成在生成完整bpMRI的同时保持有竞争力的分布保真度；直接合成ADC与计算高b值DWI优于由其合成DWI图像推导得到的结果。
AI.conclusion: 解剖条件3D扩散可同时支撑顺序与联合bpMRI合成；推荐直接合成ADC与高b值DWI而非事后推导，联合合成为完整bpMRI生成的可行高效路径。

title: LACToS: Local Anomaly Detection via Conditional Typicality of Superpixels
summary: Local anomaly detection is the task of identifying spatially confined anomalous or out-of-distribution (OOD) regions within an otherwise in-distribution (ID) image. Most existing methods are designed for a specific context, with a strong focus on industrial defect detection, where they achieve excellent performance on well-established benchmarks. However, we observe that these methods can exhibit significant performance drops in other contexts, especially when the inlier distribution is multimodal. To account for this inlier complexity, we propose LACToS, a principled local OOD detection method based on statistical typicality and made tractable through two innovations: (i) grouping pixels into superpixels and (ii) using a computationally efficient proxy to estimate typicality. We evaluate LACToS across three diverse applications spanning medical imaging, human faces, and X-ray security screening. LACToS performs more robustly than prior methods across these benchmarks. The code is released here: this https URL .

AI.tldr: 提出LACToS，一种基于统计典型性(typicality)的局部OOD检测方法，通过超像素分组与高效典型性代理估计使其可计算，在医学影像、人脸与X射线安检三类场景下比现有方法更鲁棒。
AI.motivation: 现有局部异常检测方法多针对单一场景（以工业缺陷检测为主），在inlier分布呈多模态时性能显著下降，缺乏对复杂inlier分布的适应性。
AI.method: 以统计典型性为原理性判据构建局部OOD检测；两项关键近似：(i) 将像素聚为超像素以降低计算规模，(ii) 使用计算高效的代理量估计典型性。
AI.result: 在医学影像、人脸、X射线安检三个跨域基准上，LACToS鲁棒性优于既有工业缺陷导向方法，缓解了多模态inlier下的性能退化；代码开源。
AI.conclusion: 统计典型性+超像素的框架比面向特定场景的异常检测方法更具跨域泛化性，为通用局部OOD检测提供了可行路线。

title: Dispersive Tree Agreements for Multi-Robot Coordination
comment: 19 pages, 5 figures, 7 tables. Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Robotics
summary: Multi-robot coordination of nonlinear systems is naturally formulated as joint-space optimal control subject to constraints over groups of robots. Existing methods that approach joint optimality remain largely centralized, offline, and confined to collision-free motion planning, while decentralized, real-time counterparts target safe navigation without pursuing the joint optimum. This paper develops a decentralized, real-time planner that approaches the joint optimum as an anytime process. We extend a recent single-robot framework that searches dispersive trees of forward-propagated commands for differentially flat systems to coordinate a multi-robot team near-optimally. We first show that the inter-robot coupling can be effectively replaced by some local constraints, under which locally grown dispersive trees contain a near-optimal agreement. It is this structure that the robots pursue by decentralized column generation, negotiating rents on the shared space that guide the search of each robot's tree. The negotiation settles on an agreement whose near-optimality is certified at quiescence. Our protocol, WarpWeaver, implements this negotiation as an asynchronous real-time loop over a receding horizon, and demonstrates effective closure to quiesced agreements even when real-time deadlines cut the negotiation short. In simulation, WarpWeaver reduces total travel time by up to 22% against centralized offline planners on the Dynobench suite and by up to 37% against a decentralized real-time baseline, and nearly doubles the success rate of a task-specific planner on graph connectivity. Hardware experiments on six robots planning onboard demonstrate real-world implementability.

AI.tldr: WarpWeaver：将单机器人"发散树"搜索扩展到多机器人，用局部约束替代机器人间耦合，通过异步分散式列生成对共享空间租金进行实时协商，使各机器人树收敛到近最优一致解，并在实时截止时仍能闭合。
AI.motivation: 现有多机器人协同最优控制要么集中式、离线、仅限无碰撞运动规划；要么分散式实时但只做安全导航，不追求联合最优。缺失一种既分散实时又逼近联合最优的规划器。
AI.method: 针对微分平坦系统，将机器人间耦合证明性地替换为局部约束（局部生长的发散树中即含近最优一致解）；提出 WarpWeaver 协议：各机器人分散式列生成，对共享空间的"租金"（对偶价格）进行协商以引导各自树的搜索；以滚动时域下的异步实时循环实现，静止（quiescence）时给出近最优性证书。
AI.result: 仿真中相对 Dynobench 上的集中式离线规划器最多降低总行程时间 22%，相对分散式实时基线最多降低 37%；在图连通性任务上任务专用规划器成功率接近翻倍。六机器人机载板载规划硬件实验验证可落地实现。
AI.conclusion: 用局部对偶定价协商取代集中式联合求解，可在异步实时、可被截止打断的条件下获得近最优且可认证的多机器人协同方案，并在真机上可行。

title: Decentralized Bi-Level Optimization for Cooperative Orbital Transportation of a Rigid Payload
summary: The rapid growth of the space economy, alongside increasing orbital congestion and debris, is driving demand for reliable on-orbit transportation of large and non-cooperative objects. Performing such transportation with a swarm of small spacecraft distributes risk and removes the single point of failure inherent to monolithic architectures, but requires solving a non-convex trajectory optimization coupling every agent's cone-constrained thrust to the payload's rotational dynamics. Existing approaches span decentralized control laws with asymptotic guarantees but limited constraint enforcement, and centralized and partially centralized planners that reintroduce a single point of failure. In this work, we present a decentralized bi-level framework driven by exact gradients: the problem is split into an inner convex thrust allocation and an outer search over payload torque trajectories. This decomposition yields fuel-efficient solutions quickly, without requiring full NLP convergence, and at short timescales its performance scales with the number of agents. Theoretical convergence guarantees are established, and the method is validated through extensive Monte Carlo simulation, including closed-loop recovery from in-flight faults. These properties make the framework well suited to spacecraft swarm applications.

AI.tldr: 提出去中心化双层框架，用精确梯度将小航天器集群搬运大/非合作目标的非凸轨迹优化分解为内层凸推力分配+外层载荷力矩轨迹搜索，收敛快、燃油高效且具理论收敛保证。
AI.motivation: 空间经济扩张与轨道拥堵、碎片增多，需要可靠的在轨大质量、非合作目标运输。单体架构存在单点失效风险，集群小卫星可分散风险，但需解决将各智能体锥约束推力与载荷转动动力学耦合的非凸轨迹优化问题；现有方法要么约束满足性弱（分散式渐近控制），要么重新引入集中式单点失效。
AI.method: 去中心化双层优化框架：内层为凸的推力分配问题，外层为对载荷力矩轨迹的搜索，以上下层的精确梯度驱动；无需完整非线性规划收敛即可快速获得解，短时间尺度下性能随智能体数量扩展。给出理论收敛性保证。
AI.result: 可获得燃油高效解且求解速度快，短时标下性能随智能体数增加；通过大量蒙特卡洛仿真验证，并演示了飞行中故障后的闭环恢复。
AI.conclusion: 分层+精确梯度的去中心化设计在保证约束与收敛性的同时避免了单点失效，适合航天器集群的在轨协同运输应用。

title: Squaring-the-Sphere: Distortion-Free and Seamless Panorama Generation via CubeAtlas
summary: Generating 360-degree panoramas requires both local perspective fidelity and global spherical continuity. Existing representations face a trade-off: equirectangular projection (ERP) enables seamless panorama modeling but suffers from severe distortion and a domain gap to pre-trained image generators, whereas cubemaps preserve perspective geometry but often produce inconsistent faces and visible seams. We present Squaring-the-Sphere, a panoramic image generation framework built on a novel representation CubeAtlas, which unfolds all cubemap faces into a single compact canvas. By arranging orientation-aligned, rotated polar regions alongside the equatorial faces, this representation preserves the perspective geometry of cubemaps while organizing the cross-face relationships required for seamless panorama assembly. It further enables a pretrained diffusion transformer to model the complete panorama jointly in a single pass, without altering the backbone architecture or positional encoding. While CubeAtlas has a token count comparable to ERP, its structured layout makes many dense attention interactions unnecessary. We therefore introduce a layout-aware sparse attention mask that preserves the interactions required for panorama continuity while removing geometrically irrelevant token pairs. As a result, CubeAtlas achieves better quality than ERP modeling with lower attention computation. Furthermore, we introduce a training-free super-resolution technique and a fusion scheme that enhance fine details in distortion-free perspective space before achieving the final ERP panorama. Experiments on various benchmarks demonstrate that our method improves geometric fidelity, cross-view consistency, and high-resolution visual quality over previous methods.

AI.tldr: 提出 CubeAtlas 全景表示：将立方体贴图六面带展开为单张紧凑画布（含方向对齐的旋转极区+赤道面），配合布局感知稀疏注意力掩码，让预训练扩散 Transformer 单次联合生成无缝 360° 全景，并叠加免训练超分与融合得到 ERP 全景。
AI.motivation: 360° 全景生成需同时满足局部透视保真与全球球面连续性：ERP 无缝但畸变严重、与预训练生成器存在域差；cubemap 保透视几何但面间不一致、接缝明显。目标是找到兼顾两者的表示，并避免改动骨干/位置编码。
AI.method: 核心表示 CubeAtlas：把六个立方体面按方向对齐方式（旋转极区+赤道面）展开到单一画布，保留透视几何与跨面邻接关系，使预训练 DiT 一次前向建模整幅全景；token 数与 ERP 相当但结构性强，据此设计布局感知稀疏注意力掩码，剔除几何无关 token 对、保留连续性所需交互；再引入免训练超分与融合方案，在无畸变透视空间增强细节后回投为 ERP 全景。
AI.result: 在多个基准上较先前方法提升几何保真度、跨视角一致性与高分辨率视觉质量；在注意力计算量低于 ERP 建模的情况下取得更优生成质量。
AI.conclusion: 用结构化展开表示加稀疏注意力可绕开 ERP/cubemap 的固有取舍，且无需修改预训练骨干即可零样本适配；透视空间超分+融合是提升全景细节的有效后处理范式。

title: CellTrack-Bench: Microscopic Cell Tracking Benchmark for Vision-Language Models
summary: Large language models have shown outstanding performance on text-first tasks such as coding, math, and writing. Recent efforts are shifting models' training to include scientific problems that often live in highly specialized domains beyond text, such as protein structure and biological images. However, in these scenarios, their general-purpose accuracy compared with specialized algorithms remains in question. One such domain is cell tracking, which requires spatiotemporal awareness of cell dynamics. To evaluate this, we created a new benchmark, CellTrack-Bench, which assesses Vision-Language Models' (VLMs) cell-tracking-related performance against specialized trackers. The full benchmark draws from 15 standard cell-tracking datasets across four imaging modalities and comprises 1,537 problems corresponding to 9,041 cell-linking decisions. We selected a hard subset requiring greater reasoning effort by identifying failures shared across distinct algorithmic trackers. With this proposed dataset, we: (i) evaluated different environment harnesses for VLMs; (ii) benchmarked 9 frontier closed-source models and 13 open-weight models; and (iii) provided a detailed analysis of their failure modes. Code, the stored model outputs, and a pipeline that regenerates the benchmark from the source datasets are available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: CellTrack-Bench 是一个评估视觉语言模型（VLM）细胞追踪能力的基准，覆盖 4 种成像模态、15 个细胞追踪数据集，含 1,537 个问题与 9,041 次细胞关联决策，并含一个基于跨算法共同失败筛选的高难度子集；作者系统评估了 9 个闭源前沿模型与 13 个开源权重模型及其失败模式。
AI.motivation: LLM/VLM 的能力正从纯文本任务扩展到蛋白质结构、生物图像等高度专业化的科学领域，但相比专用算法其通用精度存疑；细胞追踪需要时空动态感知，是检验这一差距的合适场景，而此前缺乏与专用追踪器对比的标准化评测。
AI.method: 构建 CellTrack-Bench：从 15 个标准细胞追踪数据集（4 种成像模态）汇总出 1,537 个问题、9,041 个细胞链接决策；通过识别不同算法追踪器共有的失败案例，构造需要更强推理的高难度子集；对比多种 VLM 环境脚手架（environment harnesses），并对 9 个闭源前沿模型与 13 个开源权重模型进行基准测试与失败模式分析，同时开源数据生成流水线与模型输出。
AI.result: 提供了与专用追踪器的对照结果、不同 prompt/环境脚手架下的性能差异、以及闭源与开源权重模型的全面横向比较和细粒度失败模式分析；未在摘要中给出具体数值结论。
AI.conclusion: 当前通用 VLM 在专业时空推理任务（细胞追踪）上与专用算法仍存在差距，该基准为诊断与改进 VLM 的科学领域时空推理能力提供了可复现的评测工具与数据管线。

title: Geometry-Dependent Properties of Physically Crosslinked PPy-PVA Hydrogels Enable Tunable Iontophoretic Drug Delivery
summary: Objective: Iontophoretic drug delivery has primarily relied on current modulation to regulate drug transport. Here, we investigate hydrogel geometry, microstructure, and local electric fields as alternative mechanisms for controlling transdermal delivery. Methods: Bovine serum albumin (BSA) was encapsulated in polypyrrole-polyvinyl alcohol (PPy-PVA) hydrogels. Five geometries, including Hilbert curve-based designs, were fabricated to vary pore architecture and local electric field distributions. We optimized PPy content, drug loading, and current density. Electric fields were evaluated using finite element analysis, and microstructures were characterized by scanning electron microscopy. Drug transport was assessed using Franz diffusion cells with artificial membranes. Results: Hydrogel geometries exhibited distinct microstructures and electric field distributions. Iontophoresis substantially enhanced permeability compared with passive diffusion, while individual geometries produced different cumulative release, flux, and permeability profiles. The average iontophoretic permeability was (3.80 +/- 1.93) x 10^-5, exceeding previously reported values using artificial membranes. Conclusion: Geometry-driven fabrication of drug-loaded hydrogels enables tunable transport characteristics under both iontophoretic and passive conditions. Significance: Geometry-mediated control offers an alternative approach to regulating iontophoretic drug delivery without requiring individual current-density modulation.

AI.tldr: 研究水凝胶几何结构（含Hilbert曲线设计）与局部电场分布对离子导入经皮给药传输特性的调控作用。
AI.motivation: 传统离子导入给药主要依赖电流调制来调控药物传输，作者希望探索几何构型与微观结构作为替代性调控手段。
AI.method: 将BSA包封于PPy-PVA水凝胶，制备五种不同几何（含Hilbert曲线）样品以改变孔结构与局部电场；优化PPy含量、载药量与电流密度；用有限元分析评估电场，SEM表征微观结构，Franz扩散池配合人工膜评估药物传输。
AI.result: 不同几何水凝胶呈现明显不同的微观结构与电场分布；离子导入显著提升渗透性，各几何样品释放量、通量和渗透系数曲线各异；平均离子导入渗透率为(3.80±1.93)×10^-5，高于既往人工膜报道值。
AI.conclusion: 几何驱动的载药水凝胶制备可在离子导入与被动条件下实现可调传输特性，提供无需逐一调制电流密度的替代调控路径。

title: Echo: Coupled Action and Task Status Signal Denoising for Vision Language Action Models
summary: Recognizing task completion and failure enables robots to stop upon success and initiate recovery or replanning after failure. Existing methods augment Vision Language Action (VLA) policies with task status signal prediction to support these execution decisions. However, learning and integrating these signals can require fine-grained supervision, external monitoring models, or complex architectural designs. Moreover, the potential of task status signals to directly guide action generation remains underexplored. We present Echo, a framework that combines task status signal learning without frame-level progress annotations with a compact design for status prediction and action generation within a single VLA. Specifically, Echo represents task status with stop and failure signals, added as two dimensions of each action chunk and denoised together with robot actions. Their combination distinguishes ongoing execution, successful completion, and failure. To learn these signals without fine-grained progress annotations, Echo constructs successful, failed, and recovery trajectories with complementary supervision properties. To enable status signal-guided action generation, Echo controls interactions between the signals and actions and denoises the signals faster than the actions. These allow later action denoising steps to condition on cleaner status estimates while preserving accurate signal prediction. Extensive real-world manipulation experiments show that Echo accurately predicts task status and consistently improves policy performance.

AI.tldr: Echo 在单一 VLA 中把"停止/失败"两个任务状态信号作为额外两个动作维度与机器人动作一起扩散去噪，无需帧级进度标注，并用更快的信号去噪为后续动作去噪提供更干净的状态条件。
AI.motivation: VLA 策略需要判断任务是否完成或失败以决定停止、恢复或重规划；现有做法依赖细粒度监督、外部监控模型或复杂架构，且状态信号直接引导动作生成的能力未被充分挖掘。
AI.method: 将 stop 与 failure 信号作为每个 action chunk 的两个附加维度，与动作联合扩散去噪，其组合区分进行中/成功/失败；构造成功、失败、恢复三类轨迹，利用互补监督在无帧级进度标注下学习信号；设计信号与动作的受控交互，并让信号先于动作收敛（更快去噪），使后续动作去噪步以更干净的状态估计为条件。
AI.result: 大量真实机器人操作实验表明 Echo 能准确预测任务状态，并稳定提升策略性能。
AI.conclusion: 在单一 VLA 内联合建模任务状态信号与动作生成是一种轻量且有效的方案，在不增加标注成本的前提下实现了状态感知的执行决策与性能提升。

title: Beyond Best-of-$k$: Prior-Consistent DAPS for Ambiguous Nonlinear Inverse Problems
summary: Diffusion models have become strong priors for solving inverse problems. However, nonlinear inverse problems such as phase retrieval remain challenging when multiple measurement-consistent solutions are distinguishable only by the prior; we call such measurements ambiguous. Existing diffusion-based samplers rely on local approximations during reconstruction. For an ambiguous measurement, these approximations can allow measurement guidance to favor a measurement-consistent mode that is close to a prior-supported mode but is itself not supported by the prior. Evaluation often masks this type of failure by reporting the best-of-$k$ runs, where the best is selected by comparison to the ground truth. We introduce Prior-Consistent DAPS (PC-DAPS), a variant of Decoupled Annealing Posterior Sampling (DAPS) designed to address this failure case by maintaining multiple candidate solutions within a single sampling run. As annealing noise decreases, PC-DAPS prunes and replaces weaker candidates according to their prior consistency, without any ground-truth access. PC-DAPS reduces the incidence of prior-inconsistent samples and improves sample quality on nonlinear inverse problems while preserving sample quality and diversity on linear inverse problems.

AI.tldr: PC-DAPS：在单次采样中维持多个候选解，按先验一致性剪枝/替换，缓解非线性逆问题（如相位恢复）中"测量一致但先验不支持"的错误模态。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型作为逆问题先验已很强，但非线性逆问题（相位恢复）中存在多个测量一致解，只能靠先验区分（模糊测量）。现有扩散采样器的局部近似会让测量引导收敛到"接近先验支持模态但自身不被先验支持"的测量一致解；且评测用best-of-k对照GT选取，掩盖了该类失败。
AI.method: 提出PC-DAPS（Prior-Consistent DAPS），DAPS的变体：一次采样run内并行维护多个候选解；随退火噪声下降，依据先验一致性对弱候选进行剪枝与替换，全程不使用ground truth。
AI.result: 降低先验不一致样本的发生率，提升非线性逆问题的采样质量；在线性逆问题上保持采样质量与多样性。
AI.conclusion: 以多候选+先验一致性筛选替代局部近似引导，可作为缓解扩散逆问题模糊测量失败模式的通用采样策略。

title: Humanoid Mobility via Attention-based Contacts
summary: Humanoid mobility over complex terrain requires accurate foot placement and coordinated whole-body motion capable of robust adaptation. Reinforcement learning (RL) policies trained without motion references generalize well across terrains, yet eliciting effective whole-body coordination through reward design and exploration alone remains challenging. In contrast, reference-based methods yield natural motions but struggle to adapt beyond the predefined trajectories in their training data. We introduce a learning framework that bridges these two approaches by using motion data strictly as a training prior. An explicit, self-supervised, attention-based contact planner predicts future body-environment contacts, while a contact-conditioned tracker translates these plans into coordinated whole-body motion. Together, they establish contact as an interface between sensory observations and control actions. This abstraction allows the policy to internalize the contact-aware structure of locomotion rather than directly replicating kinematics. Consequently, a single policy can exploit data-driven motion priors for natural whole-body coordination while retaining the flexibility to discover environment-dependent behaviors through reinforcement learning. Building on the learned contact planner and tracker, a subsequent fine-tuning stage bootstraps their acquired capabilities to explore environment variations beyond those covered by the original motion data. Operating entirely from onboard observations without any reference inputs at deployment, this framework enables versatile humanoid mobility in challenging environments.

AI.tldr: 提出以"接触"为界面的人形机器人学习框架：自监督注意力接触规划器预测未来身体-环境接触，接触条件化的运动跟踪器将计划转为协调全身动作，运动数据仅作训练先验，部署时纯靠机载观测、无需参考输入，实现复杂地形泛化。
AI.motivation: 纯RL策略跨地形泛化好但难以通过奖励设计诱发自然全身协调；参考运动跟踪方法动作自然却难以跳出预定义轨迹。需要兼得数据先验的自然性与RL的环境适应灵活性。
AI.method: 显式自监督注意力接触规划器预测未来身体-环境接触点；接触条件化的跟踪器把接触计划映射为协调全身运动；以接触作为感知观测与控制动作之间的抽象接口，使策略内化接触感知的运动结构而非直接模仿运动学；随后用微调阶段以已学能力为起点探索超出原运动数据的环境变化。
AI.result: 单一策略既能利用数据驱动的运动先验获得自然全身协调，又保留通过RL发现环境依赖行为的灵活性；微调后可探索原始运动数据未覆盖的地形；部署时完全基于机载观测、无需任何参考输入，可在挑战性环境中实现多样人形移动。
AI.conclusion: 将运动数据降格为训练先验、并以"接触"作为观测-控制的中间表示，是融合参考式与无参考式两派优势的有效途径，为人形机器人在复杂地形上的通用移动提供了可部署方案。

title: Progress Probes $P^2$: Lightweight Runtime Monitoring for Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models can perform diverse manipulation tasks directly from visual observations and natural language instructions, but they remain prone to mistakes and unpredictable failures. Deploying these policies without continuous human supervision will require robust runtime monitors that detect when the policy has gone off-course. Existing monitors use external foundation models, such as vision-language models (VLMs) to supervise the policy, introducing significant complexity and computational cost for monitoring at runtime. In this work, we investigate an alternate approach: \textit{can a VLA's own internal activations provide the information needed to monitor its execution?} Our method trains linear probes on policy activations from demonstrations to estimate progress, then flags executions that deviate from expected progress. In experiments with the open-source VLA $\pi_{0.5}$ and across simulated and real-world manipulation tasks, this approach is competitive with or outperforms VLM-based monitors in task failure detection, as well as methods which require failure data for training. These findings suggest that simple probes of VLA internals can be used to develop reliable runtime monitors, opening a path toward building policies that can act reliably and monitor their execution without external foundation models.

AI.tldr: 该工作提出用VLA策略自身内部激活训练线性探针估计任务进度，从而在运行时检测偏离预期的执行；在π0.5模型上跨仿真与真实操作任务，其失败检测效果可媲美或优于基于VLM的外部监控器及需要失败数据训练的方法。
AI.motivation: VLA模型虽可直接由视觉观测与语言指令执行多样操作，但仍易出错且失败不可预测；无人监督部署需要运行时监控器。现有方案多依赖外部基础模型（如VLM）监督策略，带来显著的复杂度和计算开销，因此作者探究能否仅用VLA自身的内部激活提供监控所需信息。
AI.method: 从示范数据中提取策略激活，训练线性探针以回归/估计任务进度；运行时用探针预测的进度与期望进度比较，偏离即触发报警，从而识别任务失败或偏离轨迹的执行。方法不依赖额外基础模型，也无需失败样本。
AI.result: 在开源VLA π0.5 上，于多个仿真与真实世界操作任务中，该探针式监控器在任务失败检测方面与基于VLM的监控器相当或更优，并且优于需要失败数据进行训练的方法。
AI.conclusion: 对VLA内部表征的简单线性探针即可构建可靠的运行时监控器，为构建无需外部基础模型、能够自我监控执行过程的策略提供了可行路径。

title: DiffDreamer: Coupling World Models with Differentiable Simulation for Agile Quadrotor Control
summary: Tasks such as quadrotor dynamic-gate racing require agents to anticipate external motion while maintaining precise high-frequency control. World-model-based reinforcement learning provides a natural solution by learning latent dynamics for future imagination, yet it often entangles environmental evolution and the robot's own dynamics in a single learned rollout, where model bias can affect policy optimization efficiency. We propose DiffDreamer, a differentiable reinforcement learning framework that tightly couples a learned world model with differentiable simulation for actor optimization. In one optimization step, the learned world model propagates latent states that capture external dynamics and history-dependent features, while the differentiable simulator propagates the robot's explicit physical state. We further decompose the actor objective into a critic-driven pathway for non-differentiable task rewards and a simulator-driven pathway for differentiable motion rewards. Experiments on aggressive tracking and dynamic-gate racing show that DiffDreamer improves training convergence over the model-free, model-based, and differentiable-RL baselines, and final performance over these baselines and classical planning and control methods. Additional experiments assess reward decomposition and the odometry-conditioned relative-state representation through ablations. We also provide proof-of-concept real-world flight experiments for validation.

AI.tldr: DiffDreamer 将学习到的世界模型（隐空间传播外部动力学与历史依赖特征）与可微仿真器（显式物理状态传播）紧耦合用于 actor 优化，并将 actor 目标分解为 critic 驱动（不可微任务奖励）与 simulator 驱动（可微运动奖励）两条通路，在激进跟踪与动态门竞速任务上提升收敛与最终性能，并给出实机概念验证。
AI.motivation: 四旋翼动态门竞速等任务需在保持高频精确控制的同时预判外部运动。基于世界模型的 RL 可做隐空间想象，但通常把环境演化与机器人自身动力学纠缠在单次 rollout 中，模型偏差会拖累策略优化效率。
AI.method: 提出可微 RL 框架 DiffDreamer：每步优化中，世界模型传播捕获外部动力学的隐状态，可微仿真器传播机器人显式物理状态；引入里程计条件化的相对状态表示；将 actor 目标解耦为 critic 驱动的不可微任务奖励通路与 simulator 驱动的可微运动奖励通路。
AI.result: 在激进跟踪与动态门竞速任务上，训练收敛优于 model-free、model-based 与 differentiable-RL 基线，最终性能优于上述基线及经典规划/控制方法；消融验证了奖励分解与里程计条件相对状态表示的作用；并提供实机飞行的概念验证。
AI.conclusion: 显式分离"外部动力学建模"与"机器人物理传播"，并用可微仿真承担运动奖励梯度，是提升世界模型 RL 在高速动态机动中样本效率与性能的有效路径；但实机验证仍停留在概念验证阶段。

title: F2G-Pose: Geometry-Aware Foundation Feature Lifting for Direct RGB-D Category-Level Object Pose Estimation
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. 22 pages, including the complete technical appendix
summary: This paper studies category-level RGB-D object pose estimation, which recovers an object's 3D rotation and translation without instance-specific CAD models or reference views. This task is highly ambiguous due to intra-class variations, symmetries, and partial observations. Current solutions struggle to balance reliability and efficiency: methods based on intermediate structures are prone to error propagation, while diffusion models suffer from high inference latency and complex post-hoc candidate extraction. To address this, we present F2G-Pose, a real-time direct, single-pass framework that predicts category-level pose, metric size, and camera-frame completed shape from a single RGB-D observation in one feed-forward pass. F2G-Pose lifts dense visual foundation features to partial point clouds, encodes local geometry with DGCNN tokenization, and integrates object-level structure with a Mixture-of-Experts Transformer. Joint size prediction and camera-frame shape completion encourage metric consistency through dense geometric supervision. With its task-specific network trained only on pose-annotated synthetic SOPE data and its frozen RADIO backbone externally pretrained, F2G-Pose achieves state-of-the-art accuracy on SOPE and ROPE while running at 28 FPS for pose-only inference, and further demonstrates strong camera-frame geometry on HouseCat6D and real-object transfer on HANDAL. Analyses of latency, robustness, shape completion, and GenPose++ candidate behavior further demonstrate the efficiency and reliability of F2G-Pose, with real-world manipulation experiments demonstrating deployment potential under segmented RGB-D inputs. The project page, code, and pretrained models are made available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: F2G-Pose: 单次前向、实时的类别级RGB-D位姿估计框架，联合预测位姿、度量尺寸与相机系形状补全，精度SOTA且姿态推理达28 FPS。
AI.motivation: 类别级RGB-D位姿估计因类内差异、对称性与部分观测而高度歧义；现有中间结构方法存在误差传播，扩散模型推理延迟高且需复杂的候选后处理，难以兼顾可靠性与效率。
AI.method: 将稠密视觉基础特征提升至部分点云，用DGCNN tokenization编码局部几何，并以Mixture-of-Experts Transformer整合物体级结构；联合尺寸预测与相机系形状补全，通过稠密几何监督保证度量一致性；仅用带位姿标注的合成SOPE数据训练任务网络，冻结外部预训练RADIO骨干。
AI.result: 在SOPE、ROPE上达到SOTA，姿态推理28 FPS；在HouseCat6D上展示强相机系几何，在HANDAL上实现真实物体迁移；延迟、鲁棒性、形状补全与GenPose++候选行为分析均支持其高效可靠；基于分割RGB-D输入的真实机器人操作实验验证部署潜力。
AI.conclusion: 单次前向的直接式框架可在保持实时性的同时兼顾精度与度量一致性，具备从合成到真实场景与机器人操作的部署价值。

title: Extending Harmonic Function Methods via Root Locus for Coordinated Path Generation
comment: 16 pages, 6 figures. Extended version of a paper submitted to Automatica. Corresponding code: this https URL
summary: We consider the offline generation of coordinated paths for N interchangeable robots and N goals in planar environments with polygonal obstacles. After a conformal map to a circular domain, starts and goals become the poles and zeros of a rational function R, and the paths are the branches of its Generalized Root Locus (GRL), i.e. the streamlines of the logarithmic potential -log R. We show that, for every phase outside a finite set of critical phases and a set of boundary phases, the induced gradient motion drives each robot to a distinct goal along pairwise disjoint paths that never reach the obstacles; the robot-goal assignment is produced by the construction, and with the gain used as a clock all robots move as the closed-loop roots of the GRL and arrive together at a prescribed time. Obstacles become streamlines through successive Milne-Thomson reflections, and for a finite number of reflections a finite test certifies safety for the potential that is actually computed. Reciprocal root-locus planning is recovered as a special case. The method is illustrated on two polygonal workspaces, 100 random instances compared with independent harmonic planning and artificial potentials, and a scene with ten robots and ten obstacles.

AI.tldr: 提出基于共形映射与广义根轨迹（GRL）的多机器人多目标无碰撞协同路径生成方法，用对数势-log R的流线作为路径，以增益为时钟实现同时到达。
AI.motivation: N个可互换机器人与N个目标的离线协同路径规划，需要同时解决目标分配、路径互不相交、避障与时间同步问题，现有调和势场/人工势场方法易陷入局部极小且缺乏理论安全保证。
AI.method: 先将多边形容器共形映射到圆域，起终点成为有理函数R的极点与零点；机器人路径取广义根轨迹（即"对数势-log R"的流线）分支。证明除有限临界相位与边界相位外，由梯度流诱导的运动可将每个机器人送到不同目标，路径两两不相交且不触及障碍；分配由构造自动给出。障碍通过连续的Milne-Thomson 反射转化为流线，有限次反射可用有限测试对实际计算的势做安全性验证。以增益作为时钟，使全部机器人作为GRL闭环根同步在指定时刻到达。互易根轨迹规划成为特例。
AI.result: 在两个多边形工作空间上演示；与独立调和规划及人工势场法在100个随机实例上比较；并给出含10个机器人、10个障碍的场景。
AI.conclusion: GRL/共形映射框架为多机器人协同路径提供了有理论保证（不相交、避障、同时到达、自动分配）的解析构造，并可通过反射处理障碍，是对根轨迹式调和规划的有力推广。

title: HiP3R: Hierarchical Pose Graphs for Long-Horizon 3D Reconstruction
summary: Feed-forward models accurately estimate camera motion and 3D geometry from short video windows. However, computational and memory costs prevent direct inference on sequences containing thousands of frames. Long videos must therefore be processed as overlapping chunks. This division produces independent local reconstructions with inconsistent coordinate frames and duplicate estimates of shared cameras. Achieving global consistency requires propagating constraints from adjacent overlaps and distant revisits across the sequence. This requirement naturally motivates pose graph optimization. However, the choice of graph level creates a trade-off. Chunk-level graphs efficiently resolve scale drift and close large loops. Yet, their rigid transformations cannot correct internal errors or conflicting frame predictions. Conversely, frame-level optimization offers local flexibility, but scaling it globally is computationally expensive and can break metric scale. HiP3R resolves this trade-off using a hierarchical pose graph. HiP3R first optimizes a robust chunk-level $\mathrm{Sim}(3)$ graph to establish the global layout and scale. It then holds this layout fixed and estimates one shared $\mathrm{SE}(3)$ camera per frame, turning overlapping window predictions into a single trajectory. Experiments across multiple benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of HiP3R in improving camera trajectories and 3D reconstruction. Our method applies to both chunk-based and streaming backends without additional training or fine-tuning. The codes are available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: HiP3R 用分层位姿图解决长视频前馈 3D 重建的"块级刚性 vs 帧级灵活"取舍：先优化块级 Sim(3) 图定全局布局与尺度，再固定布局逐帧估计共享 SE(3) 相机，合并重叠窗口预测为单一轨迹。
AI.motivation: 前馈模型（如 VGGT 类）在短窗口上精度高但显存/算力受限，长视频只能切块推理，导致各块坐标系不一致、重叠帧重复估计、尺度漂移与回环误差无法全局统一。块级位姿图能纠尺度漂移与闭环大回环却无法修正块内误差；帧级优化灵活但全局计算昂贵且易破坏度量尺度。
AI.method: 分层位姿图优化：(1) 先构建鲁棒的块级 Sim(3) 图，解全局布局与尺度；(2) 固定该布局，对每帧估计一个共享 SE(3) 相机位姿（即把重叠窗口内的重复预测融合为单一轨迹），从而在保持全局一致性的同时获得帧级自由度。无需额外训练或微调，可即插即用于 chunk 式与 streaming 式后端。
AI.result: 在多个基准上相较基线改善了相机轨迹精度与 3D 重建质量；方法对块式与流式两种推理后端均适用，且零额外训练。
AI.conclusion: 分层位姿图是低成本、无需训练的长序列前馈重建全局一致性方案，可与现有前馈几何模型组合，具备实际部署与开源价值。

title: WorldForge V2: Eliciting Camera-Trajectory Alignment in Video Diffusion Models
summary: Video diffusion models have learned rich 3D/4D priors, making them promising for scene generation and video re-rendering. However, their use in spatial tasks is limited by imprecise camera control, spatial and temporal inconsistencies, and entangled camera motion with scene dynamics. Existing approaches, such as task-specific fine-tuning and post-process warping, often introduce visual artifacts, generalize poorly, or incur high computational costs. We propose WorldForge V2 to achieve accurate camera control while preserving the generative capabilities of pretrained video models. We first develop a training-free guidance framework using warped references to iteratively refine generation along a target camera path. Optical-flow analysis identifies motion-related latent channels for selective guidance, helping separate motion control from appearance. A dual-path strategy further compares guided and unguided predictions to correct artifacts from imperfect references. Together, these components guide viewpoint changes while preserving scene appearance and object motion. To reduce refinement costs, v-cache approximates the correction using the preceding denoising prediction, avoiding an additional model evaluation. We further extend motion localization from latent channels to network blocks and introduce Trajectory LoRA, which concentrates adaptation on blocks most responsive to trajectory guidance. A two-stage training strategy teaches these adapters to denoise the states encountered during guided generation, using limited supervision effectively. This enables reliable camera control with very little training data, with a single training scene already supporting generalization to unseen scenes. Quantitative and qualitative evaluations across multiple datasets show that our method achieves state-of-the-art generation quality and trajectory accuracy in camera-controlled video generation.

AI.tldr: WorldForge V2 提出训练免费的引导框架（warped reference 迭代细化 + 光流定位运动相关 latent 通道 + 双路径纠错 + v-cache 加速）与 Trajectory LoRA（按网络块定位、两阶段训练），实现精确相机控制的视频重渲染，单场景训练即可泛化到未见场景。
AI.motivation: 视频扩散模型蕴含丰富的 3D/4D 先验，但用于空间任务时存在相机控制不精确、时空不一致、相机运动与场景动态纠缠等问题；微调或后处理 warping 又会引入伪影、泛化差或算力开销大。
AI.method: 1) 训练免费引导：用 warped 参考迭代精化目标相机轨迹下的生成；2) 光流分析筛选与运动相关的 latent 通道做选择性引导，解耦运动控制与外观；3) 双路径策略比较引导/未引导预测以校正不完美参考带来的伪影；4) v-cache 复用上一步去噪预测近似校正，省去额外模型评估；5) 将运动定位从 latent 通道扩展到网络 block，提出 Trajectory LoRA 聚焦高响应块；6) 两阶段训练使适配器适配引导生成过程中的状态，极少数据下可靠控制。
AI.result: 多数据集定量与定性评估显示，在生成质量与轨迹精度上均达相机控制视频生成的 SOTA；单训练场景即可泛化到未见场景。
AI.conclusion: 通过选择性引导 + 局部 LoRA 适配，可在保留预训练视频模型生成能力的前提下获得精确相机控制与低训练成本，为空间任务中的视频重渲染/场景生成提供实用方案。

title: UniVOE: A Removal-Driven Framework for Interaction-Aware Universal Video Object Editing
summary: Video object removal and injection are reciprocal editing operations between object-present and object-absent video states, yet they differ substantially in training difficulty. Removal can be effectively bootstrapped from video inpainting and further adapted to erase object-related interaction effects. Injection, however, requires large-scale paired supervision to model object appearance, dynamics, and scene-dependent effects, while perfectly aligned real-world pairs are difficult to collect and synthetic data lacks sufficient realism and diversity. To address this challenge, we present UniVOE, a removal-driven framework for training both video object removal and injection models. We first train an effect-aware remover by transferring video inpainting priors and finetuning on object-present/object-absent pairs. The trained remover converts real object-present videos into object-absent counterparts, creating large-scale paired supervision for injection. An injection model is trained on these pairs in the reverse direction to recover objects together with their dynamics and interaction effects. Moreover, since pixel-level reconstruction alone cannot adequately capture perceptual realism, we introduce a reward-based post-training method that aligns injection results with human preferences using a proprietary reward model. Experiments against strong open-source and commercial systems demonstrate that UniVOE achieves state-of-the-art performance on both object removal and injection, particularly in challenging interaction-effect cases.

AI.tldr: UniVOE 用"先训除物、再用除物生成配对数据训注入"的互逆思路，统一训练视频物体移除与注入，并加入奖励后训练对齐人类偏好。
AI.motivation: 移除与注入是互逆任务但训练难度不对称：移除可从视频修复预训练迁移，注入却依赖大规模精确配对监督（物体外观、动态、场景交互效应），真实配对难采集、合成数据真实性不足。
AI.method: 1) 迁移视频修复先验并微调，得到带交互效应感知的 remover；2) 用该 remover 将真实含物体视频转成无物体视频，构造大规模配对监督；3) 以反向方向在这些配对上训练 injection 模型，恢复物体及其动态与交互效应；4) 引入基于专有奖励模型的 RL 式后训练，使结果对齐人类感知偏好。
AI.result: 与强开源及商用系统对比，在移除与注入两项任务上均达 SOTA，交互效应等困难场景提升尤为明显。
AI.conclusion: 提出一种自举式互逆训练范式，把难以获取的注入配对监督转化为可由移除模型自动生成的数据，证明奖励后训练可弥补像素重建与感知真实性的差距；局限在于依赖专有奖励模型、无下游 3D/机器人应用验证。

title: GigaBench: Benchmarking Learnable Representations for Gigapixel Image Compression and Super-Resolution
comment: Project page at this https URL Accepted at WACV2027
summary: Learnable Representations (LRs) can fit parametric families of functions to diverse kinds of signals. These emergent neural-native data formats are gathering interest in the scientific community due to their compactness, resolution-agnosticism and amenability to direct neural processing. On the other hand, gigapixel images are becoming increasingly widespread across a variety of scientific, cultural, and industrial domains. In this paper, we present GigaBench, the first benchmark and experimental evaluation focused on deploying LRs with gigapixel imagery. GigaBench includes images collected, acquired, and synthetically rendered across diverse domains, and addresses image compression and super-resolution. We adapt a representative set of LRs, spanning Implicit, Hybrid, and Explicit methods, so as to operate reliably at the gigapixel scale on consumer hardware. Through systematic evaluation across reconstruction quality, model size, compression and inference times, we identify consistent trends across methods and suggest actionable guidance for future investigation.

AI.tldr: GigaBench 是首个面向十亿像素（gigapixel）图像的可学习表示（LR）基准，覆盖隐式、混合、显式三类方法，评测压缩与超分任务。
AI.motivation: 可学习表示具备紧凑、分辨率无关、可直接神经处理等优势，而十亿像素图像在科学、文化与工业领域日益普及，但现有 LR 方法缺乏在该尺度上系统评测的依据。
AI.method: 构建跨领域采集与合成渲染的十亿像素图像数据集；改造一组代表性 LR 方法（隐式/混合/显式），使其能在消费级硬件上稳定运行于十亿像素规模；系统性评测重建质量、模型大小、压缩率与推理时间。
AI.result: 给出跨方法的一致趋势，并提炼面向后续研究的可操作建议（摘要未报告具体数值）。
AI.conclusion: 为十亿像素级可学习表示提供统一的基准与工程化改造经验，指导压缩与超分方向的后续研究。

title: OmniRay: Camera-Agnostic Monocular 3D Reconstruction with Composite Ray Fields
summary: Monocular models recover 3D geometry from a single image in one pass, but most assume a pinhole camera and produce distorted geometry on the wide-angle imagery produced by fisheye and panoramic lenses. Camera-aware models remove this assumption by predicting a per-pixel ray field. However, they represent different camera geometries using a single fixed basis to capture both the overall camera projection and its finer variations. We argue that camera geometry can be viewed as having a hierarchy of complexity for representing rays. We present OmniRay, a feed-forward model whose Ray Module is composed of three components: a monotone radial base that captures radially symmetric structure, a spherical-harmonic residual for smooth deviations from it, and a free-form residual for remaining local variation. These components are composed as successive rotations on the sphere, allowing the representation to accommodate diverse camera geometries. Given a single image, OmniRay predicts a ray direction and an up-to-scale radial distance for every pixel, from which a 3D point cloud is recovered without needing camera information at inference time. Extensive experiments across different camera configurations demonstrate that OmniRay establishes a new state-of-the-art in camera-agnostic monocular 3D reconstruction.

AI.tldr: OmniRay：以分层射线表示（单调径向基+球谐残差+自由残差，按球面连续旋转复合）实现相机无关的单目广角/鱼眼/全景 3D 重建，单次前向预测每像素射线方向与尺度未知的径向距离。
AI.motivation: 现有单目 3D 重建模型多假设针孔相机，在鱼眼/全景等广角图像上几何失真；相机感知模型虽用逐像素射线场摆脱该假设，却用单一固定基同时拟合整体投影与细节变化，表达能力受限。作者提出相机几何在对射线的表示上存在"复杂度层级"。
AI.method: 提出前馈模型 OmniRay，其 Ray Module 由三部分串联组成：(1) 单调径向基，捕捉径向对称结构；(2) 球谐残差，建模相对径向基的平滑偏离；(3) 自由形式残差，拟合剩余局部变化。三者在球面上以连续旋转的方式复合，从而覆盖多样相机几何。输入单张图像，输出每像素射线方向与 up-to-scale 径向距离，直接恢复 3D 点云，推理时无需任何相机参数。
AI.result: 在多种相机配置上实验表明，OmniRay 在相机无关（camera-agnostic）单目 3D 重建任务上取得新的 SOTA，点云在各配置下均优于使用单一固定基的基线。
AI.conclusion: 将相机几何表示为分层射线基（径向 + 球谐 + 自由残差）是有效且可扩展的先验形式，使单模型无需相机信息即可统一处理针孔/鱼眼/全景，为广角场景下的前馈重建提供可行路线。

title: Gate3DGen: A Pre-processing Model that Selectively Purifies Real-World Images for 3D Generation
summary: Single-image 3D generation has achieved high fidelity on curated benchmarks, yet degrades sharply on real-world images with uneven illumination, blur, and occlusions. Purifying such inputs requires deciding when to intervene and preserving the visual cues needed for 3D generation, while leaving clean inputs unchanged. We introduce Gate3DGen, a selective pre-processing model that gates image inputs to existing 3D generators without retraining them. A degradation-aware router bypasses inputs classified as clean and extracts features to guide purification of the remaining inputs. Conditioned on these features, a 3D-oriented one-step purifier purifies degraded inputs with spatial losses that encourage preservation of object identity, contours, and textural cues. To provide paired supervision, we construct a synthetic data engine that renders clean views of 3D assets and synthesises composite degradations. On the synthetic benchmark, the purifier improves image fidelity and downstream 3D geometry in only 2.3s on average, reducing TRELLIS.2 mesh distance by 61.5% relative to degraded inputs. VLM evaluation and human preferences on real photographs further support identity preservation and degradation correction. More demos and code are available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 提出Gate3DGen：一个可插拔的预处理门控模型，用退化感知路由器判断输入是否需净化，并对退化图像做one-step净化后再送入现有3D生成器（无需重训练），平均2.3s可将TRELLIS.2网格距离相对退化输入降低61.5%。
AI.motivation: 单图3D生成在精心构建的基准上保真度高，但在光照不均、模糊、遮挡等真实场景图像上性能急剧下降；直接预处理所有输入可能损害干净图像并丢失3D生成所需的视觉线索，因此需要"何时干预"的选择性机制。
AI.method: 1) 退化感知路由器对输入分类，干净样本直接旁路，其余样本提取退化特征；2) 以这些特征为条件，用面向3D的one-step净化器处理退化输入，并施加空间损失以保持物体身份、轮廓与纹理线索；3) 构建合成数据引擎——渲染3D资产的干净视角并合成复合退化，提供成对监督；整体作为前置模块接入已有3D生成器，不重训练生成器。
AI.result: 合成基准上同时提升图像保真度与下游3D几何质量，平均仅2.3s；相对退化输入，TRELLIS.2网格距离降低61.5%；真实照片上的VLM评测与人类偏好进一步支持身份保持与退化校正效果。
AI.conclusion: 将"选择性输入净化"与"3D生成"解耦是有效且低成本的路线：门控+one-step净化+合成配对数据即可显著改善真实退化图像上的前馈3D重建，且保持对现有生成器的即插即用兼容性。

title: BrickWright: Agentic Creation of Physically Feasible Brick Builds
summary: Frontier coding agents are becoming increasingly adept at 3D modeling. Yet, they still face challenges when building objects meant to be assembled in the physical world, often creating invalid assemblies with floating, colliding, or disconnected parts. We argue that providing agents with tools for assembling builds and verifying their physical feasibility is sufficient for them to produce physically valid assemblies that still adhere to input prompts. Focusing on the domain of LEGO brick builds, we present BrickWright, a framework for generating physically feasible brick builds from text or image prompts using pre-trained agents, where a build is physically feasible if it uses only real parts, has no colliding or floating parts, and forms a connected structure if possible. BrickWright guides agents to create builds by writing code with BrickLayer, a Python toolkit with two main components: an ergonomic brick assembly API that halves inference cost compared to working in raw LDraw, and a validator that provides feedback on physical feasibility. Whereas baseline agents achieve physical validity rates ranging from only 9% (GPT-6 Luna) to 69% (GPT-6 Astra), BrickWright-guided agents achieve 100% validity on a sample of 512 prompts, while improving prompt adherence for lightweight agents and maintaining it for stronger agents. Additionally, they outperform specialized models on the text-to-brick task. Code is available on our project page: this https URL

AI.tldr: BrickWright 让预训练编码智能体借助 BrickLayer（Python 乐高装配 API + 物理可行性验证器）从文本/图像生成可真实拼装的乐高结构，512 个提示上物理合法率达 100%。
AI.motivation: 前沿编码智能体在 3D 建模上已很强，但面向真实世界拼装的物体常产生悬空、穿插、断连的无效装配；作者假设只要提供装配工具与物理可行性校验，智能体就足以生成既物理合法又贴合提示的模型。
AI.method: 以乐高砖块为域，提出 BrickWright 框架：智能体通过编写代码调用 BrickLayer——含高易用性的砖块装配 API（相较裸 LDraw 将推理成本减半）与一个给出物理可行性反馈的验证器；定义物理可行性为仅用真实零件、无碰撞、无悬空、尽可能连通。基线对比为未经框架引导的同类智能体。
AI.result: 基线智能体物理合法率仅 9%（GPT-6 Luna）至 69%（GPT-6 Astra），而 BrickWright 引导下 512 个提示全部达到 100% 合法；轻量智能体的提示遵循度提升，强智能体保持不变；在 text-to-brick 任务上超过专用模型。
AI.conclusion: 代码化装配接口+可行性验证反馈是让智能体产出物理可执行装配的有效且充分路径；该范式可推广到其他需物理可行性的设计/生成域。

title: SpectralCanary: Embarrassingly Simple Low-Frequency Traces for T2I Dataset-Use Auditing
comment: NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Attributing Model Behavior at Scale
summary: Auditing whether a text-to-image (T2I) model was fine-tuned on a particular image collection is difficult: a model can absorb collection-level visual characteristics without reproducing training images. Proactive dataset-use auditing plants a shared signal in a dataset before release, then later checks whether that signal appears in a suspect model's generated outputs. Existing approaches often trade off verifiability, fidelity, robustness, and deployability. We introduce $\textbf{SpectralCanary}$, which uses a smooth low-pass mask to blend a fixed canary image into every collection image while leaving captions unchanged and requiring neither auxiliary generation nor per-image optimization. A lightweight verifier detects the transferred signal in suspect-model outputs. Across eight tests on the Pokemon dataset and three realistic data transformations, spanning two architectures families, SpectralCanary achieves the highest average per-generation TPR@$1\%$ FPR ($91.1\%$) and fixed threshold model-level accuracy using 30 generations ($94.8\%$) among the evaluated methods. Across five datasets spanning artistic, medical, satellite, and fashion domains with SD3.5, SpectralCanary averages $92.4\%$ per-generation TPR@$1\%$ FPR while preserving the released images (SSIM $0.989$, LPIPS $0.022$) with a near-zero mean change FID (mean $\Delta$FID $0.05$) across datasets. Matched-energy ablations on Pokemon and ROCOv2 support our design choice, low-frequency placement transfers more reliably compared to mid/high-frequency placement. Under the evaluated adaptive attacks, the most effective removal requires aggressive modification and incurs more than $25$ $\Delta$FID points. These results identify low-frequency visual signals as effective carriers for collection-level T2I audit traces.

AI.tldr: SpectralCanary 提出用低频平滑掩码将固定金丝雀图像混入数据集全部图片，并通过轻量验证器检测下游 T2I 模型输出中的迁移信号，实现可验证、低失真、较鲁棒的数据集使用审计。
AI.motivation: 现有主动式数据集使用审计方法在可验证性、保真度、鲁棒性与可部署性之间难以兼顾：既需在发布前嵌入共享信号，又需在事后从生成输出中检出该信号，且不能破坏图像质量或依赖逐图优化/辅助生成。
AI.method: 固定金丝雀图像经平滑低通掩码与每张数据集图像混合，标题不变；无需辅助生成与逐图优化。轻量验证器在可疑模型生成输出上检测迁移的信号统计量，给出单图级 TPR@1%FPR 与固定阈值模型级判定。附带等能量消融，比较低/中/高频放置的可迁移性。
AI.result: Pokemon 数据集八项测试与三种真实数据变换、两类架构家族上，平均单图 TPR@1%FPR 达 91.1%，30 次生成的固定阈值模型级准确率 94.8%，为对比方法最优。SD3.5 下跨艺术、医学、卫星、时尚五个数据集平均 92.4% TPR@1%FPR，SSIM 0.989、LPIPS 0.022，平均 ΔFID 仅 0.05。等能量消融显示低频放置迁移更可靠。自适应攻击下最有效的移除需强改动且造成 >25 ΔFID 的代价。
AI.conclusion: 低频视觉信号是集合级 T2I 审计痕迹的有效载体，可在保持发布图像质量的同时获得高可验证性与移除成本。

title: OpenTac: An Open Ecosystem for Customizable, Scalable, and Transferable 3D Tactile Sensing
comment: 14 pages, 14 figures. Project website, open-source hardware and software, and demonstration videos: this https URL
summary: We present OpenTac, a novel sensor and a full-stack ecosystem for tactile skins that are highly customizable, scalable, and readily deployed in downstream robot control and learning applications. Our core contribution is twofold. First, we develop a scalable resistive tactile skin with a structured deformable overlay that converts tangential loading into spatially varying pressure. Differential responses across neighboring "taxels" support decoding of local shear vectors, and the common-mode response encodes normal force. Second, we provide a highly customizable sensor design tool that is able to automatically generate fabrication files for these tactile skins from 2D outlines and developable 3D surfaces, including from abstract descriptions such as text (e.g., "design a sensor for a size 9 shoe insole"). We develop an ecosystem around the OpenTac sensor, including the CAD design tool, a sensor simulator, cross-sensor transfer, and fast/adaptive data acquisition. We demonstrate the broad applicability of the OpenTac-CAD sensor design tool by designing and fabricating more than 30 sensors across a variety of robot embodiments. We characterize the three-dimensional tactile fields produced by OpenTac with a commercial, high-precision force/torque sensor. We demonstrate the broad applicability of 3D tactile sensing across contact-rich feedback control and manipulation policy learning on four real-world robot embodiments. Additionally, adaptive acquisition enables kilohertz-rate partial readouts, exceeding full-array raster scanning on the same sensor by 19.2X at 16 sampled taxels per update for a 1024-taxel skin. We provide all hardware, software, and result videos are at this http URL

AI.tldr: OpenTac 提出可定制、可扩展的电阻式触觉皮肤及全栈生态（CAD 设计工具、仿真器、跨传感器迁移、自适应采集），通过结构化形变覆盖层将切向载荷转为空间变化压力，用相邻 taxel 差分响应解码剪切、共模响应编码法向力，并在多种真实机器人上验证三维触觉反馈控制与策略学习。
AI.motivation: 现有触觉皮肤多为定制硬件、难以规模化制造与部署，缺乏设计工具、仿真与数据采集配套，导致难以在真实机器人控制与学习任务中快速落地三维触觉感知。
AI.method: 1) 硬件：电阻式触觉皮肤 + 结构化可形变覆盖层，切向载荷转换为空间变化的压力模式；相邻 taxel 差分响应解码局部剪切矢量，共模响应编码法向力；2) 软件：OpenTac-CAD，从 2D 轮廓、可展 3D 曲面乃至文本描述（如"9 码鞋垫传感器"）自动生成制造文件；3) 生态：传感器仿真器、跨传感器迁移、快速/自适应数据采集（千赫兹级部分读出）。
AI.result: 设计并制造 30 余种覆盖多种机器人本体的传感器；用商用高精度力/力矩传感器标定三维触觉场；在 4 个真实机器人本体上验证接触丰富反馈控制与操作策略学习；1024-taxel 皮肤上每次更新采样 16 个 taxel 时，自适应采集比全阵列栅格扫描快 19.2 倍。
AI.conclusion: OpenTac 提供了从设计、制造到仿真、数据采集与策略学习的完整触觉皮肤闭环，具备良好的可定制性与规模化潜力，硬件、软件与结果视频全部开源，可作为触觉操作与触觉反馈控制研究的通用基础设施。

title: Reading, Writing, Sharing, and Interacting with the World through Video
comment: 102 pages, 17 figures, 19 tables. Project page: this https URL
summary: Video foundation models have advanced rapidly in understanding and generating visual sequences, while video world models seek to capture the underlying dynamics of the world they depict. Despite their different objectives, both concern the relationship between video observations and an evolving world. This survey adopts world modeling as a unifying lens for examining these developments. Viewing an observed video as a partial, lossy, and temporally ordered projection of a latent temporal world, we organize the literature around four complementary operations: reading infers world properties from observed video; writing synthesizes video from specified or learned world conditions; sharing integrates understanding and generation through common modeling mechanisms; and interacting predicts and updates world states under actions and evolving observations. This perspective distinguishes temporal coherence in observed or generated sequences from consistency in the underlying world state. Across tasks, representations, models, datasets, and benchmarks, we trace a shift in emphasis from clip-level recognition and perceptual fidelity toward persistent state, controllable evolution, physical and causal validity, and evaluation grounded in interaction and downstream decisions, and we distill the open challenges that follow.

AI.tldr: 以"世界建模"为统一视角综述视频基础模型与世界模型，将视频视为潜在时序世界的部分、有损、有序投影，围绕读/写/共享/交互四种操作组织文献。
AI.motivation: 视频理解/生成模型与视频世界模型目标不同但都关注"视频观测与演化世界的关系"，缺乏统一框架来比较其进展与评价标准。
AI.method: 提出四操作分类法：reading（从观测视频推断世界属性）、writing（由指定或学习到的世界条件合成视频）、sharing（理解与生成共享建模机制）、interacting（在动作与演化观测下预测并更新世界状态）；并区分"序列时序连贯性"与"潜在世界状态一致性"，跨任务、表示、模型、数据集与基准进行梳理。
AI.result: 刻画研究重心从片段级识别与感知保真度，转向持久状态、可控演化、物理与因果有效性、以及基于交互与下游决策的评测，并提炼开放挑战。
AI.conclusion: 世界建模可作为统摄视频理解与生成的通用透镜；未来关键方向是持久状态表示、可控与物理合理演化及交互式评测范式。

title: Sensorimotor Alignment: A Platonic Proxy for Embodied Policy Success
comment: 28 pages. Project page and code available at this https URL
summary: Robotic foundation models are typically evaluated through costly closed-loop rollouts, which motivates cheap offline proxies for model capability. The Platonic Representation Hypothesis (PRH) suggests that as representations improve, different modalities such as vision and language converge toward a shared statistical model of reality. We ask whether motion trajectories form another such modality: as embodied models become more capable, should their sensory representations converge toward the structure of physical motion? To examine this, we propose Sensorimotor Alignment ($S^2$), a training-free offline metric that measures how well a model's sensory representation aligns with the geometry of physical motion. We find that $S^2$ correlates positively with downstream robot task success across embodied model families, making it a low-cost offline proxy for prioritizing models before closed-loop evaluation. $S^2$ can also identify promising vision-language model (VLM) backbones even before costly fine-tuning into vision-language-action models (VLAs). Beyond this correlation, $S^2$ offers representation-level explanations for phenomena observed in VLAs and world action models (WAMs). With $S^2$, we extend PRH to embodied models and make sensorimotor alignment empirically measurable, offering insight into why an embodied model succeeds beyond its closed-loop success rate.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练离线指标 S²（Sensorimotor Alignment），衡量模型感官表征与物理运动几何结构的对齐程度，作为机器人基础模型的低成本离线能力代理。
AI.motivation: 机器人基础模型通常依赖昂贵的闭环 rollout 评估，需要廉价的离线代理指标；受柏拉图表征假说（PRH）启发，作者追问运动轨迹是否构成另一"模态"，即具身模型能力提升时其感官表征是否向物理运动结构收敛。
AI.method: 定义训练-free 度量 S²：将模型感官表征与物理运动轨迹的几何结构进行对齐度量化（跨具身模型家族评估），无需闭环仿真或真实机器人部署；并可用于在昂贵 VLA 微调前筛选 VLM 骨干。
AI.result: S² 与多个具身模型家族的下游机器人任务成功率呈正相关，能低成本预筛模型及 VLM 骨干；同时给出 VLA 与 WAM 中若干现象的表示层解释。
AI.conclusion: S² 将 PRH 扩展到具身模型，使"感觉运动对齐"变得可经验测量，为模型成功/失败提供超越闭环成功率的表征层解释。

title: A Unified Framework for Image-to-3D Part Generation via Variable Granularity
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. Code: this https URL
summary: Controllable 3D part generation is pivotal for digital asset creation, yet existing methods lack the flexibility to accommodate diverse user workflows requiring varying levels of control. In this paper, we introduce FlexPart, a unified image-to-3D part generation framework that supports variable-granularity geometric conditions within a single model. By seamlessly integrating heterogeneous inputs, ranging from sparse points to dense bounding boxes and masks, via gated adaptive modulation, FlexPart unlocks a powerful cross-modal synergy. We also propose an asymmetric geometric guidance mechanism that leverages strong spatial priors to align representations across granularities, improving geometric consistency and facilitating inter-task synergy. Under mask conditioning on PartVerseXL, FlexPart reduces Part CD by 16.6% relative to TripoSG + SAM3D and by 10.5% relative to OmniPart, while maintaining competitive whole-mesh quality. The code can be found at this https URL

AI.tldr: FlexPart是一个统一的图像到3D部件生成框架，单模型内支持稀疏点、稠密包围盒、掩码等多粒度几何条件，通过门控自适应调制融合异构输入，并提出非对称几何引导机制对齐不同粒度的表征。
AI.motivation: 3D部件生成对数字资产生成很关键，但现有方法控制粒度固定，无法适配需要不同控制程度的多样化工作流。
AI.method: 统一条件扩散/生成框架：以门控自适应调制（gated adaptive modulation）融合稀疏点、包围盒、掩码等异构控制信号；提出非对称几何引导机制，用强空间先验对齐跨粒度表征，提升几何一致性与任务间协同。
AI.result: 在PartVerseXL掩码条件下，部件CD较TripoSG+SAM3D降低16.6%，较OmniPart降低10.5%，整体网格质量保持有竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 单一模型可灵活支持变粒度部件级控制，验证了跨模态条件融合与几何引导对3D部件生成的有效性。
